About Premo
Premo is owned by Dagens Nyheter (Bonnier News) and Svenska Dagbladet (Schibsted). Our business concept is: We ensure the spread of free speech and meet the demands of the resident's need for daily deliveries through co-distribution of newspapers and packages throughout Stockholm. Our vision is: We make life easier through superior deliveries. Every morning we share about 200,000 newspapers, magazines, packages and other products. Premo reaches about one million households and 2 million inhabitants in the Stockholm region every day of the week. Premo has about 1,100 employees, and most of our employees are distributors. We are proud that Premo is a multicultural company with about 50 different nationalities - we notice daily how people with different backgrounds make our company even better. Inclusion and equal treatment are obvious to us!
 
About the work
You will work with the distribution of newspapers, magazines and packages within the Stockholm region.
 
To help you distribute you use a walking trolley, an electric bicycle, a moped car or a company car.
 
We are proud that Premo is a multicultural company with about 50 different nationalities - we notice daily how people with different backgrounds make our company even better. Inclusion and equal treatment are obvious to us!
We can offer you:
An independent and physically active work at night and early in the morning
Work of around 40-60% and usually 4-5 hours per night
Secure terms of employment – we have collective agreement
A future opportunity to grow within the company since we care about talented employees!

We’re looking for you who:
Is responsible in your work performance
Is thorough, efficient and service-oriented
Enjoys a physically active work
Enjoys working independently at night
Has turned 18 years old
Speaks English or Swedish

Advantageous:
Previous experience of new paper deliveries
Previous experience of night shifts
B driving license

Does this sound like something for you?
 
 
Do not hesitate to send us your application today and make sure to also upload the requested documents (e.g., passport and driver’s license) so that your application can be included in the selection process. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Lärare i engelska sökes till Internationella Engelska Skolan i Täby 

 Är du en passionerad, behörig  och engagerad engelskalärare? Vill du vara en del av ett dynamiskt team på en skola som värdesätter studiero, säkerhet och respekt? Internationella Engelska Skolan i Täby öppnar nu upp för en unik möjlighet för dig som är intresserad av att forma framtidens medborgare.

 Om oss:

 Internationella Engelska Skolan Täby är en tvåspråkig grundskola för årskurserna 4–9 med 1150 elever och 110 medarbetare. Hos oss står lärande och kunskap i centrum. Vi erbjuder en lugn, strukturerad och trygg lärmiljö där tydligt ledarskap, höga förväntningar och ömsesidig respekt råder mellan elever och personal. Vi är stolta över vår dynamiska, internationella gemenskap och söker dig som vill bidra till vår framgångsrika skolkultur. 

 Din nya roll:

Vi söker en behörig och inspirerande engelskalärare för årskurs 7 till 9, I den här rollen kommer du att vara en avgörande del av vårt pedagogiska team, med ansvar för att leverera högkvalitativ undervisning på svenska.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders provanställning, heltid (100%) med tillträde snarast möjligt.

 Vem är du?

Du är en entusiastisk och engagerad pedagog med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

 Du innehar lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i engelska för årskurs 7 till 9. 

Du är en utmärkt lagspelare som värdesätter samarbete och öppen kommunikation. 

Du har en förmåga att organisera och genomföra undervisning som engagerar och inspirerar eleverna, samtidigt som du fungerar som en förebild.

Vi erbjuder:

Möjligheten att arbeta i en internationell och stimulerande miljö. 

En plats i ett engagerat och stöttande team. 

En chans att bidra till en skolkultur som präglas av respekt, säkerhet och studiero.

Ansökan:

Är du intresserad av att ta dig an utmaningen som svenskalärare på Internationella Engelska Skolan i Täby? Skicka in ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev där du berättar varför du är rätt person för denna tjänst. Ansök direkt via IES karriärsida.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomnar din ansökan snarast, då intervjuer sker löpande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Would you like to inspire young people in their learning and development in a unique and international school environment? This is a role where you will have an opportunity to influence your students’ language development and contribute to their future.

At Sigtunaskolan Humanistiska Läroverket you will become part of a unique school environment, where young people from all over the world study and develop together. Here, the work is not only about teaching, but also building rapport, creating commitment and sparking curiosity for language and culture. As a teacher, you are close to the students in their everyday life where you contribute to their academic development as well as their personal growth.

SSHL is a boarding school, with roots from the 1920s, which today has about 550 students from over 30 different countries. We offer Swedish and international education, including the Swedish high school and the IB programmes. Our ambition is to continuously work with our students’ best interests in mind.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
About the Role

We are now looking for a certified teacher of English for a substitute position during the spring term of 2027. The parental leave substitute position covers 70% teaching in our IB Programmes. The requirements for this position involve teaching in English and you will be working closely with students, colleagues and the school management in a dynamic and international environment.  

In your role as a teacher you will be responsible for the planning, implementation and follow-up of your teaching. You will also actively work to develop your teaching in collaboration with colleagues and contribute to a stimulating learning environment.

KVALIFIKATIONER
We are looking for someone who:

	• is a certified teacher in English with experience of International Baccalaureate programmes
	• can easily build a trusting rapport with young people and colleagues
	• is organised and flexible with good planning skills
	• has a solution-oriented approach and good judgment
	• is genuinely interested in teaching and student development
	• enjoys working in an international and dynamic environment

Qualifications:

	• teaching certificate for English or equivalent qualifications
	• experience in teaching in the IB Diploma and Middle years Programme
	• very good communication skills in English and Swedish are desirable
	• experience of an international environment is advantageous

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

We are offering

A meaningful role in an international environment, where you will have an opportunity to influence students learning and development, while becoming a member of a committed and supportive team of colleagues

Your personal suitability for this position will be of great importance and before employment an approved extract from the criminal record is required. During the application period interviews will continuously take place.

The application deadline is November 30th 2026 and the start date will be January 7th 2027.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact:

Kerry Browning, Principal, +46 8-592 571 00, kerry.browning@sshl.se or 

Alexandra Koumi, Vice principal, alexandra.koumi@sshl.se 

Please visit our website: sshl.se

Prior to the recruitment process, we have taken recruitment channels and marketing into consideration. We therefore wish to decline any contacts with media sales representatives, recruitment sites or similar agents.

Lärare i spanska/engelska (åk 4–9) med starkt klassrumsledarskap till IES Halmstad.

Vill du arbeta i en skolmiljö där tydligt ledarskap, studiero och höga förväntningar lägger grunden för varje elevs kunskapsutveckling? Nu söker vi en trygg och strukturerad lärare i spanska och engelska på heltid till IES Halmstad.

På Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) är läraren en självklar och tydlig ledare i klassrummet. Vårt ethos vilar på övertygelsen att alla elever kan nå sin fulla potential när de möts av en trygg miljö och god arbetsro. 

Om rollen och vårt arbetssätt IES Halmstad är en internationell skola med cirka 500 elever från åk. 4-9 och medarbetare från hela världen. Vi förenar den svenska läroplanen med en internationell atmosfär och ett väl inarbetat, gemensamt arbetssätt som präglar all undervisning på skolan – från tydliga rutiner vid lektionsstart till enhetliga förhållningssätt i hela verksamheten.

Som lärare i spanska och engelska ansvarar du för att planera, leda och genomföra undervisning av hög kvalitet i nära samplanering med dina kollegor, där ni tillsammans utvecklar både undervisningen och era gemensamma strukturer. 

Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som trivs i ledarrollen, värdesätter tydliga ramar och uppskattar att arbeta utifrån ett etablerat och gemensamt arbetssätt. Du har en god förmåga att skapa lugn, trygghet och goda relationer i klassrummet samtidigt som du utmanar eleverna och driver deras kunskapsutveckling framåt inför gymnasiet.

Kvalifikationer och egenskaper vi prioriterar:

- Legitimerad lärare med behörighet i spanska och engelska.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av undervisning i mellan och/eller högstadiet samt ett tryggt och tydligt klassrumsledarskap.
- Skicklig på att skapa tydlig struktur, förutsägbarhet och arbetsro i klassrummet.
- Uppskattar att arbeta utifrån ett inarbetat arbetssätt och bidrar aktivt i samplaneringen med ditt ämneslag.
- Professionell, ansvarstagande och med en positiv inställning till varje elevs potential.
- Flytande i engelska och svenska i tal och skrift.

Kontakt och ansökan Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Karoline Engberg, rektor IES Halmstad.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med start 8 Januari, 6 månaders provanställning tillämpas.

Rekryteringen sker fortlöpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag – skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

jobs.occupation: English and Spanish speaking Account Manager to Linköping
jobs.description:
About this position
TaxiCaller is looking to expand our sales them with an Account Mangager who will primarily work with our leads and customers in North America.
TaxiCaller has a strong inbound strategy, and you will mostly work with assigned qualified leads, but you will also work with outbound sales, e.g. cold calling.
A lead is a taxi company (or other kinds of transportation companies) who is looking to upgrade their dispatch system.
You will work with the full sales cycle from first demo to a closed deal. After the deal is closed you as an account manager will work together with our excellent support team to make sure we keep our great customer retention. 
The sales will mainly be done via web meetings and phone, so travelling will not be required for this position.
It is a very developing job in an international environment where you will interact with a lot of people every day.

About you 
We are looking for a person who has excellent skills in closing sales.
* You should have a proven track record with a couple of years’ experience in B2B sales. 
* Good track record in cold calling and outbound sales.
* You need to be fluent in English and Spanish with no accent.
* You need to have a good drive and be able to work independently.
* You have good analytical skills and you are pedagogical.
You don't have to be able to speak Swedish, since TaxiCaller is a true international company with colleagues and customers from all over the world.

We see it as positive if:
* You also speak a third language, e.g. French.
* You have previous experience in working with international SaaS sales.

About TaxiCaller 
TaxiCaller was founded in 2011 and has developed a cloud-based taxi dispatch system with support for iPhone and Android apps which quickly reached international success and is currently used by taxi companies throughout the world. TaxiCaller's dispatch system is groundbreaking because we use the latest technology in both web solutions and smartphones. We are experiencing strong demand for our product and because of that we need to strengthen our sales department.

 IES Staffanstorp är en tvåspråkig skola. Du bör känna dig bekväm med att kommunicera med kollegor, elever och deras familjer på både svenska och engelska. Vi uppmuntrar och stödjer internationellt utbildade lärare som börjar hos oss att både lära sig svenska och komplettera sin lärarutbildning för att nå en svensk lärarlegitimation på sikt.

 Internationella Engelska Skolan Staffanstorp söker nu en lärare i Sv/So/En vikariat läsåret ut. Möjlighet finns till förlängning.

  Detta är du! 

Du är lärare, behörig i svenska,so och engelska åk 4-6. Du ser vikten av att skapa och behålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och vårdnadshavare. Du motiveras av att samarbeta med kollegor i en stödjande miljö. Du är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap där du kan skapa en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet. jobs.occupation: Senior Lecturer in English with a Specialisation in Literature
jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.
 
 
Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?
 
 
Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.
 
 
The Faculty of Philosophy, conducts education and research in the humanities, social sciences and education, mathematics and natural sciences, as well as the arts. Our research and education are carried out in close dialogue with the wider community and contribute to critical knowledge development, intellectual growth, and a deeper understanding of complex societal issues. Education is offered at all levels and is grounded in scientific or artistic foundations and characterized by academic breadth. Together, we contribute to a sustainable, open, and knowledge-based society.  The Faculty comprises three departments, employing approximately 420 members of staff in total. Through our collaborative platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector, and industry to jointly advance knowledge development and address societal challenges.
 
 
The Department of Social Science and Humanities provides education in social sciences, behavioural sciences, and language and communication. Research focuses on societal issues such as democracy, migration, sustainable development and communication, and is conducted in close collaboration with the surrounding society.
Employment information
Employment: Permanent employment which begins with possible trial employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-08-01
 
Scope: Part-time 75 %
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-02
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
Department/Unit: Social Sciences and Humanities
For information and a detailed description of basic eligibility requirements and assessment criteria, that apply to a position of a senior lecturer, please consult the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalen University https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
Position description
As a senior lecturer at MDU, your main tasks are teaching. Teaching also includes supervision, examination, course evaluation and course development. At MDU, research and education are closely intertwined and research forms the basis of our programmes. Collaboration is also an integral part of our research and education mission and as a senior lecturer you will actively contribute to the university's development work.
The tasks include:
teaching and examination in literature and literature didactics on the undergraduate and graduate levels, within the primary and subject teacher programmes as well as in other contexts
teaching and examination in English proficiency courses
course coordination and other administrative tasks
supervision and examination of degree projects
participation in pedagogical, scientific and collegial development
research and contributions to the department's research environments
general administration and competence development as well as participating in the daily activities, in the work of the subject and the department
additional tasks, such as work placement visits in the teacher programmes or teaching in research education, may be included

Qualification requirements
We are looking for a person with documented teaching skills and a degree of Doctor, or equivalent academic competence.
To be qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer one must have demonstrated the academic skills and teaching abilities required for the appointment.
Teaching skills and academic competence shall be well documented in such a way that their quality can also be assessed.
In order to be employed as a teacher at MDU, training in higher education teaching and learning, or equivalent acquired knowledge, is required. A person appointed as a senior lecturer but lacking training in higher education teaching and learning will be offered in-house training within two and a half years. The course in higher education teaching and learning at Mälardalen University corresponds to ten weeks of training.
In addition to the established basic eligibility requirements, according to the Appointment Regulations for Mälardalens university, some additional requirements apply to this position.
The applicant must have a doctoral degree in English with a focus on literature or literature didactics, or in education with a focus on teaching and learning through literature in English as a foreign or second language, or in a closely related field of relevance to the position. Experience of teaching and supervision in literature and/or literature didactics is expected (within the subject of English in higher education).
Also required are an excellent knowledge of and proficiency in written and spoken English, including the ability to teach about and in the language and to communicate in it on an academic level.
 
Assessment criteria
The assessment criteria will be based partly on the degree of skill required for the position and partly on the ability and suitability otherwise required to carry out the work duties.

https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities

jobs.occupation: 1st Line Support Agent (English and Spanish speaking)
jobs.description:
The company has developed a groundbreaking cloud service for transportation companies. They have customers all over the world.
They are experiencing strong demand of their product and because of that they need to strengthen their 1st line support team with a Spanish and English speaking support agent.
This position is in Linköping and you need to work from the office.

● Help the customers through phone, web chat and email, to make sure the customers can use the system the way they want it to work.
● Supporting the sales teams in sales demos and general technical support.

● You speak additional languages, especially Swedish, Finnish, or French.
● You have experience in technical support, ideally in an international environment.

jobs.description:
SMS group är världsledande när det gäller framtidsinriktade teknologier och enastående service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på mer än 4 miljarder euro. Vi tillämpar våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska:
Som operatör i våra valsverkstäder kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i att säkerställa driften och effektiviteten av vår specialiserade utrustning samt leverera service och underhåll på kundens komponenter till de olika valsverken. Du kommer att arbeta med en rad olika teknikområden, vilket ger dig möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens inom bland annat maskinbearbetning, montage, kvalitetskontroller och mätteknik.
English:
As an operator in our rolling mills, you will play a key role in ensuring the operation and efficiency of our specialized equipment and delivering service and maintenance on customer components to the various rolling mills. You will work with a range of different technical areas, giving you the opportunity to use and develop your skills in areas such as machining, assembly, quality control and measurement technology.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska:
Arbetet innehåller både planerade och akuta service/underhållsåtgärder, vilket passar dig som tycker om att lösa problem och har en ”can do” inställning. Detta innebär även att du har ett öga för detaljer och en vilja att ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och processer. Det är viktigt att du trivs med att både arbeta självständigt och som en del av ett lag.
Du kan uttrycka dig väl i svenska och eller engelska då arbetet till stor del sker i samarbete med dina kollegor.
Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom maskinbearbetning, gärna inom tung industri, samt innehar en gymnasieexamen eller likvärdig utbildning.
Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av:
Arbete i en valsverkstad
Maskinbearbetning
Kvalitetskontroller och tillhörande mätinstrument
Hantering av travers/kran i verkstadsmiljö

English:
The work includes both planned and urgent service/maintenance measures, which suits you who like to solve problems and have a "can do" attitude. This also means that you have an eye for detail and a desire to constantly improve our working methods and processes. It is important that you enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
You can express yourself well in Swedish and/or English as the work is largely done in collaboration with your colleagues.
We would like you to have a background in machining, preferably in heavy industry, and hold a high school diploma or equivalent education.
Experience in:
Working in a rolling mill
Machining
Quality controls and associated measuring instruments
Handling of overhead cranes/cranes in a workshop environment is an advantage

Om SMS group/Abour SMS group
Svenska:
Med SMS group hittar du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är vad vi lovar våra kunder och anställda nu och i framtiden.
Låter detta som en intressant möjlighet? Välkommen till en arbetsplats där din utveckling är central och där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens lösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Då rekryterings teamet är internationellt önskar vi din ansökan på engelska.

Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Welcome to a workplace where your development is central and where we together create tomorrow’s solutions. We look forward to receiving your application in English!

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du självklart välkommen att kontakta oss. Notera att urval kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, den 31 december 2026.

We are a cozy, welcoming preschool in Hässelby that follows the Swedish curriculum and with an international profile. We focus on language development and give children opportunities to grow as global citizens. Our preschool is bilingual, with Swedish and English as our working languages.
We are now looking for an experienced English speaking childminder (Barnskötare) who would like to be part of our continued development.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow and develop alongside the children, your colleagues and the organisation. You will take part in pedagogical planning and actively contribute to the daily activities. Together with the team, you will help create a safe, stimulating and creative environment for the children.

Experience: At least two years of experience working in a preschool.
Education: A recognised preschool assistant qualification (barnskötarutbildning) or equivalent.
Language skills: Highly proficient in English. Additional languages are an advantage.

We warmly welcome your application via email and look forward to hearing from you soon!

IES Österåker opened in August 2024. We are a F-9 school, 2 parallel classes with up to 610 students. We are committed to our ethos which is a school with a calm and safe learning environment, bilingual teaching and high academic expectations.

IESÖ follows the Swedish national curriculum while embracing bilingualism and the command of the English language . After grade 3 up to 50% of the lessons are taught in English. 

The school is located in central Åkersberga, about 30 minutes from Stockholm and a 5 minute walk from Roslagsbanan. Our campus combines newly built and renovated facilities and is close to sports facilities, nature, and the Stockholm archipelago.

We are looking for a positive, creative, and service-minded person who will play an important role in creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere at our school. You will have an integral role in key events and celebrations both from an organisational perspective as well as the practical. Many things that make IES Österåker special is that which is above and beyond the ordinary. 

It is important that you are comfortable with the creative and innovative side of things and that you interact well with children of all ages. You will assist students, parents, staff, and visitors, answer questions, manage day-to-day reception tasks, and help create a positive first impression of the school.

This includes welcoming and assisting visitors, ensuring no one enters the school without authorisation and vetting , helping maintain a safe and secure school environment, handling general office administration such as deliveries, managing incoming and outgoing post and supporting the practical organisation of the school among other things.We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Is confident, welcoming, and professional when interacting with students, parents, staff, and visitors.
- Enjoys working in a busy school environment where no two days are exactly the same.
- Is highly organised and able to coordinate several tasks and events at the same time.
- Is creative and enjoys coming up with ideas for events, activities, and communication.
- Has an interest in social media, photography, content creation, or digital communication.
- Is flexible, solution-oriented, and happy to help wherever needed.
- Has excellent English and Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Swedish drivers licence is a plus What we offer

- A varied and creative role at a growing international school.
- A role where your ideas and initiative can make a real difference.
- A dynamic working environment where you will meet students, staff, parents, and visitors every day.
- Supportive and dedicated colleagues.
- The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school.
- A culture focused on learning, respect, community, and academic success.

The position is 100%

We apply a 6-month probationary period.

Would you like to work with a product loved by millions and millions of kids all across the world? With over 60 million monthly active users engaging with our play ecosystem, we are looking for a Senior Copywriter to join our Creative Hub. Working alongside highly talented animators, designers, and creative leads, you will play a defining role in telling great stories that inform, entertain, and bring Toca Boca’s products to life with relatable narratives that truly connect with kids and families globally.

You will be the guardian of our global Tone of Voice. You will balance visionary, high-level campaign ideation with hands-on creative execution, ensuring that Toca Boca sounds exactly like Toca Boca wherever we show up.

What you’ll be doing

Partner with Art Directors and Creative Leads to drive creative concepts and storytelling from the first brief all the way to final launch.

Create narrative-led marketing content (trailers, promo videos, full 360° campaigns) with relatable copy that truly connects with our core tween audience.

Balance high-level visionary work with hands-on daily production (VO scripts, performance ads, social captions, and in-app copy).

Leverage knowledge of platform specs (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) to adapt copy natively while ensuring English source text is flawlessly structured for localization.

Own, update, and protect the Toca Boca Tone of Voice, ensuring everything we publish globally sounds exactly like us.

Partner with Product and Marketing to shape our stories, review creative output, and support the wider team in writing their own copy.

Identify opportunities to use emerging tools and technology to improve creative workflows.

Is This You?

You have 5+ years of experience working as a Copywriter, preferably with experience stepping into Creative Lead or conceptual roles. You thrive on balancing high-level visionary campaign strategy with hands-on, daily operational execution.

You hold a Bachelor's degree or similar in Copywriting, Communications, English, Creative Writing, or a related field, or you have equivalent professional experience.

You are a native English speaker with flawless grammar, sharp editing skills, and structurally precise writing.

You have experience developing, maintaining, and guarding a brand's Tone of Voice across multiple touchpoints.

You have a deep understanding of current social media trends, community engagement, and digital-first campaign storytelling. Prior experience in digital gaming, entertainment, or youth-focused tech is a major plus!

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio

360° campaigns where you drove both the high-level concept and the final narrative arc.

Emotionally resonant work targeting tweens that feels authentic.

Examples proving you can define, adapt, and guard a distinct brand voice across digital, social, and physical touchpoints.

A strong mix of visionary thinking and sharp daily execution (social media content).

Flawless native English writing with the precision required for a sensitive audience.

Impactful copy built on universal truths rather than local slang, proving it can be translated globally without losing its core DNA. (Bonus)

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Piknik and Lylli, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

We seek a dynamic and experienced leader to take on the exciting challenge of leading and continuing the successful development of our IES school in Tyresö from January 2027.

IES Tyresö is a well established and successful school founded in 2014, which offers an outstanding bilingual education to 700 students in grades 4-9, and a fulfilling career opportunity for around 63 employees. 

At IES we make a difference in the lives of our students. We believe this is due to our clear ethos with engaged and visible leaders creating an environment in which teachers can teach and students learn. Our students and parents choose us because of this:  

- our students learn to command the English language 
- we have ambitious academic goals for our students and ourselves and work hard to ensure every child lives up to their potential
- we offer a safe and calm working environment for both students and staff

From January we have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and driven Principal to take over the leadership in Tyresö. The Principal will be supported by an engaged and professional leadership team, as well as a creative and knowledgeable staff body. 

Who are you?

You have a proven track-record in a leadership position in the Swedish education sector with solid people management experience. You are a visible, forward-thinking leader and positive role model for the IES culture and value proposition, inspiring both students and staff and creating a work environment for professional growth. You are passionate about education and create a climate for learning. The Swedish Principal programme (Rektorsprogrammet) and proven experience of successful leadership of a diverse staff and student body are key requisites for the role, as well as a comfortable working fluency in both Swedish and English, as we are a bilingual school.

- Watch a Digital tour of IES

- Visit IES Tyresö on Facebook
- Explore our homepage www.engelska.se

- Ha en nära och förtroendefull dialog med elever och vårdnadshavare kring elevernas kunskapsutveckling.

Vi söker dig som:

- Är legitimerad lärare med speciallärarexamen, gärna med inriktning mot språk-, skriv- och läsutveckling.
- Har god kunskap om Lgr22 och vana vid att arbeta med pedagogiska kartläggningar och åtgärdsprogram.
- Är trygg, tydlig och strukturerad i ditt ledarskap och bidrar till studiero och ett gott arbetsklimat.
- Är lyhörd, prestigelös och en lagspelare som trivs med att samarbeta i team.

MultiMathic i Sverige AB is a small Swedish company based in Täby, north of Stockholm. We build and run our own web services and digital tools on infrastructure that we host ourselves: Linux servers, virtual machines and containers, together with a number of websites and domains.

We are now looking for a junior IT operations technician who will take over the daily running of this environment, step by step and with close guidance from the owner.

What you will do
- Monitor servers, virtual machines and containers, and act on alerts
- Run and verify backups, including regular restore tests
- Install updates and security patches according to a schedule
- Operate our websites: deployments, certificates and uptime
- Manage domains and DNS records
- Troubleshoot incidents and document what was done
- Write and maintain routines and documentation for the environment

What we are looking for
- Post-secondary education in IT or a related field
- Basic working knowledge of Linux and the command line
- Basic knowledge of Docker or other container tools
- Understanding of how DNS and web hosting work
- Fluent English, spoken and written
- A careful and structured way of working, and the habit of writing things down

It is a plus if you have
- Used Ansible or another automation tool
- Worked with Cloudflare, Proxmox or similar platforms
- Knowledge of Swedish

Terms
Permanent full-time position with a six-month probationary period. Fixed monthly salary. Insurance and occupational pension at the level of the collective agreement for the sector. The workplace is our office in Täby. The working language is English.

How to apply
We accept applications by e-mail only. Send your CV and a short cover letter, in English or Swedish and preferably as PDF, to jobb@multimathic.com no later than the closing date. Please write "Junior IT Operations Technician" in the subject line and describe briefly how you meet each of the requirements above.

We are a small company and handle the recruitment ourselves. For that reason we do not take applications or questions by telephone, text message or social media, and we do not accept offers from recruitment or staffing agencies. Questions about the position are answered at the same e-mail address. Selection begins after the closing date, and everyone who applies will receive a reply by e-mail.

Du samordnar QHSE-arbetet på ett systematiskt sätt och driver initiativ för ständiga förbättringar. Arbetet är varierande och innebär mycket samarbete och nära samverkan i hela organisationen. Implementera, upprätthålla och vidareutveckla QHSE-processer och ledningssystem.

Utbilda medarbetare i QHSE-rutiner och främja medvetenheten om QHSE i organisationen.
Ta fram och genomföra introduktionsutbildningar inom QHSE för nyanställda.
Utreda incidenter och olyckor samt vidta lämpliga korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder för att förhindra att de inträffar igen.
Vara en naturlig kontaktperson gentemot myndigheter och andra intressenter.

English
Do you have a passion for ensuring that a workplace is healthy, safe, sustainable, and of high quality? Then you might be exactly who we are looking for. As the QHSE (Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment) Manager, you will work comprehensively within the QHSE area to ensure a safe, sustainable, and high-quality operation. You will systematically coordinate the QHSE efforts and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The work is varied and involves a great deal of collaboration and close cooperation throughout the entire organization. For example, you will support the organization's managers and report to the management.
Work tasks include, but are not limited to:
Implement, maintain, and develop QHSE processes and management systems
Promote a culture of safety within the organization and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations concerning quality, occupational health, safety, and the environment
Train employees in QHSE procedures and promote a culture of QHSE awareness within the organization
Develop and deliver QHSE induction training for new employees
Investigate incidents and accidents, and take appropriate corrective and preventative actions to prevent reoccurrence
Serve as a natural point of contact with authorities and other stakeholders

Du har en akademisk examen eller motsvarande utbildning och erfarenhet inom ett relevant område, samt minst fem års yrkeserfarenhet av QHSE-arbete och ledningssystem baserade på standarderna ISO 9001, ISO 14001 och ISO 45001.
Du är ansvarstagande och kan arbeta självständigt. Du har också god analytisk förmåga och är skicklig på problemlösning. Dessutom har du lätt för att bygga relationer och skapa nya kontakter, eftersom rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med alla avdelningar i organisationen. IES Österåker öppnade i augusti 2024 och är en modern F-9skola med höga ambitioner. När skolan är fullbelagd kommer vi att ha cirka 600 elever fördelade på två parallellklasser per årskurs.

Skolan ligger centralt i Åkersberga i en kombination av nybyggda och renoverade lokaler. Med närhet till idrottsanläggningar, grönområden och skärgård erbjuder vi en inspirerande arbetsmiljö, ca 30 minuters pendling från Stockholm.

Arbetsro är viktigt för oss. Vi har tydliga rutiner och en gemensam värdegrund som skapar trygghet och studiefokus i klassrummet. Det ger dig som lärare rätt förutsättningar att fokusera på undervisning och kunskapsutveckling.

Vi söker dig som 

- är legitimerad lärare i textilslöjd för åk 4–9
- har ett tydligt ledarskap och skapar struktur och studiero
- har höga förväntningar på dina elever och en stark tilltro till deras förmåga

Du har god kunskap om material, verktyg och arbetsprocesser inom textilslöjd samt förmåga att inspirera elever till kreativitet och skaparglädje.

Vi erbjuder:

- Engagerade kollegor och internationell miljö

- En kultur med höga ambitioner, arbetsro och fokus på kunskap

Who we're looking for
• Part-time job seekers, ideally students with a genuine interest in childcare
• Candidates who can dedicate at least one afternoon per week
• Responsible and creative individuals with strong social skills
• Candidates looking for a long-term commitment of at least 6 months
• Native or fluent German speakers with good English or Swedish skills
About the Position
• The family lives in central Stockholm
• One child 4 years old
• Help is needed 2–3 afternoons per week with pickups and babysitting
• Working hours: approximately 15:00–18:00 or 16:00–19:00
• Flexibility to choose the days that work best for your schedule

What We Offer
• A flexible part-time role, approximately 3–10 hours per week, with the possibility of working with multiple families
• Competitive starting salary
• Comprehensive written references upon completion of your employment
• Close contact and ongoing support from our central office
• A friendly community of fellow babysitters
Commitment
We prioritize building long-term relationships and are looking for candidates who can commit for 6–12 months.
Apply Today!
If you think you would be a good fit for this role, apply in either English or Swedish. We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Analyst

What you will do
As a Senior Analyst at Klarna, you provide analytical and business expertise to ensure we deliver value to customers, Klarna, and our investors. You act as a bridge between models, operations, products, and business decisions, building strategies that connect them across the organization. You play an important part in taking Klarna to the next level, working across sales lifecycle areas, financial planning, and stakeholder communication. You bring a "Swiss army knife" mindset, ready to move between problems and provide data-driven guidance wherever it is needed.

Who you are
- A degree from a university in a numerate subject, such as Economics, Science, Engineering, or Business
- At least 5 years of analytical experience in retail banking, e-commerce, or payments, with knowledge of consumer lending in western countries preferred
- Strong general knowledge of the sales lifecycle, with deep expertise in one area such as credit risk, product/UX, marketing analytics, accounting, pricing, or data
- Experience supporting sales and marketing efforts, such as merchant sales strategies or campaign impact analysis
- Financial analytics experience, including business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI tracking
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage external stakeholders; merchant-facing experience is a plus
- Working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English

Awesome to have
- Strong attention to detail and experience using structured approaches to problem solving
- Understanding of regional risk policies and risk profiles, with the ability to suggest or build merchant-specific policy adjustments
- Significant drive and ambition
- Strong conceptual ability
- Familiarity with data extraction and manipulation, and programming languages such as SQL, R, Python, MatLab, Java, or C#
Please include a CV in English
Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site: https://www.klarna.com/careers/

Manage the lifecycle and quality of assigned IT services
Coordinate suppliers, support teams and stakeholders
Drive incident, problem and change management routines
Track service KPIs and lead continuous improvement
Solid ITSM/ITIL experience in enterprise environments
Strong stakeholder and supplier management skills
Structured, communicative and delivery-focused
Fluent English in speech and writing; Swedish is a strong plus
Based in or able to commute to the Gothenburg area

WHY OATLY?
Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant-based. Enter Oatly, the #1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.
We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.
Our sole purpose as a company is to make it easy for people to turn what they eat and drink into personal moments of healthy joy without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process.
Sustainability, nutritional health and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in. 
WHAT´S IN IT FOR YOU?
Are you structured and enjoy solving problems? Here's your chance to contribute to making the world a better place! At Oatly, we're all about fostering a customer-centric focus and driving positive change in the food industry. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills and have fun along the way!
You will be working in one of Sweden's finest offices, located in the attractive Västra Hamnen area in central Malmö, within walking distance to public transportation. There may be opportunities for hybrid work.
WHAT WILL YOU DO
In this role, fluent English is essential, as you’ll be supporting customers and stakeholders across different markets.  Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that our customers receive their Oatsome products seamlessly. In this role, you'll play a valuable role in managing customer orders and working closely with key stakeholders to make sure everything runs smoothly. If you're organized, eager to learn, and excited about starting your career in a dynamic environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you to shine!
This is a temporary position until end of January – and it's a great chance to learn and grow. Oatly is still expanding, so being adaptable and comfortable with change in a high-paced environment will help you gain valuable experience in this role. 
Here’s what you can expect in the day-to-day:
Be responsible for order management, ensuring that our customers receive their orders on time, in the right amount to the right place and with an all-time high service.

Keeping in daily contact with customers regarding the status of their orders to ensure smooth communication.

Having close collaboration with internal stakeholders in the Supply Chain such as Planning, Logistics, Quality and Sales, but also finance.

Keeping track of stock balances and having daily contact with 3PL.

Handling customer complaints and processing claims and credit notes.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?
You’ve read about the role, and now your imagination is flying at full speed. Here are the qualities we’re looking for… do you recognize them in yourself?

You have a keen interest in Supply Chain Operations, Customer Service, or Order Administration.

You’re comfortable with technology and have some familiarity with ERP systems – preferably Dynamics D365.

You know your way around MS Office and have solid Excel skills.

To succeed in this role, you need to be fluent in English and either Polish or German.

Most importantly, we place the greatest value on personal characteristics such as being organized, adaptable, and a great team player. You must be able to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing. It's a plus if you know another European language besides English, but it's not a requirement.
If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!
YOUR APPLICATION 
Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.
As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!
Last day of application: 9th December 2026.
We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system - any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!
Love Oatly XOXO

IES Linköping opened in 2003 and offers a bilingual education to 550 students between grades F-9 and a fulfilling career opportunity for around 80 employees.

At IES Linköping we make a difference in the lives of our students. Our students master the English language in a positive environment of high expectations. We believe a safe and structured school is essential for the best possible social and academic development. We follow Swedish school law, teaching and setting grades according to Lgr 22 and we are proud of our diverse and engaged multicultural school.

We are looking for an Assistant Principal (AP) for grades 6-9 to join our leadership team, who will support the Principal in leading and creating the opportunity for every student to realise their own potential in an international environment. The AP position involves being a member of the Senior Management Team, and having staff responsibility, for instance managing both the Student Care Team functions and the Heads of Year. We are looking for candidates who can lead, manage and train their staff to ensure that students experience consistency, within a caring and supportive school environment.

The position:

- Collaborate with the Principal and other school leaders in the overall development of the school, its culture, strategy, structure and routines
- Monitor, follow up on and develop the quality of the planning, teaching, assessment and grading
- Lead and coach our team of Middle Leaders who in turn lead their teams
- Plan and lead professional development for staff
- Monitor, follow up on and develop our students’ learning and behavioral outcomes (Systematic Quality Work)
- Collaborate with other school leaders around academic and social support structures to ensure our resources are used effectively
- Lead development, appraisal and salary talks

About you:

- We are looking for someone who is passionate about education and creating a climate for learning and you have the ability to engage and inspire both students and staff
- You are a competent and enthusiastic role model and leader with a strong presence to help us continue to develop the teaching, learning & behavior
- You are a committed, strategic, positive and reliable team player and are capable of developing ideas, leading teams and coaching individuals. You also work operatively as an individual
- You promote bilingualism, have an international mindset and approach, exercise cultural intelligence and good interpersonal skills
- You are a qualified teacher or possess equivalent leadership experience within a school environment, coupled with a proven track record of student success
- You have a proven track record in student care and academics, and leadership experience including staff responsibility
- You are able to work professionally in both English and Swedish in meetings and presentations

Support:

- A strong and supportive leadership team, introduction & mentorship by the Principal
- Additional leadership training, including the possibility to do UK Senior Leadership Training and later the Swedish Principal training, once established in the role
- Monthly digital meetings and physical day conferences with other Academic Leaders from around IES
- Positive, proactive and constructive school culture
- Clear routines and systems for how we work

Opportunity

- 100% position leading to permanency; 40-hour work week
- Collective agreement with ALMEGA & additional pension payment & additional holiday days
- A transparent, positive and constructive work environment
- IES offers a wide range of social activities, career opportunities and professional development

Want to find out more?

- Watch an Introduction to IES and read what it is like to work with us
- Visit our webpage and instagram “ies_linkoping” 

A personal letter, copies of qualifications and CV should be sent to  recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se, citing  "Assistant Principal" in the subject line. 

References are required and the position starts spring term 2027 or as agreed.

We are looking for reliable, motivated and physically fit individuals who enjoy outdoor work, take responsibility and can maintain a consistently high working pace.
Employment Periods – 2027

Autumn season: 15 August – 31 October 2027

Work is mainly carried out in southern Sweden at various customer locations.

Full-time employment during both seasonal periods.

Opportunities for overtime when required.

Travel and occasional overnight stays away from the main work location are part of the job.

Main Responsibilities
Planting hedges, trees and larger plants

Digging, ground preparation and landscaping work

Loading, unloading and handling plants

Practical work in nurseries and landscaping projects

Other duties related to the company's operations

Very good physical fitness and stamina

Salary in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, taking experience and qualifications into account

Full-time employment with opportunities for overtime

Minimum 3 years of professional design engineering experience.

Sheet metal design, brackets, and installation solutions.
Plastic components and installation design.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D drawing creation.
Experience with tolerance analysis.
Good understanding of component packaging, interfaces, and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturability, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Good command of English.

Highly Valued Experience
Previous chassis design and integration experience within heavy-duty vehicles.
Experience working on BEV platforms and electrified vehicle architecture.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, such as sheet metal, plastics, and pneumatics.
Experience collaborating with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Personal Attributes
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of independently driving design activities.
Practical and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
Ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
Willingness to share knowledge and contribute to team development.

Important Assignment Details
Duration: 2 years.
Start: ASAP – immediate availability required.
Location: Södertälje, Sweden.
Work Arrangement: Full-time, on-site, 5 days per week.
Language: English.

How to Apply
Are you ready to contribute to the next generation of electric heavy-duty vehicles?
Submit your updated CV through the Hykmann careers portal: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Please highlight your previous heavy-vehicle OEM R&D experience, CATIA V5 expertise, relevant design competencies, availability, and earliest possible start date.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics.
 
 
Subject description
 
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
 
 
Project description
 
RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects.
 
 
Duties
 
As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas:
 
 
Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments
 
a. Agentic planning and reasoning
 
- Semantic mission planning using foundation models
 
- Task decomposition based on foundation models
 
- Event-driven task replanning
 
 
b. Autonomous inspection planning
 
- Uncertainty aware planning
 
- Multi-agent systems for inspection planning
 
 
Qualifications
 
To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required.
 
 
For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en.
 
 
Further information
 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to four years. Teaching and other departmental duties may be added, up to 20% of full-time working hours. The place of work is Luleå, and the starting date is by agreement.
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
We are recruiting a PhD student for a research project on regional exploration in Norrbotten, Sweden. Project is aiming to create a regional 3D geophysical model of the subsurface to guide mineral exploration and provide hints for possible deposits. Take the opportunity to study for a PhD in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.
Subject description
Applied Geophysics is a topic based on physical laws and practices, which combined with geological information can be used in a variety of applications. Geophysical research at the Division of Geosciences and Environmental Engineering includes both basic and applied research in exploration, environmental and engineering applications.
Project description
Rex project focuses on a full multi-scale geophysical prospecting for mineral exploration with added value of regional scale surveying for exploration targeting. Previous D-Rex project showed that by conducting geophysical surveys across regional-to-deposit scale it is possible to identify regional patterns, structures and anomalies that can be used to guide deposit-scale exploration.
Geophysical images transcending from continental- to deposit-scale can provide a better understanding of the geology of the region and how mineral deposits were formed and distributed. While allowing the identification of potential mineral deposits at a continental scale, and then focusing on specific areas for detailed exploration, they also lead to improved accuracy of mineral exploration by providing a more complete picture of the subsurface geology.
Duties
As a PhD student you are expected to perform both field work and theoretical work within your research studies as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. The majority of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies. You will work primarily with geophysical (magnetotelluric) data. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is a key focus of this PhD. You will work on development and extending our MR3Dmod modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have the opportunity to try the teacher role. As a PhD student, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects.
Qualifications
You must have academic credentials and recently completed your M.Sc or equivalent degree in geophysics, mathematics, physics, geology or other relevant subject. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion is required. Experience in software development (Python in particular) and management of large data sets is important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required.
For further information about a specific research subject see; http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en
Most employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority.

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: July 2027.

jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Department for Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is looking for a Senior Lecturer, who is driven by the interest to strengthen their expertise in advanced environmental technologies, particularly in addressing persistent contaminants such as PFAS, PAH, antibiotics, pesticides.
 
 
This position is intended for advancing ongoing research of the group of Waste Science and Technology in waste management, circular material flows, waste detoxification, and environmental remediation, all of which are essential for driving progress toward a sustainable and environmentally responsible society. The Senior lecturer will contribute to the development of research and education efforts by studying and developing advanced treatment methods and integrated treatment chains for waste, contaminated soils and groundwater.
 
 
This recruitment aligns with the university’s vision to position itself among leaders in environmental technology and establish robust international research collaborations, leveraging unique research and education environment.
 
 
Subject description
 
Waste Science and Technology incorporates all stages of society’s waste management – generation, collection, treatment and disposal of waste, including reuse and recycling, as well as soil and groundwater remediation. The research aims at the development of tools and processes that facilitate sustainable soil remediation and waste management.
 
 
Duties
 
Your duties will mainly consist of research and education. You will lead research projects and supervise Master and PhD students. Teaching and educational development work is included in the tasks, as well as writing and submitting new project proposals for external funding. You will co-author scientific articles to be published in international peer-reviewed journals and present research results at national and international conferences. You are also expected to contribute to the research environment at the Department through participation in meetings, events and cooperation.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as a senior lecturer, the applicants: 
must have been awarded a doctoral degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or adjacent areas or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.
must demonstrate pedagogical expertise by means of proven experience, teaching expertise and teaching development.
must have completed higher education pedagogy courses equivalent to 7.5 higher education credits or otherwise have acquired equivalent knowledge.

Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
- scientific expertise
- pedagogical skills
- other assessment criteria
 
 
Other assessment criteria (Ranked in descending order):
- experience in sample preparation and analytical methods for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) (e.g., PFAS and pharmaceuticals) in soil, waste, and water
- Experience in the development and/or application of advanced degradation technologies for CECs (e.g., electrochemical oxidation, sonolysis, and plasma-based technologies, etc.)
- the ability to obtain external research and development funding
- the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English
- the ability to communicate research and development work orally and in writing
- the ability to collaborate with the wider community and stakeholders.
 
 
Information
 
The position is a permanent, full-time appointment at Luleå University of Technology.

Contribute to the long-term feature strategy and roadmap planning.

Support the development and improvement of test methods and simulation activities.

Prepare and communicate feature status reports to project stakeholders.

Represent the Quality Impression area in discussions and technical reviews.

Educational background in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development or a related technical field.

Experience in automotive engineering, industrial design or product development.

Understanding of product quality evaluation and development processes.

Experience in requirements handling, verification, evaluation or testing.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Previous experience in Quality Impression or Perceived Quality.

Experience working with Heavy Duty Vehicles or the automotive industry.

Knowledge of CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering).

Experience with visualization techniques and 3D rendering.

Experience with simulation activities and product evaluation.

Experience in feature development, roadmap planning and cross-functional project work.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:
Curious, analytical and solution-oriented.

Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

Confident in communicating technical topics and representing their area.

Collaborative, supportive and open-minded.

Able to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders.

Focused on continuous improvement and delivering high-quality results.

We are looking for a caring, responsible, and enthusiastic Polish-speaking babysitter for a family in Sundbyberg, with two children aged 3 and 6.

Speak Polish at a native or fluent level
Communicate confidently in English or Swedish

Are available 2 weekdays per week, from 15:00 to 18:00

A regular part-time position with a family in Sundbyberg
A supportive and friendly working environment
Ongoing guidance and support from our central office

Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
We are recruiting a Researcher to work primarily in the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) project related to developing research infrastructure to archive and access geoscientific data. You will also be involved in other projects as well teaching Exploration geophysics courses. Take the opportunity to work in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.
 
 
Subject description 
 
Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.
 
 
Project description
 
The pan-European “European Plate Observing System (EPOS)” distributed e-infrastructure is a long-term sustainable solution for the collection, securing, dissemination and analysis of data related to the solid Earth and the processes forming the solid Earth and surface.  One of the core services of the project is Geoelectromagnetic observations Thematic Core Service TCS. TCS Geoelectromanetic Observations is responsible for the provision of data about the geomagnetic field between the Earth’s core and space. The EMTDAMO (the European Service of Magnetotluric Data and Models) service was introduced for data that determine the electrical resistivity of the Earth’s subsurface by measuring the response on natural time variations of the Earth's magnetic and electric fields. Luleå University of Technology is responsible for EMTDAMO, which will collect data from various sources as the basis for new and improved resistivity models of the Earth.
 
 
Duties
 
Within the EPOS project you will be working on archiving of EM data, which involves development and management of databases. A big part of your working time will be devoted to project and data management and communication with TCS partners. The position responsibilities also include both field work (to collect new data) and theoretical/development work as well as communicating your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. You will work primarily with electromagnetic data with focus on magnetotelluric observations. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is also important element of work duties, especially when being involved in other projects run at Luleå University of Technology. You are expected to work on our in-house development of modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have to teacher courses as well as co-supervise PhD students. As a researcher, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects.
 
 
Qualifications 
 
In order to be eligible for employment as a Researcher you must have a PhD or equivalent degree in Geophysics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or another relevant field, awarded no more than three years before the application deadline for this position. You must also have an academic record, experience in software development (Python, Matlab and Web development in particular) and management of large data sets are required. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion are important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required.
 
 
Most employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority.
 
 
Further information
 
This employment as Researcher is set to 75% and is limited to 1 year. Placement: Luleå. Starting date: 2027-01-01 or as soon as possible.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Maxim Smirnov, Associate Professor, (+46) 920-493413, mailto:maxim.smirnov@ltu.se
