Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
In the research subject Applied Geochemistry at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering, Luleå University of Technology (LTU), we are looking for a Postdoc Researcher. Applied Geochemistry at LTU focuses on the occurrence and mobility of elements and geochemical processes that occur in rock, soil, and water at the Earth’s surface. Research is conducted on natural and anthropogenic sources and their interactions within and between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere. This is achieved by combining analytical chemistry, isotopic geochemistry, environmental forensics, and environmental mineralogy. Research and education in this subject address environmental issues tied to the mining industry, infrastructure construction, acid sulphate soils, and sulphide-bearing rocks. The research group has a strong experimental and applied profile, with well-equipped laboratories and extensive collaborations with industry and the public sector, all geared towards building a long-term, sustainable society.
Subject description
Applied Geochemistry is concerned with studies into the occurrence and mobility of the elements in rocks, soil, and water, focusing on methods to prevent or reduce the environmental impact of metal extraction and infrastructure development.
Background
The position will support the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet) funded PhD Research School on Mining and Mineral Research – BioGeoMetals, a national collaboration between Linnaeus University (coordinator), Luleå University of Technology (LTU), and KTH Royal Institute of Technology. BioGeoMetals focuses on biogeochemical and hydrogeochemical approaches for sustainable metal recovery and environmental management in mining environments. The research school addresses the mobilization and recovery of critical raw materials from mining waste rock, tailings, groundwater, or run-off waters, as well as bioremediation of impacted mine sites. Through interdisciplinary doctoral training, joint courses, and close collaboration with industry and public authorities, the research school aims to educate the next generation of researchers contributing to sustainable mining and responsible resource management in Sweden and beyond.
Project description
The project will investigate how microbiology can be used in geochemical exploration to find ore deposits. Characterisation of solids, liquids and microbes in mining environments (e.g. tailings, mine water, and waste rock) will serve as the base for subsequent brown- and greenfield exploration trials. The successful candidate will focus on the characterisation of solids and closely work with the PhDs and partners in the project.
The work will cover:- Laboratory and field investigations- Mineralogical, geochemical and petrographic characterization- Development of analytical methods and exploration strategies
Duties
As a Postdoc, you will:
- Conduct field sampling of solid phases (rock, soil, till, sediments)
- Perform laboratory-based geochemical and mineralogical analyses
- Integrate and interpret multi-disciplinary datasets
- Design methods of mineral exploration
- Co-supervise PhD's
- Teach in geology-related courses
- Publish results in peer-reviewed scientific journals
- Present findings at national and international conferences
Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in exploration, geochemistry, field and laboratory work, microbiology, and sustainable mining.
You must have:
- A PhD degree in geology, geochemistry, environmental geoscience, or a closely related field
- Good oral and written proficiency in English
- Experience in conducting field work
- Expertise in soil-related exploration
- Strong background in characterisation techniques
- A driving license
Meritorious qualifications include:
- SEM-based automated mineralogy
- Heavy mineral concentration expertise
Personal qualities such as analytical ability, independence, collaboration skills, and strong motivation for research will be given significant weight.
Further information 
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension. The position is based in Luleå. Start date: January 2027 or according to agreement.

About the Job 
Join Symcel’s Sales and Marketing team as our new Marketing Specialist and help bring advanced instruments to researchers, laboratories and pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide.

About Symcel 
Symcel is a Swedish life science company in an exciting commercial scale-up phase, with an international team of scientists, engineers and business professionals. 
Our innovative biocalorimetry-based systems use highly sensitive isothermal microcalorimetry to detect and analyze biological activity. Our instruments supports applications ranging from rapid sterility testing of advanced therapies and pharmaceuticals to microbial testing, biofilm analysis and biological research. 
We are united by a mission to support researchers and manufacturers develop, test and deliver life-changing treatments and products. 
Our company language is English. 
Discover more about us at symcel.com.

As a Marketing Specialist, you will plan, create and execute marketing activities across digital channels, scientific content, video, webinars and events. 
This is a hands-on role where you will independently manage projects from gathering scientific input and writing content to designing materials, publishing and distribution. 
You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Product Management, Applications and Sales while taking ownership of your own projects and deliverables. 
The position is based at Symcel's head office on the Karolinska Institutet campus in Stockholm, with the option to work remotely 1–2 days per week. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Independently writing high-quality scientific and marketing content, including website copy, blog articles, case studies, brochures, presentations and sales materials. 
Designing and producing marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, images, presentations and exhibition materials. 
Creating and editing video content, including product videos, interviews and short videos for digital channels and social media.

Qualifications

Academic degree in life sciences, such as microbiology, biotechnology, biomedicine or a closely related discipline.

Why join us? 
At Symcel, you’ll join a growing life science company with a collaborative, international and positive work environment. Our technology is helping improve solutions for medical treatments and patient care, enabling faster and more efficient quality control in areas such as cell and gene therapy.

Please include examples or links to marketing materials you have personally created, demonstrating your experience in scientific content creation, graphic design and video production.

jobs.occupation: Loving and Experienced DAYTIME Nanny Wanted for a Wonderful Little Boy
jobs.description:
Ref. 4298Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced daytime nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine love for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has a permanent back injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. Having a nanny available whenever he is with his mother is therefore essential. The role involves supporting both the child and the family in everyday life.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Day Nanny – Responsibilities
The role combines childcare with light household support.
While he is at nursery, approximately 2–5 hours will generally be spent on household tasks. The nanny should remain available in case he is unwell, nursery is closed or plans change.
Responsibilities include:
Morning routines, breakfast and preparing meals and snacks.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing, engaging and supporting his interests and activities.
Preparing healthy meals for the family.
Laundry, ironing and making beds.
Keeping the child's areas tidy and cleaning up after him.
Wiping kitchen surfaces and general light household tasks.
Administering medication when required.

The family particularly appreciates someone who enjoys cooking and takes initiative in the kitchen. A weekly cleaner is employed.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.
Enjoys cooking and preparing family meals.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
The family is looking for someone who genuinely cares about his happiness and development and brings warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!
Location: Östermalm, Stockholm
Start date: November 2026 – January 2027 (TBC)
Schedule: Every other week
Working hours: 08:00–20:00 (±1 hour)
Child: One boy, 4.5 years old
Languages: English preferred
Position: Long-term, full-time employment

Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer  BEV Chassis Integration
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration | CATIA V5
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Mechanical Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration
Specialisation: Mechanical Design | Chassis Integration | Sheet Metal Design | Pneumatic Systems | CATIA V5
Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Work Model: On-site (100%)
Assignment Period: 1 December 2026 – 29 December 2028
Language: English
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to contribute to the development and integration of components and systems for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) chassis solutions.
You will work on mechanical design, component integration and installation solutions within heavy-duty vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on sheet metal components, brackets, pneumatic systems and chassis packaging.
The role involves working with advanced CAD tools, developing detailed 3D and 2D designs, coordinating with suppliers and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver technically robust and production-ready solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Mechanical Design & Component Development
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis applications.
Develop sheet metal components, brackets and mounting solutions.
Design and integrate pneumatic components and installation systems.
Create detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and technical requirements.
Perform tolerance analysis and ensure dimensional accuracy.

2. Chassis Integration & Component Packaging
Work with component packaging, interfaces and installation requirements.
Ensure effective integration of mechanical and pneumatic components within vehicle chassis architectures.
Evaluate installation space, clearances, interfaces and mounting requirements.
Develop practical design solutions considering functionality, manufacturability and serviceability.
Support the integration of components within electric vehicle chassis platforms.

3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the design and development lifecycle.
Participate in technical discussions, design reviews and engineering coordination activities.
Support supplier interactions and resolve technical design-related challenges.
Coordinate design requirements and ensure alignment across relevant stakeholders.

4. Verification, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Support design reviews, validation activities and technical investigations.
Prepare and maintain engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
Support manufacturing and production-related activities when required.
Contribute to design optimization, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant mechanical design engineering experience.
Previous R&D experience with Scania/Hero or the relevant TRATON organization is mandatory.
Strong practical experience in one or more of the following areas:
Sheet metal design and development.
Brackets and mechanical installation solutions.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Component packaging and chassis integration.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D engineering drawings.
Experience with tolerance analysis and dimensional engineering.
Good understanding of component interfaces, packaging and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing and manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic and/or pneumatic components.
Ability to develop practical and technically sound mechanical design solutions.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience in the following areas will be highly advantageous:
Heavy-duty vehicle chassis design and integration.
Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) development.
Truck chassis component integration and installation.
Sheet metal component design and manufacturing.
Pneumatic system design and integration.
Supplier coordination and technical design reviews.
Vehicle packaging, mounting interfaces and tolerance management.
Production support and engineering documentation.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a proactive and technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer who can independently drive design activities and contribute to complex vehicle integration projects.
The ideal candidate should have practical experience in heavy-duty vehicle development, strong CATIA V5 capabilities and a solid understanding of mechanical design principles.
You should be comfortable collaborating with suppliers, engineering teams and other stakeholders while taking ownership of technical deliverables, solving design challenges and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
Important Information
Previous R&D experience with the specified heavy-duty vehicle OEM/group is mandatory.
The position is 100% on-site in Södertälje.
CV must be submitted in English.
A background check will be conducted before the start of the employment/assignment.
Candidate selection will take place continuously.
There may be opportunities for an extension beyond the stated period.

Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with CATIA V5 expertise and a background in heavy-duty vehicle development?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

We are currently helping our client to find their next Polish-speaking colleague to their Customer service for their savings accounts. We’re looking for someone who is motivated, service-minded, and eager to contribute to the development of their customer service team.
About the role
As a Customer Service Representative, you will be part of the international support team, assisting Polish-speaking customers via phone, email, post and secure messages. You’ll handle inquiries related to savings accounts, deposit guarantees and account activity – ensuring each customer receives clear, professional and friendly help. The position is based at the headquarter office in Stockholm. You will collaborate closely with related teams and ensure your cases are accurately documented in our internal systems. This role is ideal for someone at the start of their career and values quality, teamwork and clear communication, and who wants to help us grow through more modern, efficient ways of working.
Work tasks
Your main responsibilities will, among other things, include:
Respond to customer inquiries in Polish and English via phone, email, post and secure messages
Help customers understand savings product and related services
Accurately document customer cases in related systems
Collaborate with colleagues in related teams
Working with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and related regulatory frameworks

We are looking for someone who is
Fluent Polish, professional proficiency in English and preferably Swedish
Experience in customer service, administration, or a similar field
Structured and has a detail-oriented approach to work
Clear communication skills and a genuine interest in helping others
Eagerness to learn and grow within customer service or finance

The most important thing is your motivation and willingness to learn. However, it is considered a strong merit if you speak Swedish or have a knowledge of any other European languages and/or previous work experience from the banking or insurance industry. You’re someone who thrives on making customers feel heard and supported. You take initiative, value accuracy, and bring a positive attitude to your team.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.  
Please note: that the final candidate will undergo a background check, which must be cleared.

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med kollegor från hela världen?

Internationella Engelska Skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad personal som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever.

Nu söker vi dig som vill vara en del av oss på Internationella Engelska Skolan i Halmstad och som vill arbeta i det viktiga uppdraget som elevassistent. Vi söker dig med erfarenhet från liknande tjänst, som är lung, stresstålig och engagerad - gärna med relevant utbildning. Du har förmåga att kunna anpassa ditt förhållningssätt och dina pedagogiska metoder utifrån elevens skiftande behov. Det är viktigt att du är prestigelös, flexibel och trivs i en föränderlig miljö. Du är väl införstådd i skolans styrdokument och har alltid elevens bästa i fokus. Du planerar och organiserar ditt arbete effektivt och är mån om att skapa och underhålla goda relationer med såväl elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du medverkar till en elev som är i behov av särskilt stöd får ett individanpassat och inkluderande bemötande samt riktade insatser som syftar till ökad måluppfyllelse.

Som elevassistent hos oss arbetar man i ett nära samarbete med ansvarig grundskollärare och specialpedagoger. Du arbetar med en eller flera elever som behöver extra stöd för att kunna följa med i undervisningen. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter handlar därför om att hjälpa eleverna att följa med i undervisningen och hjälpa dem med att finna ro i sina studier. Utöver det kan dina arbetsuppgifter också bestå av att hjälpa eleverna att träna på olika vardagsuppgifter, vara ett stöd för eleverna på raster och på utflykter.

To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.

Du studerar just nu (gärna intresserad av att studerar till lärare, pedagog, beteendevetare eller liknande, i framtiden men inget krav). 

 Du har ett genuint intresse av att arbeta med barn och unga. Du är en trygg och ansvarsfull  förebild.

Vi erbjuder en internationell, dynamisk och varm arbetsplats med stark teamkänsla. Du får värdefull erfarenhet av att arbeta inom skola och pedagogik, samt möjligheten att dryga ut studentkassan med arbetstider som fungerar ihop med ditt schema.

jobs.description:
Om skolan

Internationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen är en grundskola med årskurs F-9 som ligger vid Midsommarkransen, nära både tunnelbana och buss. Skolan startades 2014 och har idag över 120 anställda och ca 1200 elever. Om du vill arbeta i en internationell miljö med en stödjande kultur är IES Liljeholmen platsen för dig. Vi har en bred elevgrupp som talar omkring ett 50-tal olika modersmål samt en personalgrupp som är internationellt rik. Vi vill uppmuntra och stödja internationellt utbildade lärare som börjar hos oss på IES Liljeholmen att både lära sig svenska samt komplettera sin lärarutbildning för att nå en svensk lärarlegitimation på sikt.

Om tjänsten

Internationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen söker för närvarande en behörig lärare i matematik i årskurs 6-7. Du kommer att ingå i arbetslaget för årskurs 7 och dela mentorsansvar för en klass samt matematik för årskurs 6-7. Tjänsten är ett vikariekontrakt från januari 2027 - februari 2027 med eventuell förlängning.

Din profil

Du är en kvalificerad lärare för de angivna ämnena och åldersgrupperna. Vi hoppas att du inser vikten av att bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och föräldrar. Du är motiverad att ha regelbunden kontakt med föräldrar, leda mentorstimmar enligt mentorprogrammet och arbeta tillsammans i en stödjande miljö. Det finns inget krav på tidigare lärarerfarenhet, men vi värdesätter ditt självförtroende i ditt professionella ledarskap och din förmåga att skapa en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet. Du värderar och levererar personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med fokus på både struktur och elevengagemang. Som lärare är du en tydlig och aktiv förebild.

Anställningsprocess

Vi kommer att hålla löpande intervjuer för tjänsten, så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Om du tror att detta kan vara rätt tjänst för dig, tveka inte att ansöka! Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan och få möjlighet att diskutera tjänsten och dina kvalifikationer närmare.

Övrig information

Alla Internationella Engelska skolor runt om i landet delar samma vision för utbildning, kallad IES Ethos. Läs gärna mer om detta för att se om det överensstämmer med dina egna professionella värderingar och övertygelser. På IES erbjuds alla anställda en pedagogisk lunch. IES följer Almega kollektivavtal för fristående skolor.

We are looking for a Functional Safety Engineer within Automotive. You will work in a team and define concepts and set requirements for the client's platform of electrical vehicles. This is an exciting opportunity to work cross-functionally with innovation defining the future and contribute to the success of our company in the transition to zero emission vehicles.
Job description:
As a Functional Safety Engineer, you will be leading the functional safety activities starting from early concept development, moving on to defining requirements, and ensuring successful verification of the Electromobility system.
• Lead the completion of the functional safety activities including Safety Plan, HARA, TARA,  FSC, TSC, refinement of safety requirements and allocation on components.
• Lead development of and verification of the Functional Safety work products
• Manage ISO 26262 knowledge and safety culture in the team and coach other system engineers in the team.
• Represent the team in functional safety forums.
• Support the performance of the verification review (VR), confirmation review (CR) and functional safety assessment.
• Continuously monitoring/tracking & documenting the system changes for FuSa related products and execute impact analysis.
Experience & skills required: 
• You have M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science, Mechatronic or similar.
• Minimum 5 years of documented experience within system development and functional safety deliveries according to ISO 26262, preferably within the automotive industry.
• Good knowledge of deployment the functional safety standards in entire product lifecycle from start to start of production (SOP), such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ISO 13849 etc.
-Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and best practices of automotive standards and regulations (ISO 21434, UN R155) is a plus
• Hands on experience of safety activities, such as Hazard Analysis, technical safety concept, functional safety concept
• Experience of automotive E/E system development. (Including system engineering and/or HW/SW development)
• Experience from working in requirements management tools.
• Fluent in both written and verbal English.
• A driven team player with extensive experience from functional safety engineering along with experience in a dynamic and high paced product development environment.
• You should possess an analytical mindset, adept problem-solving skills, and a keen interest in acquiring new technical knowledge.
• Effective communication skills and strong networking abilities are essential for achieving success in this role.
A plus if you have:
• Background in charging system or electrical power take-off in the automotive industry.
• Previous involvement in functional safety engineering, system engineering or product development in the automotive industry
• Experience in system verification processes.
• Experience in System Weaver, requirement management tools.
•  Fluent in English

Personal Skills required:
• Proactive and self motivated
•  Excellent communication & presentation skills 
•  Flexible and analytical
•  A team player who easly can collaborate and network
•  Work in a structured and organized way
•   Enjoy knowledge sharing

Additional info:
We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.

Geometry Assurance Engineer
For our office in Västerås or/and Malmö, we are looking for a mechanical engineer with experience in tolerance analysis and geometry assurance. We want you to be familiar with geometrical tolerances and the ISO GPS standard. Experience with the Model Based Definition (MBD) concept is highly valued. We use modern tools such as CETOL 6Sigma for variation analyses and tolerance optimizations directly in the 3D CAD environment. At ARIADNE Engineering AB you will work in a dynamic team of sharp engineers who are experts in the use of Model Based Definition, tolerance analysis, FE simulation, innovation and technical calculation. Together we work with technical presentations, consulting projects and training for customers. We work in close dialogue with customers and help them develop innovative solutions in areas such as geometry assurance, dimensional management, robust design and FE analysis. When you are ready to take on the role, you will also run your own projects, of course with the support of your experienced colleagues.
Who are we?
We are a group of nine people located in Västerås or/and Malmö. Our corporate culture is characterized by flexibility, change, short communication paths and exiting challenges in interesting technology areas. Of course, we work with modern software such as CAD/CAM/CAE/CAI in our projects, so you will always work with the best software on the market.
Every year, we also host our Annual MBE Conference, a key event where companies from all over Europe and the U.S. participate. The conference brings together industry experts, customers, partners, and thought leaders to discuss the latest developments in Model Based Enterprise. It includes technical presentations, workshops, networking sessions, and opportunities to learn directly from specialists in the field.
Who are you?
You likely have an M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a similar field, and an interest in analytical methods such as FEM, CFD, and tolerance analysis.
However, we value personal drive, curiosity, and initiative just as much as formal experience. If you enjoy learning new things, like solving complex problems, and thrive in environments where you can take responsibility early, you will fit in well with us.
Since we work with international customers, fluency in English is essential. Swedish language skills are a strong advantage.
 We will be extra happy if you:
- Have worked with geometry assurance/tolerance analysis.
- Is familiar and can use geometric tolerances ISO GPS
- Has experience in FEM analysis and problem-solving methodology
- Experience with innovation methodology TRIZ is meritorious.
- Are structured, responsible and likes to solve problems.
- Master English unhindered, both in speech and writing. Good if you speak Swedish
It's important that you like to learn new things and find it easy. You enjoy working closely with customers and have great social skills. Initiative, creativity and analytical skills are qualities we value. You will work with consulting projects, technical presentations as well as training.

At Nova Industri, we are committed to shaping the green industry of the future. We are proud to contribute to the development of the region and to creating a brighter, greener future.
About Nova Industri
Nova Industri AB is now part of SMS group Nordic, with SMS group GmbH in Germany as our parent company. We are a leading service company specialising in industrial production and mechanical engineering, with operations in Boden and Kalix.
For more than 20 years, we have delivered high-quality solutions in turning, milling, welding and steel construction. Our customers are primarily industrial companies in Norrbotten, and our strong local presence is an important part of our success.
About the role
As a manual welder with us, you will be responsible for carrying out qualified welding work on various materials and in different dimensions. You will work daytime shifts, both in the workshop and out in the field.
This is an independent role, making it important that you can read and work from technical drawings, welding procedure specifications (WPS) and work instructions. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the work is carried out in accordance with applicable quality requirements.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Manual welding using the MMA (111), MAG (135, 136, 138) and TIG (141) processes.
Interpreting technical drawings, welding procedures and work instructions.
Performing welding work in various positions, such as PA, PB and PF.
Carrying out visual self-inspections of completed welds.
Contributing to a safe and clean working environment.

We believe that you have
A vocational upper-secondary education in welding or equivalent qualifications.
At least two years of documented experience in manual welding in an industrial environment.
As our working environment is international, it is an advantage if you understand and can communicate in English.
An understanding of and experience in applying occupational health and safety regulations, as well as experience working with personal protective equipment.

It is an advantage if you have
A valid welding certificate in accordance with SS-EN ISO 9606-1 for steel, or another relevant standard depending on the material.
Experience in stainless steel and aluminium welding.
Hot Work certification.
SSG Lift and Fall Protection training.
A valid driving licence and an overhead crane licence.

As a person, you are
Meticulous, with a strong focus on safety and quality.
Self-motivated, able to take initiative and solve problems that arise in your work.
Cooperative and flexible in your approach.

Submit your application today. Interviews will be conducted continuously.
We look forward to receiving your application in English. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our HR Manager, Maria Taylor, at maria.taylor@sms-group.com.
We look forward to hearing from you.

 På Internationella Engelska Skolan gör vi skillnad i våra elevers liv. Vår framgång bygger på tydliga värderingar, starkt ledarskap och höga förväntningar på både elever och personal. 

Vi arbetar aktivt för att skapa en trygg studiemiljö med fokus på strong behaviour, där ordning, respekt och studiero är centrala för elevernas lärande. Våra skolor har en dynamisk och internationell atmosfär med personal och elever från hela världen.

 Om rollen Som biträdande rektor för årskurs 4–6 blir du en nyckelperson i skolans ledningsteam. Du samarbetar nära rektor, biträdande rektor och Academic Manager för att:

 - Driva och utveckla skolans systematiska kvalitetsarbete. 

- Stärka skolans kultur, värdegrund och arbete kring studiero och starkt elevbeteende. 

- Skapa en trygg, strukturerad och stimulerande miljö för både elever och personal. 

- Stötta och utveckla lärare i deras undervisning. 

- Arbeta för elevernas sociala och akademiska utveckling. 

- Ha nära kontakt och samarbete med vårdnadshavare samt externa myndigheter.

 Vi ser att du arbetar aktivt för att upprätthålla ordning, studiero och tydliga förväntningar på elevernas beteende.

 Vi söker dig som 

- Delar IES värderingar och kan vara en tydlig och trygg ledare. 

- Är en skicklig kommunikatör på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. 

- Har god relationskompetens och kan skapa förtroende hos elever, personal och vårdnadshavare. 

- Är strukturerad, organiserad och lösningsorienterad. 

- Trivs i en dynamisk miljö och är en lagspelare med driv.

 Kvalifikationer 

 Krav: 

- Relevant akademisk utbildning. 

- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av ledarskap med goda resultat. 

- God förståelse för betyg och bedömning enligt Lgr22. 

- Kunskap om skollagen kopplat till undervisning och bedömning. 

 Meriterande: 

- Svensk lärarlegitimation.

- Erfarenhet av arbete som biträdande rektor. 

- Påbörjad eller avslutad statlig rektorsutbildning eller annan chefsutbildning. 

- Erfarenhet av rekrytering eller personalansvar. 

 Anställning Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning. 

Startdatum: Januari 2027

 Ansökan Vi intervjuar kandidater löpande under rekryteringsprocessen och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Two PhD Students in Atmospheric science
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
At the Department of Computer Science, Electrical, and Space Engineering, we are looking for two Ph.D. students in Planetary Science. At LTU, Planetary Science is formally part of the research subject Atmospheric Science. Both projects investigate planetary solid surfaces. The projects will be conducted at Luleå University’s Space Campus in Kiruna. 
 
 
Subject description 
 
Atmospheric science deals with research on the atmosphere of Earth and other planets by modelling along with development and use of instruments for remote sensing and in situ observations. Special focus is on the atmosphere's dynamical, chemical, and physical processes, as well as better weather and climate predictions. 
 
 
Project description 
 
Both PhD projects address the evolution of volatile-rich surfaces on planetary bodies. You will be welcomed into a supportive group of researchers in Luleå University of Technology’s Division of Space Technology, whose focus is on investigating physical properties and processes of solar system bodies using the laboratory experiments and spacecraft measurements. 
 
 
Project A addresses an enigmatic process without terrestrial equivalent: the formation of crusts on the martian surface. You will be tasked with reproducing a crust-like surface regolith in the laboratory under Martian conditions, measure its thermal and mechanical properties, attempt to derive mechanical properties from imagery and accelerometer data of past missions to Mars including InSight and rovers, and compare these. Your results will inform drilling and sample return missions to Mars and your findings may help mitigate the risk to ExoMars and other planetary exploration missions of the future and support projects on planetary mobility in science, education and engineering. 
 
 
Project B is, quite literally, even cooler: it will investigate the surfaces of the icy moons in the outer Solar System. The project will simulate volatile extrusion and ejection, precipitation, crust formation and surface evolution processes in cold vacuum environments. Using laboratory simulations and physical models, you will investigate the link between volatile deposition, surface morphology, and surface mechanical properties. You will compare your results to theoretical models and spacecraft imagery. Your results will help explain spacecraft observations and inform future space missions to the outer solar system. As in project A, the outcomes of this project are expected to be useful for future missions aiming to explore the surfaces of minor bodies in the outer solar system, such as Ceres, Enceladus and Europa. 
 
 
Duties 
 
As a PhD student you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies. You will communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research project, of which you are gradually expected to take ownership. 
 
In collaboration with your supervisors, you will engage in the following research activities: 
 
-laboratory experiments involving environmental simulations; 
 
-analytical modelling of experimental results; 
 
-analysis of remote sensing data and comparison with experimental results; 
 
-dissemination of results at international conferences and in scientific publications. 
 
 
In addition to learning and improving your skills while performing these tasks, you will conduct literature reviews and attend courses as part of your graduate education. Optionally, you may support teaching and other departmental duties, limited to a maximum of one year of the total period not exceeding five years. 
 
 
Qualifications 
 
We are looking for enthusiastic candidates with the ability to work independently. You must have a master’s degree or equivalent in (geo)physics, astronomy, space or planetary science, or a related subject. Good analytical skills with an affinity for experiments are desired. Ideally, you are an effective communicator and fluent in English. 
 
 
For further information about a specific subject see 
 
http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en 
 
 
Further information 
 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Kiruna. Starting: by agreement 
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Urban Water Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
The Urban Water Engineering research group at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural resources engineering at Luleå University of Technology seeks a driven and committed PhD student to investigate how smart monitoring and predictive modelling can support more effective and environmentally sustainable maintenance of urban drainage infrastructure. The research focuses on understanding sediment accumulation through sensor-based monitoring and data analysis, contributing to improved water quality and urban flood resilience. More information on http://www.ltu.se/water
Subject description
Urban Water Engineering encompasses the entire urban water system (storm drains, drinking water supply and wastewater) with respect to collection, transport and treatment, as well as organisation and planning. The research aims to encourage a strong economy, clean environment and the wise use of resources, while preserving the public’s health and safety.
Project description
Stormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.
The PhD research will focus on developing a data-driven understanding of sediment accumulation processes in urban drainage infrastructures. This includes long-term monitoring using high-resolution sensors to capture sediment dynamics across rainfall events and seasons. Based on these data, predictive models will be developed to estimate sediment accumulation and infrastructure’s remaining functionality. The results will support more effective maintenance strategies by identifying when and where maintenances are needed to maximise environmental performance and operational efficiency.
Within this project, the doctoral student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in the water and wastewater industry and will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers through LTU's well-established competence network.
Duties
As a PhD student, you will perform both experimental and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse scientific data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work. The research work for this project will specifically include experimental work.
Qualifications
We seek a candidate with an MSc degree or equivalent or fully completed course requirements of at least 240 ETCS of which at least 60 ETCS are at an advanced level or equivalent. The degree should be within the field of water and environment, environmental engineering, natural resources engineering, civil engineering, or equivalent. Specific knowledge of stormwater management, hydraulics/hydrology, statistics, machine learning, thermodynamics (e.g. heat transfer processes) and programming, as well as experience of sensor-based monitoring, are meritorious. Other important skills are the ability to work independently and take initiative, as well as being able to explore new research areas.
English language skills are required since the results will be presented internationally in scientific journals and at conferences. Swedish/Scandinavian language skills are beneficial, as they will facilitate communication with stakeholders and participation in teaching activities. Having a driver’s license is meritorious, as it will facilitate research work.
Applicants should provide contact details to minimum two reference persons upon request.
For further information about a specific subject see:
* http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en
Further information
Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added to that time with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: Spring 2027.

Engagerade timvikarier sökes till Internationella Engelska Skolan Österåker! Vill du ha ett meningsfullt och omväxlande extrajobb i en internationell skolmiljö? Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Österåker söker nu trygga och engagerade timvikarier till vår vikariepool för läsåret.  Om IES Österåker Internationella Engelska Skolan Österåker är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola belägen i Åkersberga. Vi följer den svenska läroplanen (Lgr22), men upp till hälften av undervisningen bedrivs på engelska av behöriga lärare från hela världen. Vår verksamhet vilar på tre grundpelare: en trygg och ordningsam skolmiljö där lärare kan undervisa och elever kan lära, höga akademiska förväntningar på varje elev samt goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska. Hos oss möter du en varm, strukturerad och mångkulturell arbetsplats med god sammanhållning mellan kollegor.  Om rollen Som timvikarie ingår du i vår vikariepool och täcker upp vid både planerad och oplanerad frånvaro. Arbetet är varierat och innebär ibland snabba kast, du blir oftast kontaktad på morgonen för uppdrag samma dag, men även längre sammanhängande vikariat kan förekomma. Tjänsten passar utmärkt för dig som exempelvis studerar eller har ett flexibelt schema och vill samla värdefull erfarenhet inom skolvärlden.  Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Undervisa och genomföra lektioner i olika ämnen för årskurs 4–9 utifrån ordinarie lärares lektionsplaneringar. Ansvara för och genomföra lektioner för en klass i lågstadiet (F–3) under en heldag. Upprätthålla god ordning, trygghet och skolans värdegrund i klassrummet. Arbeta som vikarie inom vår fritidshemsverksamhet, vilket innefattar att vara stöd i klassrummet, agera rastvakt samt bidra med tillsyn och stöd vid fritidsaktiviteter.  Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som är en trygg ledare, flexibel och en engagerad lagspelare med ett positivt förhållningssätt. Du har lätt för att skapa goda och professionella relationer med barn och ungdomar, tar eget ansvar och känner dig bekväm med att kliva in i ett klassrum med kort varsel.  KravFullständigt gymnasiebetyg.Flytande kunskaper i svenska samt mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.Arbetstillstånd i Sverige.Giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete inom skola och förskola (inte äldre än 6 månader).Möjlighet att hoppa in med kort varsel.

Meriterande Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som timvikarie, elevassistent eller annan relevant roll med barn och ungdomar. Pågående lärarstudier eller annan pedagogisk utbildning.  Ansökan Är du intresserad av att bli en del av vårt team på IES Österåker? Skicka in ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev där du berättar varför du passar för rollen. Ansök direkt via IES karriärsida. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomnar din ansökan snarast, då urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Lärare i svenska (åk 7–9) med starkt klassrumsledarskap till IES Kungsbacka

Vill du arbeta i en skolmiljö där tydligt ledarskap, studiero och höga förväntningar lägger grunden för varje elevs kunskapsutveckling? Nu söker vi en trygg och strukturerad lärare i svenska på heltid till vårt högstadiearbetslag på IES Kungsbacka.

På Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) är läraren en självklar och tydlig ledare i klassrummet. Vårt ethos vilar på övertygelsen att alla elever kan nå sin fulla potential när de möts av en trygg miljö och god arbetsro. I rollen som svensklärare för årskurs 7–9 kombinerar du ditt engagemang för litteratur, läsförståelse och språklig utveckling med en tydlig struktur som skapar fokus och arbetsglädje under varje lektion.

Om rollen och vårt arbetssätt IES Kungsbacka är en internationell skola med cirka 900 elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 9 och medarbetare från hela världen. Vi förenar den svenska läroplanen med en internationell atmosfär och ett väl inarbetat, gemensamt arbetssätt som präglar all undervisning på skolan – från tydliga rutiner vid lektionsstart till enhetliga förhållningssätt i hela verksamheten.

Som lärare i svenska blir du en nyckelperson i ett starkt ämneslag. Du ansvarar för att planera, leda och genomföra undervisning av hög kvalitet i nära samplanering med dina kollegor, där ni tillsammans utvecklar både undervisningen och era gemensamma strukturer. Inom ramen för tjänsten har du även förmånen att vara mentor för 16 elever. Som mentor har du ett nära och övergripande ansvar för dessa elevers akademiska och sociala utveckling.

Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som trivs i ledarrollen, värdesätter tydliga ramar och uppskattar att arbeta utifrån ett etablerat och gemensamt arbetssätt. Du har en god förmåga att skapa lugn, trygghet och goda relationer i klassrummet samtidigt som du utmanar eleverna och driver deras kunskapsutveckling framåt inför gymnasiet.

Kvalifikationer och egenskaper vi prioriterar:

- Legitimerad lärare med behörighet i svenska för årskurs 7–9.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av undervisning på högstadiet samt ett tryggt och tydligt klassrumsledarskap.
- Skicklig på att skapa tydlig struktur, förutsägbarhet och arbetsro i klassrummet.
- Uppskattar att arbeta utifrån ett inarbetat arbetssätt och bidrar aktivt i samplaneringen med ditt ämneslag.
- Professionell, ansvarstagande och med en positiv inställning till varje elevs potential.

Kontakt och ansökan Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Carl Waddington rektor IES Kungsbacka.

Rekryteringen sker fortlöpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag – skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

I tjänsten ingår delat mentorskap. Du har en positiv människosyn och förmåga att skapa goda relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Som lärare hos oss tycker du att det är roligt, stimulerande och utvecklande att undervisa elever från många olika länder och ge varje elev möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar.

Ansvarsområden:

- Planera och genomföra lektioner i idrott och hälsa
- Bedöma elevernas framsteg, ge konstruktiv feedback och föra noggrann dokumentation
- Ha mentorskap för elever i en av de klasser du undervisar
- Samarbeta med kollegor för att skapa en stödjande och inkluderande lärmiljö
- Delta i professionell utveckling och bidra till skolans gemenskap

Vem är du?

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet och legitimation att undervisa i idrott och hälsa i åk 4-9.
- Du har förmåga att anpassa dina undervisningsmetoder för att möta elevernas olika behov.
- Du har ett engagemang för kontinuerlig professionell utveckling och lärande.
- Meriterande: Du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i skola (samt goda kunskaper i engelska).

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Hos oss är studiero viktigt, varför du behöver vara trygg i din roll och ha förmågan att skapa ett gott arbetsklimat bland både elever och kollegor. Du är en lagspelare med hög arbetsmoral som trivs i en internationell skolmiljö. Vidare har du god förmåga att kommunicera och samverka med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare, samt en vilja att vara med och utveckla vår skola.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid (100 %) under perioden januari-december 2027. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-06.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are now taking steps to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.
Job Description
Are you curious about taking the next step into network security? Do you enjoy working with networks, security and protecting critical infrastructure tomorrow? Then this might be your next move. 
As a Network Security Engineer, you will join an international team that safeguards Vattenfall’s networks and supports our journey towards a smarter, more secure energy system.  
Your role 
In this role, you will gradually grow into network security by working hands‑on with experienced colleagues and modern security platforms. Together, we operate and develop secure network solutions across offices, data centres and wide‑area networks. 
You will: 
Work with the operation, development and maintenance of network security infrastructure 
Support secure connectivity across LAN, WiFi, WAN and data centre networks 
Learn how we protect Vattenfall’s networks using tools such as firewalls, proxies and intrusion prevention 
Contribute to security assessments and improvements in new and existing projects 
Collaborate closely with network, infrastructure and security teams across countries 

This role is designed to help you transition into network security, step by step, while building on what you already know. 
Your profile 
You have a solid networking foundation, combined with an experience in security. 
We believe you bring: 
Solid experience in network, infrastructure and security technology
Swedish and good English, both spoken and written 
Working knowledge of routing & switching (e.g. CCNA level) 
Experience with infrastructure security technology 
The ability to work in a structured and careful way, even when things get complex 
Good communication skills and enjoyment of working together with others 

Technologies you will work with:
Firewalls and network security platforms (e.g. Cisco, FortiGate, Check Point) 
Web proxy and secure internet access solutions 
IDS / IPS technologies 
Working together with Security, Network monitoring and management tools 
WAN, LAN and wireless environments 
ITIL‑based operational processes 
Basic scripting or automation (nice to explore over time) 

On‑call duty is part of the role and will be introduced gradually with proper support. 
Location & way of working 
Based at our Solna office next to Arenastaden or - in any Vattenfall IT country for Swedish speakers. 
Hybrid working model (not fully remote) 
Occasional travel for team or project meetings (on average once per month) 

Additional information
At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.
For more information about the position you are welcome to contact IT Recruiter Marta Jura via marta.jura@vattenfall.com
We welcome your application in English latest on the 30th of November

jobs.occupation: Learning Experience Consultant for an International Transformation Project
jobs.description:
About the role
We are looking for an experienced Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner to support the development of a practical and scalable Retail Sales Academy for a global organization within the consumer goods sector. The assignment is focused on transforming an existing Retail Sales Job Architecture and Skills Building Framework into structured, role-based and skill-based learning journeys that are ready for implementation in a modern Learning Experience Platform (LXP).
The Academy will support approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets and cover the areas of Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement. You will work independently with significant ownership of the project while collaborating closely with stakeholders across multiple functions and markets. In your role as Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner, your main responsibilities will include:
Defining the Academy structure, learner navigation and curriculum architecture.
Reviewing and evaluating existing learning content and mapping relevant materials to roles, skills and proficiency levels.
Designing engaging, role-based learning journeys with clear learning outcomes, progression and practical application.
Identifying capability gaps and recommending where existing content should be adapted or supplemented.
Developing a scalable language and localization approach that balances English master content with local-language learning assets.
Preparing learning-path specifications, metadata, taxonomy structures and implementation documentation.
Supporting knowledge transfer and handover to ensure long-term ownership and maintenance of the Academy.
Collaborating with subject-matter experts, managers and other stakeholders to validate learning needs and proposed solutions.

This position is a consulting assignment with an expected duration of approximately 4 months, starting as soon as possible. The role is based at the company´s office in Mölndal.
About you
To succeed in this role, you have extensive experience designing corporate academies, curriculum frameworks and role-based learning journeys. You are comfortable translating business requirements, competency frameworks and capability needs into practical and scalable learning solutions that create measurable business value. You have likely led similar projects before and can quickly familiarize yourself with existing structures, identify stakeholder needs and drive progress independently. You are confident working across multiple functions and markets, building relationships and engaging the right people to gather insights and move initiatives forward.
You have a structured and pragmatic approach, with a strong belief in leveraging existing learning resources before developing new content. You understand how learning journeys should connect formal learning, practical application, manager support and peer learning to drive real capability development.
Important qualifications for the role:
Proven experience designing corporate academies, curricula and learning journey frameworks.
Experience translating competency models, skills frameworks and proficiency levels into learning solutions.
Experience reviewing, curating and evaluating large learning content libraries.
Experience supporting learning programs across multiple countries and languages.
Experience creating implementation-ready documentation, governance models and handover material.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Previous hands-on experience with Cornerstone and Learning Experience Platforms (LXP) is considered an advantage.

Contact Information
If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact the responsible recruiter: Victoria Johansson at victoria.johansson@adecco.se
If you have any questions regarding the application process or registration, please contact our support team at info@adecco.se.
Please note that we do not accept applications via email.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Are you interested in the intersection of IT and treasury/finance? We’re looking for a detailed and collaborative IT support professional who wants to develop their expertise in a global environment. Joining Sandvik Group Treasury, you help shape reliable and effective IT systems while building connections across an extensive international network.  
About your job 
At Treasury, we support our global business in managing financial exposures and transactions. As part of Treasury IT, you ensure high-quality support, maintenance and continuous development of systems used for payments, trade finance, internal invoicing, netting, foreign exchange, credit management and money market deals.  
Job responsibilities 
Provide operational IT support to business key users and other key stakeholders.  
Coordinate IT-related changes with relevant stakeholders.  
Gather business needs and translate them into requirements and directives for system development and maintenance.  
Drive system development in line with our strategy and targets, including opportunities within AI.  
Coordinate acceptance testing, user education and user documentation.  
Participate in IT projects and review, update and report on internal IT general controls.  

Location

Your profile 
Your experience comes from IT, treasury/finance and payments, and you understand IT systems, treasury and finance processes. Perhaps you’ve worked with internal system responsibility in treasury/finance or banking sector or gained comparable experience from another relevant environment.  
Your background includes 
An understanding of IT systems, payments combined with treasury and finance knowledge.  
Experience supporting or taking responsibility for internal business systems.  
The ability to communicate fluently in English and Swedish, both verbally and in writing. 
Stakeholder management and networking skills in an international environment.  

 
Collaborative and curious, you listen carefully and turn business needs into practical solutions. You’re comfortable moving between the bigger picture and important details, while a hands-on and agile approach helps you respond to changing priorities and ad hoc situations.  
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. SO-lärare åk 7–8, vikariat 60 %

Har du ett engagemang för undervisning och en vilja att inspirera unga människor att utvecklas? Är du trygg i ditt ledarskap och brinner för att skapa en strukturerad och stimulerande lärmiljö? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Om IES Årsta

Internationella Engelska Skolan Årsta är en grundskola för årskurs 4–9 med cirka 440 elever och 60 medarbetare. Vi är stolta över vår internationella gemenskap och den mångfald som präglar vår verksamhet. Hos oss står höga akademiska förväntningar, trygghet och respekt i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en skolmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential.

Skolan ligger i Årsta med goda kommunikationer till både Gullmarsplan och Årstaberg.

Mer information om IES och våra skolor hittar du på www.engelska.se.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker en engagerad lärare som vill ta över undervisningen i SO för elever i årskurs 7–8 under vårterminen. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 60 % med anledning av föräldraledighet.

I rollen ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisningen samt skapa goda förutsättningar för elevernas lärande och utveckling. Du blir en del av ett kollegialt sammanhang där samarbete, tydlig kommunikation och ett gemensamt ansvar för elevernas skolgång är viktiga delar av vardagen. 

Vi söker dig som

- Har ett genuint intresse för undervisning och ungdomars utveckling.
- Är trygg i ditt ledarskap och kan skapa struktur, tydlighet och studiero i klassrummet.
- Har förmåga att planera och genomföra engagerande undervisning.

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens utbildning på Interntionella Engelska Skolan i Halmstad?

Vi söker nu en behörig lärare i NO/Teknik för åk 7-9 med svensk lärarlegitimation på heltid. Här på IES får du vara en del av en internationell och trygg lärandemiljö där alla elever står i centrum och får de bästa förutsättningarna för sitt livslånga lärande.

Om oss

Internationella Engelska Skolan har i över 30 år haft en positiv inverkan på sina elevers utveckling. Vi är övertygade om att detta framgångsrika resultat kommer från vårt starka etos, där engagerade och närvarande ledare skapar en miljö där alla strävar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får lärarna fokus på det viktigaste – undervisning och lärande. Eleverna är alltid i centrum, och alla elever är dina elever. Vi tror på värderingar som grund för framgång, och samarbete är en självklar del av vårt sätt att arbeta.

Vad innebär tjänsten?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidare anställning på heltid med start 7/1. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning. I tjänsten ingår mentorskap. 

Som en del av vårt engagerade arbetslag och ämneslag kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med dina kollegor för att verkligen göra skillnad i elevernas utveckling. Vår starka tro på elevernas potential genomsyrar vår undervisning, och du kommer tillsammans med dina kollegor skapa en trygg, strukturerad och utvecklande lärmiljö där eleverna får möjlighet att både utmanas och stimuleras.

I rollen arbetar du nära både lärarkollegor och stödpedagoger i ett nära samarbete, där vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. Du får dessutom ansvaret för mentorskap för en klass, vilket ger dig möjlighet att skapa långsiktiga relationer och bidra till en positiv skoldag.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har lärarexamen i NO och Teknik och svensk lärarlegitimation. Du är en pedagog med god insikt och förmåga att omsätta läroplanens mål i ditt dagliga arbete. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd och har ett tydligt ledarskap som gör att du står starkt i dina elevgrupper och skapar en positiv lärandemiljö.

Du är öppen, kommunicerar på ett rakt och ödmjukt sätt och skapar tillitsfulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Då undervisningen sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi både svenska och engelska, behöver du behärska båda språken flytande i tal och skrift.

Ansökan

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 

Intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret är ett krav om du blir erbjuden tjänsten.

Job description
Are you passionate about molecular biology, assay development, and shaping the future of precision medicine?
We are currently looking for a hands-on and collaborative R&D Development Engineer for a 6-month consulting assignment at a world-leading, innovative life science company in Uppsala. Join a dynamic R&D team driving groundbreaking protein biomarker discovery!

About the Role
As part of an innovative R&D organization focusing on proteomic sciences, you will play a key role in building and evaluating novel protein biomarker panels for future translational products. This position combines practical, hands-on laboratory work with close cross-functional collaboration, translating scientific concepts into robust, scalable solutions that empower researchers worldwide.

To succeed in this role, you are curious, structured, and a true team player. You enjoy hands-on bench work in a fast-paced R&D environment where open communication and knowledge sharing are valued. You are motivated by contributing to innovative technologies that advance biomedical research and improve human health.
As a consultant at Randstad Life Sciences, you get the opportunity to work at a cutting-edge company in the life science sector while having the security of a collective agreement, competitive salary, pension, insurances, and wellness allowance. You will also have a dedicated Consultant Manager supporting you throughout your assignment. Selection and interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the final application date. We look forward to receiving your application in English as soon as possible!

Responsibilities

Plan and execute laboratory experiments according to project plans and timelines.

Evaluate assay and panel performance using established analysis tools and quality criteria.

Analyze, document, and communicate experimental results following standard operating procedures.

Collaborate across multidisciplinary R&D teams to achieve product development milestones.

Participate in technical discussions, troubleshooting activities, and scientific reviews.

Support the transfer of product specifications and knowledge to internal stakeholders.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of laboratory methods, workflows, and development processes.

Qualifications
Required:

M.Sc in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

2–5 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience in assay development, product development, or laboratory-based research.

Practical experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS library preparation, and/or immunoassays.

Strong ability to analyze and interpret experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Proven ability to thrive and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

Experience with multiplex protein detection technologies or molecular diagnostics platforms.

Experience with laboratory automation systems and high-throughput workflows.

Familiarity with LIMS and structured experimental documentation.

Knowledge of product development processes within regulated environments.

About the company

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

We are looking for a Dutch-speaking Customer Service Representative to join STRONGER for a full-time maternity cover position from March 2027 until August 2028, with the possibility of extension.
At STRONGER, Customer Service is an important part of the entire customer journey. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine passion for service with strong technical aptitude, a solution-oriented mindset and excellent written communication skills in Dutch and English.
The Role
You will support our customers via email, chat and occasional phone support, handling questions about products, orders, deliveries, returns, payments and technical issues throughout the e-commerce journey.
Alongside your Customer Service responsibilities, you will support our E-commerce and CRM teams with Dutch-language translation and localization for our website, newsletters and other customer-facing content. Your ability to write clear, natural and engaging Dutch that reflects the STRONGER tone of voice will be an important part of the role.
You will also collaborate across teams, identify recurring customer issues, share insights and contribute to improvements in our customer experience and internal processes.
Key Responsibilities
Provide professional, personal and solution-oriented customer service via email, chat and phone, primarily for Dutch-speaking customers.
Assist customers with products, orders, deliveries, returns and payments.
Investigate and troubleshoot technical and system-related issues across multiple platforms.
Translate, proofread and localize website content, newsletters and other e-commerce communications into Dutch.
Ensure Dutch copy is accurate, consistent, engaging and aligned with the STRONGER brand voice.
Collaborate with E-commerce, CRM, Operations, Logistics and Tech when needed.
Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes and the customer journey.
Work towards Customer Service KPIs and shared team goals.

Who We’re Looking For
You are proactive, structured and solution-oriented, with a genuine interest in providing great customer service. You enjoy taking ownership, working both independently and as part of a team, and switching between customer conversations and written content tasks.
You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable learning digital systems, investigating problems and finding practical solutions.
Requirements
Fluent Dutch, both written and spoken, with excellent spelling, grammar and the ability to adapt your tone for different audiences.
Strong English skills, both written and spoken.
Previous Customer Service experience, preferably within e-commerce or a digital environment.
Strong technical aptitude and confidence working across multiple digital systems.
Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a structured way of working.
Ability to maintain high service quality in a fast-paced environment.
Confidence in writing, editing and proofreading customer-facing content in Dutch.

Nice to Have
Experience with Zendesk, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Centra.
Technical troubleshooting experience within e-commerce.
Experience with automation, AI-supported customer service tools or similar technologies.
Additional languages: Swedish, German and/or French.
Previous experience with translation, localization, newsletters or e-commerce copywriting.

How to Apply
Please send your CV and cover letter to madelene@stronger.se.
In your application, highlight any experience with the systems, technical areas, translation or localization tasks, and additional languages listed above, including your level of proficiency.
Use Dutch-Speaking Customer Service Representative as the email subject line.
Employment: Full-time (100%), fixed-term maternity cover, March 2027 – August 2028, with the possibility of extension.
Start date: March 2027
Location: Stockholm
We look forward to hearing from you!

Du arbetar bra i team, men kan också ta egna initiativ.

Vi sätter barnet i centrum under hela skoldagen. Vi har en positiv inställning till elevers och kollegors förmågor och vi reflekterar ständigt över hur vi som vuxna tillsammans kan påverka den undervisning vi bedriver i en positiv riktning.

jobs.description:
