You’ll have ownership of your work, from early concepts and wireframes through to testing and improvement.
At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. What you’ll be doing
You’ll design UI for new features and game systems, creating wireframes, mockups, and interaction patterns that make complex functionality clear and easy to use. You’ll bring your designs into Unity using UI Toolkit, working hands-on to turn them into polished, functional experiences.
You’ll playtest and evaluate your work regularly, gathering feedback and using it to improve the player experience. You’ll work closely with game designers, client developers, artists, and other team members throughout planning, development, and testing.
You’ll also contribute to how we work with UI as a discipline. This includes establishing best practices, creating useful workflows, and helping maintain consistency across the game. Is this you?
You’re an experienced UI Designer with professional experience designing for games, including mobile and touch interfaces. You have worked on at least one game in a free-to-play, midcore, turn-based strategy, live-operated, or external IP environment, with experience across several of these areas being particularly relevant.
You have experience implementing UI in Unity, and if you have experience with UI Toolkit that would be great. You’re comfortable working with tools such as Figma, the Google Suite, and Adobe Suite, and have experience with version control such as GitHub.
You care about practical UI/UX design and getting your work into the hands of players. You understand common patterns and best practices in mobile games, but also know when consistency needs to give way to a better solution for the player or the product.
You pay attention to detail and understand that not every problem needs a perfect solution. You’re comfortable giving and receiving feedback, asking questions, and discussing your ideas openly. Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?
We are now looking for a Senior Game Designer
Join the Helldivers 2 team and expand our mission toolbox with more systemic variables, more dynamic objectives and more room for emergent shenanigans.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll come up with ideas for missions and game modes, then build, script, balance and debug them yourself in the engine.
What you'll do:
From Ideation to Game: Create missions. You’ll draft the core loop, flow and win/fail conditions, then script the working prototype yourself

Design for Modular Worlds: Create mission structures and objectives that work with our semi-procedural map generation

Design for Sandbox Emergence: Create mechanics that cut across mission objectives to spark unexpected encounters

Engine Scripting: Script objective flows, encounters, interactable objects and success/fail states in our in-house engine

Stress-Test & Debug: Test and debug your own setups, chasing down edge cases, logic breaks and performance issues so your missions hold up in live multiplayer

Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Work closely with Level Design, Tech Design, Code, UI, Art and Audio

Iterate with Live Data: Use telemetry, completion rates and player feedback to balance and improve missions after release

Mentor & Lead: Share best practices in encounter flow, system design, and design documentation with other designers.

Who you are:
You’re as passionate about co-op shooters as we are. You’re friendly and helpful, but also efficient, hard-working and dedicated to the game design craft. You also…

Have about 5+ years of game design experience in AA/AAA, with at least one shipped title where you personally implemented missions, encounters or systems

Are comfortable scripting in the engine (Lua, Python, C# or similar). You can build mission logic and state machines without relying on engineers for the basics

Are a Systems Thinker who understands player psychology, systemic design, pacing and core loops

Have Autonomy & Problem-Solving skills that take a high-level pitch like “a multi-stage sabotage operation against an Automaton strongpoint”, break it down, greybox it and see it through to release

Are able to write Clear design docs and explain your decisions to other disciplines

Have Strong Co-op Sensibilities, to know what makes shared victory feel earned and team failure feel hilarious rather than cheap

Are a Master of Emergent Sandbox Chaos, to balance objectives around unpredictable systems like roaming AI, physics and destructible environments

Have Great English skills, both written and spoken

How to apply
If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.
We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.
Practical Information
Scope: Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period

Location: Office first, hybrid solution possible with minimum 3 days per week in the office

Eligibility: You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.
What we offer
Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.
Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. There are a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.
Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.
 
Employment information
Employment: Temporary employment
 
Period of employment/Start date: 2027-02-01
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-18
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences (FTH)/Department of Engineering Sciences (ITV)
 
Third-cycle subject: Energy and environmental science
Admission to third-cycle (doctoral) education is regulated in MDU’s admission regulations, which compile national and local rules for eligibility and admission to doctoral studies at Mälardalen University. https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/education/third-cycle-studies
 
The doctoral position includes full-time employment as a doctoral student for the duration of the education, which corresponds to four years.
Position description
The doctoral student will work in the PyroMet project, where we develop a computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-based digital twin of an industrial slag fuming furnace together with Boliden, Linde and Luleå University of Technology. The research focuses on understanding and modelling reactive multiphase flows at high temperature, where gas and slag interact through chemical reactions. The student will develop physics-based models of the fluid flow, heat transfer and reactions in such systems, and will use machine learning to build fast simulation methods that keep the accuracy of high-fidelity CFD. The aim is to support both the experimental and numerical activities of the project, further develop the existing numerical modelling framework for submerged injection, and optimise the relevant system components to improve the efficiency and performance of the slag-fuming process.
 
The work combines theoretical and experimental fluid dynamics with modern computational tools, Optimisation methods and also data-driven methods. Part of it will be done together with the industrial and academic partners.
 
The doctoral student is responsible for his own doctoral education, following the individual study plan. This includes planning and carrying out research together with supervisors and colleagues, publishing the results in peer-reviewed journals, and completing 60 credits of courses.                                                       
Entry requirements, General entry requirements, Specific entry requirements, Selection criteria
 
This advert is abridged. To see the full advert, please go to:  https://www.mdu.se/en/malardalen-university/about-mdu/work-with-us/job-opportunities
 
We value the qualities that an even distribution of age and gender, as well as ethnic and cultural diversity, can contribute to the organization.
 
Application
The application is to be completed online. Please submit your application by clicking on the "Apply" button below.
The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete in accordance with the advertisement and will reach the university no later than closing date for application. The application should include the required documents to confirm eligibility and provide grounds for merit assessment. Degree certificates and/or transcripts must always be included and must be officially issued by the degree-awarding institution.
Documents may be submitted in Swedish or English. Supporting documents in other languages must be translated into Swedish or English by an authorized translator. Copies of the original documents in the original language must also be included.
If the admitted candidate requires a residence permit to stay in Sweden and pursue their studies, and if the studies require physical presence at Mälardalen University, the university reserves the right to withdraw the admission decision if a valid residence permit cannot be presented by the start date of the studies.
We look forward to receiving your application!

The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 

Job Description
Are you committed and passionate about delivering solutions that support our business? Do you go the extra mile to understand requirements and processes that enable us to propose and build solutions that meet business needs and expectations?

Then you should apply and become part of our department Customer Metering & Settlement Solutions as a Functional Consultant and use your talent to reach Vattenfall's business goals.
Customer Metering & Settlement Solutions, which is part of Customer IT that develops and operates specialized IT solutions based on SAP IS-U and SAP CRM supporting all Nordic business units in Vattenfall that have a customer relation.

About the position  
As a SAP IS-U Consultant (Metering and Supplier switch), you are responsible to provide expertise to ensure that stable and reliable solutions are designed, developed, implemented and maintained and you will contribute to quality assurance activities to meet business needs.

Initiate and maintain continuous dialogue with business stakeholders
Monitor system activities on a daily basis
Handle and resolve incidents
Create functional/technical design of error corrections, small assignments and projects.
Secure that implemented changes fulfill business needs and are compliant with relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies / guidelines.
Coordinate changes and collaborate with other departments

We believe that you have strong communicative skills and a creative and analytical mindset. You master Swedish and English in both spoken and written format. You are always eager to learn more even though you already have in-depth SAP IS-U knowledge and/or functional SAP and/or energy market experience since many years. Service Notification/Order
EDM
Device Management
Market communication (EDIEL) and Idoc processes
Web Services

Functional knowledge and experience related to SAP IS-U e.g. Billing and Invoice processes, Workflow

At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we create the technology that keeps the world moving. With over 13,500 colleagues, we are passionate about supporting companies of all sizes in meeting today's and tomorrow's material handling challenges. We recognize that our industry is essential-and often critical-to everyday life and society as a whole.
From our headquarters in Mjölby (Sweden) and Willebroek (Belgium), to our sales companies across Europe and our factories in France, Italy, and Sweden, you can be part of an extraordinary journey. Together, we are moving the world towards easier, more sustainable solutions.
The Position
At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we are now looking for a structured and proactive Project Coordinator Manager to join our strong team within Service & Logistics department. We have a very active role in all development projects around the R&D centers in Europe and in this role, you will manage the complete lifecycle of the products - from concept and development through industrialization and production launch until the usage of our products at our customer sites, all from an aftermarket perspective.
Together with your colleagues you will provide valuable input to ensure that aftermarket requirements are captured, and you will follow up on key activities to secure successful project outcomes. You will work in cross-functional project teams where you will play a central role in ensuring that all spare parts data and information are accurate, complete, and available throughout the project lifecycle.
You will report to the Manager of Parts Project Coordination
Your responsibility
Participate as a core team member in product development projects, representing the Service & Logistics function and ensuring requirements and activities are identified, coordinated, and followed up.
Collaborate closely with multiple departments across Toyota Material Handling, including Project Management, Product Management, R&D, Purchasing, Production, Order Management, and Aftermarket.
Manage spare parts related activities together with key suppliers, including external truck manufacturers producing products under Toyota brands (OEM).
Keep the organization informed and engaged regarding project status, milestones, and ongoing activities.
Follow the Engineering Change process in development projects, ensuring aftermarket requirements are validated and implemented in ERP systems.
Ensure all spare parts are accurately documented in Spare Parts Catalogues and available for ordering through ERP systems (SAP).
Work cross-functionally to continuously improve processes, ways of working, and collaboration across departments.
Ensure compliance with TMHE policies, guidelines, and requirements.
Your Profile
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build strong relationships at all levels of the organization.
Well organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured and efficient manner.
Proactive and driven, with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for developing both processes and ways of working.
Experience working in cross-functional teams and collaborating across larger organizations.
Experience or knowledge of Toyota Material Handling products is considered an advantage.
Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
Experience working with systems such as SAP, Enovia, and the Microsoft Office suite.
A degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or equivalent professional experience.

At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we're more than a global leader in a fast-paced industry-we're a collaborative team driven by innovation, continuous growth, and creating real value for our customers. Our diverse and international environment offers a workplace where your ideas are valued, and your contributions can make a meaningful impact. We offer a competitive benefits package, including an annual bonus and flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance. jobs.description:
Lärare i NO åk 4-9 vikariat under vårterminen 2027,

 40% NO 4-9 möjlighet till förlängning - finns även möjlighet att kombindera med ca 20-40% matematik om så önskas.

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerad och närvarande lärare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum och alla elever är våra elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. Din egen undervisning sker på svenska men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska. 

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare i NO för ett vikariat under VT 2027, möjlighet till förlängning finns och möjlighet att kombinera med matematik finns om man önskar t.ex 60-80% tjänst.

Tjänsten är på heltid. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Arbeta som lärare i åk 4-9.

 Du ingår i ett arbetslag med lärare 4-9 och i ett ämneslag i NO. I ditt arbete ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp din undervisning utifrån LGR22. Du har även ett mentorskap vilket innebär att du har ett övergripande ansvar för elevernas kunskapsutveckling. Du har en nära dialog med elevernas vårdnadshavare och genomför utvecklingssamtal.  

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygghet, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans i team med lärarkollegor, stödpedagoger och fritidspersonal. Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling. I teamet hjälps pedagogerna åt med planering, undervisning och elevernas skoldag. 

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med behörighet i alla 4 NO ämnen, samt svensk lärarlegitimation. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du har ett tydligt ledarskap och står starkt i dina elevgrupper. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. 

Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll undervisar du på svenska och engelska. Kollegor emellan pratar vi svenska och engelska.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se 

Glöm inte att bifoga CV, personligt brev och din lärarlegitimation. Märk ansökan med ”Lärare NO 4-9 vik VT27”.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret uppvisas vid intervjuer.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.description:
Environmental Coordinator
OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden
Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure
HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.
We are currently looking for a collaborative Environmental Coordinator to join the OL31 railway project in Vagnhärad. This is a role within one of Sweden's most important infrastructure projects, where safety, coordination and collaboration are critical to success.
About the Project
The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.
The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.
About the Role
As an Environmental Coordinator, you will support the project organization in the daily management of environmental matters and ensure compliance with project, client, and regulatory environmental requirements. You will act as the environmental team's operational representative within the production organization, providing hands-on support on site and helping to identify, manage, and mitigate environmental risks at an early stage.
Key Responsibilities
·        Conduct regular environmental inspections, site walks, and environmental audits.
·        Provide day-to-day support and guidance to site management and production teams on environmental matters.
·        Monitor compliance with environmental requirements from Trafikverket, authorities, permits, and project procedures.
·        Support and participate in investigations of environmental incidents, deviations, and non-conformities, and follow up on corrective actions.
·        Support production teams with matters related to material and soil mass management.
·        Monitor water management activities, treatment solutions, and environmental protection measures.
·        Ensure compliance with project chemical management requirements and support chemical handling processes.
·        Prepare, maintain, and follow up environmental documentation, records, and reporting.
·        Act as the operational link between the environmental function and the production organization.
·        Promote environmental awareness and best practices across the project.
Your Profile
Mandatory Requirements
·        2-4 years of experience in environmental coordination within construction, civil engineering, infrastructure, or similar projects.
·        Practical experience working closely with production teams on active construction sites.
·        Experience with environmental inspections, soil and material management, water management, and chemical management.
·        Ability to independently identify, manage, and resolve environmental-related issues.
·        Strong communication and collaboration skills.
·        Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
·        Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
·        Valid Category B driving license.
 Preferred Qualifications
·        Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or railway projects.
·        Knowledge of Swedish environmental legislation and authority requirements.
·        Experience working with environmental permits, compliance monitoring, and contractor environmental management.
·        Experience supporting environmental investigations and corrective action processes.
·        Familiarity with Trafikverket's environmental requirements and project environments.
·        Relevant academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
Language Requirements
·        Fluent Swedish, preferably native-level or equivalent proficiency.
·        Professional English language skills, both written and spoken.
 We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.
Expected start date: Q1 2027 (January or February).

 
Location
 Vagnhärad, Sweden
Apply
If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,
or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ 
Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

Do you want to shape trade compliance for a global business while staying close to real deals and day-to-day operations? At Business Area Rock Processing, we’re looking for a Trade Compliance Officer to lead our work across sanctions, customs, global trade and export controls. You combine a strong understanding of international trade compliance with a practical mindset and the confidence to turn complex requirements into effective ways of working. 
About the job 
You own and develop our trade compliance framework in line with Sandvik policies, helping our Divisions translate requirements into practical processes and controls. Working across the business, you combine governance with hands-on support in deals, projects, and operational matters. You report to our Chief Compliance Officer.  
Job responsibilities 
Establish monitoring and controls, support authority audits and represent Rock Processing in Sandvik’s trade compliance network at all levels in the organization. 
Improve trade master data and integrate compliance controls into how we buy, ship and sell, including screening, review and approvals. 
Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, US, UK, China and other markets, and prepare the business for major changes such as the EU Customs Reform. 
Own restricted party screening, conduct trade compliance due diligence and advise on risks, controls, contract clauses, Incoterms and customs matters. 
Support third-party risk activities and M&A. 
Develop and deliver training to internal teams and key partners. 

Location and flexibility 
The position is based in Malmö, Stockholm or Sandviken, Sweden. Other Sandvik locations in Europe may also be considered. Occasional travel is included in the job. 
Your profile 
You bring extensive experience in trade compliance within an international environment, ideally from an industrial company, and you’re comfortable working across both governance and operational matters. Your expertise covers sanctions, customs and export controls, and you know how to apply complex requirements in a global business. 
Your background includes: 
Solid knowledge of EU and US trade regulations, including customs classification, sanctions management, origin, valuation and Incoterms. 
Experience working with trade processes and data in ERP systems. 
Experience covering sanctions, export controls and customs, from governance through to operational implementation. 
Fluency in English, verbally and in writing. 

Experience with authority audits, licensing and external advisors is an advantage, as is knowledge of anti-bribery and corruption compliance, or data privacy. 
You’re independent and hands-on, with the drive to learn and take on new challenges. With strong integrity and a pragmatic mindset, you know when to stand firm and communicate complex topics clearly across different audiences. Reports to: Middle School Principal

Job Description
Teacher for Swedish Language and Literature for Middle Years Programme, grades 6 - 9. This is a Permanent part-time position (60%).  
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers. 	
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond. 

Duties/Responsibilities:
A teacher is responsible for the preparation, instruction and follow-up involved in teaching the designated curricula. 
A teacher also has the following duties and areas of responsibility:
● The academic, personal and social welfare of students
● Assessing learning and grading all students in relation to the curricula
● Collaborate with Language B and Language A Teachers on placement tests and transition policies.
● Informing parents with regard to academic and social questions
● Actively participating in Parent/ Teacher/Student conferences
● Comfortable with the use of technology in the classroom, for example the use of ManageBac, Google Classroom, Seesaw, etc
● Ensuring that student attendance is checked and recorded in accordance with the security regulations of the school
● Attending and taking part in planned meetings set by the school and or leadership.
● Attending other meetings called with 2 weeks’ notice
● Being an advisor/mentor for projects e.g. Personal Project (MYP) 
● Learning and Incorporating Positive Discipline practices both in and out of the classroom
● Serving as Homeroom teacher, or Advisory teacher* when appointed/elected. 
● Acting as leaders for Sport/outdoor events during directed working time 
● Being available for school trips or learning outside of school. 
● Actively contributing to teams, committees and task forces.
● Contributing to the development, documentation and implementation of curriculum.
● Participating in Professional Development
● Upholding the Child Protection measures implemented at school

Qualifications and Experience: 
● Be familiar with IBMYP curricula or and equivalent international curricula
● Fluent in written and spoken English and Swedish
● Have excellent communication skills
● Be able to establish rapport with adults and students
● Be able to work effectively in a team
● Be able to function effectively under pressure
● Perform their duties conscientiously
● Be able to show initiative and work independently
● Have a pleasant and friendly personality
● Preferred qualification to teach other disciplines

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 
Contract: Part-time (60%) (Posibility of more time if the candidate is willing teach Swedish in the Primary 20%) 
Permanent Contract (with a 6-months probationary period) 
Salary: Fixed salary (salary scale)
Starting: January 7, 2027

Application: 
Last day for applications December 6, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier). Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen. SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. Please send a letter of interest, your CV and two references to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Secondary Swedish MYP Teacher”.

jobs.occupation: Product Development Project Manager  Supplier Risk & Crisis - Automotive
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Development Project Manager – Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Senior Product Development Project Manager / Supplier Risk Leader
Specialisation: Automotive Product Development | Supplier Risk Management | Crisis Management | Project Leadership | Stakeholder Management
Seniority: Senior
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Language: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Type: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Product Development Project Manager to take responsibility for supplier risk management and crisis coordination within a complex automotive product development environment.
In this role, you will work closely with product owners, project leaders and senior engineering stakeholders to identify potential supplier-related risks at an early stage, coordinate appropriate actions and ensure minimal disruption to product development activities.
You will play a key role in managing critical situations, driving cross-functional collaboration and improving processes related to supplier risk identification, escalation and crisis management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Identify, assess and proactively manage supplier-related risks affecting product development activities.
Monitor early risk indicators and initiate appropriate actions to prevent potential disruptions.
Coordinate crisis management activities and ensure timely responses to critical situations.
Prepare risk-related cases and support decisions on appropriate actions and next steps.
Ensure relevant resources are engaged and stakeholders are informed.
Guide engineering and product development teams through challenging supplier-related situations.

2. Project & Stakeholder Coordination
Collaborate closely with project leaders, crisis management teams and product owners.
Maintain regular communication with product owners to anticipate potential issues and identify effective solutions.
Coordinate risk-related activities across different product development organizations.
Facilitate discussions and ensure alignment between engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
Support effective decision-making and ensure clear ownership of actions.
Communicate risks, priorities and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders.

3. Risk Assessment & Decision Support
Analyse supplier-related challenges and evaluate their potential impact on product development.
Prepare decision-making material and recommend appropriate courses of action.
Ensure the right technical and organizational resources are involved in resolving issues.
Support prioritization of activities based on business impact, urgency and operational requirements.
Drive issues towards resolution through structured follow-up and coordination.

4. Process Improvement & Leadership
Develop and improve working methods for supplier risk and crisis management.
Identify opportunities to improve risk identification, escalation and communication processes.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Legitimerad speciallärare med inriktning mot matematikutveckling till IES Sigtuna 

Vill du arbeta på en skola där specialpedagogisk kompetens spelar en central roll för att varje elev ska lyckas? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna söker en engagerad och legitimerad speciallärare med kompetens inom matematikutveckling. Vi söker dig som vill säkerställa att våra elever får rätt stöd, vid rätt tidpunkt och utifrån sina individuella behov, med särskilt fokus på elever som behöver stöd i matematik. 

Du har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas och lyckas. Du är trygg i din profession, väl insatt i specialpedagogiska arbetssätt och van vid att omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken. Du ser till elevens hela skolsituation och förstår att framgångsrika insatser bygger på nära samarbete mellan elev, vårdnadshavare, lärare, elevhälsa och skolledning. 

IES Sigtuna är en mångkulturell och tvåspråkig skola. Du behöver därför kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och väl på engelska. 

Om rollen 

Som speciallärare arbetar du både direkt med elever och konsultativt gentemot skolans lärare. Beroende på elevernas behov arbetar du enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. 

En viktig del av uppdraget är att kartlägga och stödja elevers matematiska utveckling. Du planerar, genomför och följer upp riktade insatser för elever som behöver särskilt stöd i matematik. Du handleder även lärare i hur matematikundervisningen kan anpassas och göras mer tillgänglig. 

Du blir en viktig del av skolans SEN-team och arbetar nära elevhälsoteamet, vår Student Care Manager, våra Academic Managers och skolledningen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni skolans arbete med extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd, skolnärvaro och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. 

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter 

• Undervisa och stödja elever enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. • Kartlägga elevers matematiska utveckling och identifiera hinder för lärande. • Planera, genomföra och utvärdera riktade stödinsatser i matematik. • Handleda lärare i anpassad och tillgänglig matematikundervisning. • Genomföra pedagogiska kartläggningar och utredningar. • Utarbeta, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram. • Dokumentera insatser och elevärenden i ProRenata. • Arbeta med elever som har problematisk skolfrånvaro. • Observera lektioner och handleda lärare kring extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. • Delta i möten med elever, vårdnadshavare, kollegor och externa aktörer. • Samverka med elevhälsan och skolledningen kring stödinsatser. • Bidra till utvecklingen av skolans elevhälsoarbete. 

Vi söker dig som 

• har svensk lärarlegitimation och speciallärarexamen med inriktning mot matematikutveckling, • har kunskap om matematiksvårigheter och metoder för att stödja elevers matematiska utveckling, • har erfarenhet av pedagogiska kartläggningar, utredningar och åtgärdsprogram, • har erfarenhet av elever med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och andra behov av särskilt stöd, • har god förståelse för skolans styrdokument och bestämmelser om särskilt stöd, • uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och kan kommunicera väl på engelska, • arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och lösningsorienterat, och • har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och samarbeta med andra. 

Erfarenhet av problematisk skolfrånvaro och dokumentation i ProRenata är meriterande. 

Om IES Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever. Undervisningen bedrivs på svenska och engelska i en internationell och mångkulturell miljö. 

Hos oss står kunskap, trygghet och höga förväntningar i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en lugn och välstrukturerad skolmiljö där eleverna kan fokusera på sitt lärande och utvecklas både akademiskt och socialt. 

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett engagerat och internationellt kollegium som värdesätter samarbete, tydlighet och professionellt ansvar. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via IES Careers!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.occupation: FMT (Trelleborg) is looking for a MANUFACTURING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Dabico FMT designs and builds passenger boarding bridges for airports and seaports around the world. FMT has more than 50 years of experience and is based in Trelleborg, Sweden. Its bridges are in service at more than 85 airports and seaports. FMT is owned by Dabico, a US-based group that supplies airport ground support equipment. We are now ramping up our operations in Sweden, and we’re looking for an engineer who understands design and knows how to turn it into bridges that are right first time and efficient to build.
We welcome candidates with a few years of experience as well as those with more extensive backgrounds. What matters most is your motivation to develop, learn, and gradually take on greater responsibility within the team.
Main responsibilities
Review designs and drawings together with our design engineers for manufacturability, cost and ease of assembly – and propose improvements before they reach the floor.
Translate designs into production: bills of materials, process plans, routings and work instructions.
Define fabrication, welding and assembly methods, fixtures and tolerances for large steel structures and glass-walled tunnels.
Support the production floor day to day – solve technical issues, handle deviations, and feed lessons learned back into the design.
Work with suppliers and other Dabico production sites on make-or-buy decisions, sourcing and component quality.
Ensure our bridges are built to the relevant standards for quality, welding and safety (e.g. EN 1090, ISO 3834, EN 12312-4).
Work closely with our experienced design engineers for guidance and competence development.

The position is full-time, based in Trelleborg. We are a small company where everyone works toward shared goals. You will report directly to Head of Engineering. Occasional business trips are expected a few days per quarter. 
Qualifications and profile
Degree in mechanical or production engineering, or similar.
Around 2–3 years or more of experience in manufacturing or production engineering, preferably with welded steel structures or large mechanical assemblies.
A solid understanding of mechanical design – you read drawings critically, understand tolerances and can see how a design will be built.
·Experience with 3D CAD and drawings, and with BOMs and ERP systems.
Knowledge of welding and fabrication methods; experience of lean or continuous improvement is a plus.
Fluency in English and good proficiency in Swedish.
Hands-on and comfortable spending time on the production floor as well as at the desk.
Curious, analytical, and solution oriented.
Ambition to grow into the role and take on more responsibility, and a team player who wants to be part of a skilled and technology-driven organisation.

Contact and application
In this recruitment process, we co-operate with the recruitment company ComCube. If you are interested and match the profile, please apply through the link with a cover letter and a CV in English where you describe your experience and expertise in the areas outlined above. Please answer the following questions in your cover letter:
Why are you interested in the position as Manufacturing Engineer at FMT?
What do you think you can contribute as Manufacturing Engineer at FMT?

If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process or the position, you are very welcome to contact our consultants in this process: Helena Heijmink, +46 70 554 03 42, helena.heijmink@comcube.se, or Helena Fransson, +46 70 554 05 04. This is an ongoing selection, so please apply as soon as possible. We can only accept applications through the link. 
FMT is a privately owned company with more than 50 years of experience in design, manufacturing and delivery of innovative passenger handling and operational support systems for airports and seaports worldwide. All research & development, manufacturing and the direction of the sales & marketing take place at FMT´s headquarters located in Trelleborg, Sweden. FMT works closely with partners around the world. FMT´s range of products includes a wide variety of Passenger Boarding Bridge Systems, specifically designed to meet the particular needs and requirements of an airport or seaport and after-sales support. FMT´s expertise lies in creating tailor-made solutions to improve safe, flexible and fast turnarounds for airports and seaports with high passenger flows.
For more information, please visit https://www.fmt.se/

Sinch is looking for a forward-thinking Senior Product Designer to drive the next generation of our design system infrastructure. Rather than focusing solely on maintaining static components, you will take a central role in redefining how our visual language, layout principles, and patterns operate in an AI-assisted product development lifecycle. Your mission is to define the visual standards, semantic tokens, and clear system guidelines (.md files) that allow both human designers and AI-agents to generate cohesive, high-quality, and on-brand UI across multiple product suites. This is a unique opportunity for a system-level designer who wants to bridge the gap between creative visual craft and generative AI.
Drive the vision and architecture for an AI-ready design system, creating a framework of semantic rules and patterns optimized for prompt-based UI generation.
Collaborate closely with our central Brand team to ensure Sinch's brands are accurately and consistently represented in our digital product patterns and component libraries.
Translate our design patterns into clear, structured instructions and guidelines (.md files) that allow engineering teams and AI-agents to reliably generate on-brand interfaces.
Collaborate closely with design leadership and stakeholders to establish the long-term roadmap for our global design system across multiple Sinch products.
Work with your fellow product and engineering partners to build, test, and ship scalable design system tooling. 
Partner with and support product teams globally, ensuring they have the tools, templates, and guidance to design and develop quickly using the system.
Ensure high standards of accessibility (WCAG), usability, and visual quality are deeply baked into the underlying system architecture, so they are automatically inherited during UI generation.
Experiment with and pioneer new workflows that integrate AI-assisted design and prototyping tools directly into our daily design system operations.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant experience as a Design Systems Designer or Senior Product Designer working on complex, multi-product design systems at scale.
Deep understanding of design system architecture, including advanced token strategies, component lifecycles, and keeping design patterns aligned with code.
Experience in generative AI frameworks, prompting structures, structured markdown (.md files), and how LLMs interpret design semantics and visual rules. 
A strong strategic and visionary mindset, with a proven history of defining direction and driving alignment with design leaders, product managers, and engineering stakeholders.
Excellent collaboration and advocacy skills, comfortable presenting to and educating diverse product teams on new workflows and design system standards.
Outstanding craft and execution skills, with a portfolio showing systematic thinking, clear design documentation, and a strong eye for visual consistency and modern UI patterns.
Strong understanding of how design translates to code (HTML/CSS, React, Tokens), as you do not need to be a production engineer, but you should easily speak the same language as developers.
Comfort conducting user research and discovery as part of a product trio to understand how internal teams use the design system and where friction exists.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Stockholm as the preferred location and Malmö as an alternative. You’ll report to the Director, Product Design. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
Why this role matters
As Sinch scales, keeping our products coherent across multiple platforms requires a fundamentally new approach to design systems. By designing the infrastructure for AI-assisted workflows, you will enable teams to ship features faster while keeping our interfaces accessible and on-brand. Your work will directly shape how every product team at Sinch designs and builds, transforming our design system from a static reference library into an active engine for AI-assisted, high-quality product development.

Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for creating awesome character design concepts, magical environment concepts and whatever is needed to enhance game experience? Are you excited about crafting vibrant visuals for mobile games that captivate millions of players?
As a Concept Artist at Snowprint, you’ll have a broad role with plenty of room to influence the visual direction of our new game project. You’ll mainly work on character and outfit concepts, but also contribute to props, items, environments, key art, and whatever else is needed to bring the game’s visual world together.
You’ll be part of a small team where your ideas and perspective matter. You’ll work closely with the Art Director, other artists, designers, and developers, with the freedom to take ownership of your work and find solutions rather than simply working from a list of tasks.
At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and a shared passion for making great games are key to creating a good place to work and great games.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll primarily create concepts for characters and their outfits, developing ideas that can be translated into 3D models and eventually brought into the game. You’ll work from early ideas through to more detailed concepts and turnarounds, making sure your designs communicate the character clearly and give the 3D team what they need to take them further.
You’ll also create key art and title screens, as well as concepts for props, items, environments, and other visual elements when needed. The role gives you the opportunity to work across different types of concept art and contribute to the overall visual quality of the game.
You’ll work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the art team, sharing work early, discussing ideas, and responding to feedback throughout the process. You’ll be encouraged to explore different approaches, adapt your style to the needs of the game, and keep moving rather than over-polishing before getting feedback.
Is this you?
You’re an experienced Concept Artist with professional experience working on at least one released game. Experience from a stylized, fantasy, or high-fidelity game is particularly relevant.

You have a strong understanding of character design, including anatomy, proportions, clothing, poses, lighting, composition, mood, and surfaces. You know how to make designs feel visually interesting while still having a clear function and purpose.

You understand the path from concept to 3D. You know how to create clear character turnarounds and other concepts that give 3D artists what they need to build and implement the asset.

You’re adaptable and comfortable working within an established art direction. You can adjust your style to what the game needs and are comfortable working across characters, props, environments, and key art.

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio
Strong character / creature appeal and design fundamentals

Dynamic / interesting character presentation

Work samples showing confidence in human and animal anatomy

A strong understanding of light and material behaviour

Clear character sheets for 3D artists

Where you’ll work
Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.
We’re unable to support relocation for this position, so you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden.
About Snowprint Studios
Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment, while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.
Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.
For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.
At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.
Good to know
We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

Mälardalens Arkitektur är ett konsultföretag som stöttar bygg- och industriprojekt med teknisk och miljömässig expertis. Vi arbetar nära långvariga kunder inom industriell tillverkning och hjälper dem att möta ökande krav på klimatredovisning, materialeffektivitet och hållbart byggande. Läs mer på vår webbplats: https://malardalensarkitektur.se/sv/.
Vi har ett långvarigt samarbete med ett stort företag, en ledande tillverkare av separatorfilm för litiumjonbatterier. Vår kund bygger upp sin europeiska produktionsbas i Eskilstuna, där de två första fabrikerna redan är under uppförande. Inför ett nytt uppdrag för vår kund med start 2027 utökar vi vårt team med en miljöingenjör / LCA-analytiker.

Rollen
Du kommer att leda livscykelanalyser och miljöanalyser för bygg- och industrianläggningsprojekt och arbeta direkt med våra kunders projekt- och hållbarhetsteam. Rollen kombinerar teknisk analys med rådgivning, och du hjälper kunderna att förstå miljöpåverkan av sina material- och utformningsval.
Arbetsuppgifter
Genomföra livscykelanalyser enligt ISO 14040/14044 och SS-EN 15978 för byggnader och industrianläggningar
Upprätta klimatdeklarationer och stötta arbete med miljöcertifiering (t.ex. Miljöbyggnad, BREEAM)

Samla in och strukturera miljödata från leverantörer, entreprenörer och produktionsprocesser
Stötta kunder med beräkningar av klimatavtryck och hållbarhetsrapportering, inklusive krav kopplade till CSRD
Skriva tydliga tekniska rapporter och presentera resultat för kunder och projektgrupper

Kvalifikationer
Civilingenjörsexamen/masterexamen eller högre inom materialvetenskap, miljöteknik, kemiteknik eller närliggande område
God förståelse för material, deras produktionsprocesser och miljöpåverkan
Erfarenhet av LCA-metodik och minst ett LCA-verktyg (t.ex. SimaPro, Sphera/GaBi, openLCA eller One Click LCA)
Stark analytisk förmåga och förmåga att kommunicera tekniska resultat till icke-specialister
Flytande engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande
Erfarenhet av industriella eller batterirelaterade material
Kunskap om svenska regler för klimatdeklaration av byggnader
Kunskaper i mandarin

English:
Environmental Engineer / LCA Analyst MÄLARDALENS ARKITEKTUR – Eskilstuna
About us Mälardalens Arkitektur is a consultancy that supports construction and industrial projects with technical and environmental expertise. We work closely with long-standing clients in industrial manufacturing, helping them meet growing demands on climate reporting, material efficiency and sustainable construction. Please visit our homepage for more info: https://malardalensarkitektur.se/sv/.
We have a long-standing collaboration with our client,  a leading manufacturer of separator film for lithium-ion batteries. Our client is building its European production base in Eskilstuna, with its first two factories there already under construction. Ahead of a new assignment for our client starting in 2027, we are expanding our team with an Environmental Engineer / LCA Analyst.
The role You will lead life cycle assessments and environmental analyses for construction and industrial facility projects, working directly with our clients' project and sustainability teams. The role combines technical analysis with advisory work, and you will help clients understand the environmental impact of their material and design choices.
Responsibilities
· Perform life cycle assessments according to ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15978 for buildings and industrial facilities
· Prepare climate declarations (klimatdeklarationer) and support environmental certification work (e.g. Miljöbyggnad, BREEAM)
· Evaluate and interpret EPDs and material data, and advise on lower-impact material alternatives
· Collect and structure environmental data from suppliers, contractors and production processes
· Support clients with carbon footprint calculations and sustainability reporting, including CSRD-related requirements
· Write clear technical reports and present results to clients and project teams
Qualifications
· Master's degree or higher in materials science, environmental engineering, chemical engineering or a related field
· Solid understanding of materials, their production processes and environmental impacts
· Experience with LCA methodology and at least one LCA tool (e.g. SimaPro, Sphera/GaBi, openLCA or One Click LCA)
· Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate technical results to non-specialists
· Fluent in English, spoken and written
Meritorious
· Experience with industrial or battery-related materials
· Knowledge of Swedish regulations on climate declarations for buildings
· Mandarin language skills
Employment terms
· Type: Permanent position (tillsvidareanställning), full-time
· Start: By agreement
· Location: Eskilstuna, with travel to client sites as needed
· Salary: Individual salary according to agreement
How to apply Send your CV and a short cover letter to info@malardalensarkitektur.se no later than 15th Jan, 2027. Selection is ongoing, so feel free to apply early

jobs.description:
Behörig speciallärare till F–3 sökes!

Är du en behörig och erfaren speciallärare som kan inspirera och stödja våra elever på IES Kista? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Kista öppnade 2015 och har idag omkring 640 elever från F till årskurs 9. Vi är övertygade om att vårt tydliga etos och våra engagerade och närvarande ledare bidrar till en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare möjlighet att fokusera på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör – alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella Engelska Skolan arbetar vi som ett team och strävar åt samma håll. För att trivas hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande samt gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi vill att varje elev ska känna sig trygg och trivas i en stimulerande lärmiljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga.

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker en kvalificerad och erfaren speciallärare som ska arbeta specifikt med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3. Du har ett positivt förhållningssätt och en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga att utvecklas.

Tillsammans med klasslärare, fritidsassistenter, specialpedagog och övrig personal i elevhälsoteamet arbetar du för att skapa en trygg, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö. Du bidrar med speciallärare kompetens och stöttar elevernas kunskapsmässiga och sociala utveckling.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

- planera, genomföra och följa upp riktade stödinsatser för elever i F–3
- undervisa enskilda elever och elever i mindre grupper
- stödja elever i klassrummet vid behovs
- arbeta förebyggande och främjande tillsammans med klasslärare och elevhälsoteamet
- handleda lärare och samarbeta med övrig pedagogisk personal
- arbeta med ett särskilt fokus på språk-, läs-, skriv- och matematikutveckling.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100 procent, med tillträde så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Provanställning tillämpas under de första sex månaderna.Vem är du?

Det är ett krav att du har:

- svensk lärarexamen och svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i F–3
- speciallärarexamen eller specialpedagogexamen
- dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 3.

Du har god pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att omsätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du är trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap och i mötet med eleverna. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Som en närvarande och reflekterande pedagog utmanar och stimulerar du eleverna i deras utveckling.

Du ser samarbete som en viktig framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen. Du kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Du har erfarenhet av pedagogisk dokumentation och av att upprätta och följa upp åtgärdsprogram. Du har goda kunskaper om NPF och tydliggörande pedagogik samt erfarenhet av positivt beteendestöd och lågaffektivt bemötande.

Du är positiv, lösningsfokuserad och samarbetsvillig samt beredd att ingå i ett internationellt team.

I din roll undervisar du på svenska och/eller engelska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personalen. Du behöver därför behärska både svenska och engelska väl, i tal och skrift.

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se:https://engelska.se/our-schools/kista/about-our-school/

Intervjuer genomförs löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret och giltig ID-handling krävs.

What will you do?
As a AI/ML Engineer at Rebtel you will define how AI is done at Rebtel. What tooling we standardise on, how we evaluate models we put in front of real users, what "good" looks like for our prompts and our pipelines. AI is going from a side project to the core of how Rebtel operates and what we ship to our users. We're hiring the second engineer on our ML/AI subteam to help build it classical ML for the business, LLM-powered systems for the product, and a clear production mindset on both.
You'll sit inside the Data team, report to our Head of Data, and partner with one other ML/AI engineer to shape this capability from the ground up.
Areas of ownership: You'll own work across two complementary tracks, and you'll ship in both.
Classical ML, in production, for operational leverage

Risk and fraud models across payments, top-ups, and account behaviour

Churn prediction and retention modelling on a user base of a million-plus

Forecasting, pricing, segmentation, and the next batch of operational problems we haven't tackled yet

Owning models end-to-end scoping with stakeholders, building, deploying, monitoring, retraining

LLMs and AI agents, from internal automation to in-product features

Start with our customer support agents and automations: RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, tool-use, evaluation harnesses

Move LLM capability into the product as user-facing features

Help guide the company on where AI actually creates leverage, what to build, what to buy, what to ignore and turn the good ideas into shipped systems

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

4+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python, with real production ownership not just notebooks

Strong fundamentals in classical ML: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and the unglamorous parts of keeping a model healthy in prod

A genuine production mindset: monitoring, retraining, eval harnesses, CI/CD for models, and the instinct to debug when something drifts at 2am

Comfort working the whole loop: stakeholder scoping → data → model → deployment → measurement → iteration

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to translate between business problems and ML ones

Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents

Built RAG systems, agentic workflows, or LLM-backed products that real users (or real internal teams) actually used

Comfortable with vector databases, embeddings, prompt evaluation, and measuring LLM systems with something more rigorous than vibes

Obsession with staying up-to-date on developments in the AI space 

Experience with a major cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure), containers, and a modern data stack

Experience in MLOps tooling: MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes and feature stores is a plus

Background in fintech, payments, telecom, or other regulated / operational domains is a plus

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The role is hands-on and focuses on making sure that content is accurate, customer-friendly, aligned with the relevant brand and tone of voice, and correctly published.

Good written and spoken English.

A structured and detail-oriented way of working.

A genuine interest in AI and new digital tools, and curiosity about how they can change the way we work.

Experience with CMS platforms or content publishing is a plus but not required.
Start: January 2027 or by agreement Location: Stockholm

About this opportunity
Are you a recent graduate in electrical engineering or a related field, curious about wireless technology and eager to work hands-on in a lab? Join Ericsson’s Radio Verification organization and help design and verify the test environments used to assess the performance of multi-standard radio products.
 
As part of the Test Environment 1 team, you’ll work with RF components, measurement equipment and laboratory setups. You’ll help make sure these environments meet their requirements and deliver reliable results. You’ll learn from experienced colleagues, collaborate with suppliers and build practical expertise at the intersection of RF engineering, wireless communications and product quality.
 
What you will do
Support formal design verification of test environments for radio performance verification of multi-standard radio.
Plan, develop and implement calculations for RF components and complete test environments.
Prepare and maintain formal requirement specifications for components and test environments.
Work with suppliers to evaluate and optimize component performance.
Troubleshoot, maintain and improve lab environments used for design and performance verification.
Collaborate with colleagues across the Radio Verification organization and contribute to shared team goals.

 
The skills you bring
A recently completed bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
A solid foundation in RF and communications theory, and an interest in wireless systems. Coursework or specialization in RF/microwave engineering, wireless communications or communication systems is a strong plus.
Familiarity with RF components such as amplifiers, filters or directional couplers, and RF instruments such as signal generators and spectrum analyzers.
Analytical skills, attention to detail, and a practical approach to troubleshooting. Lab experience is a plus.
Good written and spoken English.
Familiarity with Windows, Microsoft Office, Linux and basic networking is beneficial.

 Job Overview
Assignment Description
Work with a turbine engineering team on the development, analysis and technical support of gas turbine components.
The role focuses on heat transfer calculations, component temperature analysis, CFD simulations and the development of internal engineering tools. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and contribute to technical investigations, design improvements and ongoing development projects.
What You Will Work On
Perform calculations and analyse temperatures in gas turbine components.
Develop models and simulations using internal tools and commercial CFD software.

In this role, you will work with complex data structures, security-related entities and relationships, building scalable graph database solutions. You will also contribute to integrating graph data with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines using GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying.
You will collaborate with technical teams to develop reliable data architecture, automate ingestion workflows and ensure secure and efficient access to graph data.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop Knowledge Graph architecture, ontology and data models.

Build and maintain graph data ingestion pipelines.

Implement GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying to integrate graph data with LLM-based applications.

Develop and manage graph database solutions using Neo4j and Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin).

Integrate data ingestion and graph update workflows into CI/CD pipelines.

Manage graph database configurations, updates and data relationships.

Ensure data quality, consistency, scalability and secure access to graph information.

Collaborate with engineering, AI and cybersecurity teams.

Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j.

Experience with Azure Cosmos DB and Gremlin API.

Strong background in data engineering and data modelling.

Experience designing and developing Knowledge Graphs and ontologies.

Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration of data workflows into automated pipelines.

Understanding of graph querying, database architecture and data relationships.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with GraphRAG and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Experience integrating graph databases with LLM applications.

Knowledge of vector databases and hybrid search solutions.

Experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or security data analytics.

Experience with cloud-based data engineering solutions.

Are you someone who thrives in a collaborative environment where attention to detail makes a real difference? Perido is now looking for a Document Controller who wants to play an important role in supporting a major project within the green energy and manufacturing sector. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a large-scale initiative while working closely with a dynamic team!
About the position
Perido are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Document Controller to join our client’s team. The client company is an industrial company driving large-scale initiatives in green energy and manufacturing. This role is essential to ensuring the integrity, accessibility, and traceability of the technical documentation and data that support the success of one of our client’s large-scale projects. The role is based at the client’s office in Stockholm, where you are expected to be on-site minimum three days per week.
Your daily tasks

The role involves close collaboration across different functions, where you will promote best practices within the wider project delivery team. You will also ensure that Document Control processes are followed and clearly communicated as part of the project onboarding.
Key responsibilities:
Become a subject matter expert in EDMS (OMEGA 365), providing system support and guidance to the project team
Configure and maintain the EDMS to ensure documents are accurately filed in accordance with established document control procedures
Work with key stakeholders to populate and maintain each Master Document Register (MDR) and Document Distribution Matrix (DDM) for your assigned project area, ensuring deliverables are tracked and distributed appropriately
Set up automated distributions based on the DDM to ensure timely and accurate delivery of documents to relevant stakeholders
Assist internal and external parties in preparing and submitting documentation with correct metadata and access permissions
Help the site team locate and compile documentation required for regulatory compliance and project handover
Provide one-on-one support and training to project team members on document management processes, including locating, exporting, reviewing, and approving documents
Contribute to the development and refinement of document control procedures and work instructions
Respond to information requests and technical queries related to documentation as needed
Assist with tasks such as verifying document formatting and compliance with templates, printing/scanning, and managing physical document archives

Your characteristics
To succeed in this role, you are highly organized, detail-oriented and proactive, with a strong focus on achieving results. You have excellent communication and time management skills and enjoy collaborating with others, while also being able to take responsibility and work independently when needed. You are adaptable and comfortable managing several tasks simultaneously, always maintaining a structured and solution-oriented approach. Furthermore, you are confident in taking initiative, sharing your knowledge and supporting colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient workflows.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Fot this position we only accept applications written in English.

A degree in Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience working as a Document Controller or in a similar capacity
A thorough understanding of the document and data requirements of construction projects
Previous experience working with electronic document management systems
Proficiency in English (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly communicate technical information

Meriting:
Previous experience working with Omega365, Autodesk Construction Cloud is a plus

Full-time consulting assignment through Perido until 2027-06-30. Start 2026-12-15.
Let us help you take the next step in your career

We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities.
