Would you like to use your experience in open pit mining to influence both technical solutions and operational practices? As a Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan, Sweden, you’ll take on broad responsibilities covering mine design, mine planning, drilling, blasting and water management.You’ll join a lean organisation with short decision-making processes, working closely with production and seeing your recommendations put into practice. In this newly established role, you’ll share your expertise and contribute to both the existing open pit operation and the planning of a larger future open pit.This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with a broader perspective on mine development in an international environment where English is the working language.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
Work in a lean organisation with close collaboration and the opportunity to see your technical recommendations put into practice.
An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement are key priorities.
A flexible and rewarding work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.
Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.

Your Responsibilities
Develop and optimise open pit mine design, mining sequences and short- and long-term production planning.
Plan bench development and mining sequences, contributing to the future development of Björkdal´s open pit operations.
Provide technical support for drilling and blasting, including design, quality control and performance monitoring.
Work with dewatering, drainage and water management to prepare new mining areas.
Monitor production performance and technical data, translating analysis into improvements in safety, productivity and cost efficiency.
Support production technicians through technical problem-solving, knowledge sharing and the development of operational practices.

The Bigger Picture
This is a full-time, permanent position based at Björkdalsgruvan, near Skellefteå, Sweden. You will work regular daytime hours with flexible working arrangements based on trust and responsibility. The role is primarily site-based, with some flexibility depending on operational needs.
This is a newly established position where you will work closely with a small team consisting of two production technicians and a supervisory function. Initially, you will report directly to the Mine Manager and collaborate with the mine´s other planning functions.
Björkdal´s open pit operations are entering an exciting phase of development. The existing open pit has an expected remaining operational life of 3–4 years, while a potential expansion of the original Björkdal main open pit could extend operations by at least another 5–6 years. This offers you the opportunity to contribute to both ongoing production and technical challenges that will shape the mine´s long-term development.
Our Expectations
The most important qualification is several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining operations. You may have worked as a Mining Engineer, Open Pit Engineer, Mine Planner or Drill and Blast Engineer.
To succeed in this role, you will need:
Several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining.
A solid understanding of mine design, mine planning, drilling and blasting.
A degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience with mine planning and design software, along with the ability to learn new systems.
A valid Category B driving licence and good English communication skills.

It would be an advantage if you have:
Swedish language skills.
Experience supporting and developing other technical team members.

As a person, you are solution-oriented and confident in your technical judgement. You can identify challenges, develop practical solutions and clearly communicate your recommendations to colleagues with different areas of expertise. You are comfortable working independently while also valuing close collaboration with production and technical teams.
Interested?
The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with Talent Navigation Group (TNG), a recruitment and staffing company, and the technical recruitment specialists at TNG Tech. By taking a broader perspective on technical expertise, they identify more engineers, technicians and managers who match the needs of Swedish employers, both today and in the future.We look forward to receiving your application with your CV or LinkedIn profile. No cover letter is required.Please note that we do not accept applications via email, but you are always welcome to contact the recruiter by email if you have any questions.Once you have submitted your application, we will anonymise your personal information and invite you to complete a couple of recruitment assessments before conducting an initial objective evaluation. You will receive more information about each step as the process progresses, and you can track the status of your application in real time through our website.Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.We look forward to receiving your application!

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology
Third-cycle subject area
Biology
Description of the doctoral project
 
The apical hook is a temporary organ structure that forms at the tip of the stem (hypocotyl) in darkness, aiding the germinating seedling as it emerges through the soil. Apical hook formation serves as an excellent model to study plant morphogenesis, as it involves distinct phases of growth promotion and inhibition. The phytohormone indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) is central to plant morphogenesis. This project focuses on investigating the modulation of auxin's spatiotemporal distribution in response to mechanochemical signals during development in Arabidopsis thaliana.
About the position
The research will utilize a range of approaches, including molecular biology techniques, cell biology methods (such as confocal and electron microscopy), mechncobiology experiments, physiological studies, proteomics, and genetic analysis.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have:
been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification;
satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or
acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
You must have equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
The applicant should have a strong interest in plant biology, molecular plant biology, mechanobiology or related fields. A background in cell and molecular biology is essential. Previous experience or expertise in mechanobiology or plant cell wall biology would be considered an advantage.
The successful candidate should be highly motivated, driven and curious, with good interpersonal and communication skills. After an initial training period, they are expected to take increasing responsibility for their research, show initiative, and work independently, while continuing to receive guidance from their supervisor.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English are essential.
Beyond academic qualifications, we place great importance on personal integrity, honesty, open communication and a collaborative attitude. We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing both successes and difficulties, communicates openly about challenges and mistakes, takes responsibility for their work and contributes positively to a supportive and constructive research environment.
About us
The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

Acting as a bridge between technology and business, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in Finance and Commercial, as well as maintain ongoing dialogue with external system vendors. The role is based at our client’s office near Humlegården in Stockholm, following a hybrid work model where you are expected to be on-site at least three days a week.
This is initially a 6-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with great opportunities for long-term employment with our client thereafter
You are offered
A unique opportunity to build valuable experience within the regulated and expanding global medtech industry.
Close mentorship and continuous support from senior architects in a welcoming, low-prestige environment.
Hands-on experience working at the forefront of modern AI tools for code generation and system automation.
An international workplace collaborating across global markets, including the UK and the US.

Work tasks
This role focuses on backend development, business system integrations, and process automation rather than frontend or app development. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure data flows securely and efficiently across platforms.
Take technical ownership of the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and Salesforce.  
Build and maintain integrations between business systems, the data lake, and the AWS platform using REST APIs (JSON payloads) and AWS Lambdas.  
Automate manual workflows and commercial processes using Python and TypeScript scripts as well as low-code tools.  
Leverage modern AI coding assistants to accelerate development, focusing on reviewing, understanding, and ensuring the quality of generated code.  
Write and optimize database queries in SQL, SuiteQL, and SOQL to extract, validate, and reconcile business data.  
Collaborate closely with Finance and Commercial teams to translate business requirements (from quote-to-order and contracts to usage and billing) into concrete technical solutions.  
Ensure high data integrity, accurate numerical reconciliation, and strict compliance with data privacy and information security standards.  
Coordinate and communicate with external system suppliers regarding ongoing integrations and system updates.

We are looking for
A recently completed academic degree (M.Sc. or B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related technical field.
A solid foundation in programming (such as Python, Java, or TypeScript) and the ability to quickly grasp system architecture and codebases.
A basic understanding of commercial and financial flows, including quote-to-order, contracts, invoicing, and usage-based billing.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as English is the corporate language (Swedish is not required, though you must hold a valid work permit for Sweden).

Prior experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or AWS is not required—what matters most is your technical foundation, business curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.
To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Business-minded and communicative: You enjoy interacting with people, feel comfortable initiating dialogue with colleagues and external vendors, and can turn vague requests into clear technical specifications.
Detail-oriented and quality-driven: You are meticulous with numbers, always double-check that data reconciles before handing it over, and respect the high standards of data privacy required in medtech.
Analytical problem-solver: You quickly understand cause and effect in complex environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

When critical IT incidents occur, clear coordination and decisive action make all the difference. As Global Incident Manager, you lead the response to major and high-impact incidents, bringing the right people together to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.  
You join Service Management and work within the Service Stability area alongside Global Incident Managers and colleagues focused on Incident, Problem and Event Management. 
About the job 
You’re the central coordination point during major and critical IT incidents, creating structure, driving progress and ensuring clear communication, escalation and decision support. Your scope covers global Incident Management operations, including major incidents, escalation support and Cybersecurity Incident Management (CSIM) when assigned. Your focus is operational incident leadership, while using hands-on experience and lessons learned to continuously improve our ways of working.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead and coordinate the end-to-end response to P1, major and other high-impact incidents. 
Establish effective command and control, with clear responsibilities, action tracking and decision points. 
Bring together resolver teams, service providers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to drive incidents toward resolution. 
Remove blockers and escalate when service restoration, business continuity, security or regulatory targets are at risk. 
Provide timely and clear communication to operational teams, business stakeholders and leadership. 
Facilitate post-incident reviews, follow up lessons learned and improvement actions, monitor recurring issues and contribute to improvements in processes, tools and capabilities. 
Take part in on-call duties and respond to incidents outside normal business hours, according to the agreed operational model. 

Location 
The position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken. 
Your profile 
You’ve built solid experience in Incident Management or a similar operational IT field and know how to coordinate major incidents in complex environments. Working across multiple stakeholders comes naturally to you, and you combine operational IT knowledge with a structured approach to service management. 
Your background includes: 
Experience with IT service-management processes and tools in a global or multi-stakeholder environment. 
A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience in IT operations, service management or a related field. 
ITIL Foundation or an equivalent service-management certification. 
Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. 

Experience in process improvement, governance, cybersecurity incident response or crisis management is beneficial. Advanced certification within ITIL, Incident Management, security, process management or crisis management, as well as additional relevant languages, are also considered an advantage. 
Being calm and decisive under pressure, you create clarity when situations are complex and moving quickly. You communicate clearly with technical, business and leadership audiences, take ownership and persistently drive incidents toward service restoration. You’re comfortable influencing others without formal authority while turning incidents and deviations into opportunities for learning. 
Our culture 
Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? 3+ years as Process Owner/Product Owner or similar role in digital solutions supporting aftermarket sales, service, finance

Curious, self motivated and problem solver

Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO
As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
You will:
Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
We are looking for people with:
Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
An example of our benefits:
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

international organisations and non-governmental organisations working to advance the sustainable use of natural resources worldwide. The work of the clients may include but is not limited to international collaboration, policy engagement, knowledge sharing, and capacity development.

the development and implementation of international programmes and policy
initiatives related to sustainable resource governance.

decision-making. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic international environment with governments, multilateral organisations, research institutions, NGOs, and private sector stakeholders.

Conduct policy analysis and research on environmental governance issues at local, national, and international levels.
Engage with governments,international organisations, donors, and other stakeholders to advance programme objectives.

Contribute to the development
of policy briefs, reports, technical papers, and knowledge products.
Organise and facilitate workshops, consultations, conferences, and multi-stakeholder dialogues.

Monitor developments in international environmental and water policy and identify implications for programme activities.
Represent the organisation in external meetings, working groups, international forums, and professional networks as required.

Master's degree or higher in Environmental
Governance, Environmental Policy, International Development, Natural
Resource Management, or a closely related field.
Minimum eight (8) years of relevant professional experience in sustainable governance of natural resources or related fields.
Demonstrated experience working in the Global South with international environmental and sustainability policy processes.
Proven experience organising and hosting events at international conferences related to natural resource management.
Experience engaging with senior government officials, ministries, public authorities, intergovernmental organisations, and other high-level stakeholders.
Strong understanding of environmental governance, environmental policy, sustainable development, and international cooperation frameworks.
Experience working in Sweden with Swedish stakeholders.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, research, drafting, and report-writing skills.
Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills.
Advanced computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite and practical experience with SAP, Microsoft Project, or similar enterprise and project management systems.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively contributing to multinational and multidisciplinary teams.
Willingness and ability to undertake extensive international travel.

Desirable Qualifications
Additional language skills, particularly Spanish, Swedish, German, or other internationally relevant languages.
Experience working with international NGOs, UN organisations, development agencies, research institutions, or donor-funded programmes.
Experience in natural resource management approaches.
Knowledge of international environmental agreements and global sustainability frameworks.
Experience in programme management, monitoring and evaluation, donor reporting, and partnership development.

Personal attributes
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Strong intercultural awareness and the ability to build effective relationships across diverse cultural, political, and institutional contexts.
Proven capacity to engage confidently with high-level decision makers and represent the organisation in international forums.
Excellent diplomatic,negotiation, and communication skills.
Strong project coordination and organisational abilities.
Initiative, adaptability, and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive issues and stakeholder relationships.
A strong commitment to sustainable development and environmental stewardship.

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to contribute to global efforts that strengthen sustainable development worldwide.
A dynamic and international work environment with engagement across governments, multilateral organisations, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
The opportunity to work with leading experts and decision makers in the fields of environmental governance, and sustainable development.
A competitive compensation and
benefits package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Excellent opportunities for professional growth.
Exposure to high-level international policy processes, conferences, and strategic initiatives.
An inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven organisational culture that values innovation,
diversity, and impact.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are invited to submit:
A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.
A detailed CV in English.
Contact details for three professional references.

Applications should be submitted no later than dec 13 2026 to: Sales@Huntconsulting.se 
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates may be contacted for interviews prior to the application deadline. The organisation reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a suitable candidate has been identified.
Hunt Consulting AB is managing this recruitment. All applications will be treated with the utmost confidentiality. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Data Protection Notice (GDPR)
For questions regarding the processing and management of your personal data, please
contact Sales@Huntconsulting.se.

We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced night nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine passion for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has an injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. A nanny must therefore always be present and available when he is with her, providing essential practical support.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Night Nanny – Responsibilities
He usually goes to bed around 20:00 and sleeps until 05:30–06:30, occasionally waking briefly.
Responsibilities include:
Being available and monitoring his wellbeing throughout the night.
Comforting and assisting him if he wakes.
Preparing breakfast, meals and snacks.
Completing morning routines and getting him ready for nursery.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing and spending quality time together.
Supporting his interests and activities.
Packing his nursery bag.
Making beds and keeping his areas tidy.
Child-related laundry and ironing when needed.
Light household tasks, including tidying up and wiping kitchen surfaces.
Administering medication when required.

The nanny sleeps in a separate area with the child, away from the mother.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and genuinely passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
We are looking for someone who will genuinely care about his happiness and development and bring warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!

Lead and coordinate the annual budget process and ongoing budget follow-up.
Ensure monthly reconciliations, financial monitoring and reporting.
Oversee year-end reconciliations, accruals, financial statements, closing procedures and external audits.
Establish, maintain and monitor effective internal controls and financial procedures.
Oversee procurement, purchasing, contract management and related administrative processes.

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

Strong analytical skills and experience in business and operational performance management.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable recommendations and well-founded decision-making support.

From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it. 
At Husqvarna Group, within Global Aftermarket Operations P&A, our Supply & Inventory Planning team ensures that products flow efficiently from our factories and external suppliers to our sales companies and distributors. Our mission is to provide customers with the right products, at the right time, while maintaining capital efficiency and operational excellence. 
We are now looking for a Supply & Inventory Planner to join our team in Huskvarna. Pro-actively monitor supply risks, mitigate and escalate internally & externally. 
Balance availability and capital efficiency by managing inventory and driving the elimination of slow-moving articles within your assortment 
Maintain and continuously improve planning parameters and master data, including article setup and registration, to ensure accurate planning and execution. 
Be an active  part in product launches and phase-outs and support resolving quality issues. 
Drive improvements and play an active role in organizational change initiatives. 

Who we are looking for 
You are a structured, analytical, and driven problem solver who thrives in a collaborative environment. You demonstrate strong personal leadership traits, such as initiative, accountability, and adaptability, and you value the potential for continuous improvement and positive change. You are service-minded, flexible, and able to manage multiple stakeholders while balancing competing priorities. 
Your skills and background 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
University degree in logistics, economics, or equivalent professional experience. 

You will be welcomed into a company and a culture that values collaboration, personal leadership, and continuous improvement. Whether you have recently graduated or already gained some relevant experience, we offer an opportunity to build your skills and grow within our organisation. You do not need to have all the answers from day one; what matters is your curiosity, willingness to learn, and motivation to contribute. 
Location: 
This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe in a dynamic, energized workplace and day-to-day collaboration, and we meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%). 
Your application 
Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations. 
For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Samuel Spjuth, at samuel.spjuth@husqvarnagroup.com.  
For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.  
We look forward to hearing from you!  
Processing of personal data 
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. 
For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice. 
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.     
Our culture is built on three core themes:

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Test Fleet Engineer – Expert | Vehicle Fleet Management & Test Operations
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Test Engineer – Expert (Test Fleet Engineer)
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience
Language: English
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Test Fleet Engineer at Expert level to support advanced vehicle testing and engineering operations.
In this role, you will take responsibility for ensuring maximum availability and utilization of test vehicles throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with project management, engineering teams, testing departments, workshops and external suppliers to ensure that vehicles are maintained, prepared and available for their planned test activities.
The position combines vehicle fleet management, technical coordination, project planning, logistics, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Test Fleet Management & Vehicle Uptime
Ensure maximum uptime and availability of the complete test vehicle fleet.
Act as the first point of support for vehicle uptime and coordinate support for field-test vehicles.
Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting vehicle availability.
Coordinate activities during unplanned vehicle stops, including workshop resources and necessary repairs.
Monitor vehicle utilization and identify opportunities to improve fleet efficiency.
Plan and coordinate vehicle maintenance between testing and loan periods.

2. Workshop & Technical Coordination
Coordinate internal and external workshop resources to ensure timely vehicle repairs and maintenance.
Identify, order and manage spare parts, materials and required services.
Arrange towing and special transportation between different testing locations.
Coordinate vehicle readiness and ensure appropriate documentation before transportation.
Manage external supplier activities and follow up on related invoices.
Ensure that vehicle modifications, updates and damages are properly documented.

3. Fleet Optimization & Project Coordination
Analyse individual vehicle and overall fleet utilization.
Optimize the number of vehicles required to support ongoing testing activities.
Coordinate timely divestment of vehicles to optimize fleet size and reduce unnecessary capital tied up in vehicles.
Participate in project meetings and lead actions related to vehicle uptime and fleet optimization.
Communicate requirements, provide recommendations and share knowledge with relevant stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities meet established test fleet requirements.

4. Logistics & International Transportation
Plan and coordinate vehicle transportation between testing facilities.
Organize special transport and towing requirements.
Coordinate resources and transportation documentation for vehicle export and import outside the EU.
Ensure vehicles are properly prepared and documented before transportation.

5. Continuous Improvement
Identify and implement improvements to fleet management processes and operating procedures.
Develop efficient methods to improve vehicle availability and utilization.
Document processes, share knowledge and contribute to long-term operational improvements.
Support engineering teams in achieving testing objectives through effective fleet planning and coordination.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in test engineering, vehicle operations, fleet management or related automotive engineering activities.
Strong understanding of vehicle systems and automotive product development.
Experience in vehicle fleet coordination, testing operations or technical project management.
Proven ability to manage multiple activities and coordinate different stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Experience coordinating workshops, repairs, maintenance and external suppliers.
Ability to analyse vehicle utilization and identify opportunities for operational optimization.
Good understanding of vehicle transportation and logistics processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience with the following systems and tools will be an advantage:
PROTOM
KOLA
GLORIA
IMPACT
BOSS

Additional experience in international vehicle transportation, customs-related documentation, test fleet lifecycle management and automotive project coordination is highly beneficial.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a senior engineering professional who can take ownership of vehicle fleet operations and proactively ensure that test vehicles are available, maintained and ready for planned testing activities.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, coordination and problem-solving capabilities, together with the ability to influence stakeholders, manage complex operational challenges and drive continuous improvements.
At expert level, you should also be comfortable mentoring colleagues, sharing technical knowledge and acting as a trusted point of contact for complex operational and technical matters.
Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced automotive professional with a background in test fleet management, vehicle operations or engineering coordination?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage
Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.
Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.
About the job
This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.
Ceph (block and S3) is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.
Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:

Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions

Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.

Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today

You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

How we work together:
You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.
There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.
About you
You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.
We're looking for:

Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply

Strong Linux fundamentals - the substrate everything else sits on

Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through

We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.
We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.
Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager emil.nilsson@telavox.com. 
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.
This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.
Build and evolve the data platform
Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

Design and ship customer-facing backend services
Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

Own multi-cloud infrastructure
Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

Raise the bar on engineering excellence
Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

Lead and mentor
Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

Nice to have
Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Vi söker en legitimerad SO och svensklärare för årskurs 4–9, med planerad start i januari 2027. 

Internationella Engelska Skolan i Norrtälje öppnade 2024 och har idag omkring 520 elever i årskurs F–9. 

Som medarbetare hos oss ingår du i ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten. Vi arbetar för att varje elev ska känna trygghet och trivsel i en lärande miljö. Vi arbetar för att väcka elevernas lust, engagemang, nyfikenhet och kreativitet. Varje elev ska få möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina förutsättningar och känna tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Undervisningen i SO och svenska sker på svenska, medan engelska används frekvent i kommunikationen mellan personal.Det här erbjuder vi

Hos oss får du:

- En internationell och inspirerande arbetsplats där svenska och engelska används parallellt.
- Kollegor som samarbetar, stöttar varandra och arbetar mot gemensamma mål.
- En skola med studiero, tydliga rutiner och en positiv kultur som gynnar både elever och personal.
- Möjligheten att ingå i en väletablerad organisation där din kompetens tas tillvara.

- Heltidstjänst.

- Ferieanställning med tillträde januari 2027. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. Your role with us

IES Norrtalje continues to expand and with this increase in student volume we are now looking for an extraordinary person to work in the school as an ‘SO Lärare’. This role is one which requires a person who has the ability to multi-task´: One can find oneself working one on one with individuals and or with small groups in classrooms. Furthermore, we expect our SO teacher to follow the National Curriculum, teaching History, Geography, Religion and Civics, but also expect SO subjects to inform students about general good behaviour and the correlation between Humanities and life. All teachers at IESN act as mentors to 15 students and our academic expectations are very high. The suitable applicant needs to have the ability to engage with students across Mellanstadiet and Högstadiet and to believe in the IES ethos of good discipline, good manners and wherein going the extra mile to win is a given part of your inner characteristic. Experience, positively socialisation with young children and winning their confidence, would be desirable skills that a bilingual SO Lärare would supply in abundance. At IES Norrtalje engaging with students is not work, it is a calling!Vi söker dig som

- Har svensk lärarbehörighet för ovan nämnda ämnen och åldrar. 

- Är trygg i ditt professionella ledarskap och skapar en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet.

- Värdesätter och levererar ett personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med både kontroll och elevengagemang i fokus

- Är en entusiastisk och engagerad lärare med en stark vilja att bidra till både elevers och kollegors framgång.

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i skolan samt anpassa undervisning och arbeta tillsammans med elevhälsa och specialpedagoger.

- Känner dig bekväm med att undervisa och kommunicera både på svenska och engelska.Varför välja oss?

Hos oss blir du del av en engagerad och varm arbetsgemenskap där glädje, professionalism och samarbete går hand i hand. Du får chansen att göra verklig skillnad för elever – samtidigt som du får utvecklas i ditt yrke.

*För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/norrtalje/

Vill du vara med och inspirera framtidens matematiker och samtidigt ta nästa steg i din karriär?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt fantastiska team!

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats eller till peter-john.fyles.norrtalje@engelska.se så snart som möjligt.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Mission
The Backbone of Operations: Every 3DAI™ deployment starts with a phone and a holder in a box. You make sure devices are set up, tested and shipped across Europe on time and fully traceable.

Quality at the Source: Our AI is only as good as its data. You help keep our annotation work accurate and on schedule.

The Heart of the Office: You shape the everyday experience of 40 scientists, engineers and business builders in our bright office by the water in Hammarby Sjöstad.

Established yet Agile: Founded in 2015, we have the stability of an established firm with the speed of a startup.

The Role
A hands-on, varied role spanning data, hardware, logistics and workplace. No two days look the same, and you'll be the go-to person who makes things happen.

Data Annotation & Quality: Annotate, re-annotate and validate data, monitor quality standards, and troubleshoot annotation tools.

Annotation Team Support: Help annotators meet productivity, quality and deadline targets. Train new annotators and answer questions about processes and tools.

Device Setup: Charge, configure and install apps on phones and car phone holders, create user accounts per internal guidelines, and test every device before it ships.

Packaging & Shipping: Pack collection kits according to checklists, label and document contents, ship via our providers, and log tracking so all hardware is traceable.

Inventory Management: Keep device and accessory inventory up to date, run regular stock checks, and initiate replenishment when stock runs low.

Office Coordination: Organise weekly team breakfast and Lunch & Learns (polls, food orders and all), manage office hardware, and handle deliveries, including pickups from local collection points.

Workplace Environment: Keep the office tidy and welcoming, from desks and fridges to fresh flowers, and proactively improve how we work.

Who You Are
Organised by Nature: You love structure, checklists and accurate records.

Hands-on and Practical: You're comfortable unboxing deliveries, setting up a phone, packing a shipment and fixing a basic tech issue, all in the same afternoon.

Detail-oriented: Whether validating annotations or labelling a package, you get it right the first time.

Service-minded: You enjoy helping colleagues and making the workplace better for everyone.

What You Bring
Required:

Experience: Background in office coordination, administration, operations, logistics or a similar hands-on role.

Tech Comfort: Confident setting up smartphones and apps and quick to learn new tools.

Accuracy: A track record of maintaining precise records, inventories or quality-controlled work.

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to explain processes clearly and train others.

Preferred:

Experience with data annotation, labelling or quality assurance work.

Experience with inventory management, shipping or e-commerce logistics.

Swedish language skills.

AI-tool literacy — using AI to speed up your own workflows and problem-solving.

Driving licence.

What's in It for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work keeps our operations running.

Variety and Growth: Gain exposure to AI data workflows, hardware deployment and international logistics, with real room to shape how we work.

The "Work-Life" Blend: A culture that values output over "desk time". Overtime is rare, something you don't find in many tech startups.

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:
Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns with internal or external speakers, with catered lunch paid by the company.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week's wins at Friday After Work (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!).

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

If you're an organised, hands-on problem solver who loves keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you.

Your CV

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are seeking a hands-on, technically fluent engineer to drive the adoption of AI across our entire development organization - someone who finds the friction in how teams work and turns it into automated, AI-powered solutions.
As our AI Enablement Engineer, you will embed with engineering and product teams to identify where AI can remove repetitive, manual work, then build and ship the solutions that make it happen. You will work closely with our AI Efficiency Architects and AI Evangelist to turn high-level AI strategy into concrete, measurable wins on the ground.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, moves fast, and gets real satisfaction from seeing their work adopted and relied upon by teams across the company.
 
Your Mission
Accelerate how the entire development organization works by finding high-impact use cases for AI, building the solutions that automate them, and spreading those wins so they scale across teams.
 
 
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 

Use Case Discovery: work directly with engineering and product teams to map their workflows, spot repetitive or slow processes, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation across the development organization.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: act as a builder - lead the technical design and implementation of working solutions such as prompt workflows, lightweight agents, scripts, and integrations that prove value fast, then partnering with the AI Efficiency Architects to harden anything that needs to run in production.
Reusable Enablement Assets: create templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns so a proven AI win can spread from one team to many without bespoke work each time.
Adoption & Measurement: drive genuine adoption of AI tooling across teams and tie every solution back to concrete outcomes - time saved, throughput, and delivery speed - so impact is visible and quantifiable to leadership.
Feedback to the Platform: surface recurring needs and friction back to the AI Efficiency Architects, so the internal AI gateway and tooling evolve toward what teams actually need.
Technical Mentorship & Influence: mentor senior engineers on AI best practices and influence engineering roadmaps.

 
 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Staff-Level Engineering Foundations: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience (Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript) with a proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in a production environment.
Production-Ready AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience moving AI from a cool prototype to a real-world tool. You don’t just write basic prompts - you know how to build reliable agents and RAG workflows, and you understand the practical side of LLMs, like managing costs, speed, and context limits to make tools actually work for production.
Strategic Problem-Solving: You have a strong bias for action and can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution fast. While you focus on delivering value quickly rather than chasing perfection, you always think big - building smart, reusable tools that fix root problems for hundreds of developers, not just one team.
Collaboration & Communication: excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work alongside many different teams, understand their needs, and bring them along on the adoption journey.
SDLC/DevOps Familiarity: working knowledge of the tools that underpin the software delivery lifecycle (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control) so that solutions fit naturally into how teams already work.
Self-Direction: capacity to manage a varied portfolio of work across multiple teams, prioritize for impact, and deliver with minimal supervision.

 
NICE TO HAVES

Excellent presentation and training skills
Previous experience running enablement, developer experience, or internal tooling initiatives

 
 
WHO WE ARE

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?

This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

You will work on our .NET microservices backend — primarily hosted in Azure, with Corniche as our API-driven core banking system at its heart — collaborating with engineers across Borås, Stockholm, Gdansk, Málaga, and the Czech Republic. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will contribute to technical direction, share knowledge across the team, and help shape our platform and engineering culture.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and development of microservices and their architecture using .NET Core

Drive cloud-based solution design, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable services on Azure Cloud Native

Oversee CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows using Kubernetes, Docker, and Azure Pipelines

Optimize systems and applications for high performance, reliability, and maintainability

Implement and improve logging and observability using OpenTelemetry

Share knowledge and support developers of varying seniority, contributing to technical and architectural discussions

Collaborate across distributed teams and ensure alignment on technical strategy and best practices

What We're Looking For
5+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, and Azure

Proven experience with transaction-intensive systems and agile development processes

Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed system design

A collaborative, team-first mindset with a passion for engineering quality

Fluent in English and Swedish

Experience in e-commerce, payments, or finance is a plus, as well as familiarity with systems like Corniche or Mambu

What We Offer
A hands-on technical role with real impact on platform architecture and direction

The opportunity to work on a modern, unified payment platform serving 14 European markets

A collaborative, distributed team with a strong engineering culture

Growth opportunities both technically and professionally

Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 
Business Area (BA) Markets optimises assets and sources and trades commodities to deliver the best value for Vattenfall and our customers. BA Markets is active across Europe, with around 450 professionals working in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. 

Job Description

Would you like to work at the intersection of energy markets, trading and the energy transition? Now you have the opportunity to join Vattenfall as a Guarantees of Origin Trader and take an active role in the evolving European market for Guarantees of Origin (GoOs).
Based in Stockholm, you will join our Nordic Power and Environmental Commodities team, trading GoOs across European markets while managing market risk, optimising positions and identifying opportunities to create commercial value.
You will become part of an experienced trading team with colleagues in Stockholm and Hamburg and collaborate closely with sales colleagues across the Nordics and Continental Europe.
Your responsibilities 
Your trading and portfolio decisions will have a direct commercial impact. The role requires analytical thinking, sound judgement and the confidence to take calculated risks. 
Your key responsibilities will be to: 
Trade GoOs across European markets. 
Analyse market developments, pricing and trading opportunities. 
Manage trading positions and financial risk. 
Execute trades through exchanges and bilateral markets. 
Build and maintain relationships with brokers and other market participants. 
Support sales colleagues across the Nordics and Continental Europe. 
Identify opportunities to optimise the portfolio and create commercial value. 
Contribute to the continuous development of trading standards and best practices.

Qualifications

You combine strong analytical skills with a commercial mindset. You enjoy following markets, interpreting information and translating analysis into trading decisions. You take ownership of your decisions and adapt as market conditions change.
We are looking for:
A  minimum of 2–5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in GoO trading. 
A relevant master’s degree, for example in economics, finance, engineering, engineering physics or a related quantitative field.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
The ability to assess risk and make sound commercial decisions in changing market conditions.
An interest in energy, commodity or environmental markets.
Fluency in English. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Knowledge of environmental markets or Guarantees of Origin is highly advantageous.

Your approach
Trading requires more than an understanding of price and volume. You bring curiosity, discipline and sound judgement, especially when markets move quickly and information is incomplete.
You make well-informed decisions and combine a commercial outlook with a collaborative approach. You enjoy exchanging perspectives with colleagues across markets and functions.

Additional Information

Our Offer We offer a challenging and international work environment and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues as ‘Ask and Share’ concept is essential for the way we work. We offer attractive employment conditions (smart working, flexible working hours and a good-work-life balance) and opportunities for personal and professional development. Click here for further information.  Location: Solna, StockholmFor more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Laurent Cheval at laurent.cheval@vattenfall.com. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Kajsa Loman at kajsa.loman@vattenfall.com Trade union representatives: Simon Salomonsson (Unionen) and Sven Gunnar Gremlin (Akademikerna). To contact them, please call the Vattenfall switchboard on +46 8 739 50 00.We welcome your application in English no later than December 13th 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV. At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture. We firmly believe that diversity helps build a more profitable and attractive company, and we strive to be good role models when it comes to diversity. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.  The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process.
