jobs.occupation: Researcher – Artificial Intelligence and High-Performance Computing
jobs.employer_name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
About the position
The convergence of high-performance computing and artificial intelligence is transforming how research is done, how industry innovates, and how society solves its most complex challenges. We are now strengthening our High-Performance Computing (HPC) group with a researcher who can work at exactly this intersection - combining deep expertise in AI and HPC to help researchers, companies and public organisations make effective use of Europe's most powerful computing infrastructure.
You will join a team that works across the full innovation chain, from methodological development to applied science and societal deployment, ensuring that advanced computing translates into real impact. At the core of our activities is Sweden AI Factory, one of the European AI Factories established under the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) and co-operated by RISE and NAISS, as well as ENCCS, the Swedish national competence centre in HPC. You will work across ENCCS, Sweden AI Factory and related initiatives - both EuroHPC-funded projects and projects supported by other European and national funders.
What you will do

Develop, scale and apply AI methods - from deep learning to large language and other foundation models - to real-world problems, in collaboration with industrial and academic partners.

Design, run, and optimise large-scale training and simulation workloads on GPU-accelerated European supercomputers.

Act as a technical expert and advisor to companies and public sector organisations, from startups and SMEs to large industry, helping them identify how HPC and AI can be put to work in their own domain.

Contribute to the design and delivery of training activities - workshops, hands-on labs and hackathons - that build HPC and AI competence in Swedish research and industry.

Contribute to ENCCS, Sweden AI Factory and related EuroHPC-funded and other national and European projects, and take an active role in preparing proposals for new funding from the EU and national agencies.

Represent RISE in international HPC and AI conferences, workshops, and community initiatives, and help build cross-border collaboration with other AI Factories, Centres of Excellence, and National Competence Centres.

Who we are looking for
Required:

PhD or equivalent experience in computer science, applied or computational mathematics, computational science, or a related field.

Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

Demonstrated experience of distributed training and parallel computing on GPU-accelerated HPC systems (e.g. PyTorch DDP/FSDP, DeepSpeed or Megatron-LM, MPI, CUDA or ROCm), including batch scheduling with Slurm.

Experience of applying AI and machine learning to real-world research or industrial problems, working with real, imperfect data.

Experience of organising or teaching courses, summer schools, workshops, or other training activities.

Excellent communication skills in English, and a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical results into clear recommendations for non-specialist audiences.

Meritorious:

Experience of training, fine-tuning, or deploying large-scale models, such as large language models or other foundation models, on HPC systems.

Experience of efficient inference and model serving (e.g. vLLM, quantisation), containerised workflows (e.g. Apptainer), or MLOps practices on shared infrastructure.

Experience of contributing to funding proposals to EU programmes (e.g. Horizon Europe, Digital Europe) or national funding agencies.

Experience of collaborative projects with industrial partners, including delivering results and reviews to industry stakeholders.

Experience of supervising students, thesis workers, or junior engineers.

Familiarity with the European research computing landscape (EuroHPC, AI Factories, national HPC centres), and experience of leading proposals or work packages in EU projects.

Familiarity with trustworthy AI, data governance, and the regulatory landscape, including the EU AI Act.

A strong scientific publication record.

Communication skills in Swedish.

We place great weight on personal qualities. You are curious and independent, comfortable moving between deep technical work and the applied needs of an external partner, and you enjoy working in a team where knowledge is shared openly. Swedish language skills are not a requirement - our working language is English, and we support employees who wish to learn Swedish.
Are we right for each other?
At RISE, we like different and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge for the future. With us, passionate problem solvers meet to solve some of the world's most important, and perhaps fun, problems. We can not promise you an easy job, but what we can promise you is a bunch of committed colleagues and some really exciting societal and industrial challenges to tackle. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. With us, you get the opportunity to make a real difference. Welcome to the entire Swedish research institute and innovation partners!
Welcome with Your Application!
For more information, please contact the recruiting manager Thor Wikfeldt, Group Manager, at thor.wikfeldt@ri.se. The last application date is December 20. Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously during and after the application period. Apply without cover letter.
Our union representatives are Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22 and Linda Ikatti, Unionen, +46 10 516 51 61.

Technical Marketing Manager Poultry Nordics
Location: Denmark
Date: Nov 13, 2026
Area of interest: Sales & Marketing
 
Shape the Future of Poultry Health in the Nordics
 
At HIPRA, prevention is at the heart of everything we do.
As a global biotechnology company focused on innovation, vaccines, and animal health solutions, we work alongside veterinarians and producers to improve animal health, welfare, and productivity. Through science, technology, and a strong commitment to prevention, we help shape the future of animal health worldwide.
HIPRA NORDIC is responsible for the sale and promotion of HIPRA products across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We are now looking for a Technical & Marketing Manager Poultry to lead and develop our poultry business throughout the Nordic region.
This is a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial vision, and market development in a highly visible role with responsibility across three countries.
 
Your Mission
As Technical & Marketing Manager Poultry, you will drive the development of HIPRA's poultry business across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.
Through technical expertise, customer engagement, and strategic market development, you will strengthen HIPRA's position as a trusted partner to poultry producers and veterinarians while promoting our prevention strategy and innovative solutions.
You will work closely with customers, key industry stakeholders, colleagues across the Nordic organization, and HIPRA's Poultry Team at headquarters in Spain. As part of a small and agile Nordic organization of 12 employees, you will enjoy a high level of visibility and influence while working closely with colleagues across functions and countries. At the same time, you will have access to the expertise, innovation, and support of HIPRA's international poultry network.
 
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement the poultry business strategy across the Nordic region.
Identify market opportunities and translate customer insights into business initiatives.
Analyze market developments, customer needs, disease trends, and competitive activity.
Support the successful launch and implementation of products and services.
Provide technical and scientific support to customers and internal teams.
Deliver product training, workshops, and scientific presentations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders and industry stakeholders.
Partner closely with sales colleagues to identify opportunities and support business growth.
Contribute to marketing initiatives and ensure effective local execution.
Collaborate with Nordic and international colleagues to share best practices and drive continuous improvement.

 
Who We Are Looking For
You are a veterinary professional who enjoys combining science, business, and relationship building. You are motivated by helping customers succeed and thrive in an environment where you can make a visible impact.
 
Qualifications
Degree in Veterinary Medicine.
Preferably 3+ years of experience within the poultry industry, poultry health, or animal health sector.
Good knowledge and understanding of the Nordic poultry market.
Experience in poultry production, poultry health, vaccination programs, or animal health will be considered an advantage.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders.
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution.
Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
Positive, proactive, and customer-focused mindset.

 
Language Requirements
English is the corporate language within HIPRA, and a strong command of English is required.
Candidates must also be fluent in at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian). Given the Nordic scope of the role, Scandinavian language skills and an understanding of the Nordic market are essential.
 
Location & Travel
The successful candidate can be based in Denmark, Sweden, or Norway.
This is primarily a home-based position with regular travel to customers, meetings, congresses, and industry events throughout the Nordic region. Significant travel across the Nordic countries should therefore be expected.
 
HIPRA Nordic's office is located in Vejen, Denmark.
 
Why Join HIPRA?
Take ownership of the poultry business across Denmark, Sweden, and Norway.
Join a global animal health company recognized for innovation and prevention.
Work in a highly visible role with significant influence and responsibility.
Be part of a small, collaborative Nordic team with strong international support.
Collaborate with industry experts, key customers, and global colleagues.
Enjoy a flexible, home-based work environment.
Access continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Contribute to a company dedicated to improving animal health and supporting sustainable food production.

 
Interested?
If you are passionate about poultry health and excited by the opportunity to combine technical expertise, commercial insight, and market development in an international environment, we would love to hear from you. Applications will be considered continuously as we receive them, so don’t hesitate to submit yours.
If you have any questions to the position, you are welcome to contact the Business Manager:
Camilla.velvin@hipra.com, phone +47 9366 5174
 
Apply by submitting your CV and cover letter.
 
 
HIPRA offers equal opportunity to all of its employees.
All qualified applicants will be considered for the position to be filled, without regard to gender, race, nationality, disability or age.All hiring decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence and the needs of the company.

Job Description
Are you an experienced media relations professional who knows how to turn complex topics into clear, credible stories? We are looking for a Press Officer & Communications Specialist to join the H&M Global Communications Media Relations & Reputation team. In this role, you will help tell our story, build trust and protect the reputation of H&M and H&M Group. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
You will work both proactively and reactively across a broad range of topics. As a trusted media expert, you will research issues, develop messages and create timely responses for Swedish and international media. You will collaborate closely with colleagues and spokespeople across H&M Group functions, H&M at global and sales-market level and the other brands within H&M Group. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Responding to incoming media enquiries and taking part in regular press duty 
Drafting messages, Q&As, statements, press releases and other communications materials 
Acting as a spokesperson for H&M Group when appointed 
Initiating proactive media strategies and stories, interviews and engaging content together with functions and brands  
Organising and participating in interviews, press events, press trips and meetings with media 
Maintaining and developing relationships with key media and opinion formers 
Advising and supporting global and local spokespeople and communications colleagues on media-related matters and crisis communications  
Preparing interview briefs and delivering communications and media training 
Using media analysis tools to identify opportunities, risks and follow-up actions 
Following up budgets and performance for the projects you manage and contributing to the team’s overall goals 

WHO YOU ARE 
You are curious, proactive and motivated to investigate new topics and find the facts and proof points needed to build credible communications. You combine sound judgement with a positive, collaborative and non-prestigious approach. You can prioritise effectively, stay focused when the pace is high and work independently while contributing actively to the team. 
To succeed in this role, we believe you have... 
An academic background in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Business or an equivalent higher-level education 
At least five years of experience in communications or media relations, ideally from a listed company or communications agency 
Strong knowledge of how the media works and an understanding of the corporate media landscape 
A strong interest in current affairs, global trends and developments relevant to our industry, with the ability to identify potential stories, opportunities and risks 
Excellent writing and communication skills in both English and Swedish. Additional language skills are an advantage 
The ability to communicate key messages clearly, creatively and persuasively 
Strong relationship-building skills and the confidence to coach and advise colleagues, spokespeople and partners 
A structured and methodical way of working, with strong attention to detail and planning skills 

You bring a passion for storytelling and an inclusive, service-minded approach. You are flexible, decisive and action-oriented, and you continuously look for ways to improve how we work. 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office at Sveavägen 44 in Stockholm. If you feel that your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please submit your CV in English at your earliest opportunity. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 
WHO WE ARE 
 
H&M Group is a global family of brands and businesses. We make it possible for customers around the world to express themselves through fashion and design. We are a family of strong fashion brands, including H&M, COS, Weekday, Cheap Monday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Sellpy and Singular Society. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  
An example of our benefits:  
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online, including H&M, COS, Weekday, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. 
H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.  
With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and opportunities for international mobility. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

Lead the next phase of our enterprise sales growth across Europe. As Head of Enterprise Sales Europe at Tool Flow Solutions, you lead and develop the regional sales team while staying close to the business yourself, winning new TDM customers, and growing strategic customer relationships. 
About Tool Flow Solutions 
Tool Flow Solutions is Sandvik’s digital tool-management business, helping manufacturers manage tools and tooling data more effectively. Our portfolio brings together TDM, Toolhive and Cribwise, covering different customer needs and levels of complexity, from enterprise-wide tool-data and process management to cloud-based tool management and inventory control.   
In this position, you lead the European sales organization focused primarily on TDM solutions, while working closely with our Digital Sales team and other functions to identify opportunities across the broader portfolio and provide customers with the right solution. 
About the job 
You drive profitable enterprise sales growth across Europe by translating commercial priorities into clear regional plans and disciplined execution. Combining leadership with active involvement in strategic opportunities, you secure new TDM customers, expand existing accounts, and strengthen relationships with customers and partners. You report to the Head of Sales & Marketing, Tool Flow Solutions.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead, coach and develop the European enterprise sales team across different countries. 
Drive enterprise sales processes from qualification and discovery through negotiation and closing. 
Own the European TDM sales pipeline, CRM discipline and evidence-based forecasting. 
Develop and execute regional sales plans to grow new businesses and expand existing strategic customer relationships. 
Build business through direct sales, resellers, Sandvik companies and other relevant partners. 
Strengthen collaboration across the wider commercial organization, bringing together Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Product around key opportunities and customer needs. 
Support Toolhive and Cribwise opportunities in coordination with the Digital Sales team.  

Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Tübingen, Germany, or Stockholm, Sweden, with a hybrid working arrangement. Travel within Europe and occasional travel outside the region are required.  
Your profile 
You’re an experienced sales leader with significant B2B enterprise software or industrial technology sales experience, and you lead from the front. You combine people leadership with hands-on sales execution – building practical sales plans, coaching your team in real customer situations, and bringing the drive to turn plans into results. Your background includes complex buying processes, enterprise account growth, and cross-border collaboration.  
Your background includes: 
Proven experience leading and coaching sales teams across countries, with a clear focus on improving performance and execution. 
A strong track record of winning complex enterprise deals and expanding established customer accounts. 
Experience working with CRM, structured opportunity qualification, pipeline reviews, and sales forecasting. 
A university degree in business administration, engineering, industrial technology or a related field, or equivalent professional education and experience. 
Strong English and German communication and presentation skills.  

Experience from manufacturing, software integration, resellers, or distribution is highly relevant. Knowledge of tool-management software, TDM, subscription or cloud offerings is an advantage, as are other European language skills. 
Being hands-on and commercially minded, you bring structure and momentum to both individual opportunities and team performance. You build trust across cultures and functions, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain resilient when priorities or market conditions change. With a coaching approach and strong ownership, you help people develop while keeping customers and results firmly in focus. 
The team 
You lead enterprise sales professionals located across Europe. The team works across countries and collaborates closely with Digital Sales, Marketing, Sales Operations, Product, Customer Success, implementation teams and regional partners.  
Our culture 
Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.   
Contact information 
For further information about this position, please contact Oskar Edqvist, hiring manager, oskar.edqvist@sandvik.com

Job Description
ABOUT TECH ACADEMY 
 
Tech Academy exists to empower H&M Tech colleagues to build the skills they need to deliver on business needs. By strengthening key tech capabilities and creating a strong learning culture, we help make technology a competitive advantage for H&M. 
 
We do this through two main offerings: Academy Initiatives, leadership-sponsored programs that build business-critical skills at scale and Explore & Learn, platforms, events and communities that support employees’ own development 
 
JOB DESCRIPTION 
As Learning Experience Designer, you’ll play an important role in shaping how H&M Tech colleagues learn and build new capabilities. You’ll turn Tech Academy’s priorities into engaging learning experiences that build real capability and make a difference to business results. 
 
In this role, you will turn Tech Academy’s priorities into well-designed, engaging learning experiences that make a real difference to how H&M Tech colleagues deliver business results. You will work closely with the Tech Academy team, Tech Centers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and the People organization to support upskilling within prioritized skill areas. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Key responsibilities include: 
Analyze tech upskilling and performance needs, translating them into clear learning objectives and effective learning experiences. 
Lead the design of engaging, interactive learning experiences, from scenario-based digital learning to workshops and micro-learning, in collaboration with SMEs and external partners. 
Partner with and coach SMEs to translate their experience into effective learning experiences.

Design content and activities for communities of practice and learning campaigns that keep colleagues engaged and make offerings easy to find. 
Set clear KPIs, evaluate the effectiveness and impact of learning initiatives and use learner feedback and data to continuously improve them.  
Partner with external learning providers and tech partners, such as Microsoft and Google Cloud, to integrate their expertise into learning experiences. 
Explore and apply AI-enabled ways of designing, building and delivering learning where they improve the learner experience 

WHO YOU ARE  
You’re a learner-centered designer who understands how great learning experiences can build skills and create business impact. You enjoy working collaboratively in a large, complex organisation and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. 
You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences and can advise stakeholders on how people learn best. You’re also comfortable taking ownership and bringing an idea from an identified learning need through to a finished experience.

Experience using learner feedback and data to evaluate and improve learning, ideally including learning analytics and impact measurement 
Strong project management and stakeholder collaboration skills, with experience leading complex initiatives from early idea to finished learning experience 
Fluency in English, written and spoken, and experience working in global, complex matrix organizations 
Experience using AI as an enabler in learning design is an advantage

If this sounds like an opportunity for you, we’d be happy to hear from you. Please submit you CV in English and a portfolio at your earliest availability.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

Do you want to shape the future of Finance through data, technology and smarter ways of working?
 
As our Finance Data Development Lead, you will drive the development of financial analysis models, reporting, AI functionalities and systems across the Group. Acting as the bridge between finance, data and technology, you will lead initiatives that improve processes, increase automation and support better decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across Finance, IT, BI and Data Governance, you will help create a more standardized, efficient and data-driven finance function with one common version of financial truth across the Group.
 
 
Some of your key responsibilities: 
 
- Own and develop our FP&A platform Anaplan, acting as both Product Owner and Model Builder.
 
- Drive the Finance Data Governance agenda, including data quality, reconciliation controls, reporting standards and KPI governance.
 
- Lead the development and continuous improvement of finance processes, systems and reporting to increase standardisation, automation and operational efficiency across the Group.
 
- Evaluate, implement and drive the adoption of AI solutions within Finance, helping shape the Finance AI agenda and enhance reporting, forecasting and decision support.
 
- Act as the business owner for finance reporting development and support the ongoing development of BI reports and analytics.
 
- Establish and communicate best practices for how finance data is managed, shared and used across the organisation.
 
- Lead and coordinate cross-functional projects and initiatives, ensuring stakeholder alignment and successful delivery.
 
- Deliver training and support colleagues in understanding and applying Finance Data Governance principles.
 
- Support ad hoc financial analysis, management reporting and performance follow-up.
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of 7. As our operation spans several countries, occasional travel will be required.

At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.

Description of the doctoral project
 
Douglas-fir is a promising alternative for diversifying Swedish production forests under a changing climate. Its wider use requires better knowledge of needle diseases that can cause needle loss, crown thinning and reduced growth. This four-year PhD project will investigate how host genetics, fungal communities and environmental conditions influence Douglas-fir health and productivity. It will examine disease patterns across Swedish growing conditions, identify the fungi involved and explore genetic variation in a major needle-disease pathogen. The project will also investigate differences in resistance and tolerance among provenances and how disease affects growth. The aim is to support the selection of suitable planting material and sites for future forestry.
The project is based at the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre in Alnarp, in collaboration with Skogforsk, Södra and international researchers. The doctoral student will join a multidisciplinary forestry research environment. The project combines field surveys and established forestry trials with fungal diagnostics, sequencing and population genetics analysis.

Description of the doctoral project
This PhD project aims to establish subjective time perception as a new animal-centred dimension of animal welfare. It combines animal welfare science, ethology, comparative cognition, affective neuroscience and human time-perception research. The project will examine how affective state, predictability and agency influence animals’ temporal experience, using dogs as the principal model species.

The PhD student will:
conduct a structured interdisciplinary review of time perception and its relevance to animal welfare
adapt, pilot and validate an interval-timing task for dogs
design and conduct experiments examining timing behaviour under neutral, positive and mildly negative affective conditions
train dogs using positive reinforcement and collect behavioural and physiological data
analyse video recordings, operant responses, heart rate, heart-rate variability and salivary cortisol
contribute to the development of a conceptual framework for studying time perception across companion, farm, laboratory and zoo animals
publish the findings in international scientific journals and present them at national and international conferences

You will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment with expertise in animal welfare, animal cognition, and affective states. The position provides opportunities to develop skills in animal experimentation, cognitive testing, behavioural analysis, physiological measurements, statistics and scientific communication.

experience in ethogram development, behavioural observations and/or video coding

handling or training dogs or other animals using positive reinforcement

The PhD project is a collaboration between the Animal Centred Environments group and the Horticultural and Agroecological Systems (HAS) subject area within the Department. How can sustainability assessment support the transition to more resilient and sustainable farming systems? jobs.occupation: PhD - Linking Stem Nitrogen Homeostasis to Tree Growth
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology
Third-cycle subject area
Plant Biology
Description of the doctoral project
 
Nitrogen is a major determinant of forest productivity, influencing tree growth, biomass accumulation and wood formation. However, the physiological and molecular mechanisms linking nitrogen availability to wood formation and tree growth remain poorly understood. While nitrogen uptake and assimilation have been extensively studied in roots and leaves, much less is known about nitrogen transport and metabolism within the vascular tissues of tree stems. In particular, the role of nitrogen homeostasis in the cambial region, where new wood cells are produced and differentiate, remains largely unexplored. Understanding these processes is important for identifying mechanisms that regulate tree growth and nitrogen use efficiency, with implications for sustainable forest production.
This PhD project aims to establish a mechanistic understanding of how nitrogen transport, uptake and metabolism in the cambial region influence wood formation and growth in aspen (Populus tremula). The research combines plant physiology, molecular biology and systems biology, using approaches such as stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, RNA sequencing, spatial and single-cell transcriptomics, microscopy and mathematical modelling.
About the position
The doctoral student will investigate how nitrogen transport and metabolism in the vascular tissues of aspen (Populus tremula) regulate wood formation, tree growth and nitrogen use efficiency. The research will focus on nitrogen homeostasis in the cambial region, including the vascular cambium and developing xylem, and its relationship to growth and wood properties.
The work will involve physiological experiments with aspen trees, including analysis of nitrogen compounds in xylem sap, stable isotope (^15N) tracing to quantify nitrogen uptake and transport, and spatial metabolomic analyses. These measurements will be combined with RNA sequencing and existing spatial and single-cell transcriptomic datasets to identify regulatory mechanisms involved in nitrogen homeostasis. The student will also analyse tree growth and wood anatomical and chemical properties, and participate in developing quantitative models linking nitrogen metabolism to growth and nitrogen use efficiency. Functional validation of candidate genes will involve genetically modified aspen trees.
The position offers opportunities to develop expertise in plant physiology, molecular biology, metabolomics, bioinformatics and systems biology through collaboration with researchers from complementary disciplines.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have:
been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification;
satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or
acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

To meet the specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology, you must have equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
The applicant should have a Master's degree in biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, engineering or equivalent. Excellent spoken and written English skills, experience with plants as an experimental system, and knowledge of statistics in, for example, the programming language R or Python are necessary. We attach great importance to the ability of the applicant to collaborate and function well in a strong research environment, an interest in learning new things, and a willingness to individually develop the project in collaboration with the research group, as well as high motivation to pursue doctoral studies. Previous experience with plant nitrogen physiology, trees as a model system, genetics, genomics, or bioinformatics are valuable merits.
About us
The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. As our new Application Engineer in Sweden, you'll be a key technical partner to our customers and sales team, turning customer needs into practical drive and power conversion solutions. 
 

You'll join a small, experienced Swedish team working across the country. This gives you a broad role with exposure to different customers, industries and applications. Rather than focusing on one specific segment, you'll use your technical expertise where it creates the most value, particularly for key customers and during the pre-sales phase. 

 

You'll support customers from the first technical discussion through solution design, sizing and quotation to implementation. You'll have the independence to manage customer relationships in Sweden while working closely with technical and commercial colleagues across Sweden, Denmark and Norway. 

 

The role offers flexibility in where you work. You can be based in the Stockholm, Linköping, Göteborg or Malmö area, including locations within reasonable travelling distance, and combine homeworking with customer visits and time at a Danfoss office. 
What You’ll Be Doing
 
Work with customers and our sales team to understand technical requirements and assisting system designs, supporting customer meetings, project scoping and pre-sales discussions. 
Dimension and select frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for different applications.
Act as a trusted technical partner to key customers, taking technical ownership of their applications from initial requirements and product selection through technical clarification, verification, implementation and commissioning on site.
Perform technical analyses, testing and evaluations against customer specifications, helping customers and sales colleagues solve technical challenges.
Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software training, and collaboration with sales, service partners and technical colleagues across Scandinavia. 

 
You'll have regular contact with customers, so travel is a natural part of the role. You can expect 20-30 travel days per year, mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to Denmark and Norway. 
 
What We're Looking For
We're open to different educational and career paths. What matters most is a strong technical foundation, practical electrical understanding and an interest in working directly with customers. 
 
To succeed in this role, you'll bring: 
A technical background in electrical engineering, automation, mechatronics or a related field. You may also have started your career as an electrician or electrical installer and are now ready for the next step.
Practical electrical knowledge and an interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion.
The ability to work independently, translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions and manage different priorities.
Confidence working directly with customers and supporting sales colleagues in technical and pre-sales discussions.
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken. Swedish is essential for customer collaboration in Sweden, while English is used across our Scandinavian organization. 

 
Experience with drives, frequency converters, power conversion, electrification or similar technologies is an advantage, but not essential. Familiarity with Danfoss Drives products or Salesforce would also be beneficial. 
 
Most importantly, you bring technical curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn. We value practical experience alongside formal education, so if you've built your expertise through hands-on work combined with further technical learning, we'd encourage you to apply. 
What You'll Get from Us
 
You'll join a small, experienced Swedish team where you'll have significant independence and the opportunity to build close relationships with customers and sales colleagues. At the same time, you'll be part of a wider Scandinavian technical community where knowledge, expertise and assignments are shared across Sweden, Denmark and Norway. 
 
The breadth of the Swedish market means you'll work with different customers and applications rather than being limited to one segment. It's an opportunity to deepen your technical expertise, develop your commercial understanding and take real ownership of customer challenges. 
 
The position offers a flexible hybrid working model, including the possibility of working from home. Depending on where you're based and the needs of the role, your week may combine homeworking, customer visits and time at a Danfoss office. 
 
We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths. 
 
You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. 
 
You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. 
 
You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.
Ready to Make a Difference?
 
If you enjoy combining hands-on technical expertise with customer interaction and want the freedom to take ownership of technical challenges, we'd like to hear from you. 
 

You don't need to come from one specific educational or industry background. If you have strong electrical knowledge, enjoy solving technical problems and are motivated to develop your expertise in drives and power conversion, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every preferred qualification. 

 

Apply and help us turn customer challenges into practical drive and power conversion solutions.

Why Join SalMar?
Become part of a diverse team representing over 40 nationalities. At SalMar, we're more than a company - we're a community built on innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Chalmers University of Technology is seeking a Director for ourhttps://www.chalmers.se/en/research/infrastructure/ecommons/ (e-commons) who combines professional expertise and sound judgement with strong leadership and a clear focus on delivery. We are looking for a leader with a collaborative mindset, who puts the mission and collective success first, takes a broad organisational perspective, works effectively across organisational boundaries, and creates an environment that enables individuals and teams to succeed.
About us 
Chalmers University of Technology is driving academic excellence in order to address the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science. 
Chalmers e-infrastructure Commons (e-commons) is our integrated digital infrastructure for research, providing advanced digital resources, services, and expertise to support research activities across all our 12 departments. The e-commons services cover the life cycle of research data by integrating functions embedded at different parts of the university with functions available in national and international e-infrastructure initiatives and collaborations. The mission of e-commons is defined by the central Research Committee of Chalmers with representatives from all departments.  
The host department for e-commons is https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/physics-and-astronomy/ 
The Role 
As Director of e-commons, you will hold a strategically important leadership role at Chalmers, with overall responsibility for leading and developing e-commons and ensuring high-quality, reliable services for the research community. You will also serve as Head of Division for the computational infrastructure within the Department of Physics and Astronomy.  
You will set direction, build a strong and collaborative organisation, and bring together people and expertise across organisational boundaries to turn complex research needs into effective solutions. You will ensure that e-commons evolves in line with Chalmers’ needs and the developments in national and international e-infrastructures. 
Your key responsibilities include: 
Leading and developing e-commons in accordance with its mission, budget, operational plans, strategic objectives, and established policies, while ensuring the infrastructure continues to meet emerging research needs and developments in national and international e-infrastructures.  
Holding overall responsibility for personnel, work environment, and operational management of the division, which currently consists of approximately 20 employees.  
Advising the Vice President for Research and the Research Committee on e-infrastructure matters. 
Collaborating with other support functions and research infrastructures. The position may involve representing the university in national and international e-science contexts. 

Qualifications and merits
The successful candidate should have:
A master’s degree in a relevant field. 
Proven leadership and management experience. 
Experience in leading and collaborating within complex organisations. 
Extensive knowledge of the e-infrastructure domain, including its current developments, opportunities, and challenges. 
Excellent communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken. 

The following qualifications are considered advantageous: 
A doctoral degree in a field relevant to the operational activities of e-commons. 
Broad understanding of e-infrastructure needs across different research disciplines. 
An established national and international professional network within the field. 
Leadership experience within an e-infrastructure organisation. 

Personal Characteristics 
You are an experienced, collaborative, and pragmatic leader with sound judgement, integrity, and a strong focus on quality. You listen to different perspectives, build trust, and bring people together around shared goals, while being prepared to make clear and well-considered decisions when needed. 
As a leader, you create the conditions for people and teams to succeed, take a broad organisational perspective, and work effectively across organisational boundaries.  
You are comfortable navigating complexity and balancing different needs and priorities, maintaining a clear focus on the mission defined by the needs of Chalmers’ researchers. 
Employment terms 
Full-time, permanent position as Director. 
The recruitment of the Director follows Chalmers’ guidelines for leadership appointments and is carried out by a recruitment committee. The final decision is made by the head of the Department of Physics and Astronomy. 
Start date by agreement. 
What we offer
At Chalmers, you will have the opportunity to lead a strategically important research infrastructure that supports world-class research and innovation. You will work in an international, collaborative, and dynamic environment alongside leading researchers, technical experts, and university leadership. 
This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of research infrastructure at Chalmers and contribute to national and international developments in e-infrastructure and e-science. 
 
Read more about what we offer at www.chalmers.se
 
Application
Applications must be in English and submitted through the Chalmers recruitment portal. All files should be in PDF format (max 40 MB each; ZIP files not supported). 
Include: 
CV  
Personal letter 
Other documents (optional): copies of completed education, leadership training.  

Only complete applications submitted through the portal will be considered. 
 
A background check may be conducted as part of the application process. 
 
Application deadline: January 10th, 2027
Contact
For questions about the position, please contact:
Margareta Wallquist, Advisor, University Executive Office, Chalmers Operations Support
 
Email: mailto:margareta.wallquist@chalmers.se
We look forward to your application! 
 
*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

Purpose of the Job
 To design, build and continuously improve Ikano Bank's native Android mobile applications, creating secure, simple and reliable banking experiences for customers across our markets. The role will help drive our Mobile First ambition by combining strong engineering craft, modern Android development practices, DevSecOps, automation and close collaboration with product, design and technology teams.
 
 Responsibilities of the Job
 • Design, develop, test and maintain native Android applications for Ikano Bank's mobile banking products.
 • Build secure, reliable and scalable mobile features using modern Android engineering practices.
 • Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, backend engineers, architects, security and operations teams.
 • Contribute to technical design, solution architecture and implementation decisions for mobile capabilities.
 • Ensure high quality through automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and strong release discipline.
 • Support Google Play releases, monitoring, incident analysis and continuous improvement of the mobile app.
 • Apply DevSecOps principles, including secure coding, privacy-by-design and early identification of risks.
 • Improve developer productivity through automation, modern tooling and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering.
 • Translate business and customer needs into clear technical tasks and deliverable solutions.
 • Mentor colleagues, share knowledge and help raise the engineering standards of the mobile team.
 • Challenge existing ways of working and contribute to Ikano Bank's broader technology transformation.
 
 Experience/Demonstrated Competencies
 • Several years of professional experience developing native Android applications, preferably for customer-facing digital products.
 • Demonstrated experience building, releasing and maintaining high-quality mobile apps in production.
 • Proven ability to work with Kotlin, modern Android frameworks and mobile architecture patterns.
 • Experience working in cross-functional product teams with designers, product owners, backend engineers, architects and security specialists.
 • Demonstrated ability to deliver secure, reliable and maintainable software in a regulated or high-quality engineering environment.
 • Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and Google Play release processes.
 • Proven ability to translate business and customer needs into clear technical solutions.
 • Experience improving engineering practices, development workflows and team productivity.
 • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical topics clearly and work constructively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 • Experience mentoring other developers or contributing to stronger engineering standards within a team.
 • Demonstrated curiosity and openness to modern tools, automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering.
 • Experience from banking, fintech, insurance or another high-security environment is considered an advantage.
 
 Language Competencies
 Tech Stacks: Kotlin (required). Python is a bonus, as the mobile team also contributes to the Python BFF (backend-for-frontend)
 Language: Professional in written and spoken English
 
 Knowledge required
 • Strong knowledge of native Android development using Kotlin.
 • Good understanding of Jetpack Compose, Android Jetpack libraries and modern Android application architecture.
 • Experience with Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and responsive mobile application design.
 • Knowledge of mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM, MVI, modular architecture or clean architecture, and dependency injection with Hilt/Dagger or Koin.
 • Experience integrating mobile apps with REST APIs, WebSockets and backend services.
 • Understanding of secure mobile development, authentication, secure storage, privacy-by-design and app hardening.
 • Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and mobile release processes.
 • Knowledge of Google Play Console submission, app signing, keystores, Gradle build configuration and release management.
 • Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Jira, Figma, Jenkins, Gradle, Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions or similar.
 • Understanding of agile and DevSecOps ways of working.
 • Fluent English, both spoken and written.
 • Experience from banking, fintech or another regulated/high-security environment is an advantage.
 • Knowledge of AWS, Kafka, feature flags, observability or AI-assisted engineering tools is also valuable.
 
 Capabilities for this job
 • Ability to take ownership of mobile features from idea and design through development, release and continuous improvement.
 • Ability to write clean, maintainable and secure code in a banking environment.
 • Ability to understand customer and business needs and translate them into robust technical solutions.
 • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team with product, design, backend, architecture, security and operations.
 • Ability to challenge assumptions, ask good questions and improve solutions without creating unnecessary friction.
 • Ability to balance speed, quality, security and long-term maintainability.
 • Ability to analyse technical problems, make pragmatic decisions and communicate trade-offs clearly.
 • Ability to work with modern engineering practices, including automation, testing, CI/CD and DevSecOps.
 • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies, tools and ways of working.
 • Ability to mentor others, share knowledge and contribute to a stronger engineering culture.
 • Ability to use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while maintaining quality and control.
 
 What motivates you?
 You are motivated by building mobile products that customers rely on every day. You care about creating simple, secure and high-quality digital experiences, and you take pride in strong engineering craft, clean code and reliable delivery.
 
 You enjoy working in a team where ideas are challenged, decisions are made, and technology is used to solve real customer and business problems. You are curious about modern Android development, automation, AI-assisted engineering and better ways of working, and you want to help shape the future of mobile banking at Ikano Bank.

jobs.description:
(English text below)
Om jobbet
Söker du ett praktiskt arbete där du får kombinera fysiskt packningsarbete med att schemalägga tillverkningen i fabrikens produktion? Hos Swedish Nutra i Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, söker vi en noggrann medarbetare som vill ta ansvar för att våra produkter etiketteras, packas och färdigställs för leverans i tid.
I denna roll får du förtroende att analysera ordrar och lagersaldon för att schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandningsteamet. Du styr sedan paketerings- och utleveransflödet i produktionshallen- oavsett om det gäller mindre sändningar eller större volymer. Du ansvarar även för god ordning och pallstruktur på produktionsytan.
Arbetsuppgifter
Linjearbete & Packning: Betjäna vår automatiska etiketteringslinje (påmatning till transportband och avplockning från akkumuleringsbord), packa färdiga varor och färdigställa utleveranser.
Batch- & Packplanering: Analysera inkommande ordrar och lagersaldon för färdiga produkter. Schemalägga tillverkningsbatcher åt blandnings- och fyllningsteamet samt lägga upp det dagliga packschemat.
Färdigvaror & Pallstruktur: Utföra regelbundna lagerräkningar av färdiga produkter samt ansvara för struktur och ordning på pallytorna i produktionshallen.
Tätt Teamsamarbete: Arbeta i nära kontakt med tillverkningsteamet för att synka schemat mot leveransdeadlines.
Spårbarhet & Utrustning: Kontrollera batchnummer och utgångsdatum före utleverans samt logga data via Excel och tavlor. Hantera manuella/elektriska pallyftare och tejpmaskiner.

Arbetstider & Kvalifikationer
Heltid (40 h/vecka), dagtid. Tillsvidareanställning (provanställning tillämpas). Arbetet är fysiskt.
Noggrann, strukturerad och lärovillig med stark känsla för precision och ordning.
Goda/flytande kunskaper i antingen svenska eller engelska är ett krav.
Meriterande: Erfarenhet av packning, orderhantering, tillverkning eller truckkort (A+B).

Om Swedish Nutra
Swedish Nutra är ett Malmöbaserat familjeföretag som tillverkar flytande kosttillskott för en global marknad. Hos oss möter du ett ungt, drivet och mångkulturellt team där engelska är en helt naturlig del av vardagen. Vi erbjuder en varm och engagerande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare räknas och där det finns goda möjligheter att växa.
Arbetsplats: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö (Mellersta Hamnen)
Ansökan & Viktig information
Intervjuer sker löpande. Skicka CV och personligt brev till: hr@swedishnutra.com
⚠️ VIKTIGT ANGÅENDE DIN ANSÖKAN ⚠️
På grund av hög e-postvolym sorteras alla ansökningar automatiskt. För att ditt mail ska synas måste du använda följande ämnesrad:
Ämnesrad: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Ansökan: [Ditt Förnamn + Efternamn]
(Exempel: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Ansökan: Anna Andersson)
Observera: Vi gör vårt bästa för att återkoppla till alla, men p.g.a. högt tryck kan vi inte besvara varje ansökan individuellt. Har du inte hört något inom två veckor har vi gått vidare med andra kandidater.

Production Specialist – Packaging & Dispatch
About the Job
Looking for a dynamic, hands-on role that pairs packaging line operations with production scheduling and inventory flow? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, we are seeking a detail-oriented team member to take charge of labeling, packing, and dispatching orders on time.
In this role, you will evaluate incoming orders and inventory levels to schedule required batch production runs for our manufacturing team. You will also organize the daily packaging queue and dispatch workflow, handling volume demands ranging from smaller shipments to large multi-pallet orders — while keeping our staging areas organized. Full on-site training is provided!
Key Responsibilities
Packaging Line Operations: Operate our automated labeling line, pack finished goods, and stage outbound orders.
Batch & Production Scheduling: Review incoming orders and finished stock to schedule batch runs for the mixing team and set daily packaging priorities to hit shipping deadlines.
Inventory & Staging: Conduct routine stock counts of finished goods and keep pallet staging zones clean, safe, and structured.
Daily Coordination: Work closely throughout the day with mixing and bottling teams to align production output with dispatch deadlines.
Quality & Compliance: Verify lot numbers, expiry dates, and batch records using Excel and tracking boards. Operate manual/electric pallet jacks and taping machinery.

Role Details & Requirements
Terms: Full-time (40 hrs/week, day shifts). Permanent position (probationary period applies). Physically active role.
Profile: Detail-oriented, organized, and eager to take on expanding operational responsibility over time.
Languages: Good command of either English or Swedish is required (fluent in at least one).
"Good to have" experience: Background in packaging lines, order fulfillment, manufacturing, or holding a forklift license (A+B).

About Swedish Nutra
Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family business producing premium liquid supplements distributed worldwide. You’ll be joining a young, energetic, and multicultural team where English is spoken daily. We offer a warm, collaborative workplace culture where every team member is valued and given room to grow.
Location: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö, Sweden (Mellersta Hamnen)
How to Apply & Important Information
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Send your CV and cover letter to: hr@swedishnutra.com
⚠️ IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ⚠️
Applications are filtered automatically. To ensure your email is processed correctly, you must use the exact subject line format below:
Subject Line: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦 Application: [Your First & Last Name]
(Example: 📦PRODUKTION & UTLEVERANS📦Application: John Doe)
Please note: While we do our best to reach out to everyone, high email volume means we may not be able to reply to every applicant individually. If you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we have moved forward with other candidates.

Time allocation: 100%
Our vision
To be recognized as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community, through internationally recognized learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Description/Purpose 
The Head of Learning, together with other members of the school leadership team, strategically develops the school and ensures that SIS maintains its  Mission, Vision, values, policies, and procedures. 
The Head of Learning has a key role to play in ensuring the development of the SIS curriculum that is focused on the SIS Mission and Vision to ensure the highest quality for students’ learning, internationalism, and innovation to meet future challenges. The Head of Learning is in charge of the school’s (re)accreditation processes. 
Duties/Responsibilities
Promotes the school’s definition of learning and internationalism and keeps them alive throughout the school. 
Is in charge of the school’s vertical and horizontal alignment of curriculum as well as its regular revisions. 
Creates the agenda and leads the Educational Leadership Team meetings.
Is in charge of the school’s (re)accreditation processes. 
Strongly cooperates with IB programme coordinators and subject leaders to ensure vertical and horizontal curricular alignment, as well as its revision.
Is aware of the work happening in the PLC groups and contributes to it by suggesting readings and topics for discussion. 
Together with the director, sets a yearly curriculum development budget. 
Decides on curriculum-related professional development for any particular school year and in cooperation with the ELT. 
Leads the Professional Development, Support & Evaluation (PDSE) process of a group of teachers on an annual basis. 
Implements with the ELT the school’s agreed approach to PDSE/Development talks for all teachers in their PDSE group.
Works with the Advancement Director to identify and develop Cases for Support.
Assists with the strategic development of the whole school in cooperation with other members of the leadership team to meet future challenges the school may face. 
Gives appropriate feedback to the Board when called upon to do so.

Required Qualifications and Attributes
Has previous experience in a leadership position within a school.
Has previous successful experience with IB Programmes. 
Holds a university degree, either a BA in Education or Teaching qualifications.
Demonstrates strong team leadership and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Is community-oriented and motivated to involve the full range of the school community - staff, students, and parents in the management and development of the curriculum.
Acts as a school ambassador in engaging with external stakeholders when needed.
Is sensitive towards, and familiar with, a diverse range of student learning needs.
Is sensitive toward and understands cross-cultural issues. 
Is successful in sharing teaching best practices and inspires a love of learning.
Is fluent in English (reading, writing, speaking).
Demonstrates ability to effectively manage human, financial, and physical resources to deliver a high-quality organizational outcome.
Has the ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team.
Has the ability to show initiative and work independently. 
Has the ability to function effectively under pressure. 
Has a pleasant and friendly personality.
Is a self-reflective life-long learner.
Has strong ethical principles and a sense of fairness.

Preferred Education and Experience
Demonstrated interest in remaining at the forefront of educational trends. 
Demonstrated strategic thinking and analytical skills and the ability to use those to influence the educational agenda of the school.
Proven track record of success in leading members of a school’s faculty.

As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last year of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

Contract
Administrative Position
Permanent full-time (with six months probationary period)
Starting: August 6, 2027, or such other date as may be mutually agreed upon by both parties.
Employment rate: 100%

Salary
Individually negotiated
Application
Last day for application: December 7, 2026
We only accept applications in English and from certified candidates. 
Please send your letter of interest and CV to application@intsch.se. Please write Head of Learning in the Subject Line.
SIS holds the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Supplier Strategy Lead, you will help H&M Beauty Fragrance build the supplier partnerships and production capabilities needed to grow its fragrance business. You will shape and implement a strategy covering fragrance oils, suppliers that fill the finished products, packaging and components. Your focus will be on making product development and production faster and more efficient, while ensuring suppliers can support growing volumes.

jobs.occupation: Talent Sourcer for a Leading Fashion Company
jobs.description:
Do you want to help identify and attract creative talent for one of Sweden’s most well-known fashion companies? We are currently looking for a Talent Sourcer, apply today!
About the role
Our client is an international Swedish fashion company headquartered in central Stockholm. As a Talent Sourcer, you will work closely with the recruitment team and support the early stages of the recruitment process, focusing on building candidate pipelines, scheduling interviews, and ensuring a high pace of delivery.
You will primarily support high-volume recruitment within creative functions, such as design and product-related roles, where multiple positions need to be filled within a short timeframe. You will join a driven and collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, teamwork, and a positive work environment.
Work tasks
In this role, you will:
Identify and engage relevant candidates through proactive sourcing activities.
Conduct initial screening interviews.
Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and recruiters.
Ensure candidate information and recruitment processes are accurately maintained within the recruitment system.
Contribute to building strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

For the right candidate, there will be opportunities to take on greater ownership of the recruitment process.
We are looking for
Has previous experience in sourcing and recruitment.
Experience recruiting for creative roles is considered an advantage.
Is structured, self-driven, and comfortable working towards clear targets.
Has excellent communication skills and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Is fluent in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.

As a person, you enjoy working in a goal-oriented recruitment environment where you can drive processes forward, identify the right talent, and create results. You are service-minded, quality-focused, flexible, and adaptable.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Ten graduates. A company-wide learning agenda. A new Learning Portal taking shape. This is a role for someone who enjoys creating structure, building relationships and turning plans into progress. 
 
 
As our Learning and Talent Development Specialist, you will lead our ongoing Graduate Programme and guide our graduates through the next stages of their journey – from rotations and development activities to programme completion. You will be the main point of contact for our graduates and work closely with stakeholders across Stena Line to create a valuable and engaging experience. 
You will also contribute to our wider Learning & Development agenda by coordinating learning initiatives, helping develop our new Learning Portal (LMS) and exploring how digital tools and AI can help us work smarter. 
 
 
The role is a one-year fixed-term contract covering parental leave within our People Development & Performance team. 
Some of your key responsibilities 
 
Graduate Programme:
 
- Lead and coordinate our Graduate Programme 
 
- Maintain programme timelines, milestones and dependencies across different functions and locations 
 
- Manage programme communications, updates and schedules across relevant platforms
 
- Coordinate and follow up with key stakeholders involved in the graduate journey 
 
 
Learning & Development:
 
- Support the implementation and ongoing development of our Learning Portal, including updates and processes
 
- Coordinate learning initiatives, including invitations, registrations, participant communication, materials and follow-up 
 
- Utilise on AI and digital tools to improve efficiency, communication and ways of working within Learning & Development 
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
Based on our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of six.
 
 
You will join an engaged team working together to develop our people and create a consistent and engaging employee experience. You will take ownership of a company-wide programme while gaining broad exposure to Learning & Development and contributing to initiatives connected to our strategy. 
 
 
Being part of our team also means plenty of laughter, a strong team spirit and lots of energy – from sharing new ideas and taking initiative to the occasional team Pilates or gym session over lunch!
 
 
Who are you? 
 
At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.
 
 
We believe you are driven, structured and reliable, with the confidence to take ownership and keep several activities moving forward. You enjoy creating structures, staying on top of details and deadlines, and making sure things get done.
 
 
You are service-oriented, build strong relationships and communicate clearly with different people across the organisation.  At the same time, you are digitally confident, quick to learn new systems and curious about how technology, AI and automation can help us work smarter and more efficiently.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
- A degree in HR, Communications or another relevant field 
 
- Experience within HR operations, Learning & Development, communications, administration, coordination or a similar area 
 
- Experience leading or coordinating projects or programmes 
 
- Experience using AI tools in your work 
 
- Fluency in English, both written and spoken 
 
 
Experience within Learning & Development or working with a Learning Management System (LMS) is considered an advantage, but it is not a requirement.
 
 
What matters most is that you are motivated, digitally curious, and ready to take ownership and develop with us.
 
 
Interested? 
 
This is a full-time, one-year temporary position based in Gothenburg starting in January 2027 or as agreed. Within our People Development & Performance department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than 7 December, 2026. We are having an ongoing selection, so do not wait with your application. To ensure the secure and structured processing of your personal data, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. 
 
 
We have collective bargaining agreements with Unionen, among others, who you can contact for more information. Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment. As part of our efforts to ensure the quality of our recruitment process, we will conduct background checks.
 
 
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Janine Sjöö, Group Head of People Development & Performance at janine.sjoo@stenaline.com or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, at hedwig.blixt@stenaline.com. 
 
 
About Stena Line
 
As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.
 
 
Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.
