jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO  
As Global Paid Social Media Lead, you’ll own and develop the Paid Social channel, driving best-in-class activation across platforms while enabling markets and teams to deliver strong performance and continuous improvement.
This is a highly visible role where deep Paid Social expertise goes hand in hand with commercial thinking and the ability to influence at senior level. You’ll move comfortably between platform detail and the bigger business picture, setting direction for the channel and turning performance and insights into recommendations that move the business forward.
You’ll combine strategic direction with hands-on expertise, ensuring consistent execution and innovation across our global Paid Social ecosystem.
Your key responsibilities include:
Own the global Paid Social setup, including channel strategy, activation principles and ways of working.
Define, maintain and evolve best practices across formats and platforms such as Meta and TikTok.
Ensure consistent application of Paid Social best practices across markets and agency partners.
Define and prioritise Test & Learn initiatives, scaling proven approaches globally.
Collaborate closely with platform partners to drive innovation and capability development.
Align the Paid Social development agenda with cross-channel media initiatives.
Work closely with internal teams such as Creative Production and Measurement & Analytics to enable effective Paid Social activation.
Translate Paid Social performance and data into clear business implications and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Lead senior stakeholder conversations, building trust, creating buy-in and constructively challenging existing approaches when the data or business opportunity calls for it.
Connect channel performance to broader business priorities, identifying where Paid Social can create the greatest impact.
Share insights and learnings to drive continuous improvement across markets.

 
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH  
You’ll work in a highly collaborative, global environment, partnering with Paid Media Specialists, Creative Production, Measurement & Analytics teams, markets, agencies and external platform partners.
As a trusted Paid Social expert, you’ll connect teams and perspectives across the organisation, helping create alignment around how the channel evolves and delivers impact across markets.
 
WHO YOU ARE  
You’re a Paid Social expert who combines deep channel knowledge with strong commercial judgement and the presence to influence at senior level. You’re comfortable moving between the details of platform performance and the bigger business picture, and you know how to turn complex information into a clear point of view and recommendation. You’re someone who takes ownership, asks the right questions and isn’t afraid to challenge established ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve. You build credibility through expertise, but you also know that driving change in a global organisation requires curiosity, collaboration and the ability to bring people with you. You communicate with clarity and confidence, adapt your message to your audience and are comfortable leading conversations with senior stakeholders. Rather than simply presenting results, you help others understand what they mean for the business, what needs to happen next and why.
We are looking for people with:
7-9 years’ experience in Paid Social, digital media or performance marketing roles.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics or a related field.
Strong expertise in Paid Social platforms and advertising products, such as Meta and TikTok.
A structured and analytical mindset, with experience leading Test & Learn initiatives.
The ability to translate performance data into actionable improvements and best practices.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and turning complex media and performance topics into clear business recommendations.
Strong commercial judgement and the ability to connect Paid Social performance to broader business objectives.
The confidence to lead discussions, challenge constructively and create alignment across different teams and perspectives.
The ability to communicate with impact, adapting your message to audiences ranging from channel specialists to senior leaders.
A curious, proactive approach and the ownership to move complex topics forward across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills in English.

 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 
JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page. 
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Help Build the Next Generation of Mathematics Learning
Albert Group is a Nordic EdTech group developing digital education services that help children learn and grow. Through Albert Junior and Sumdog, the group has established experience in digital learning for both home and school.
Albert Group is now developing a new AI-powered mathematics platform designed to make learning more personalised, engaging and effective.
The platform will offer two complementary services. For schools, the focus is on providing teachers with better tools for instruction, classroom activities and understanding students' learning progress. For home use, a standalone service is being developed where children can learn new mathematical concepts, practise their skills and receive personalised support through AI.
Both services will work independently while also having the potential to complement each other and strengthen children's learning.
For this initiative, E-commerce Recruit is looking for a VP AI Ventures to take overall responsibility for developing the product, building the business and bringing the offering to market.
About the Role
You will take full ownership of developing the new business, from product strategy and technical priorities to launch and commercial growth.
The product is already under development. Your role will be to take it forward, establish clear priorities and ensure that technology is translated into valuable, commercially viable services.
You will lead a small team with expertise in technology and education, while also working with external developers and specialists. The role involves close collaboration with other businesses within the group and reports directly to the CEO.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Own the product strategy, roadmap and priorities for the AI-powered platform.
Lead internal developers, educational specialists and external consultants, while driving key technical decisions.
Ensure the product is grounded in relevant educational research and that technology supports learning.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies targeting both schools (B2B) and parents (B2C).
Take responsibility for the business model, positioning, pricing and commercial launch.
Drive pilot programmes and measure learning outcomes, user engagement and business performance.
Build the team and business step by step, with responsibility for budget and results.
Develop the business with international expansion in mind, initially focusing on the Nordic markets and the UK.

During your first months, you will familiarise yourself with the existing product development work and establish a clear product and go-to-market plan. The next priorities will be to launch pilots, measure results and create the conditions for acquiring paying customers.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for someone who has experience building, developing and launching digital products or new business areas, and who understands what it takes to turn an early-stage idea into a viable business.
You have a strong technical understanding and hands-on experience with AI-powered products. You do not need to write the code yourself, but you must be able to understand technical opportunities, challenge development teams and make well-informed decisions.
You also bring a strong commercial mindset and experience turning product ideas into offerings that customers want to use and are willing to pay for.
We believe you have:
Experience building and launching digital products, preferably within SaaS, with responsibility for both product development and commercial results.
Hands-on experience with AI products, such as LLM-based features, prompt engineering, evaluation or personalisation.
Experience leading developers, product teams or external technology partners.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies.
A data-driven approach based on testing hypotheses, measuring results and making informed decisions.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Swedish is highly preferred, but we welcome strong candidates who speak English only.

Experience in EdTech, consumer applications or international digital services is an advantage. A background in startups, entrepreneurship, the UK education market or data protection is also valuable.
Your Personality and Approach
To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable operating in an environment where not all the answers are available from the start.

jobs.description:
Rådgivare inom parkslide och kontaminerade jordmassor, Stockholmsregionen

Om ProGreen
ProGreen Sverige AB arbetar med att bekämpa invasiva främmande växtarter. Det är arter som parkslide, jätteloka, jättebalsamin, kanadensiskt gullris, blomsterlupin och vresros, som tränger undan inhemsk flora, skadar byggnader och infrastruktur och kostar samhället stora summor varje år. Uppdragsgivarna är kommuner, myndigheter, byggföretag, bostadsrättsföreningar, företag och privatpersoner i hela Sverige.

Arbetet omfattar hela kedjan: inventering och kartläggning av bestånd, mekanisk och kemisk bekämpning, dispensansökningar, uppföljning över flera säsonger samt rapporter och rådgivning till beställare. ProGreen arbetar långsiktigt och med fokus på att bestånden faktiskt ska försvinna, inte bara hållas tillbaka.

Varför tjänsten finns
Parkslide är en av de svåraste invasiva arterna att bli av med. Rhizomen kan sträcka sig flera meter från plantan, och mycket små fragment räcker för att arten ska etablera sig på nytt. När jord flyttas vid bygg- och markarbeten följer parkslide ofta med, och nya bestånd sprids på det sättet över stora områden. I Sverige finns i dag mycket lite praktisk kunskap om hur sådana massor ska hanteras, medan andra länder, till exempel Storbritannien, har arbetat systematiskt med frågan i många år. Därför är erfarenhet från länder där metoderna redan är etablerade särskilt värdefull.

ProGreen bygger nu upp rådgivning kring parkslidekontaminerade jordmassor som ett eget verksamhetsområde och söker en specialist som kan vägleda beställare, entreprenörer och myndigheter.

Vad jag söker
Jag söker dig som kan parkslide på djupet, ovan och under mark. Du kan bedöma en plats, avgöra hur långt rhizomen sträcker sig och förklara för beställare och entreprenörer vad som krävs för att massor ska kunna flyttas utan att arten sprids vidare. Du är lika trygg på en byggarbetsplats som i ett möte, och du är bra på att omsätta kunskap i tydliga och praktiska råd.

Du kommer att arbeta nära mig och få stort inflytande över hur verksamheten byggs upp, från metoder och rutiner till hur tjänsten erbjuds till kunderna. Tjänsten passar dig som vill vara med från början och bygga något nytt.

Arbetsuppgifter
• Bedöma platser och rhizomutbredning inför schakt- och markarbeten
• Upprätta åtgärdsplaner för massor: nedgrävning på plats, inkapsling, rotspärrar eller borttransport till godkänd mottagare
• Ge råd till beställare, entreprenörer och kommuner före och under projekt
• Genomföra kontroller på plats under schakt och sållning
• Ta fram rutiner för biosäkerhet på arbetsplatser och vid transport
• Utbilda entreprenörer och maskinförare
• Dokumentera arbetet och följa upp behandlade ytor
• Utveckla metoder, offerter och tjänsteutbud

Krav
• Erfarenhet av hantering av jordmassor som innehåller parkslide eller andra invasiva arter med rhizom.
• God förmåga att identifiera parkslidens rhizom och kronor i fält
• Erfarenhet av samarbete med entreprenörer och maskinförare i schaktprojekt
• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande
• Branschcertifiering inom parkslidebekämpning, till exempel Riksförbundet Svensk Trädgård eller PCA (Property Care Association) eller motsvarande
• Erfarenhet av att upprätta åtgärdsplaner
• Maskinvana, till exempel grävmaskin
• B-körkort
• Kunskaper i svenska

Anställningsvillkor

• Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal
• Tillträde i april 2027
• Utgångsort [Strängnäs/Huddinge], uppdrag främst i Stockholmsregionen men även i övriga Sverige

Knotweed Advisor, Contaminated Soil, Stockholm, Sweden

About ProGreen
ProGreen Sverige AB controls invasive alien plant species such as Japanese knotweed, giant hogweed and Himalayan balsam. Clients include municipalities, authorities, construction companies, housing associations and homeowners across Sweden. The work covers the whole chain: surveying, mechanical and chemical control, permits, multi-year follow-up and advice, with the aim of eradication, not just suppression.

Why this role exists
Knotweed rhizome can extend several metres from the plant, and tiny fragments are enough to re-establish. When soil is moved during groundworks, knotweed moves with it. Sweden still has very little practical knowledge of handling such soil, while other countries, such as the UK, have worked on it systematically for years. ProGreen is now building this up as a dedicated advisory service and needs a specialist to guide clients and contractors.

What I am looking for
An advisor who knows knotweed above and below ground. You can assess a site, judge how far the rhizome extends and explain to clients and contractors what it takes to move soil without spreading the plant. You are confident on construction sites and in meetings, and good at turning expertise into clear, practical advice. You will work closely with me and help shape the service from the start.

Tasks
• Assess sites and rhizome extent ahead of groundworks
• Write management plans: on-site burial, encapsulation, root barriers or removal to approved facilities
• Advise clients, contractors and municipalities before and during projects
• Carry out site inspections during excavation and screening
• Develop biosecurity procedures for sites and transport
• Train contractors and machine operators
• Document work and follow up treated areas
• Develop methods, quotes and service offers

Requirements
• Experience handling knotweed-contaminated soil
• Able to identify knotweed rhizome and crowns in the field
• Experience working with contractors on excavation projects
• Good spoken and written English

Desirable
• PCA certification or equivalent
• Experience writing knotweed management plans
• Excavator experience, driving licence B, Swedish

Terms
Permanent, full time, all year round, with a 6-month probationary period. Salary and terms according to Swedish collective agreement. Start April 2027. Based in [Strängnäs/Huddinge].

Send your CV and a few lines about your previous projects to Alex@progreen.se

jobs.occupation: Doctoral student in Mechanical Engineering - specialisation in wire drawing
jobs.description:
Örebro University and the School of Science and Technology are looking for a doctoral student for the doctoral programme in Mechanical Engineering, concluding with a doctoral degree.
Start date: January – March 2027.
Project description
Steel wire is an essential component of countless products and applications, from everyday items such as ballpoint pens and car tyres to critical infrastructure such as buildings and bridges. As industry advances towards more sustainable manufacturing, there is an increasing need to produce steel wire products with greater resource efficiency, improved material performance, and reduced environmental impact.
This doctoral project aims to advance the knowledge and technologies needed to make wire drawing processes more efficient, robust, and sustainable. The research is carried out in close collaboration with the wire drawing industry, ensuring that scientific developments address real industrial challenges and contribute to more sustainable production of steel wire products. Particular emphasis will be placed on improving process understanding and developing and evaluating innovative drawing tools.
The research will combine experimental investigations of wire drawing processes, tool behaviour, and resulting wire properties with sensor-based measurements, data analysis, and modelling. A central objective is to understand how material properties, process conditions, lubrication, and tooling interact and influence process performance, tool wear, and wire quality. This knowledge will support the development of practical solutions that improve resource utilisation, extend tool life, and enhance the efficiency and sustainability of industrial wire drawing.
As a doctoral student, you will plan and conduct experiments, analyse data, develop models, and communicate your findings through scientific publications and presentations. You will work closely with academic researchers and industrial partners, contributing to research that bridges fundamental scientific understanding and practical industrial applications.
The project offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the intersection of mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, materials engineering, measurement technology, modelling, and control engineering. By addressing challenges associated with resource efficiency, production performance, and the green transition, the research aims to contribute to the development of next-generation wire drawing processes and tools that support more sustainable steel wire production.
Supervision: The doctoral student will be supervised by Christer Korin (principal supervisor) and Joakim Larsson (assistant supervisor).
The programme and the doctoral studentship
The doctoral programme consists of courses and an independent research project that you will present in a doctoral thesis. The programme concludes with a doctoral degree and comprises 240 credits, which corresponds to four years of full-time study.
Our ambition is for your doctoral studies to be stimulating and purposeful throughout the programme until you have obtained your doctoral degree. A thorough introduction will therefore get you off to a good start and provide a solid foundation on which you can build your studies. As a doctoral student at Örebro University, you will be offered a specially tailored seminar series, covering matters ranging from doctoral programme rules and careers to support during the study period and networking.
The place on the programme is linked to a full-time doctoral studentship for the duration of the study programme, which corresponds to four years of full-time study. More information on doctoral studentships, part-time studies and part-time doctoral studentships can be found on https://www.oru.se/english/study/doctoral-studies/how-to-become-a-doctoral-student/. The initial salary for a doctoral studentship is SEK 32 300 a month (salary period 2025-2026).

jobs.description:
Merch that moves business needs a platform that moves just as fast.
From scattered purchases without brand control, to the magic that happens when it all clicks: merch that makes a real impact, on one global platform customized for each client, as if they built it themselves.
That’s what we’re building at Exakt. The platform is up and running, but this is only the beginning. Now comes the most advanced part, and we’re looking for an engineer with the drive and the skills to build it on a global scale. 
What you’ll do  You’ll build and own our merch platform, full stack: TypeScript and React on the frontend, Node APIs in the middle and a MedusaJS headless commerce backend, all running on GCP. 
It’s live with our first clients, and the codebase is still young enough that your decisions will stick. From here, you’ll:

Own the platform end to end, from architecture to checkout

Refine and develop the product logic. One t-shirt can come in 62 colors and seven sizes, from several suppliers, production partners and locations. Find new ways to make it all run even more smoothly

Take our client dashboard further, with the advanced features our clients didn’t know they needed, and even more transparency around orders, statistics and the environmental impact of what they buy

Automate the manual work, on the platform and behind the scenes, so the team can spend more time on the creative work

Set the technical direction with our founder, and help shape the team as we grow 

Who you are
You enjoy figuring out what’s needed and making it happen without waiting to be asked. And you’re curious about the business behind the code, whether you’re shaping a feature or talking ideas through with a client, in English.

You’re resourceful, and happy to use a smart existing solution instead of reinventing it

You bring experience and an open mind. You know how to move fast, and you’re always curious about new ways of working

You know when speed matters more than perfection, and you make sure the quick fix doesn’t become permanent

You work AI-first, and take security and client data just as seriously

You like people, and you’d rather be at the office with the team than on mute

You’re comfortable across backend and frontend, and our designers take care of the design. Experience with e-commerce, Medusa or multi-tenant platforms is a plus, but not a must. 
Tech you’ll work with  We’re guessing you already have the essentials. The limited editions are a bonus, and the rest you’ll pick up along the way.

The essentials: TypeScript, React, Node, PostgreSQL, Git, and GCP or a similar cloud platform

The limited editions: MedusaJS, Next.js, Redis, Prisma, Terraform, Clerk, Stripe 

About Exakt
Exakt, the world’s boldest merch agency since 2004. Bold, but true. We start with who a brand wants to reach and what it wants to say, and help turn that into products people keep, use and remember. Our clients feel safe with us. They know they’ll get the right thing, on time and delivered to the right place.
We’ve run webshops for our clients for more than 10 years. Now we’re scaling up our platform, continuously building new processes around our clients’ needs and our own workflow efficiency, and automating more and more of what has been done by hand. The whole process, and the service and ownership we’re known for, become transparent and easy to follow.
With new print techniques, new ways of working with our print partners and years of industry know-how, we have turned our knowledge into a platform that’s unique in our industry.
Picture a company where everyone, from sales and marketing to HR and finance, gets the merch they need from one place. Always on brand and always the strongest choice for the target group, whether it’s printed on demand, custom-made or shipped from stock, with full control over costs and climate impact. Behind it sits a multi-tenant platform built around each client. There’s no off-the-shelf solution for this, so we’re building our own.
We work with brands like Samsung, Electrolux and KRY, and things are going well: we’re profitable, growing fast and have never needed venture capital. Put our merch expertise together with a platform that handles every part of it, and you get something no one else offers.
Why Exakt
You’ll have real ownership of the tech from day one, with the influence of a startup in a company that’s already on solid ground. Exakt is known in our industry for always being a step ahead, in how we work with ideas, proposals, solutions and suppliers, so you really get the best of both worlds. We’re a team of eight with zero prestige, and we’re growing, looking for the right expertise to expand our team in every area. We support each other through whatever comes our way, celebrate together, eat lunch together and take our merch-cap throwing competitions a little too seriously.
You’ll find us at our office on Lidingö, where client work happens in English and office chat in Swedish, so you’ll need to understand it.
Apply
Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you. We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no need to wait.
Curious about something first? Emelie is helping us find the right person and is happy to answer anything about the role: emelie.stjarnas@ants.se

jobs.occupation: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
jobs.description:
Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)
Third-cycle subject area
Biology
Description of the doctoral project
A PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:
 
How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?
How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?
In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?
In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale.

 
About the position
The main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites.
 
The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland.
 
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
 
Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
 
Desirable experience
Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.
Experience working with fish.
Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.
Experience with independent writing.
Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.
Experience with analysis of large datasets.
Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.
Will contribute to a good working climate.
Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.
Driver’s licence.
Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work.

 
About us
At the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:
 
An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues
Access to a broad international network of scientists
Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale
Good welfare benefits

 
Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/
 
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
 
Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ 
 
Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)
Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.
 
Scope
100%
 
Location
Drottningholm, Stockholm
 
Start date
2027-04-01, or upon agreement.
 
Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
 
Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/
 
Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.
 
Academic union representatives
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
Note: This is a shortened version of the advertisement adapted to the Swedish Public Employment Service’s (Platsbanken) system. Please see the full advertisement on SLU’s website: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses.

At the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering, the university has brought together research and education in electrical engineering, space technology, computer and systems science. We are now looking for a PhD student who can contribute to our growing activities in modelling and measurement of power grids at the EISLAB division. We carry out research in the areas of electronic systems, machine learning and cyber-physical systems. The electronic systems group works with, among other things, electronic design, electrical measurement technology, electromagnetic compatibility, and modelling and measurement of power grids and energy systems. We have access to a number of laboratories and to a test bed in an inland municipality in northern Sweden, with a physics-based model of the local distribution grid and measurement nodes in the grid. 
 Subject description 
Electronics systems include electronics design, measurement technology and electromagnetic compatibility for control, monitoring and instrumentation of technical processes and systems, with close connection to applications and applied research. 
 
Project description 
The electrification of vehicles, heating and services means that local power grids and buildings need to interact in new ways. Power is often lacking in the grid during the hours when demand is highest, although the grid is lightly loaded for much of the year. Using the existing capacity safely requires better knowledge of the state of the grid, but in smaller distribution grids measurements are often sparse and delayed.
Digital twins, where physics-based models are combined with measurement data and forecasts, are a promising way to address this. Important research questions are how such models can be kept up to date with few measurement points, how uncertainty in model and data can be quantified and propagated to decisions, and how the model results can be turned into signals that buildings, EV charging and other flexible loads can follow, while maintaining comfort, function and electrical safety.
A digital twin is never better than the measurements it is built on. This is where the group's competence in electronics and measurement technology contributes. We develop our own measurement nodes that are placed in the grid, with sensors, embedded systems and local data processing, and we study how measurements from new nodes and from existing smart meters can be combined.
As a PhD student you will work in a research project in this area, in collaboration with a municipality and a local grid operator, and, with the support of our team of researchers, develop into an independent researcher. The specific focus, for example more towards modelling and state estimation or more towards measurement nodes and measurement systems, can to some extent be guided by your background and interest. 
 
Duties 
As a PhD student you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies. This includes modelling of distribution grids, analysis of real measurement data, state estimation with sparse measurements and evaluation of measurement nodes in the grid, and the work includes recurring travel to the test bed. You will communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies. In addition, you can have the opportunity to try the teacher role. As a researcher, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects. 
 
Qualifications 
We are looking for committed people who have
- a solid educational background, civilingenjör or master's degree or equivalent, in electrical engineering, electric power engineering, energy engineering, control engineering or related fields,
- knowledge of programming, preferably Python, or MATLAB or C/C++,
- a foundation in power systems or circuit theory and measurement technology, preferably with experience of power flow analysis, measurement systems or embedded systems,
- effective communication skills to convey complex ideas with clarity and impact. 
 
Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage, since the work is carried out in close dialogue with a municipality and a grid operator.

Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support to production when required.
Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.
Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.
Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

Intermodulation Products AB is a pioneering company developing advanced test and measurement equipment for the quantum technology sector. As we continue to expand the reach of our flagship Presto platform, we are looking for a highly technical and outgoing Quantum Application Engineer to join our team in Stockholm.
In this role, you will be the crucial link between our technology and the global physics community. Your primary focus will be helping existing and potential customers understand how Presto can solve their most complex measurement needs across superconducting circuits, quantum sensing, computing, and communication. You will own and run live demonstrations using our in-house superconducting qubit setup, represent us at scientific conferences, and provide critical technical support for both sales and existing users. You will also travel to customer laboratories, spending time with researchers to deeply understand their experimental workflows and pain points, and bring those insights directly back to our development team. This role is perfect for a physicist who loves being hands-on with technology but finds it equally fun and energizing to interact with people.
Responsibilities
Help existing and potential customers understand how the Presto platform solves specific measurement challenges in quantum tech and RF.
Own, maintain, and present live technical demonstrations using our superconducting qubit setup.
Represent the company at international scientific conferences, presenting our products at the booth and engaging with fellow physicists.
Partner with the sales team to provide technical pre-sales support and system configuration advice.
Assist customers with high-level technical support questions and troubleshooting.
Travel to customer labs to spend time on-site, understanding their measurement pain points and workflows.
Act as the voice of the customer, forwarding field knowledge and feature requests to our internal development team.

Requirements
PhD (preferred) or MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Quantum Engineering, or a highly related field.
Strong background in experimental physics with hands-on knowledge of microwave and low-temperature measurements.
A highly technical mindset coupled with a strong willingness and enthusiasm to engage, network, and interact with fellow physicists.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly.
Willingness and ability to travel to scientific conferences and customer laboratories globally.
Good written and spoken English.

Meritorious Qualifications: You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
Experience with Python programming, specifically for data acquisition, instrument control, and data analysis.
Previous experience in technical sales, field application engineering, or customer-facing scientific support.
Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators or other cryogenic systems.
Practical experience working directly with superconducting qubits or similar solid-state quantum devices.

jobs.description:
Objektvision is rebuilding its platform from scratch and is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape it. If you'd rather ship real UI in Claude Code than polish screens in Figma, this could be your next step.
The role
You'll be part of the team building our new customer platform: the tool property owners, managers and brokers log into to list, manage and rent out their space. That covers the obvious parts, like making it effortless to publish a listing, and the less obvious ones: access levels, billing and invoicing, and the view our customer service team works in every day. You need to understand the system behind the screens, not just the screens. 
The Product Manager prototypes ideas and tests them with customers. Once we decide to go for something, you take over: you design the interaction and UI and build the frontend yourself in Claude Code, so it's close to ready when the Full-stack Engineer picks it up. You'll design AI-powered features like listing quality scoring and matching together with our Data & AI Lead, and help build one shared design system for all markets. 
You work daily with a Product Manager and a Full-stack Engineer, and you'll have another Product Designer in the company to exchange ideas and feedback with. 
About you

5+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped products. A background in development before moving into design is a big plus

Hands-on with Claude Code (or similar) for prototyping and real frontend work

Comfortable in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React (or similar)

Pragmatic and quick to move; you know when something is good enough to ship, and you enjoy finding the best solution together with the team

Fluent in English; working/conversational Swedish required (team language is English, but daily life at the office is in Swedish)

Nice to have: experience designing AI features (chat, agents, recommendations), owning a design system, or a marketplace/proptech background 

About Objektvision
Objektvision is Sweden's leading marketplace for commercial real estate, part of Finland's Alma Media. They're rebuilding their entire platform from the ground up, going AI-first and shared across markets. Being a small company means they can actually change how they work, not just talk about it. You'll be based centrally in Stockholm, in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with flexibility to work from home the rest of the week. The culture is close-knit and generous - shared lunches, regular offsites, and a wellness allowance, with occasional trips to the team in Finland. 
Application
We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible. Objektvision is collaborating with Ants for this recruitment. Questions about the role? Reach out to Julia Lagerblad at Ants: julia.lagerblad@ants.se

The key responsibility of the Quality Control technician is for  receiving  and analyzing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Research & Development, Testing & Validation, and Production using a range of instruments as well as participating in problem solving and technical troubleshooting exercises on the execution side.   
Key Responsibilities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Execute work instructions and participate in laboratory functions/tasks/work.   
Follow 5S and safety protocols within the production and laboratory work environment.  
Conduct analysis on a wide range of instruments and report data/results for a diverse set of samples in the expected template and/or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); and maintain control charts.  
Able to understand and execute testing and validation plans for incoming parts, product intermediates, finalized products, and other material accordingly. 
Identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Be able to troubleshoot basic to advance problems; utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Understand the fundamental principles of method development and/or method validation and able to participate in the execution.   
Able to write support documentation for standard operations.  
Maintaining instruments and measurement areas to a high standard, involving responsibility to ensure that the laboratory or production room(s)/area(s) comply with safety related guidelines, 5S guidelines, maintaining consumable inventory and instrument readiness.  
Able to train and qualifying personnel according to a skill and competence level.  
Strict adherence to Quality Assurance and Quality Control Principles.   
Participate in improvement plans and investigations for various topics.   

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor´s degree or master’s degree in a technical field is preferred.  
2 years experience in quality control from relevant industry is preferred.  
Specific knowledge in any relevant instrumentation, measurement system, or scientific field used by the company. (preferred)  
Familiar with quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, Total Quality Management (TQM). 
Familiar with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. (Preferred)  
Curious, technically educated and preferably with a strong business background.  
Experience in Cell Manufacturing, or Test and Validation is an advantage.  

 Specific skills & Knowledge 
Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.

As a Senior iOS Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel iOS app. The iOS team is two engineers, and you'd be the third. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our iOS platform.
Areas of ownership:

Drive the modernization from legacy Objective-C to a modern Swift + SwiftUI stack

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

Build and modernize iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Contribute to architecture decisions (VIPER to MVVM-C transition, Combine, platform improvements)

Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions

Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

Maintain and improve the overall health of the iOS platform

5+ years building iOS apps

Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C

Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)

Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring

Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns

Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions

Work effectively with AI coding tools

Good English (we write and speak it all day)

jobs.occupation: R&D Senior Engineer for System Design
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Join our HVDC R&D team at Hitachi Energy and help pioneer the future of energy transmission. We are now looking for a R&D Senior Engineer to contribute to the development of advanced control strategies for HVDC systems, including Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) and Line Commutated Converter (LCC) technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work in a global, collaborative environment focused on innovation and technical excellence.
In this role, you will design and optimize control algorithms for MMC- and LCC-based HVDC systems, including multiterminal HVDC (MTDC) configurations. You will also perform small-signal stability analysis, harmonic studies, and transient simulations to ensure robust and reliable system performance. A key part of your responsibilities will be to lead system-level dynamic performance evaluations and drive continuous improvements in control strategies. Additionally, you will mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, helping shape the future direction of HVDC control systems and power electronics design.
How You Will Make an Impact
Contribute to converter topology design, control and protection, and main circuit development for VSC HVDC and LCC HVDC systems.
Perform insulation coordination, steady-state and dynamic stability studies, harmonic analysis, and performances under various conditions.
Address evolving customer requirements with a strong stakeholder focus.
Uphold our core values of safety, integrity, and responsibility.
Collaborate in a supportive and agile team environment.
Take ownership of both technology and your personal development.

Your Background
PhD or MSc in Power Systems, Electrical Machines and Drives, or Power Electronics Control.
Several years of experience in HVDC or FACTS technologies.
Strong knowledge of MMC topologies and HVDC control systems.
Experience in small-signal stability analysis and transient simulations.
Skilled in simulation tools: MATLAB, PSCAD/EMTDC, EMTP-RV, and ideally Modelica, RTDS, Python, C/C++.
Open-minded, solution-oriented, and collaborative with strong organizational skills.
Proficiency in English is required

What we offer 
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us

Automation Process Engineering Manager
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (alternative location: Shanghai, China)
Help Scale the Manufacturing Platform Behind Next-Generation AI Technology
Smart High Tech AB is a Swedish deep-tech company developing graphene-enhanced thermal interface materials for AI infrastructure, semiconductors, data centres and advanced electronics.
As we move from commercialisation into industrial scale-up, we are seeking an experienced Automation Process Engineering Manager to lead the development of automated, scalable and high-performance manufacturing operations.
The Role
You will lead the transition from current manufacturing to stable, high-volume production. Working closely with R&D, Production and Quality, you will develop the processes, automation systems and manufacturing capabilities required to support rapid growth while ensuring operational excellence and product quality.
Key Responsibilities
Lead manufacturing scale-up from current production to mass production.

Design and implement automated manufacturing processes and workflows.

Develop robust process architectures ensuring efficiency, stability and repeatability.

Define automation requirements and manage equipment selection and integration.

Establish process control systems to meet customer and quality requirements.

Drive continuous improvement in yield, quality, productivity and operational performance.

Support factory design, production line development, commissioning and ramp-up.

Collaborate with R&D, Production, Quality and Supply Chain teams to ensure successful industrialisation.

Build and develop a high-performing process engineering capability.

Qualifications & Experience

Drive continuous improvement of procurement processes and supply chain performance.

About us
LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents.
We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. It is a pivotal stage for the company, and you could get the chance to lead it.

As Process Engineer, you will be the one who takes our process from the lab to industry. You will transfer today's sheet-to-sheet manufacturing to roll-to-roll and build the network of partners who will handle production, from substrates and printing to lamination and quality control. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and owning the scale-up of our production from sheet-to-sheet to roll-to-roll
Implementing and optimising our processes in production environments with partners and in existing facilities
Leading the collaboration with our production partners and taking part in customer and partner demos as well as EU projects
Being responsible for quality, routines and compliance in production
Travelling internationally to implement and follow up production on site

We believe that you…
…hold a Master of Science in Engineering, for example in materials engineering, chemical engineering or physics. You have experience of production, roll-to-roll and process development. Experience of scaling a production process, solution based device fabrication at scale and printed electronics are merits. You communicate fluently in English.
As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market.
We offer
🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world
💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up
🌍 An international and dedicated team
✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners

Start: By agreement
Scope: Full-time
Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. International travel is part of the role

jobs.occupation: Industrial Painter / Surface Treatment Technician - Offshore - Norway
jobs.description:
Job description: 
Industrial painting, surface preparation and protective coating work on offshore oil and gas installations in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea. Typical work includes abrasive blasting, water jetting, coating application by airless spray / brush / roller, stripe coating, and application or repair of epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), including Chartek systems. Work is performed in accordance with project specifications, coating procedures, HSE requirements and client quality standards.

Requirements: 
- Minimum 2 years of relevant, documented experience in industrial painting and surface treatment.
- Hands-on experience with surface preparation, including abrasive blasting and/or high-pressure water jetting, and application of protective coating systems.
- Documented experience with epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), preferably Chartek or equivalent systems.
- Experience with NORSOK M-501 or equivalent offshore coating requirements is an advantage.
- Trade certificate (fagbrev) in industrial painting/surface treatment is an advantage. Candidates without a trade certificate must meet §13 or equivalent site-test competence requirements, where applicable.
- Minimum B1 level in a Scandinavian language: Norwegian, Swedish or Danish.
- Before offshore mobilisation, candidates must meet the assignment-specific requirements for recognised basic safety/emergency training and a valid offshore medical certificate. Exact certificate requirements will be confirmed during recruitment.
- Strong HSE awareness, quality focus, reliability and ability to work effectively in multicultural project teams.

Type of work contract: 
Permanent employment with JJS ProsjektPartner AS, subject to the applicable probationary period. Offshore assignments are normally organised on a 2 weeks on / 4 weeks off rotation, subject to client and project requirements.

Starting date: 
Expected start: 01.01.2027. Exact mobilisation date to be agreed with the selected candidate.

Working hours: 
Typical 2/4 offshore rotation: 14 days on / 28 days off, normally 12-hour shifts (168 working hours per 6-week rotation cycle), subject to the assignment schedule.

Place of work: 
Offshore installations in the Norwegian sector of the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS), depending on assignment.

Salary: 
Salary and applicable supplements in accordance with the relevant Norwegian collective agreement (tariff) and assignment-specific terms.

Other information: 
ProsjektPartner coordinates assignment-related travel and accommodation. Selected candidates will receive guidance on mobilisation, required documentation and client-specific courses. ProsjektPartner can assist with selected training through companies in NSE Gruppen.

About the company: 
JJS ProsjektPartner AS is a Norwegian staffing company specialising in qualified personnel for complex industrial projects, both onshore and offshore. With roots dating back to 2003 and as part of NSE Gruppen, we provide experienced professionals within industrial painting and surface treatment, insulation and cladding, scaffolding, and mechanical trades. Our focus is to supply the right competence at the right time, with high standards for HSE, quality and reliable project execution.

How to apply? 
Send your CV and relevant trade/certificate documentation to marco@propartner.no. Please include a short summary of your surface-treatment, offshore and PFP/Chartek experience. You may also call +47 975 92 360.

Contact: 
Marco Scharin
+47 975 92 360
marco@propartner.no

Marco speaks both Finnish, Norwegian and English, and Finnish-speaking candidates are welcome to contact him directly in Finnish.

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a driven Customer Success Specialist to support our Benelux operations.
About the Role
In this hybrid role, you will bridge relationship management with active credit risk assessment. You will manage incoming SMB loan applications, conduct financial health checks, and guide Dutch-speaking business owners through their lending journey, ensuring both strong customer satisfaction and healthy portfolio quality.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate and process standard-to-mid complexity SMB loan applications using our risk frameworks and credit data.

Act as the main consultative contact for business applicants in Dutch, guiding them through underwriting and closing deals.

Analyze financial statements, cash flow patterns, and credit reports to verify deal quality and risk profiles.

Collaborate with senior underwriters on complex, high-ticket cases that require customized financing structures.

Act as a voice of the customer, sharing insights to continuously improve our product and localized operational processes.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a commercially driven, analytical team player who understands business finance and loves solving problems for entrepreneurs. You possess strong interpersonal skills, carry an eye for numerical detail, and are eager to take clear ownership of SMB credit applications.
Qualifications
A few years experience in Customer Success, B2B account management, strategic lending, or credit processing within Banking, Fintech, or Financial Services.

Hands-on familiarity with evaluating financial statements, corporate documents, and credit scoring models.

Native or professional fluency in Dutch, combined with strong professional English.

A structured approach, good business acumen, and a keen interest in SMB financing models.

Strong communication and negotiation skills with a drive to help small businesses succeed.

Detail-oriented, comfortable working with data, and skilled at prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Qred?
This role offers a clear path to fast-track your career in commercial lending and fintech. Qred operates with a non-bureaucratic structure, short decision paths, and a high-performing culture where initiative is rewarded. You will take true ownership of your portfolio while deepening your credit and financial expertise alongside top industry talent.
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach with the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis, and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Taking ownership of assigned game projects, from initial planning through execution and delivery.

jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
As an HMI Engineer, you will play an important role in designing, developing and implementing Human-Machine Interface (HMI) solutions for HVDC control systems. Your focus will be on creating user-friendly, efficient and reliable interfaces that meet technical requirements and quality standards.
You will work closely with engineers and technicians across different disciplines to ensure seamless integration of HMI solutions into larger control systems. Your responsibilities will cover several stages of the development process, including design, system integration, testing, troubleshooting and technical documentation.
You will also contribute your technical expertise to project activities and support the planning and follow-up of project schedules and budgets.
Responsibilities:
Design and develop user-friendly HMI solutions for HVDC control systems

Integrate HMI solutions into larger technical systems

Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimise system functionality

Test and troubleshoot HMI systems to ensure performance and reliability

Identify and resolve technical issues and software bugs

Prepare technical documentation, user manuals and specifications

Participate in project meetings and contribute technical expertise

Support project planning and follow-up of schedules and budgets

Who are you?
We are looking for someone with a genuine interest in technology and a strong willingness to learn and develop professionally. You approach technical challenges with curiosity, analytical thinking and a solution-oriented mindset.
You are structured, thorough and attentive to detail, with a natural focus on quality. You feel comfortable taking responsibility for your own work while also enjoying collaboration and knowledge-sharing with colleagues. Furthermore, you communicate effectively and thrive in an environment where different technical disciplines work towards common goals.
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a related field

Has several years of work experience in software engineering, HMI development, industrial automation or a related technical field

Has programming knowledge and experience working with SCADA systems

Has good communication skills English, both written and spoken

It is considered an advantage if you have good communication skills in Swedish
Practical information
Location: Ludvika
Start: According to agreement
Working hours: Full-time, weekdays during daytime
Employment: You will work as a consultant through A-hub for 12 months, with the ambition of transitioning to direct employment with our client thereafter
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

At Björkdalsgruvan, just outside Skellefteå, you will take on a varied and independent role as a Process Engineer, combining process analysis with technical improvements in the mineral processing plant. Working closely with operations, you will lead development projects aimed at improving and optimising production. You will also play an active role in modernising the plant, including enhancing process control and automation. You will be part of a flat organisation with short decision-making processes, a high degree of responsibility and real opportunities to make an impact.We are looking for someone with solid experience in process engineering, preferably from the mining industry, ore processing or mineral processing. We look forward to receiving your application!
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, hands-on problem-solving and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.
Swedish language lessons available if needed.
A flexible and stimulating work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.
Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.

Your Responsibilities
As a Process Engineer, you will provide technical support to the Processing Plant Manager and Operations Managers responsible for the processing plant and crushing operations. You will be responsible for ongoing process monitoring and lead improvement projects from investigation and planning through to implementation and follow-up.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Collecting and analysing process data, identifying deviations and optimising processes to ensure stable operations and improved gold recovery.
Investigating technical challenges related to flotation, grinding and reagent dosing.
Performing process engineering calculations and metal accounting.
Working with process flow diagrams, technical drawings and P&IDs as part of improvement projects.
Conducting laboratory-based process development and testing.
Collaborating with operations and maintenance teams on troubleshooting, planning and scheduled maintenance shutdowns.
Providing technical support to the processing plant, crushing operations and tailings facilities.
Participating in budgeting activities and contributing to systematic health, safety and work environment improvements.

The Bigger Picture
Your workplace will be the mineral processing plant at Björkdalsgruvan. This is a daytime position with flexible working hours based on trust and individual responsibility.
The plant uses ABB control systems, along with various systems for process monitoring and maintenance management. One of the current development priorities is reagent dosing, with the aim of automating process control to achieve a more stable, consistent and efficient operation.
Our Expectations
To succeed in this role, you will need:
A relevant university degree in Process Engineering, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering or a related field.
A good understanding of the relationship between chemistry, engineering and industrial processes.
Experience in technical problem-solving and process improvement.
The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, process flow diagrams and P&IDs.
The ability to work independently and turn analysis into practical, actionable solutions.
The ability to communicate effectively in English in a professional environment.

It would be particularly advantageous if you have:
Experience from the mining industry or mineral processing plants.
Knowledge of mineral processing operations, such as flotation and grinding.
Experience in technical improvement projects and industrial control systems.
Swedish language skills.

Interested?

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about automation engineering and curious about complex converting machine technologies?
As part of Tetra Pak Development & Technology organisation, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and implementing world class converting solutions, enabling Tetra Pak to deliver competitive packaging solutions.
We are currently looking for a Technical Responsible within Automation Finishing, where finishing represents the last process step in production of packaging material. In this position you will lead and supervise specific high complex Automation design activities, related to D&T Converting solutions equipment's. You will act as mentor and coach for other Automation Engineers, give support and guidance to other colleagues and suppliers in the area as well as participating in strategy and roadmap work.
This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden.
What you will do
As our Technical Responsible, you will have the technical responsibility for the automation and OT solutions in Finishing, including Life Cycle Management. You will plan, conduct and supervise assignments, review progress and evaluate results. You will belong to a network of Technical Responsible Automation and OT systems (TRA/TRO) from other equipment areas. In addition, you will ensure stable integration, operation, support, development and continuous improvement of Operational Technology (OT) systems within the Finishing area. You will participate in portfolio analysis together with System Engineers and Architects and act as the bridge between equipment teams and IT/OT development teams.
Other responsibilities:
Drive the development, support, and continuous improvement of Automation and OT solutions.
Act as the interface between equipment teams, IT/OT development teams, System Engineers, and Architects.
Monitor system performance, manage incidents, and ensure reliable operation and availability.
Lead and prioritize lifecycle management, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure data flow integrity and data quality across connected systems.
Provide technical support to factories and share knowledge through mentoring and coaching.
Develop and maintain technical documentation in compliance with company standards and legal requirements.
Plan, estimate, and coordinate automation projects and technical activities.
Conduct and follow up technical reviews with internal stakeholders, factories, and suppliers.
Collaborate with Technical Responsible across other equipment areas to align standards and best practices.

Who you are
We believe that you have a solid background with more than 4 years of relevant work experience in automation. You have extensive knowledge and understanding of Automation solutions generally with Siemens's systems. Experience in Finishing and/or knowledge within Motion systems is considered an advantage and you have an understanding of Industrial IT and Operational Technology.
You have personal drive with a clear focus on delivering results with quality. You also understand how to lead and motivate people, having the ability to adjust your leadership to different situations. As Tetra Pak for sure is a global company, you communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
We offer you
Variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
Culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our engineering experts drives visible results
Equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.
Objective of the position
Help us build the test systems behind safer, smarter vehicles.
At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team makes sure every product that leaves the line performs exactly as it should. As our new Test Engineer, you'll own the test solutions for new product introductions — designing them from the ground up — and continuously sharpen the tests already running in production. Your work directly shapes the quality, reliability and efficiency of technologies that go into commercial vehicles around the world.
You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and work alongside a hands-on, cross-functional team that values curiosity and ownership.
What you'll do

Design and build production test software, methods and equipment for both new products and existing lines.

Specify, procure, install and validate new test systems — and keep current ones running at their best.

Be the go-to expert for production teams when test challenges, product changes or process changes come up.

Build and evaluate prototypes, giving the development team clear feedback to improve quality and manufacturability.

Own the documentation — test procedures, verification and training that keep knowledge in the team.

Drive the numbers that matter: test yield, downtime and PPM, and support quotations and approval workflows.

What you bring

BSc/MSc in Electronics (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years in test engineering, production or industrialization — automotive preferred.

Strong electronics fundamentals — you can read and create electrical schematics.

Experience with vision systems (Cognex VisionPro, AVT or similar).

Proficiency in graphical programming tools such as LabVIEW or Keysight VEE.

Solid grasp of statistics (Cpk, standard deviation); Six Sigma Green Belt is an advantage.

Professional level of Swedish and English.

Bonus skills: Minitab, C# and CAN protocols.

What we offer
You will be welcomed to a Fun, Diverse and Inclusive workplace, where we base our culture on our Core Values: Integrity, Customer orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social responsibility. This role is a central role in shaping the future within a multinational automotive technology company focusing on safety and security. We also offer you an opportunity for personal and professional growth in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving organization with competitive salary based on knowledge and experience.
