jobs.occupation: Build Your Career in Family Medicine in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. 
Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden
Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.
We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.
Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.
Professional Development
General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.
Relocation and Support
Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.
Your personal advisor will assist with:
medical licensing
relocation planning
practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.
Support for Your Family
Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.
We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.
Language Training
To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.
Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.
Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.
Living in Sweden
Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.
Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.
Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.
Requirements
We are looking for physicians who:
Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a Midwife looking for a rewarding career opportunity in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting Midwives to join well-established antenatal care clinics in central Sweden. This is an opportunity to work in a supportive and patient-centered environment focused on pregnancy care, reproductive health, preventive healthcare, and women's wellbeing. 
You will become part of a dedicated team working closely with fellow Midwives and other healthcare professionals to provide high-quality care for women and families throughout pregnancy.
About the role
As a Midwife, you will work within antenatal care, providing support and guidance to women throughout pregnancy and reproductive life.
Your responsibilities may include:
Antenatal care and routine pregnancy follow-up
Health assessments and pregnancy monitoring
Patient education and counselling
Reproductive and sexual health consultations
Cervical screening
Preventive healthcare and health promotion
Supporting women and families throughout pregnancy
Collaboration with women's healthcare, primary care, and family health services 

You will work in close cooperation with colleagues within maternal healthcare, women's healthcare, primary care, and family health services. The organization is committed to continuous improvement and follows national guidelines to ensure high-quality care. 
Requirements
Hold a valid Midwife license issued in an EU/EEA country
Good English language skills
Motivation to learn Swedish
Motivation to relocate and work in Sweden on a long-term basis

Meritorious
Experience within antenatal care
Experience in reproductive health and preventive women's healthcare
Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language

We are looking for Midwives who are:
Responsible and professional
Flexible and adaptable
Team-oriented with strong collaboration skills
Committed to person-centered care 

What the workplace offers
Permanent employment
Individual introduction and onboarding
Mentorship and support from experienced colleagues
A collaborative and welcoming work environment
Opportunities for professional development and continuing education
Five professional development days per year
A healthcare organization focused on quality improvement and continuous development 

The clinics are part of a forward-thinking organization that continuously develops and improves maternal healthcare services, supported by dedicated professionals and strong multidisciplinary collaboration. 
Why central Sweden?
Central Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities, beautiful natural surroundings, and excellent public services. The region combines career opportunities with a healthy work-life balance and easy access to outdoor activities throughout the year.
What Dignus Medical offers
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested?
We would be happy to tell you more about the position, the clinics, and how we support healthcare professionals relocating to Sweden.
We look forward to hearing from you.
We look forward to hearing from you.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Head of Property Operations & Technical Services
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Facility Management leader to drive the development of safe, reliable, compliant and cost-efficient facilities for a multi-site logistics organisation.
The role combines strategic leadership with operational oversight. You will establish a shared FM strategy and governance framework, coordinate regional delivery and act as the main contact for the organisation’s central real estate function.
Key responsibilities

Develop and implement a common FM strategy, service standards, processes and improvement roadmap across regions and sites.

Lead and develop regional FM teams and facility coordinators, establishing clear responsibilities, objectives and ways of working.

Oversee facility services, building operations and technical maintenance to support reliable day-to-day logistics operations.

Coordinate maintenance, inspections, contingency arrangements and facility-related safety and compliance activities with relevant stakeholders.

Lead facility projects and support new site openings, customer implementations and operational changes.

Manage supplier performance, contracts, budgets and cost follow-up in collaboration with Procurement and Finance.

Drive energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives and continuous improvement while maintaining safety, compliance and service quality.

Build effective collaboration with operations, landlords, real estate, security and health, safety, environment and quality teams.

Your focus will be to create a coordinated FM function that strengthens local delivery, supports business continuity and meets the organisation’s evolving operational needs.
Essential requirements

Demonstrated leadership experience in Facility Management, property operations or technical services, ideally within logistics, industry, retail or a similar business operating across multiple sites.

Solid knowledge of integrated facility services, technical maintenance, mandatory inspections, supplier management, contracts, budgeting and cost efficiency.

Experience introducing consistent processes, developing teams and driving change across decentralised or geographically dispersed operations.

Strong commercial awareness and analytical skills, with the ability to translate operational requirements, financial data, risks and service results into clear priorities and measurable improvements.

Experience delivering facility projects and incorporating FM requirements into new sites, customer onboarding and operational changes.

A good understanding of how FM responsibilities connect with workplace health and safety, fire protection, security and environmental requirements, including clear allocation of accountability.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and collaborate with site teams, senior leaders and central corporate functions.

A hands-on, organised and results-focused approach to leadership.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

A relevant academic degree or equivalent professional experience. Professional qualifications in Facility Management or property management are an advantage.

A valid driving licence.

Embedded Software Engineer - Radar team
Do you want to work at the forefront of technology, where your creativity and ideas directly shape the next generation of intelligent surveillance? As an Embedded Software Engineer in our Radar team, you'll help develop world-leading radar and sensor fusion solutions that make a real difference. This is a permanent, full-time role based on-site at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden.
Who is your future team?
You'll join a small, supportive team of four dedicated software engineers. We value different perspectives, continuous learning and open collaboration. We work closely with colleagues in electronics, mechanics, software, signal processing and graphics to take innovative products from concept to market.
Our recent work includes advanced radar analytics, precise speed measurement and intelligent algorithms that keep improving for our users. We have also developed new ways of combining radar with PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) cameras, which enables powerful automated tracking. We build everything from standalone radar systems to integrated platforms that solve real-world surveillance challenges.
What you'll do here as Embedded Software Engineer
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll play an essential part in developing our new radar products. You'll work across the whole embedded Linux stack, so you'll see your contributions in everything from low-level drivers to the features our customers use every day. You will:
Be part of our product development team, building the next generation of radar products
Analyze, design and write software for features in our upcoming products
Find and fix issues wherever they occur, from Linux kernel drivers to applications

Who are we looking for?
You're curious and interested in technology, and you enjoy tackling challenges together with your team. You take initiative and do well in a workplace built on openness, creativity, trust, commitment, playfulness and encouragement.
As your closest manager, I will support your personal development, give you freedom and trust, and guide you in your career. - Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager
We'd love to hear that you have:
A couple of years of professional experience developing software in C++, or equivalent experience
Experience with Linux
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Bonus points for:
Experience with low-level programming on Linux
Experience programming FPGAs

What Axis has to offer
At Axis, you'll have the freedom to explore different technical areas, grow your skills, and shape your own career path. We offer a flexible work environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to work with cutting-edge technology in a global company.
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Life at Axis blog 
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
Ready to act?
Axis knows the value of a diverse workforce. Diversity in teams creates a better working environment and encourages creativity, which is fundamental to our success. We welcome all applications. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.
If you have questions, please contact the recruiting manager, Peter Wahlberg, Engineering Manager, at 0701710068.
We review applications continuously, so don't wait. Apply today and help us build the future of intelligent surveillance!
This recruitment is handled solely by Axis Communications AB. We politely but firmly decline all contact from recruitment and consulting companies.

jobs.occupation: Test Lead ABB Process Control Platform
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Cluster Manager CION.
Do you want to shape the future of industrial automation and quality assurance?
At ABB, we're developing the next generation of our world-leading Process Control Platform, used by customers across a wide range of industries worldwide. As a Test Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of a global product developed in Malmö and deployed across ABB's Process Automation portfolio.
You will lead a growing team of test engineers and drive the development of advanced automated testing solutions for a highly complex technology environment. This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for leadership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Your role and responsibilities
Lead and develop the PIT (Product Integration Test) team, currently consisting of 6-7 engineers and expected to grow.
Drive the development of automated test solutions for both embedded controllers and engineering components.
Oversee testing of backend services, advanced engineering tools and editors, communication layers, software libraries, and complex platform functionality.
Ensure quality and coverage for critical areas such as redundancy, hot swap capabilities, cybersecurity, safety, performance, and system stability.
Lead the continued development of the PIT test framework, a platform developed in Malmö and intended for global use across ABB.
Report test progress, quality metrics, and overall test status to development projects and stakeholders.
Plan and coordinate test activities within the team while acting as Scrum Master.
Define, implement, and continuously improve the test strategy and test processes.
Collaborate closely with other testing organizations and development teams within Process Control Platform R&D to ensure a consistent quality approach.

Qualifications for the role
Proven experience as a Test Lead or in a similar test leadership role within software and hardware development.
Experience testing physical products and systems in complex technical environments.
A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Hands-on experience with automated testing and test frameworks.
Strong knowledge of containerized environments, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps.
Experience with scripting and basic software development.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

More about us
We develop today's and tomorrow's world-leading DCS (Distributed Control System) for process industries all over the world. Our customers include the pharmaceutical industry, mines, refineries, steel mills and power plants. 
Recruiting Manager Mårten Svensson, +46 725 887 121 will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Hakan J. Gustavsson, +46 72 230 10 93; Ledarna: Leif Öhrberg, +46 724 644 016; Unionen: Mikael Hammar, +46 730 887 060. All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Irma Leijon, +46 724 612 314. 
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

What you'll do:
Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.

At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.

As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN, CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE. You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.

Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates", CAFEIN combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.

Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.

Your responsibilities: 
- Develop and test federated learning software and algorithms.
- Implement and evaluate privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy and homomorphic encryption.
- Develop tools to optimise data ingestions and assess the quality of data and images.
- Design and run machine-learning experiments using programming languages like Python with libraries asTensorFLow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
- Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).
- Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, optimising federated learning for utility, communication efficiency, energy use and scalability.
- Design and deploy Internet of Things (IoT)-based federated learning architectures.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience developing and deploying federated learning solutions in real-world environments.
- Proficiency in federated learning techniques, including aggregation algorithms, communication and network architecture, security and privacy features.
- Hands on experience with network security, including certificates, encryption, access control, authorisation, and authentication.
- Proven experience in coordinating or technically leading machine-learning deployments.
- Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with software life-cycle tools and procedures (proficiency with Git and GitLab).
- Excellent knowledge of programming techniques and languages: Python, deep learning framework (e.g. TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Jax or scikit-learn).
- Experience in data analysis in a health care environment would be an asset.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science or Data Science or a related field.

Your Skills: 
- Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.
- Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.
- Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.
- Knowledge of best practices for developing secure software.
- Administration of computing systems, upgrades, application of security patches, system and data migrations, backup and recovery.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, taking action to address them; delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
- Cooperates constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balances personal goals with team goals.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Shares knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaches others to ensure knowledge transfer.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Senior Oracle PL/SQL Developer for a long-term consulting assignment within a complex, business-critical IT environment. The consultant will join an experienced team responsible for the development and maintenance of databases and backend solutions.
This is a hands-on development role with a strong focus on Oracle PL/SQL, database-centric business logic, and transaction-intensive systems. The environment handles large data volumes, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows, with demanding requirements for stability, performance, and availability. A significant portion of the business logic is implemented directly in the database through SQL and stored procedures. Microservices developed in Java and .NET operate above the database layer and communicate with different business functions and external systems.
The position is specifically focused on Oracle PL/SQL development and business logic. It is not a traditional database administrator role and does not focus on Data Warehousing or Business Intelligence.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and enhance database functionality and business logic using Oracle PL/SQL and SQL.
Design and maintain stored procedures and other database-centric application components.
Troubleshoot database code and resolve issues in complex, transaction-intensive backend systems.
Analyze and optimize database performance across large-scale Oracle environments.
Work with high-volume data processing, parallel processes, and critical transaction flows.
Develop and maintain integrations and data flows between databases, microservices, external partners, and connected systems.
Collaborate closely with senior developers and architects on technical solutions, system enhancements, and improvements to existing platforms.
Understand complex business processes and translate functional requirements into reliable database-level implementations.
Contribute ideas, technical improvements, and knowledge sharing within a senior, international engineering team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database platform: Extensive, current hands-on experience with Oracle Database and PL/SQL development.
Database programming: Advanced SQL skills, including stored procedures and database-centric programming.
Performance: Experience troubleshooting and optimizing code in large database environments with stringent performance and availability requirements.
Backend architecture: Experience working with complex, transaction-intensive backend systems and high-volume data processing.
Microservices: Understanding of microservices architecture and backend services developed with Java or .NET is advantageous.
Integrations: Experience implementing data flows and integrations with external partners and systems is advantageous.
Business systems: Experience with billing platforms, CRM solutions, or other business-critical transaction systems is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience
The successful consultant will have substantial and recent practical experience in Oracle PL/SQL development, together with a strong understanding of SQL, stored procedures, business logic, and transaction flows. Experience diagnosing technical issues, improving performance, and solving problems in large Oracle environments is required. The role also requires the ability to work independently, take initiative, and quickly understand complex technical environments and interconnected business systems.
Previous experience in banking, financial services, energy, or another transaction-intensive industry is advantageous. The consultant should be comfortable collaborating with experienced developers and architects while contributing to technical discussions and continuous system improvement. Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.

jobs.occupation: Client Service Associate (Dutch) Build a Career in Finance (London)
jobs.description:
Are you a Dutch speaker looking for an opportunity to develop professionally, learn new skills and build a long-term career within the financial services industry?
Our client, a leading international investment management company, is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Dutch Client Service Associate to join their growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, supporting clients and business operations, and is eager to grow within an international organisation. No finance background is required – what matters most is your motivation, willingness to learn and ambition to develop.
The Role
As a Client Service Associate, you will play an important role in supporting the company's daily operations and ensuring a high level of service for its Dutch-speaking clients.
This is primarily a back-office and administrative role, involving collaboration with different teams and financial institutions across Europe.
Your responsibilities will include:
Handling administrative and operational tasks in collaboration with leading banks and financial institutions.
Supporting internal teams with client-related inquiries and daily operations.
Preparing reports and maintaining accurate client information.
Working closely with colleagues across different departments and European markets.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and contribute new ideas.
Gradually taking on additional responsibilities as you develop within the role.

Career Development
What makes this opportunity particularly interesting is the potential for long-term career growth.
Our client believes in developing talent from within and offers comprehensive training, ongoing support and opportunities to explore different career paths across the business.
You will be encouraged to take initiative, develop new skills and take on greater responsibilities as you progress. Whether your future interests lie in operations, management, analytics or other areas of the business, there are opportunities to shape your own career path.
Our client wants you to grow with the company and chart a course for a rewarding, long-term career.
Your Profile
We are looking for someone who is motivated, organised and genuinely interested in the position and the opportunity it offers.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
Native or fluent Dutch and good English skills, both written and spoken.
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong communication and organisational skills.
A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to work well within a team.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop.
An interest in building a long-term career within an international business environment.

A background in finance, economics or business is an advantage but not a requirement.
The Offer
Full-time, permanent position.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
A collaborative and international working environment.
Excellent opportunities for internal career progression.
The chance to build a rewarding, long-term career within a growing international organisation.

Location: London, United Kingdom (office-based).
Interested?
If you are a Dutch speaker looking for more than just your next job, and are excited about the opportunity to learn, develop and grow within an international company, we would love to hear from you!
Apply today and take the next step towards building your future career.

Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for an experienced Back-End Developer to join our IAM engineering team in Stockholm, developing products for authentication, identity management and digital signing.
Working alongside experienced engineers, architects and product specialists, you will contribute to the continued evolution of established software products used by organisations across the public and private sectors.
About Clavister
Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.
The role
As a Back-End Developer in our IAM team, you will design, develop and maintain Java-based server-side software that supports secure authentication, identity management and digital signing.
You will work with established products that continue to evolve as customer needs, security requirements and technology change. This means balancing new functionality with reliability, performance, maintainability and technical debt.
You will be part of a collaborative engineering team where technical discussions, shared ownership and continuous improvement are important parts of everyday work.
Key responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain Java-based backend services and applications.

Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions.

Develop secure, reliable and maintainable software with a focus on long-term product quality.

Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, including performance and reliability challenges.

Identify and address technical debt while balancing new development with improvements to existing products.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, Product Management and Customer Success to deliver customer value.

Contribute to engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvement.

To thrive in this role we believe you have
Several years of professional experience in Java backend development and a strong understanding of the Java ecosystem.

Experience developing asynchronous or concurrent software.

Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.

Familiarity with both Windows and Linux environments.

An understanding of software design, maintainability and quality.

A collaborative mindset, curiosity and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges.

Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points for
Experience with IAM, authentication, authorisation, identity management or digital signing solutions.

Experience designing and developing complex enterprise software products.

Familiarity with security-related technologies, protocols or integrations.

Frontend development experience using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript or React.

What we offer
Meaningful work developing cybersecurity products that protect digital identities and critical services.

The opportunity to work with experienced engineers on technically challenging, established software products.

A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning are encouraged.

The opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the long-term evolution of our IAM portfolio.

A supportive team culture that values work–life balance and sustainable software development.

Join us
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, developing reliable software and contributing to products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.
The position is based in Stockholm. We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

jobs.occupation: PHINIA Sweden AB (fd SEM AB) söker en projektledare
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead and coordinate multiple automotive projects and engineering change initiatives from development through production launch, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, customers, and stakeholders to manage project plans, resources, risks, and business objectives while driving successful product launches and continuous improvement.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead multiple/parallel projects and engineering change requests according to plant necessity.
Develop project plans (project scope, timeline, cost, resources, risk, quality, communication and procurement) then lead and deploy overall project timing to the team.
Coordinate the cross functional teams, to develop and implement plans to fit within timeline and key milestones.
Conduct regular project team meetings and ensure teams are accountable for their deliverables and timeline, managing risk escalation and resolution.
Support customer meetings and support all functional discussion at customer.
Manage and track all prototype phases A: alpha, B: betta, C: gamma up to and including PPAP, followed by production ramp up tracking and serial life.
Lead and apply PDP process, PDP Gate reviews and support engineering to run PDP design reviews
Create and update Project Online reporting – identify, analyze, resolve and/or escalate risks in a timely manner.
Support BU initiative for tracking flawless launch of all product programs.
Support and where appropriate lead in production activities as per our change management process.
Be positive, encourage, coach & share knowledge with all cross functional teams.
Communicate effectively, develop and conduct regular presentations to the customers and PHINIA management.
Lead preparation for regular project business case updates and ensure purchased costs, capex, volume, pricing, and engineering costs are collected and supplied to finance for consolidation in the business case.
Where a project business case is not meeting the defined targets lead the teams for cost improvement activities and drive recovery plans.
Facilitate collaboration among team members from sample team and from cross functional teams to encourage efficiency.
Manage resource allocation effectively to optimize team productivity.

Essential
Minimum 5 years of experience in a team management and coordination role within the automotive industry.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer - ATLAS ITk Pixel Detector
jobs.description:
What you'll do
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing.

As a mechanical engineer in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment on the design, construction and installation of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer System.

Your responsibilities
-Design of precision tooling for the integration, testing and installation of the ITk Pixel Outer System Detector, comprising the Outer Barrel, Endcaps and Inner System Support Tube.
-Design and develop service installation procedures and tooling, including temporary service management solutions for testing of the ITk Pixel Detector.
-Verify the design of components and tooling according to the relevant standards and best engineering practices, performing both, analytical and numerical calculations.
-Develop, document and implement tools and procedures for integration and installation of detector components and services.
-Participate hands-on in the detector integration work in the ATLAS SR1 cleanroom as well as the preparation on surface and in the cavern for the installation.
-Prepare technical specifications for components and tools, following up their production, acceptance and installation.
-Support preparation of and participate in the ATLAS ID detector extraction.

Your profile
-Proven experience in the design of precision mechanical components and assembly tools for complex systems.
-Demonstrated experience in the use of CAD software for 3D modelling and management of large assemblies. Proficiency in Catia V5 would be a plus.
-Demonstrated experience in the production of 2D technical drawings according to the relevant standards for dimensioning and tolerances (e.g. ISO Geometrical Product Specifications, GPS).
-Proven hands-on experience in the construction and testing of mechanical systems.
-Demonstrated experience drafting technical specifications, assembly procedures and engineering reports.
-Experience with assembly of sensitive equipment in a clean room environment is advantageous.
-Experience with structural joining techniques, particularly orbital welding is advantageous.
-Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
-Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
-Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
-Integration of mechanical systems.
-Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.
-Knowledge and application of joining techniques, welding.
-Delivers high quality work on time and fulfils expectations.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements, adopting a pragmatic approach. Understands the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.
-Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships, but also works well autonomously. Takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

You will develop and maintain service and repair methods for Volvo Construction Equipment products, with a primary focus on wheel loaders and powertrain components.

Developing and improving service and repair methods and instructions for aftermarket operations. 
Supporting product development projects with serviceability expertise. 
Planning and executing service procedure development and time studies. 
Designing and validating special tools and workshop solutions. 
Collaborating with technical writers to ensure accurate and high-quality service documentation. 
Driving new ways of working by exploring and implementing digital technologies such as AI, VR, and other innovative solutions. 
Working closely with design engineers, product specialists, and other stakeholders across Volvo CE. 

 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how future products are maintained and serviced while contributing to an improved customer experience worldwide.
Who are we?
Methods Engineering Wheel Loader and Powertrain is part of Aftermarket Service Technology within Volvo Construction Equipment. We are a team of approximately 20 skilled and engaged colleagues based in Eskilstuna. 

Our mission is to develop service methods, technical documentation, spare parts solutions, and serviceability improvements for wheel loaders, axles, transmissions, and engines. We combine technical expertise with a strong customer focus to deliver solutions that support uptime, safety, and sustainability.
Who are you?
We believe you are a curious and solution-oriented person who enjoys combining technical expertise with practical applications. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are motivated by continuous improvement and innovation.

Hands-on experience working with heavy vehicles, construction equipment, or similar products. 
A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience. 
Strong technical understanding and an interest in developing efficient service solutions. 
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. 
A structured and analytical way of working. 
A valid driver's license (B).

CAD and/or PDM systems. 
Hydraulics, electrical and electronic systems. 
Engines, transmissions, or driveline components. 
Service development, workshop operations, or technical documentation. 

 
We know that no one checks every box. If you are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every qualification listed.

At Volvo Construction Equipment, you will be part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and sustainability drive everything we do. You will join a diverse and supportive team where different perspectives are valued and where your ideas can make a real impact. Together, we create solutions that help our customers succeed and contribute to a more sustainable world. 
Ready for the next move?
If you are interested in joining us and helping shape the future of aftermarket service solutions, we look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Lärare i textilslöjd samt bild till Paradisskolan
jobs.description:
Vi är stolta över Trollhättans stads över 5 000 medarbetare, som varje dag gör en positiv skillnad i våra invånares liv och är med och utvecklar stadens hållbarhet och livskraft. Vi drivs och motiveras av ledorden Mod, Delaktighet, Nytänkande och Handlingskraft. Här finns en spännande utveckling där du kan vara med och göra vår stad ännu bättre.
Är du en engagerad och kunnig slöjd- bildlärare som vill inspirera och utmana våra elever? Vill du arbeta i en skola där trygghet, studiero och lärande står i fokus, och där vi tillsammans skapar möjligheter för varje elev? Då kan Paradisskolan vara rätt arbetsplats för dig!
Vi söker en legitimerad och behörig lärare för undervisning i årskurs 3–9. Du blir del av ett engagerat och kompetent kollegium, med nära tillgång till elevhälsoteamet som arbetar nära undervisningen och verksamheten.
Om Paradisskolan
Paradisskolan är centralt belägen i Källstorp i västra Trollhättan och har cirka 400 elever i årskurs 4–9. Vår elevgrupp präglas av mångfald, vilket berikar både undervisning och skolmiljö.
På skolan finns även English Speaking Class (ESC) där undervisning i NO och SO bedrivs på engelska. Vi tar emot elever från hela Trollhättan och från olika delar av världen, vilket bidrar till en internationell och levande skolmiljö.
Vårt utvecklingsarbete fokuserar på undervisningens kvalitet och en trygg miljö för lärande. Vi arbetar utifrån visionen:
”Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden genom form, förutsättningar och förväntan.”
Vi tror på att:
Alla vill lyckas
Framgång skapas gemensamt
Vi möter varandra med nyfikenhet, respekt och omtanke
Vi prövar olika metoder för att varje elev ska nå sitt bästa jag

Kvalifikationer
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i slöjd/bild. Du har en djup och uppdaterad ämneskunskap inom ämnena och kan förmedla hantverkets möjligheter på ett inspirerande och kreativt sätt. Genom varierad, praktisk och kreativ undervisning skapar du nyfikenhet, lust att skapa och hjälper eleverna att utveckla sina förmågor – både hantverksmässigt, problemlösande och personligt.
Du har ett relationellt ledarskap där du bygger trygga, respektfulla och professionella relationer med eleverna. Du leder undervisningen med tydlighet, värme och struktur och du möter elevernas olika behov och erfarenheter med flexibilitet, tålamod och engagemang. Du arbetar aktivt för att skapa studiero, positiv motivation och arbetsglädje och du fungerar som en stabil och positiv förebild i både vardag och undervisning.
Vidare ser vi att du:
skapar goda relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
har förmåga att anpassa undervisningen efter elevernas olika förutsättningar
har goda IKT-kunskaper och använder digitala verktyg i slöjdens planering och dokumentation
har trygghet i styrdokumenten och kan omsätta dem i praktiken
deltar i kollegialt lärande och bidrar aktivt till skolans utvecklingsarbete
möter eleverna med höga förväntningar, nyfikenhet och respekt

Vi söker i första hand en behörig och legitimerad slöjdlärare, men vi är öppna för alla sökande med relevant kompetens, hantverkserfarenhet och ett tydligt engagemang för elevernas lärande och utveckling.
Anställningsinformation
Utdrag ur Belastningsregistret är obligatoriskt vid arbete med barn.
Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.
Tjänsten är en visstid med möjlighet till förlängning.
Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons!
Trollhättan är en stark och attraktiv kommun som ska bli större. I dag är vi ca 59 000 invånare och vi har siktet inställt på att växa till 70 000 trollhättebor. Inom Trollhättans stad arbetar vi med att skapa förutsättningar för detta. Vi är över 5 000 medarbetare och våra 350 olika yrken bidrar på olika sätt med att ge service och underlätta en bra vardag för våra invånare - nu och i framtiden. Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund.
Trollhättans stad tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

An international organisation is looking for a consultant to strengthen Compensation & Benefits (C&B) governance across its R&D operations and bring C&B expertise to organisational design and job grading projects.
The consultant will assess how organisational decisions affect employment conditions, pay and benefits across countries. They will identify where local practices can be aligned and propose common principles or measures to manage differences where local arrangements need to remain in place.
Key responsibilities

Lead the R&D C&B portfolio by setting priorities, clarifying ownership, tracking actions and reporting progress to management.

Represent R&D HR in strategic C&B forums and coordinate with central HR, business units and service providers.

Lead preparations for EU pay transparency requirements in Sweden and Germany, including local delivery models, data needs, roles and coordination with providers.

Support the design and rollout of FY2027 compensation and incentive structures through analysis, recommendations and stakeholder coordination.

Map salary structures, incentives, benefits, employment conditions, processes and the annual C&B cycle across R&D locations.

Assess how local practices align with the shared job architecture and grading framework. Explain the business implications of material differences and develop options and recommendations for decision-makers.

Clarify how C&B services are delivered, including service-level agreements, provider expectations, data and benchmarking requests, ownership and handover documentation.

Advise on organisational design and grading projects that affect related HR processes.

Occasional travel between Sweden and Germany.

Required qualifications

University degree or equivalent education in HR, business administration, economics or a related field.

Several years of experience in Compensation & Benefits and organisational design in an international organisation, with a strong understanding of how job evaluation and grading affect compensation and benefits.

Solid knowledge of grading methods, fixed and variable pay, bonus and incentive eligibility, benefits and salary bands.

Experience working with HR Business Partners, service providers and central functions in a matrix organisation.

Strong analytical, strategic and project management skills.

Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn complex information into clear material for decision-makers.

English proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA.

Additional training in Compensation & Benefits or change management, for example through WorldatWork.

Certification in a recognised job grading methodology.

Knowledge of German collective agreements and Swedish compensation practices.

Experience designing or implementing job architecture, including job families, levels and career paths.

Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or a comparable HR system.

Experience in a multi-brand, automotive or industrial organisation.

German, Swedish or Portuguese language skills.

Working style
You can take ownership of ongoing work quickly, make sense of complex or partly documented issues and deliver accurate recommendations with limited guidance. You communicate clearly, adapt to your audience and build trust across functions and cultures. You are diplomatic when interests differ and confident in moving decisions forward, even when information is incomplete.
Application & Start Date
Start Date: 2027-01-13 End Date: 2027-07-09 Application Deadline: ASAP Remote work: 2–3 days/week Location: Södertälje

Strong analytical skills combined with a structured and systematic approach to work.

Verified started with solutions for electronic signatures, identification and contract management. Working closely with our customers, we have since built digital flows for anti-money laundering (AML/KYC) and supplier assessments, including through the acquisition of GRC Watch in 2024. Today Verified is a RegTech company that helps businesses work securely, efficiently and in line with regulation.
We are around 100 people focused on the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. At Verified, everyone helps build the company's future and takes responsibility for what we promise and deliver, both internally and to our customers.
About the role and the team
As Senior Product Manager you will have end-to-end ownership of one or more of Verified's products, from vision and strategy to launch and continuous improvement. You will work in a small, cross-functional team, close to both customers and developers, where your decisions quickly show in the product and the business.
In the role you will, among other things:

Shape and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap, linked to Verified's business goals.

Meet customers and users regularly to understand their needs and turn insights into product decisions.

Prioritise based on short- and long-term business value and own the product backlog.

Work hands-on with the team: write requirements, test ideas quickly and follow up on impact after launch.

Work closely with Sales, Support, Solution Management and other product teams, for example in customer conversations and demos.

Make sure legal and regulatory requirements are handled in product development.

Use AI both in the product and to improve how we work.

About you
We would like you to have

At least five years of experience in product management, some of it in a SaaS, fintech or scale-up company.

Experience of shaping a product vision yourself and driving it to measurable results.

Experience with B2B products and of working directly with customers and a sales organisation.

An interest in regulatory topics and an understanding of the compliance challenges businesses face.

Hands-on experience with AI, both in products and in your own way of working.

Excellent Swedish and English.

It is a plus if you have

A background in finance, fintech or another regulated industry.

Knowledge of regulations such as AML, DORA, NIS2 or eIDAS.

Experience with products that have network effects, or platforms.

Experience with products in e-signing, digital identity or KYC.

Personal qualities
You are driven by building products that customers actually use and pay for. You are curious, take ownership and get things done, even when not all structures and resources are in place.
You thrive where priorities can change quickly, and you would rather make a well-founded decision today than a perfect one in three months. You enjoy switching between strategic work, customer dialogue and close collaboration with the team.
What we offer
At Verified you will have real influence over both our products and how we work. Our culture is built on engagement, collaboration and community.

30 days of vacation and five compensation days

Wellness allowance, occupational pension and a benefit bike

Shared breakfasts, social activities and moving days

Hybrid model with at least two days a week at our Stockholm office

Practical information
Start: by agreement

Scope: full-time

Process: an initial call, interviews with Verified, personality and logic tests, and a case. References and a background check at a later stage.

About the role As a Global Events Manager at Xensam, you will play a key role in driving our global event marketing initiatives, generating pipeline, building brand awareness, and strengthening relationships across our key markets.
In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of our international trade shows, hosted events, and webinars, from identifying opportunities and developing concepts to planning, execution, and follow-up. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and Customer Success to ensure that our events contribute to measurable business growth.
This is a hands-on and commercially driven role where you combine creativity with strong project management skills and a results-oriented mindset to deliver impactful events and maximize their business value.

Own and manage Xensam's global event and webinar calendar, maintaining a rolling 12-month plan

Plan, execute, and follow up on international trade shows, hosted events, webinars, and regional marketing activities

Research and evaluate new event opportunities and develop concepts across our key markets

Manage event budgets, timelines, logistics, vendors, and external stakeholders

Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Business Development to promote events, drive registrations and secure meetings with customers and prospects

Ensure effective lead follow-up in collaboration with Sales and Business Development

Track and analyze event performance, including MQLs, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline contribution

Capture photos, short videos, and event highlights to support marketing activities

Continuously improve event performance and ways of working through data, insights, and AI tools

Qualifications 

Proven experience managing events from planning to execution and follow-up

At least 3 years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or a similar role, preferably within B2B

Experience managing event budgets, vendors, and external stakeholders

Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

A commercial mindset and an understanding of how events contribute to pipeline generation and business growth

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English

Confidence in using AI tools to improve productivity and streamline workflows

Structured, proactive, and able to take ownership in a fast-paced environment

What you get

A generous work culture with free drinks and snacks, office massages, and more.

Three days in-office (with remote work on Mondays and Fridays).

An opportunity to shape your career growth while contributing to the company’s success.

A dynamic position embracing "freedom under responsibility".

If sales targets are met, all employees enjoy an annual destination trip.

Other location-specific benefits.

Our values at Xensam
Rebellious We challenge the norm and act with initiative – always with responsibility.
Humane We foster a caring, inclusive environment that values diversity and respects individuality.
Harmony We value balance and create a supportive workplace where people thrive.
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on final candidates to fulfill our commitments to customers and ensure a safe work environment.

You will be part of Global Supplier Quality – GPG Automation & Communication, working together with a team of nine colleagues across Sweden and India.
As a Supplier Quality Specialist, you will serve as the dedicated Supplier Quality representative in cross-functional projects, ensuring supplier quality activities are planned, executed, and delivered according to project milestones, technical requirements, and quality objectives.
You will own and drive Supplier Quality deliverables throughout the project lifecycle, including supplier qualification, quality planning, APQP activities, supplier audits, process and product readiness, PPAP/FAI approval, non-conformance management, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
You will proactively identify and mitigate supplier quality risks, ensuring suppliers demonstrate the required process capability, product conformity, and manufacturing readiness before introduction into serial production.
How you will make an impact
Implement and maintain production test verification processes.
Monitor production test performance at suppliers and identify deviations.
Initiate and support corrective and preventive actions related to process variation and supplier quality performance.
Plan and execute supplier quality audits of supplier processes.
Drive supplier process qualification and test equipment qualification activities.
Monitor test equipment management and maintenance at EMS suppliers.
Contribute to continuous improvement of production verification capabilities.
Travel approximately 30% to supplier locations, primarily within Europe.

jobs.occupation: Finance Manager Sweden & Norway | DOVISTA | Edsbyn
jobs.description:
Lead Finance across Sweden and Norway in a key leadership role within DOVISTA. As Finance Manager Sweden & Norway, you will combine people leadership, financial governance, and business impact while helping shape the future finance organisation in an international manufacturing group embarking on a major finance and ERP transformation journey.

Drive Financial Excellence Across Sweden and Norway
 As Finance Manager Sweden & Norway, you will be responsible for Finance Reporting & Compliance activities across DOVISTA Sverige AB and Natre Vinduer AS. Reporting to the Head of Accounting & Reporting Region North, you will lead and develop a team of eight finance professionals in Sweden, covering General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable, while collaborating closely with colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Group Finance.
You will ensure high-quality financial reporting, compliance, governance, and internal control across the region, while supporting budgeting, forecasting, and business performance follow-up. In addition, you will play an important role in driving process improvements, standardisation, and future ERP initiatives across the organisation.
What You'll Bring
We believe you are an experienced finance leader with a strong accounting foundation and a genuine interest in developing both people and processes. You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on involvement when needed.
To succeed in this role, you bring:
- A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven people leadership experience within finance, accounting, reporting, or controlling.
- Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting, compliance, audits, and internal controls.
- Experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
- Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.
Experience from ERP implementations, finance transformation projects, or Norwegian accounting regulations is considered an advantage.
Why Join DOVISTA?
DOVISTA is one of Europe's leading providers of vertical windows and exterior doors, with approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets. In Sweden, DOVISTA includes well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds, and VELFAC, while Natre is a leading window manufacturer in Norway.
In this role, you will:
- Lead a dedicated finance team.
- Influence the future development of the finance organisation.
- Drive improvement and transformation initiatives.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the Nordic region.
- Make an impact in a business with approximately 950 employees and annual revenues of around SEK 2 billion.
The position is based in Edsbyn and offers a hybrid working model, with regular on-site presence supporting close collaboration, leadership, and team development. Limited travel within the Nordic region is required.
Application
Apply by clicking "Ansök nu" in this advertisement.
Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.
In this recruitment process, DOVISTA Sverige AB is collaborating with Jefferson Wells. You will be employed directly by DOVISTA Sverige AB.
Apply as soon as possible, but no later than December 18, 2026. Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI. It all runs in one connected flow, where prices, taxes and payments have to add up.
We're now expanding beyond a proposal tool into a complete AI-powered platform for group sales and event management. As Full-Stack Engineer (Payments) you'll own the payment infrastructure across our different products. You'll join an experienced engineering team where good ideas win arguments. Expect us to challenge your designs, and expect to challenge ours. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Own our payment infrastructure from idea to launch: shape the scope with product and leadership, design it, build it and follow it into use.

Design and build our payment provider integrations, covering payments, refunds, webhooks, payouts and reconciliation.

Make architecture decisions for flows where a mistake costs a hotel real money, with idempotency, retries and clear audit trails built in from the start.

Work across the rest of the platform too, in a TypeScript codebase that handles real bookings for hotels in more than 40 countries.

Review your colleagues' code, and have yours reviewed.

Work with finance and customer success to understand how hotels actually get paid, and turn that into product decisions.

Ensure secure and compliant payment operations, including PCI DSS, KYC, and evolving regulatory requirements as we scale our payments offering.

A bit about you:

You have built and run payment systems in production, and you know what breaks in them.

Hands-on experience integrating payment providers. You can walk us through an integration you built and the decisions behind it.

You understand finance and fintech: how money moves, settlement, fees, currencies and reconciliation.

You review AI-generated code as carefully as your own.

You care that money is correct to the cent, and that code is still easy to change a year later.

Experience with several payment providers, or with hospitality tech, is a strong plus.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

You live in Stockholm, and want to work on-site with your team.

Some of the technologies you'll work with:

TypeScript, React, Next.js

Node.js, PostgreSQL

Payment provider integrations

Vercel, AWS

What we offer:

Real ownership. Payments is a growing part of Proposales, so you'll shape how it's built instead of inheriting someone else's design.

Problems worth solving. Many currencies, tax rules and hotel systems, all in one flow that has to add up.

A proven product. Proposales has been recognised as #1 in the Hotel Tech Awards for five consecutive years and is listed on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the EMEA region.

Short decision lines. You'll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive salary that reflects your experience.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

How we work:
In payments, being correct matters more than being fast. Code goes through review, and the critical parts are covered by tests before anything reaches customers. We use AI agents every day: they speed up the work, but engineers own the design and the code. We're serverless first, hosted on Vercel.

About us
EcoPhi builds hardware for digital substations. Our two products are the CMPC800, a centralised substation server, and the QMU800, a modular merging unit. Utilities and system integrators use them to modernise the grid with IEC 61850-based protection, control and monitoring.
We are looking for an application engineer who will push our products to their limits in the lab, so they never fail in the field.
The role
You are responsible for our test lab. You build realistic substation setups, run the CMPC800 and QMU800 through normal operation, edge cases and failure scenarios, and find the problems before our customers do. Your findings go straight to R&D and inform the next release.
You also bring that knowledge to customers. You know how our products behave, so you help customers configure them, test them and put them into service.
What you will do
Lab and experimental setup
Build and maintain our test lab: test benches, network setups and reference substation configurations
Design experimental setups that simulate real substations, including third-party IEDs, switches, clocks and protection relays
Use hardware in the loop devices, such as Omicron or Typhoon-HIL, to inject currents and voltages and verify behaviour
Prepare demo and proof-of-concept setups for customers and exhibitions

Testing and stress testing
Write and run test plans for new hardware revisions and firmware releases
Stress test the products: high network load, many sampled value streams, GOOSE storms, loss of PTP time sync, redundancy failover (PRP/HSR), power cycling and long-duration runs
Run interoperability tests with other vendors' equipment
Prepare for and support type testing, certification and IEC 61850 conformance testing
Automate recurring tests where it makes sense

Analysis and feedback to R&D
Capture and analyse network traffic with tools such as Wireshark
Measure timing, latency, accuracy and synchronisation performance
Reproduce field issues in the lab and find the root cause together with R&D
Write clear test reports and bug reports

Customer support
Help customers and integrators configure our products, including SCL files, sampled values, GOOSE and time sync
Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT) and commissioning when needed
Write application notes, configuration guides and test procedures

Who you are
Must have
Degree in electrical engineering, power engineering or a related field
EU citizenship or permanent residency
Practical knowledge of IEC 61850: SCL files, GOOSE and sampled values
Experience building lab setups and running structured tests
Comfortable with network analysis and Ethernet networking
Methodical, curious and good at documenting what you find
Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have
Experience with testing, substation automation, or protection and control
Experience with relay test sets, such as Omicron CMC or Doble
Knowledge of PTP time sync (IEEE 1588, IEC 61850-9-3) and PRP/HSR redundancy
Experience with type testing, EMC or environmental testing
Experience from a utility, system integrator or substation equipment vendor

What we offer
Ownership of our test lab and a direct impact on product quality
Close collaboration with R&D and a direct line to the founders
Hands-on work with the latest digital substation technology
Benefits: Occupational pension (ITP) and a generous wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
Location: Primarily in our Gothenburg office, with flexibility on partial remote work

How to apply
Include your CV and a short note on why this role fits you. If you have any questions, reach out to jakob@ecophi.ai.

In this multifaceted role, supporting our product line director and the overall company activity, you will be responsible for procuring highly specific materials related to enzymes and biomanufacturing, managing day-to-day activities with existing raw material suppliers and production facility, supporting cost-saving procurement strategies, and optimizing logistics networks. You will also oversee daily warehouse, fulfilment, international shipping and business workflows to maximise productivity and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a master of cross-functional execution who balances hands-on operational ownership and a higher-level picture of supply chain and process efficiency oversight.
You will choose and negotiate with suppliers, plan materials for each CMO campaign, keep inventory accurate across our sites and arrange shipments that arrive on time and comply with regulations. When costs rise, stock runs low or a delivery slips, you will spot it early, bring the right people together and drive it to a solution. This is a hands-on role with plenty of room to build the function your way as we grow.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the purchasing of raw materials, from request to delivery.
Identify and qualify new suppliers and CMOs in collaboration with the Product Line Director 
Develop and maintain the supply base, focusing on quality, delivery and cost efficiency.
Establish and update agreements with key suppliers and CMOs, including pricing and purchase terms.
Plan and coordinate material supply for production campaigns at our CMOs, and follow up on timelines.
Monitor inventory levels to secure material availability while avoiding excess stock.
Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
Follow up on spend against budget and drive cost-saving initiatives as needed.
Streamline daily operations and improve processes for ordering, receiving and shipping. 

Who you are
Required
A university degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or similar.
At least 5 years of experience in production planning, supply chain or procurement within the manufacturing industry, specialty chemicals, cosmetics, food or a similar industry.
Experience from driving cross-functional collaboration, improvement work and process development.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written

Nice to have
Experience navigating global trade tariffs, customs clearance protocols, and international sourcing networks.
Proven ability to operate as subject matter expert in a company building its operations function.
Experience in a scale-up moving from R&D to pilot or commercial production, including technology transfer to CMOs.

 
What we offer
A people-driven, forward-looking company of 30+ people from more than 15 nationalities;
A fast-moving, collaborative and multidisciplinary team shaping the future of industrial biotech;
A start-up environment with minimal red tape, real responsibility and ownership, and room to learn and grow;
A competitive salary and wellness grant;
25 days of paid annual leave plus bridge days, occupational health and injury insurance, and an occupational pension plan mirroring ITP-1.

Prepare and participate in workshops, collaborate with cross-functional teams and follow up on project activities
Support project planning, documentation, and routine administrative tasks to ensure projects stay organized and on track.

Currently studying Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Structured and goal oriented. With ability to work independently and approach people easily
Strong interest in manufacturing, logistics and continuous improvement

Knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Good analytical skills and problem-solving mindset
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English
