jobs.occupation: Bioinformatician with experience in eDNA and AI
jobs.description:
About the job
Microdentify Sweden AB (https://microdentify.com/) develops cutting-edge biotechnology and AI-driven solutions for law enforcement, national security, and defense. Operating at the intersection of computational biology, artificial intelligence, and forensic intelligence, we are pioneering next-generation technologies designed to address some of the most complex challenges in security and defense.
Microdentify is seeking an excellent Bioinformatician or Computational Biologist to conduct computational analyses of environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing data, using machine-learning approaches for biological and forensic applications.
The position involves analyzing sequencing datasets to identify biological patterns, develop computational methods for classification and prediction, build pipelines, and develop software to deliver results. The role focuses on analyzing biological and environmental DNA profiles and developing models for forensic intelligence.

Main responsibilities
The successful candidate will:
· Process and analyze environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing datasets.
· Analyze biological community profiles generated from environmental samples.
· Apply statistical and machine-learning approaches to classification and prediction problems.
· Develop and evaluate computational models for geographic prediction from biological data. Create Nextflow pipelines.
· Analyze spatial patterns in biological communities and assess relationships between biological similarity and geographic distance.
· Evaluate model performance using appropriate validation and testing procedures.
· Work with large reference datasets containing biological and geographic information.
· Produce figures, tables, and statistical summaries of analytical results.
· Document computational workflows and contributions to scientific reports, presentations, and manuscripts.
· Work collaboratively with researchers in bioinformatics, molecular biology, environmental genomics, and forensic science.
· Develop an interface for law enforcement and defense.

Qualifications
Applicants should have:
· An MSc or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.
· Experience analyzing DNA or eDNA sequencing or other high-dimensional biological data.
· Experience with Python for data analysis.
· Experience with machine learning and statistical modeling.
· Experience working with biological community, microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data.
· Ability to work with large datasets and develop reproducible computational analyses.
· Good written and spoken English.
· Excellent grades and/or publications
· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.
Meritorious qualifications
· High-quality publications in eDNA, metagenomics, machine learning, or forensics
· Experience with feature selection and dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional sequencing data.
· Experience training LLMs.
About the position
This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of bioinformatics, environmental genomics, machine learning, and forensic science, with an emphasis on developing computational approaches to analyze biological sequencing data and build practical predictive tools.
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, independence, and an interest in developing computational approaches to challenging biological problems.
About Microdentify
Microdentify Sweden AB is a pioneering deep-tech startup operating at the frontier of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and forensic intelligence. We are developing next-generation technologies for high-stakes applications in law enforcement, national security, and defense, pushing the boundaries of what we can extract from biological data.
We are assembling a select team of exceptional AI researchers and developers to tackle complex, unconventional challenges at the cutting edge of science and technology. This is a rare opportunity to work on groundbreaking, mission-critical technologies, where innovation meets real-world intelligence and discretion is paramount.
Applicants should submit.
Cover letter
CV
Transcripts
Diploma
Proof of work with microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data

Email all your materials to
Nicla's attention at: jobs@microdentify.com

Data Engineering Manager 
Remote within Sweden 
Some travel, under about five days a quarter 
Every request, quote, and booking on Avinode is a signal nobody else holds. Today it sits in pipelines that work but were built one at a time, for the needs of the moment. We're building the foundation that turns it into governed, reusable data: one identity for member, company, aircraft, and trip; contracts on every source; and quality you can see rather than assume. 
We're looking for a data engineering manager and tech lead: the person who builds that foundation with their hands and builds the team around it. About seven days in ten, you'll be writing code, reviewing designs, and settling architecture. The rest is people: you'll lead a small team and shape who joins it. 
What you'll do 

You’ll hold the technical direction for our data platform on Databricks, and write a good part of it yourself. 

You’ll own acquisition, modeling, and data quality: contracts for every source we depend on, tests, monitoring, lineage, access control. You’ll set the review bar, and move pipeline and test code to proposed changes that get reviewed. 

You’ll keep your own work off the critical path, so the team never waits for you and the people side never gets dropped. 

You’ll lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers. Hire for open roles, set clear expectations, and support each person’s performance, development, and growth. 

You’ll work with the Director of Data & AI on sequencing and standards, with our product manager for data on what we promise, and with Engineering on platform, security and oncall. 
Who you are 

You have real hands-on depth in data engineering on a modern platform: ingestion, modeling, quality, and the pipelines that stay up. 

You have real hands-on experience with Databricks in production: jobs, Delta, Unity Catalog, cost control. 

You have a strong interest in not only the technology, but the business outcomes it enables. 

You have worked with data scientists and ML engineers and know what turns a notebook into something that serves. 

You communicate clearly in writing: you document decisions, data contracts, and standards so the team can move forward without needing you in every conversation. 

You have experience managing or leading a small team, or formally mentoring engineers, and an interest in continuing to build hands-on while leading others. 
Nice-to-haves 

Having been the first lead of a data team, or built one. ML platform experience, feature pipelines, or model serving. 
What you’ll work with 

Databricks, Python, SQL.
What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.
We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

You will work closely with the Nordics Hub Business Controller, Sales, and other stakeholders across the organization. As you settle into the role, you will gradually take full responsibility for operational controlling across the Nordic markets.

Controlling, month-end close, forecast and budget for the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland).

Around 1–3 years of experience in a controlling, accounting or finance role, with a strong grasp of end-to-end accounting principles, P&L and Balance Sheet.
Strong Excel skills and openness to using modern automation and AI tools.
Experience with a passion for financial analysis, generating data-driven insights, monitoring data quality, and summarizing and presenting financial data.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

About iBinder
iBinder is a Swedish SaaS company that develops digital information management services for the construction and real estate industry. With more than 700,000 users, iBinder helps customers create structure, improve collaboration and manage information more efficiently. Founded in 2005 and owned by Fidelio Capital since 2019, the company is in an exciting growth phase, with a strong focus on developing its business and offering.
About the role as Finance Operations Specialist
As Finance Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in managing and developing iBinder's financial operations, with a particular focus on subscription management, invoicing and accounts receivable. You will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and accurate process from quote to payment, working closely with both internal stakeholders and customers.
You will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Global Finance Operations. The role combines hands-on operational responsibilities with opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data quality and contribute to automation initiatives. You will also collaborate closely with the sales team to ensure that customer agreements, renewals and new business are handled correctly throughout the financial flow.

Manage subscriptions, invoicing and accounts receivable, including payment follow-ups, collections and customer inquiries related to agreements and payments.
Work closely with Sales to ensure accurate customer agreements and billing, while supporting renewals, upselling and new business.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company with 12 million customers and approximately 21,000 employees. We are convinced that there is a way to build a future in which everyone can choose fossil-free ways to transport, produce, and live.

Job Description

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you'll have the opportunity to complete your internship close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.
About the internship
As an intern, you will join the Energy Transfer & Environment group within Vattenfall R&D Laboratories, working alongside specialists in fluid mechanics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Our work includes numerical flow modelling and experimental measurements for energy applications, including hydropower and nuclear power.
During the internship, you will work with CFD on a defined fluid-mechanics problem relevant to the group’s ongoing activities. Proposed tasks include preparing simulation models and computational meshes, setting up and running simulations, evaluating flow behaviour, and comparing results with available experimental data or reference cases, where applicable. The specific application and simulation tools will be agreed with the supervisor.
The aim of the internship is to develop practical skills in CFD and contribute to the understanding of an energy-related flow problem. You will document modelling assumptions, assess the quality and limitations of the results, and present your findings in a technical report and a final presentation to the group.
Duration: Five months, full-time.This internship is for two students. 

Qualifications

We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in ongoing studies and are eager to put their knowledge into practice through an internship at Vattenfall. You are also someone who identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive, and Safety. In addition, we expect you to meet the following requirements:
Education: Ongoing university studies in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Energy Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with coursework in fluid mechanics, numerical methods and CFD.
Previous experience with a CFD solver and programming or data analysis is an advantage.
Language skills: Good command of English, both spoken and written, for technical discussions, documentation and presentations.
Availability: Able to undertake a five-month internship as part of your ongoing studies.

Additional Information
Start of assignment: By agreement.
Location: Solna. 
Application – a document with your CV.
Application deadline: 2026-11-30.
Contact person and proposed supervisor at Vattenfall: Eric Lillberg, Senior Principal R&D Engineer, Fluid Mechanics/CFD, eric.lillberg@vattenfall.com, +46 70 537 29 94.

Diversity and Inclusion – In Everything We Do
At Vattenfall, we value being Active, Positive, Open, and Safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our company culture. We believe that diversity helps build a more successful and attractive company, and we strive to be role models in diversity and inclusion. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have equal opportunities and rights, regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.
Vattenfall is part of Sweden’s critical infrastructure, and therefore many of our positions are security-classified. If this position is security-classified, a security screening will be conducted prior to employment in accordance with the Swedish Security Protection Act.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

We are looking to expand our EATS´ team with a Calibration Engineer to work within Engine Controls & Diagnostics.
Job description:
You will work in a team responsible for securing that the engine fulfils the emission legislation, by developing and calibrating its own inhouse software models. The team consists of calibration engineers and function developers. You & the team will calibrate start and catalyst heating, emission control and purge control. The team delivers engine software to combustion engines in both mild hybrid and hybrid applications. 
From an early stage you will be involved in the development of new powertrain concepts and its software, where the team has the responsibility for vehicle emissions, and develop solutions that meet both legal requirements and give the customer an outstanding product. 
Early in the projects you will  be collecting data from the engine test rigs, in order to calibrate the software-models. Validation and later, final verification are always performed in cars or what the application is suited for. The job variety is huge and the need for further development is always there, which provides an interesting research atmosphere.
What you will do:
You will work in a team with experienced engineers but have a clear area of responsibility. Your main tasks will be to calibrate emission-related functions. 
The team is doing a large amount of our work in different engine test cells located in the laboratory, but also in vehicles on site and during expeditions to find extreme climates and altitudes. You will use advanced programs for modelling and data processing for best results.
﻿Main tasks:
Plan and develop methods of the calibration process.
Define and handle requirements within the system and from other areas.
Deliver calibration and verification of emission related functions.
Verify calibration in rigs and cars in different environments.
Evaluation and problem analysis.

 
Is this you?
To enjoy and succeed in the role, we see that you have a great interest in the latest technology, and you have an interest in powertrain controls and calibration. You also like to dig into a huge amount of data. You are a positive and self-driven person, who strives to see "the big picture" to be able to contribute in the best way. You appreciate being a part of a team and are a good communicator. Further, you are always curious, and love to solve problems in a pragmatic way!
 Skill requirements
Qualifications:
•	We believe you have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in the field of Mechanical, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent You have a passion for cars and internal combustion engines.
•	Fluent in Matlab/Python/Simulink
•	Fluent in English (written and spoken)
•	Driver’s license (Swedish B-level, passenger car)
•	Fluent in Swedish (written and spoken) is a plus
•	Good knowledge of internal combustion engines
•	Passion for vehicles and powertrains
•	Theoretical courses in combustion engines, software programming and electronics
•	Experience in ETAS INCA software
﻿Personal qualities
•	Self-driven with a positive attitude
•	Strong analytical skills as well as being able to execute tests “hands-on”
•	You plan, conduct, summarize and report your work in a structured and thorough manner
•	A curious and problemsolving mindset
• You can easily communicate and collaborate
• A true teamplayer open and supportive
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to advanced engine development while being part of a collaborative and supportive team.
You need to be living in Sweden and be able to work 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
Looking forward to meeting you!

What you'll do
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes back the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the Electrical Engineering (EL) group of the EN department, you will join the Maintenance and Operation (MO) section, which operates and maintains CERN's electrical distribution network.

Learn more: https://videos.cern.ch/record/2301705

Your responsibilities
Contribute to the management of electrical equipment throughout its lifecycle, from procurement and installation to maintenance activities.
Manage supply contracts for low-voltage switchboards: coordinate with suppliers and follow up on orders, deliveries, warranties and after-sales services.
Prepare technical specifications and tender documents and contribute to the correspondent procurement activities.
Contribute to define and improve equipment data models in CERN's Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS), so that technical information, drawings and as-built documentation are organised and kept up to date.
Coordinate and follow up on site surveys, from data collection and verification to process and update the corresponding information in the CMMS.
Work with maintenance managers to define preventive and corrective maintenance activities in the CMMS, including maintenance task plans, standard work orders, required resources and spare parts.
Support engineers, technicians and contractors in using the CMMS through training, user guides and technical assistance.
Contribute to developing dashboards and KPIs that monitor maintenance activities, equipment performance and data quality.
Collaborate with the Asset Management team to improve and harmonise equipment data and work management processes across equipment families in the CMMS.

Your profile
Good knowledge of electrical assets such as transformers and MV/LV switchgear.
First experience with, or a strong interest in, Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
Good understanding of project management and procurement processes.
Familiarity with technical documentation, specifications and engineering drawings.
Your studies focused on Electrical/Industrial Engineering.

Your skills
Strong interest in electrical equipment, its lifecycle and maintenance processes.
Interest in procurement and contract management, with the ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders and follow up on commitments.
Willingness to learn and to help improve existing methods and processes.
Structured approach to work, with strong attention to detail.
Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage responsibilities.
Positive and collaborative attitude, with strong teamwork and communication skills.
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
A valid driving licence.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot, Croatian and Turkish nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.
By the application deadline, you have a maximum of 2 years of professional experience since graduation in the respective field and your highest educational qualification is either a bachelor's or master's degree. You must have a university degree and can't hold a PhD.
You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

You will need these documents to complete your application
Your CV (English or French)
A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your school (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)
Any document you consider relevant to your application

Jobbeskrivning
Company Story
 
Sigma Connectivity is a global tech house with all the resources needed to bring a product to market under one roof. We believe in investing in knowledge and education, making a positive impact on society and shaping a brighter future for all.
Through our core values, at Sigma Connectivity we create an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Our company culture promotes the freedom to explore new ideas and push the boundaries of what is possible.
Working with us means you will be working in an international environment with a diverse and inclusive atmosphere. We operate globally from 12 sites and have expert teams in North America, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, United Kingdom and Poland.
 
We are looking for a Senior System Architect!
In this role, you’ll translate client visions into robust blueprints for connected products, bridging hardware and software to define the project skeleton. As a part of the Industrialization & System Design team, you’ll own the end-to-end strategy for manufacturability, testability, and product launch—driving DFX (Design for Excellence, including DFM and DFT) directly into early PCB designs and defining test architectures from initial prototype validation through to mass production.
 
What we offer
High-Impact Engineering: Own the technical vision for complex, market-defining products from concept to high-volume manufacturing.
World-Class Team & Culture: Work alongside elite cross-functional engineers in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.
Cutting-Edge Projects: Direct access to diverse, challenging hardware and IoT projects for leading global brands.
Autonomy & Influence: High visibility and direct influence over architectural decisions, client strategies, and design-for-test practices.

Work tasks
This role focuses on the early-stage design and technical leadership of industrialization projects, ensuring that hardware and software components are optimized for production and testing.
Architecture & Strategy: Lead system architecture definitions and create comprehensive production test strategies that balance quality, yield, schedule, and cost.
Requirements Breakdown: Convert product, hardware, and quality constraints into clear specifications, including System Requirement Specifications, Production Test Requirements, and Test Implementation Specs.
DFX & Risk Management: Review hardware schematics and PCB concepts early to identify manufacturability, testability, and reliability risks, driving proactive mitigations with R&D teams.
Test Architecture Definition: Define test coverage, interfaces, embedded test functionality, fixtures, measurement methods, and factory data traceability.
Cross-Functional & Client Leadership: Drive technical discussions and balance trade-offs with customers, EMS partners, suppliers, R&D, quality, and sourcing teams.
Mentorship: Guide engineering teams on best practices in systems engineering, hardware testability, and production deployment.

We are looking for someone with
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Engineering Physics, or equivalent practical background.
Proven experience working as a System Architect guiding complex electronic or embedded products from concept to production.
Proven background in production and manufacturing engineering, with strong practical experience bridging development and mass manufacturing environments.
Solid hardware depth to evaluate schematics, drive DFT/DFM improvements, and establish production test architectures alongside EMS partners.
Fluent English communication skills to present trade-offs, draft specifications, and align stakeholders

It is meritorious if you have
Experience with connected/IoT devices, wireless protocols, or embedded systems.
Exposure to end-of-line testing, RF validation, JTAG, or factory yield optimization.
Track record supporting customer proposals, SOWs, or technical pre-studies.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Social
Intellectually curious
Respectful

 
References
Reference checks are conducted as part of the recruitment process and may include both provided and independently identified professional references.

Luleå University of Technology experiences rapid growth with world-leading expertise within several research areas. Our scientific and artistic research and education are conducted in close collaboration with international, national and regional companies, the public sector and leading universities. Luleå University of Technology has an annual turnover of just over SEK 2.3 billion. We have more than 1,800 employees and nearly 21,600 students.
The Machine Learning group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for experienced students from the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme for a project focusing student retention through the mentoring and support of first year students in the programme.
 
 
You will have the opportunity to work together with other mentors and keep in contact with some senior staff, while getting the opportunity to:
Meet new people and refresh information from earlier courses
Improve your communication- and social skills
Gain leadership/mentoring experience

Job Duties
 
Typical job duties for this position will focus on tasks related to leadership and mentoring:
Organizing regular meetings with the mentee-group assigned to you, where you discuss their current challenges and questions
Having some hours set aside on a weekly basis in case one of your mentees would like to have an individual meeting/discussion
Advising students on who they can help/advise them in certain situations (if you cannot do so yourself)
Keeping in regular touch both with the mentees and other mentors

Qualifications
 
To be eligible for the position, you must be enrolled as a student in the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme of LTU. You must be in at least your second year of study and have some experience in mentoring (e.g. having had earlier meetings with the 1st year students during the first study period of the year). You are also expected to be able to take your own initiative and work independently.
 
 
It is a merit to have contributed to the programme in some capacity before (e.g. as student representative, member in Programme Council, having a role in the program association).
 
 
Terms and conditions
 
Employment as a teaching assistant is governed by Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance. Only those admitted to first- or second-cycle studies may be employed as teaching assistants (Chapter 5, Section 10 of the Higher Education Ordinance).
 
 
Hourly pay/renumeration
 
All assignments provide hourly pay and valuable work experience for your CV. The hourly rate depends on the complexity of the duties:
Level 1: 156 kr/hour 
Level 2: 171 kr/hour  
 
 
Information
 
The position is 10% full-time, corresponding to an average of a half day/week over a period of 6 months from December 2026  to June 2027 or as agreed. The place of work is Luleå.
The workload may vary over time and by agreement. The goal is to distribute the work so that it is compatible with your studies.

ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS INTERFACE ENGINEER 
Join Us in Shaping the Future of Large-Scale Laundry Solutions! 
We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Interface Engineer who thrives where hardware, software, and electrical systems come together. You bring a curious mindset, enjoy solving cross-functional challenges, and are eager to contribute to technical decisions that shape future products.  
With us, you will work with innovation and future-oriented large-scale laundry machines! 
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING  
We want to focus on future product features 3–5 years ahead, which is why we have chosen to expand the team with an additional colleague. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions at an early stage, help shape the products of the future and most importantly work with innovation rather than purely maintenance and sustainment tasks. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Act as a technical bridge between electrical design and electronics. 
Contribute to long-term technical strategy and future product features. 
Understand and contribute to PCB development, including both hardware and software aspects. 
Maintain technical documentation and ensure that design data, drawings, specifications, and revisions are correctly managed and released according to established processes in PDM systems. 
Participate in the development of specifications for electronic control boards. 
Ensure seamless interaction between electrical systems, electronics, and control systems. 
Take part in testing, analysis, and further development of solutions. 

WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE 
We believe you are relatively early in your career but already demonstrate a strong technical drive and ability to take ownership. You enjoy working where hardware, software, and electrical systems meet, and you are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with experienced colleagues. 
Qualification: 
A few years of experience working at the interface between electrical systems, electronics, software, or embedded systems 
Solid understanding of PCB development, control boards, and control systems 
Comfortable working across both hardware and software domains, with the ability to understand how the two interact in a complete product 
An eagerness to learn and grow technically, combined with a senior mindset and the confidence to challenge solutions and contribute to technical discussions 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines 
Knowledge of EMC, electrical safety, and relevant standards is considered a merit 
Analytical, communicative, and solution-oriented mindset 
Master’s degree in ex. Electrical Engineering /Electronics/Embedded Systems, Mechatronics/Engineering Physics/Mechanical Engineering.

We are the global leader in dispensing solutions for liquid portion control. We specialize in creating dispenser solutions for businesses in the foodservice, personal care, and cleaning industries. Whether it is ketchup, mayonnaise, hand soap, or detergent - ASEPT ensures accurate and reliable liquid dispensing. We are committed to reducing the environmental footprint through sustainable dispensing solutions.
In addition to our base in Lund, Sweden, we have two more group companies located in the Netherlands and in the US. ASEPT Group has around 100 employees and are a part of Lagercrantz Group listed on NASDAQ Stockholm. Read more at www.asept.com
 
Business Development Manager to ASEPT 
Would you like to work with a unique product developed in Lund and used by customers worldwide? Are you passionate about Business Development and eager to drive sales to new and existing customers?
Then join ASEPT and be part of the company’s exciting growth journey! You will play a key role in keeping current business and developing new business by launching innovative products and services that help customers to be more successful.
Your customers will typically range from large companies like Kraft Heinz, Unilever and Orkla, quick-service-restaurant (QSR), to local smaller food producers. The position involves extensive collaboration, both internally and externally, and requires you to have excellent collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy being close to your customers, both in person and digitally, and see travel as a natural part of the role.
You will be part of a great team and a workplace with supportive and committed colleagues in a culture that is innovative, down to earth and growth oriented. For the right person, this is a great opportunity to build an exciting career in an international, fast-growing environment where you can make a real impact on the company’s continued journey. You will be part of the Sales & Marketing team in Lund with five additional colleagues and report to the Sales & Marketing Director at ASEPT AB.
 
Key Responsibilities
Customer Relationship Building: Foster long-lasting relationships with customers by understanding their needs (KAM).
Lead and motivate yourself and collaborate with the other parts of the ASEPT Group to achieve and exceed targets for customers in Europe and other parts of the world.
Strategic Planning: Develop and implement business plans to expand our market presence.
Market Awareness: Stay informed about our markets and competitors.
Performance Monitoring: Present sales reports and revenue forecast

Requirements
Proven experience in Sales or in a relevant role (e.g. KAM).
Successful track record in meeting or exceeding targets.
Strong business acumenship and preferably industry expertise
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels of customer organizations
International B2B experience and fluency in both English and Swedish (other languages, e.g. German, French, or Spanish is an advantage).

Your background
As a person you have a strong and analytic business mind. Your background is probably either in B2B Sales or in some related field like Business Development / Key Account Management / Market Management. Experience from the food-service industry and being familiar with large food-producing companies or the quick-service-restaurant (QSR) industry will give you a head start but it’s not a necessary requirement. Are you an experienced Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer with a strong understanding of vehicle electrical architecture and embedded systems? Do you enjoy working with complex system design challenges and shaping future vehicle solutions? Then this could be your next opportunity.
ALTEN is now looking for an Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer for an assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will work with system-level design and architecture, supporting the development of future vehicle solutions through robust Electrical & Electronics concepts and system design.
About the role
As an Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer, you will drive system-level design activities related to vehicle electrical architecture, embedded systems, software platforms, and communication networks. You will evaluate technical concepts, define system solutions, and support development teams throughout the product lifecycle.
A key part of the role is understanding how functions and services are realized through software, electronics, sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces. You will work closely with architects, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure scalable and robust system solutions that support both current and future vehicle platforms
Main responsibilities
Drive system design and concept development activities within Electrical & Electronics systems
Define and evaluate electrical architectures, ECUs, communication networks, sensors, and actuators
Explore and assess alternative technical concepts during early development phases
Ensure alignment with Functional Safety and Cybersecurity requirements
Develop and document system concepts and technical solutions
Support diagnostic strategies and system documentation activities
Provide technical guidance and system expertise to development teams
Collaborate with architects, software developers, and stakeholders across the organization
Support vehicle-level integration of hardware and software solutions

Your profile
You are a structured and analytical engineer with extensive experience in system design and vehicle electrical architecture. You enjoy working from a holistic perspective and navigating complex technical environments involving multiple stakeholders and engineering disciplines.
We see that you have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
Several years of experience in system engineering, system design, or function design within the automotive industry
Strong understanding of vehicle Electrical & Electronics architecture
Experience working with embedded systems and Electronic Control Units (ECUs)
Knowledge of software platforms such as AUTOSAR and/or Embedded Linux
Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet
Understanding of Functional Safety and Cybersecurity principles
Strong communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to both engineers and management
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious:
Experience with vehicle-level hardware and software integration
Experience working as a System Engineer, System Architect, or Technical Lead
Experience from complex electrical architectures within heavy vehicles or automotive products

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest engineering and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in around 30 countries. Our engineers carry out advanced projects throughout the product development cycle for leading companies in sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace, Energy, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are about 1,300 committed employees across 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north. For the sixth consecutive year, ALTEN has been recognized as one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, thanks to our strong focus on career development, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Visit www.alten.se to learn more about us.

jobs.description:
Our dynamic Pro Robotics R&D team, consisting of around 100 people, is expanding, and we are investing further in Pro Robotics solutions. We are seeking a Senior System Engineer to join our System & Test group. Our group currently includes 10 people, containing both Technical Project Managers, System Engineers, and System Testers.

We believe in optimizing customer value by taking a solutions perspective. Our responsibility includes professional robotic products and related digital solutions. This offers the opportunity to work in a focused and agile team with cutting-edge technology across various engineering fields. We solve complex problems together with highly skilled colleagues from other disciplines, contributing to a more sustainable world.

As a Senior System Engineer, you will be responsible for the overall requirements and design of the Pro robotic lawnmower products and solutions. You will tackle complex questions to find the best solutions by integrating electronics, software, and mechanics. In this central role, you will often lead cross-disciplinary technical teams and ensure comprehensive system documentation, both internally and externally.

Your profile
You are a goal-oriented, analytical, and communicative professional who takes responsibility for your work. You are open-minded, curious, and eager to learn and develop new technologies alongside your colleagues.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
Extensive experience in product development and/or systems engineering, with expertise in at least two of the following areas: embedded software, electronics, mechanics, or mechatronics.
Practical experience in requirements management.
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus

Leading technical teams or projects
Working with autonomous systems or robotics
Certification or Functional Safety

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. We are a team of 15+ professionals located across multiple sites, delivering Automation & Communication solutions for HVDC projects worldwide. Our scope includes Auxiliary Automation Systems, SCADA, RTU, Communication Systems, and Cybersecurity, supporting projects throughout their lifecycle.
Our team brings diverse technical and project backgrounds, enabling us to adapt to the dynamic project environment while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and customer expectations. We are responsible for defining work breakdown structures, planning deliverables, and driving successful project execution.
We are looking for a motivated engineer who is eager to develop within Auxiliary Automation and contribute to innovative HVDC projects. In this role, you will work closely with experienced colleagues and gain hands-on experience with control and monitoring solutions for critical infrastructure. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys technology, problem-solving, and collaboration in an international environment.
How you'll make an impact
Be proactive and solution oriented.
Support the design, implementation, and testing of Auxiliary Automation solutions for HVDC projects.
Work with control and monitoring systems for auxiliary equipment and plant services.

Collaborate with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders throughout project execution.

jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark's power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installations
You will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibility

TL;DR
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Security at Lovable, end-to-end, from conception through rollout. You'll make sure the millions of apps built on Lovable are safe, trustworthy, and secure by default, turning security from a checkbox into a genuine product differentiator.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role
Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about
Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable
Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisions

What you'll do
Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction
Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users
Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection
Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't
Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker
Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the company

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Fiber Technicians at Optic Tunnels
jobs.description:
Optic Tunnels is a new Swedish provider of data communication and AI services for demanding organizations – services produced on truly dedicated infrastructure, all the way down into the ground. To deliver them, we are building an entirely new, independent fiber backbone network between the Nordic capital regions, with strict requirements for security and performance at every step. Our services are launched step by step as the network grows, for customers along the entire route – not only between the endpoints. The network build-out is well underway, initially focused on Greater Stockholm, the Mälaren Valley, Dalarna and Skåne, and we are now looking for experienced fiber technicians who want to join us on the journey.
The role
As a fiber technician at Optic Tunnels, you will work with fiber installation and high-precision fusion splicing, as well as measurement and documentation. You will work closely with the civil works, follow each route from trench to completed connection, and take part alongside our subcontractors when the fiber cables are installed in the ducts.
The work is largely in the field along our backbone network, but also in our own small data centers along the routes and at end-customer premises. This means flexible, mobile working days with a high degree of responsibility for planning your own work.
A strategic capability we are building in-house
While Optic Tunnels procures most of the network build-out from external contractors, all fiber splicing, measurement and documentation is carried out by our own staff. This is to ensure maximum control and security in the most sensitive parts of the network.
Measurements and documentation of splice quality and the optical properties of the fiber matter more to us than to most. The measurement data is used not only to verify that the fiber and the splice meet specification at the moment of testing, but also as a reference for detecting anomalies and intrusion attempts throughout the fiber's lifetime. This is a central part of our security offering, which is why careful measurement and impeccable documentation are as important as the fiber and the splices themselves.
What we are looking for
•      Documented experience as a fiber technician on backbone networks
•      A category B driver's license
•      The right to work in Sweden
•      Good computer skills and experience working with documentation
•      Fluent spoken and written English, the language of all our technical documentation. Working knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
You are orderly and meticulous, and you see documentation as a critical part of the work, not an add-on to it. You enjoy planning your own work and taking responsibility for it.
Terms
Location: Stockholm. The work involves travel and work throughout Optic Tunnels' network.
Extent: Full-time
Type of employment: Permanent, following an initial probationary period
Start: By agreement. Positions are filled on a rolling basis.
Working hours: The work is mainly carried out during daytime. Some tasks, such as planned maintenance within scheduled maintenance windows, may be carried out at other times. Around-the-clock on-call duty for repairing infrequent network faults is included on a rotating schedule, with compensation under the applicable agreement.
Applications and questions
Send a description of yourself and your experience as a fiber technician – the types of networks and projects you have worked on, and your responsibilities in them – together with details of your references, to jobs@optictunnels.com. We will only contact your references once we have agreed with you to do so. Questions about the position are welcome at the same address. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Read more about Optic Tunnels at www.optictunnels.com.

Market Garden Production Manager 
Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027 

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.
About us 
Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden
We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.
The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.
Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture. 
The role 
As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.
You will: 
Plan weekly and daily production priorities.
Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.
Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.
Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
Keep essential production and harvest records.
Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.
How you work matters 
We are looking for someone who:
Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.
Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.
Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.
Communicates clearly and leads by example.
Is self-motivated and also motivates others.
Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills
Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.
Experience 
You should have:
At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.
Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.
Good communication skills in English.
A valid driving licence.
The legal right to work and live in Sweden.

A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan

Practical details

Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden

We're looking for a Marketing Art Director to help shape how THE FINALS and ARC Raiders look everywhere outside the game: in campaigns, key art, trailers, merch, and partner work.
You'll sit in the Marketing team and work side by side with the Game Art Directors on both titles. Together you'll keep each game's identity consistent from in-game to out, and find ways to bring great marketing work back into the games. You'll set the visual direction, build the systems that let others execute it well, and stay hands-on when the work needs it.
Example of responsibilities 

Partner with game Art Directors to expand Embark’s 2D art production capabilities, unlocking new opportunities for marketing campaigns

Lead art direction across marketing campaigns, keeping the full asset suite consistent across key art, paid media, trailer slates and motion graphics in partnership with game Art Directors.

Build brand design systems that turn our games’ visual identities into scalable toolkits for campaigns and advertising.

Create and maintain style guides so agencies and partners can apply the brand correctly and consistently across digital, print, merch and licensing work.

Explore new visual territory for upcoming marketing opportunities through concept references, mockups and mood boards.

Present creative work with clear reasoning that ties visual choices to channel requirements, audience insights and expected impact.

Direct internal artists, agencies and freelancers, and give feedback that is kind, clear and actionable.

Who you are

A bridge between strategy and craft. You can shape the big-picture direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it real.

A systems thinker. You design for scale, so a single idea can carry from a trailer slate to a T-shirt without losing its identity.

Curious about what's next. You keep up with new tools, techniques and design principles to help us lead rather than follow trends.

A natural collaborator. You like partnering with game teams, respect their vision and look for chances to make in-game and out-of-game work stronger together.

A generous leader. You make the people and partners around you better through clear direction and thoughtful feedback.

Passionate about games, especially ours. You're excited to bring our worlds to life for our players and community.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

Experience as an Art Director or Senior Designer in marketing or brand, ideally for games, entertainment or consumer brands.

A portfolio showing campaign work and brand systems you've led, from first concept to final execution across several channels.

Deep knowledge of the channels where marketing art lives (social, paid media, store pages, out-of-home, broadcast, print, merch, licensing) and what each one demands.

Proven experience building brand identities, design systems or style guides that other teams and partners have used at scale.

Experience directing external partners such as agencies and freelancers alongside internal artists.

Strong skills in typography, layout, colour and composition, plus solid knowledge of motion design principles.

Comfort with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) or similar tools, and the ability to jump in hands-on.

Interest in emerging technologies, and experience integrating these into your workflows

Clear communication in English, written and spoken, including presenting to stakeholders.

 
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

jobs.description:
The opportunity
As Team Manager System Solutions for HVDC C&P - IT/CS at Hitachi, you will lead a team responsible for the design, development, and implementation of IT and Cyber Security solutions within High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Control and Protection systems. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise in industrial control systems, IT infrastructure, and cybersecurity, coupled with proven leadership and project management skills.

How you’ll make an impact
• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of engineers and specialists focused on IT and Cyber Security aspects of HVDC Control & Protection systems.
• Oversee the entire lifecycle of IT and Cyber Security solutions, from requirements gathering and architectural design to implementation, testing, and commissioning.
• Develop and implement strategies for secure and robust IT infrastructure within HVDC systems, adhering to industry standards and best practices (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
• Collaborate closely with HVDC Control & Protection engineers to integrate IT/Cyber Security solutions seamlessly into the overall system architecture.
• Stay abreast of emerging technologies, cybersecurity threats, and industry trends relevant to HVDC systems.
• Ensure compliance with all relevant company policies, industry regulations, and safety standards.

Your background
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related technical field.
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT or Cyber Security roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team management capacity.
• Good understanding of network architectures, operating systems (Windows, Linux), virtualization, and cloud technologies.
• Familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulations such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and ISO 27001.
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Your primary role will be to drive and lead SHE and Continuous Improvement (CI) as Test Factory Expert across Test Factory in Lund. As a Test Factory Expert, you will lead improvements related to safety ways of working, ensuring compliance with the Swedish Work Environment Act and supporting a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
You will work across the full Test Factory organization in Lund, collaborate with the Test Factory’s in Modena, Italy, when relevant, and report to Test Factory Integration.
Your responsibilities will include:
Driving a proactive and business-oriented approach to safety, order, and workplace standards within the test halls. A key part of the role is to be present in the daily operations, supporting test engineers and teams with a high-quality approach focused on safety, risk prevention, and sustainable ways of working.
You will be responsible for driving and coordinating improvement activities related to Fire Safety, Electrical Safety, Chemical Safety, Pressurized Equipment, and safety rounds in the test halls. You will lead awareness sessions, training activities, and workshops to strengthen safety knowledge and engagement across Test Factory.
As the Test Factory Expert you will drive the collection, analysis, and follow-up of incidents, deviations, and losses connected to the test environment, ensuring root causes are identified and sustainable corrective actions are implemented. You will coach and support teams and contribute to the continuous development of an agile and safe Test Factory.
The role also includes maintaining of systems and processes that support compliance with Group OHS requirements and local legislation, monitor safety performance, support investigations, and ensure that mandatory OHS training programs are completed and followed up within Test Factory.
To fit this role we believe you are someone who combines personal engagement with a strong improvement mindset, can build collaboration across teams, empower colleagues, and drive a proactive safety culture through visible leadership and continuous improvement.

Experience on all or some of the delegation areas; fire, electric and chemical

Join Us and Make an Impact

Apply today and join our R&D team in Gothenburg.

Ascom is committed to providing an inclusive workplace where individuals are treated fairly and with respect. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus
You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do
Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets
Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)
Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)
Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin
Frontend: React and Typescript
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: Technical Writer to a global company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to join their team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will be responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining technical documentation for complex electrical systems and installations, covering everything from high- and low-voltage systems to control systems, HMI, and related equipment.
You will work closely with system engineers, technical specialists, and project teams to gather, analyze, and transform complex technical information into clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation. The role requires both technical understanding and strong communication skills, as you will play an important part in ensuring that technical information is accessible, consistent, and easy to understand across different engineering projects.
Key responsibilities
Create, structure, and maintain technical documentation for electrical installations, systems, and engineering solutions

Gather and interpret technical information in close collaboration with engineers and technical specialists

Produce user manuals, system descriptions, technical specifications, and other relevant documentation

Review, improve, and standardize existing technical documentation to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency

Plan and coordinate documentation activities across multiple engineering projects

Contribute to improving documentation processes, templates, and ways of working

Who are you?
We are looking for a structured and communicative person who enjoys combining technical understanding with clear and precise writing. You have a genuine interest in technology and the ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them in a way that is easy for others to understand.
To succeed in this role, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, manage your own priorities, and enjoy collaborating with engineers and technical specialists across different projects. You also take pride in delivering high-quality documentation and contributing to the development of effective ways of working.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or technical documentation

A university degree, Bachelor’s or higher, in a relevant technical field

Experience documenting complex technical systems or engineering solutions

Good written and verbal communication skills in English

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with electrical systems, power systems, HVDC technology, or industrial installations

Good communication skills in Swedish

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed
Employment type: In this recruitment process, you will initially be employed as a consultant by A-hub and work on assignment at our client. After 12 months, the ambition is for you to transition into direct employment with the client.

We look forward to receiving your application!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

The Opportunity
At Hitachi Energy Components in Ludvika, we are continuing to grow and develop our business. As more employees join our organization and new competencies are required, ensuring a structured and effective approach to onboarding, training, and competency development has become increasingly important.
We are now looking for a Training & Development Specialist who will take ownership of our internal training structure and learning processes. jobs.description:
Our client is a global technology company within power transmission and electrification. The organization designs, builds, and upgrades high-voltage transmission installations that move electricity across regions and countries, and its technology is a key enabler of the ongoing energy transition. The site in Ludvika is one of the company's main engineering centres in Sweden, with a large international engineering community and a strong technical tradition.
About HVDC Service The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. Since these installations have a lifespan of around many years and are upgraded regularly, this is a long, ongoing pipeline of brownfield engineering work.
About the role We are looking for a Senior Systems Hardware Engineer to join our clients engineering organization supporting HVDC, transmission, grid modernization and substation projects.  In this role you will contribute to hardware engineering, system design, technical evaluations and engineering coordination throughout the project lifecycle. The role offers the opportunity to work on critical energy infrastructure projects supporting the transition towards a more sustainable, reliable and resilient power system.
We are looking for a profile with experience in transmission and distribution systems, substations, hardware engineering, renewable energy integration, battery energy storage systems (BESS), utility environments or other power system applications.
A minimum of 8 years of experience in hardware engineering, system design, transmission and distribution, utility engineering or related energy infrastructure projects is required.
Responsibilities
• Develop and review Plant Circuit Diagrams and related engineering documentation. • Perform hardware selection activities for control, protection and auxiliary systems. • Develop cubicle designs and associated hardware engineering deliverables. • Support engineering teams in HVDC, substation and grid infrastructure projects. • Perform technical studies, system assessments and engineering evaluations. • Coordinate technical activities across multidisciplinary project teams. • Support project execution, planning and stakeholder coordination activities. • Contribute to technical specifications, project documentation and engineering deliverables. • Support customer discussions, technical workshops and engineering reviews. • Participate in risk assessments and technical reviews throughout project execution.
Background
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or equivalent. • Experience with hardware engineering and system design activities for substations, HVDC, FACTS or grid infrastructure projects. • Experience developing Plant Circuit Diagrams and other hardware engineering documentation. • Experience with hardware selection and cubicle design activities. • Experience working with transmission and distribution networks or substations. • Understanding of power system planning, grid integration and energy infrastructure development. • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments. • Fluent English is required. Swedish is considered an advantage.
Meritorious
• Experience from battery energy storage systems (BESS) and energy storage integration projects. • Experience working with regulatory frameworks, permitting processes, grid codes or utility compliance requirements. • Experience from HVDC, FACTS or STATCOM projects. • Experience from renewable energy integration projects. • Experience coordinating engineering activities or technical work packages. • Experience working with utilities, transmission operators or grid owners. • Project Management certification or formal project management experience. • Experience working in international project environments. • Willingness to learn Swedish and engage with the local working environment. 
Other
Location: Presence in Ludvika is mandatory.
Start date: According to agreement
Employment type: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months
Security screening: Background and security checks will be conducted as part of the recruitment process. Some roles require Swedish citizenship.
