Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.
Job description: Join our team   
As a Production Quality Engineer, you play a key role in shaping the quality, reliability, and safe performance of our products. You will be at the forefront of ensuring that every product leaving our production facilities meets and exceeds customer expectations, while contributing to a safe, efficient, and world-class manufacturing environment. 
 This is more than a quality role. It is an opportunity to make a visible impact on our products, processes, and future technologies. By driving quality excellence and safety improvements, and reducing disturbances throughout the production flow, you will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational performance, and business success. 
 Your mission 
 In the role as Production Quality Engineer, you will contribute and support the organization to exceed customer´s expectations with safe products and components with the right quality and highest reliability.  
 You will inspire and contribute to efficient and disruption-free production from a safety and quality perspective. Cross-functional collaboration with several different departments regarding quality issues.
   
Be part of and contribute to the daily work and improvement work within the Production Quality department. 
 
    
Advanced troubleshooting during quality disturbances with a high focus on new technology e.g. electrification.  
 
    
Investigate and forward feedback. 
 
    
To be a case holder during advanced quality deviations and perform root cause analysis. 
 
    
Develop and review quality processes. 
 
    
In connection with quality outcomes from field, product audits and testing. Evaluate, educate, implement and follow-up on improvements. 
 
    
Takes ownership to prevent future deviations using risk analyses, Lean principles, create and manage data collection and 6 sigma methodology. 
 
    
Perform module inspection. 
 
  
 Your profile
 To thrive as a Quality Engineer, you are a team player capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Your curiosity about new technology and a thoughtful and structured approach allows you to think innovatively and show initiative. Flexibility is key, and you enjoy building and maintaining an extensive network both internally and externally. A service-oriented mindset is second nature to you, and you see stimulating tasks as opportunities rather than limitations.  
   
You have a technical university degree or equivalent work experience and a strong interest in technology.  
 
    
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Word, 
 
    
Experience working in M3 and Teamcenter, along with other quality tools, is highly desirable.  
 
    
With excellent proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, you can communicate smoothly within our global network.  
 
  
 
 Your experience in quality and assembly, coupled with in-depth knowledge of our products, makes you an ideal candidate for the role. 
  
 Location and other 
 This position is located in Örebro, Sweden. Occasional travel is required.  
  
 Why Epiroc? 
 By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. 
  
 To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:  
   
Global career opportunities 
 
    
Learning & Development programs 
 
    
Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus) 
 
    
Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being 
 
    
Global Parental Leave Policy

A Snapshot of Your Day
By managing the progress of Problem Solving under complex boundary conditions, this position as a Product Integrity Program Manager / Project Manager for Technical Issues is very challenging. In your role, you will have a high visibility to the upper management and the opportunity to grow and to develop your own skills.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Responsibility for planning and managing prioritized projects to ensure effective and timely fleet-wide issue resolution
Coordination of the complete issue-resolution process, from defining clear problem statements and conducting root cause analyses to validating and implementing sustainable technical solutions
Leadership and alignment of all relevant cross-functional interfaces across the organization to maintain project progress and successfully resolve complex technical challenges
Development and execution of risk mitigation strategies, as well as coordination of internal and external communication related to ongoing projects and technical issues
Creation, maintenance, and monitoring of project plans, milestone schedules, and project budgets to ensure successful project delivery
Promotion of continuous improvement through lessons learned, quality feedback to engineering teams, prevention of issue recurrence, and participation in or support of customer meetings worldwide as a technical partner to the commercial project organization

What You Bring
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or in a comparable field 
Several years of experience within the industrial gas turbine industry or a related technical business environment 
Knowledge about commercial projects and power plant business 
Proven experience as a Program Manager or Project Manager, including leadership of multidisciplinary project teams
Training or certificate in Project Management is meritorious
Strong self-motivation and ability to easily navigate through ambiguity
Good skills in talking and reading English.

About the Team
Join an open and dynamic team where professional and personal development is high on the agenda! You will be part in a team consisting of 5 colleagues, located in Sweden and United Kingdom.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. jobs.description:
Senior Associate – Legal and Business Affairs - Media and Entertainment
Jefferson Saleh is a boutique legal and business affairs consultancy (organised as a Swedish juristbyrå) serving the UK media, entertainment and creative industries. We advise across the full lifecycle of creative content, from development and financing to production, exploitation and licensing, including talent deals, IP strategy, clearances and generative AI. We also provide legal operations and back-office support.
Our clients are primarily based in the UK and US and range from creators and talent to production companies, agencies, financiers and international studios, across film, television, digital, branded and emerging media. 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English-qualified solicitor to advise clients primarily on film and TV development and production. The role is suitable for a service-minded candidate who is comfortable leading complex talent negotiations with UK and US talent agents and lawyers, managing high-profile client relationships and advising on production, financing, talent and commercial matters. The candidate should enjoy solving unconventional problems, have a healthy appetite for risk and want to help shape a small but growing consultancy.
The successful candidate will work with a high degree of autonomy alongside senior client stakeholders, producers, financiers, talent representatives and other client legal teams, often across multiple jurisdictions. 

Our Values 
We prioritise speed, quality, trust, commercially meaningful advice and long-term relationships. How we work matters as much as the work itself. Our clients operate in fast-moving environments and expect responsive, available and pragmatic advisers who understand both the legal and commercial sides of a deal. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 
Managing the production legal workflow: drafting, reviewing and negotiating talent (writer, director, producer) agreements, PSAs, development and format agreements, finance documentation, distribution and licensing deals, crew and HOD contracts, rights acquisition and chain of title documentation, brand partnership and sponsorship arrangements and other copyright-based agreements.  
Advising on: financing structures, guild and collective bargaining agreements, broadcasting code clearance, production risk, cultural tests and tax incentives 
Managing: transactions and negotiations from inception to delivery 
Acting as: a day-to-day contact for clients and counterparties 
Supporting: business development initiatives 
Supervising: junior lawyers and/or trainees where appropriate

Essential Minimum Requirements  
Qualified solicitor in England & Wales (Australian or US qualified considered if experienced working in the UK market)
At least 5 years’ PQE working with transactional entertainment/media law, primarily advising film and television clients
Experience independently managing film/TV production legals 
Excellent grasp of contractual risk allocation 
Private practice experience or a desire to work in a client-facing role
Understanding of the practical applications of Pact, Equity and BECTU rules
Excellent written and spoken legal English

Desirable Experience 
Understanding of how the UK guild landscape interacts with SAG, WGA and DGA
Understanding of US studio practices and priorities
Ability to negotiate against LA-based acting talent representatives
Working on studio or SVOD commissioned production legals 
Production financing and security arrangements 
AI issues affecting the entertainment industry 
Understanding of GDPR and Data Privacy laws

 
About You  
Proactive and capable of taking ownership
Commercially pragmatic and solutions-focused 
Collaborative and team-oriented 
Interest in the entertainment industry 
Puts clients’ needs first 

Working Arrangements
Full-time in Härryda, Gothenburg, Sweden.

Salary
Gross SEK 60,000–79,000 per month. Where an offer sits within the range will depend on a number of factors, including PQE, depth of film and TV production experience, US talent negotiation experience, level of guild understanding, ability to work without supervision, any existing client relationships and the level of responsibility the successful candidate is able to take on from day one.

Other Benefits
Occupational pension (tjänstepension) 
Private health insurance
Bicycle scheme via salary exchange (förmånscykel)
Discretionary annual bonus scheme
Salary top-up during parental leave based on years of service 
Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) at or near the tax-free maximum
25 days’ paid annual holiday plus Swedish public holidays
Paid professional annual practising certificate renewal with the SRA 

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Role Summary
The Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We have seen strong traction since opening, and being able to start immediately is a big plus.
Key Responsibilities
●     Develop and own a guest issue-resolution procedure that classifies complaints and incidents by severity (for example, an allergen reaction is critical and a wrong order is minor), sets out what staff can resolve on the spot (such as a free remake or refund) and what is escalated to the manager, and ensures every case is logged and reviewed
●     Build and manage staff rotas around expected demand, including lunch and dinner peaks, keeping labour cost on target, adjusting staffing in real time, and sharing staff between locations while the next location gets established
●     Set clear, rule-based handling for delivery and online orders, including missing items, late deliveries and refund claims, so that cases are resolved quickly and consistently
●     Go beyond completing HACCP logs: when a food-safety check fails (for example, a temperature reading), investigate the root cause and put corrective and preventive actions in place so it does not recur
●     Carry out regular service and food-quality spot checks using simple scorecards, and use the results to coach staff
●     Monitor Google and delivery-app reviews, reply to guests, and turn patterns into fixes
●     Train new staff to our service and food-safety standards ahead of the next opening
●     Interpret sales, food, labour and waste figures in our dashboards, and act on them
●     Lead daily outlet operations, including opening and closing, front-of-house service, kitchen coordination, HACCP and hygiene standards, and supplier ordering and stock control
 Required Skills and Profile
●     Master’s degree or equivalent in Business, Management, Hospitality or similar
●     Experience in operations, customer service or hospitality, including handling escalated customer complaints (international experience acceptable)
●     Fluent in English. Fluency in Nepali strongly preferred.

●     Experience writing customer-issue procedures and investigating recurring problems
●     Experience training and coaching teams, including running quality checks

●     Root cause analysis or Six Sigma experience is an advantage
●     Understanding of food‑safety principles and willingness to undertake required certifications

jobs.occupation: PhD student in pavement engineering / AI based analysis
jobs.description:
VTI, the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, is looking for a PhD student in pavement engineering with an emphasis on AI based automated data back-analysis method for pavement conditions and performance predictions. The position will be based in Linköping or Stockholm, Sweden
About the position
The goal of this doctoral project is to increase our knowledge and create new competencies regarding deterioration and condition development of flexible roads at the network level by utilizing artificial intelligence and large datasets. Collected data from rolling road surface testing methods (non-destructive testing) as well as climate data and registered road construction data will be analysed and used to provide reliable information about the structural condition of the pavement structure. Your assignment will be to develop methods to interpret rolling road surface testing data together with climate and pavement layer data to predict the pavement condition. The aim is to use analysis results to predict the mechanical performance of different layers in the road structure as a function of time. You will work in collaboration with the division’s professor of Road and Railway Engineering. The Swedish Transport Administration is funding the project for four years.
Your work will use information from rolling road surface measurements from Sweden and the Nordic region. Although you will devote yourself mainly to your doctoral education, you will also work to some extent with other research, field and laboratory testing, and the dissemination of research results to various actors and stakeholders.
Your qualifications
You have an MSc or equivalent in engineering or sciences, e.g. within Civil and Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant fields including computer or computational sciences.
You have an interest in data analysis and modelling, as well as laboratory and experimental work. Experience in the field of pavement/structural/geotechnical engineering, programming and in computational modelling is beneficial. The job duties require a solid foundation in the relevant theory and methodology, and you must be able to compile, analyse and present material independently.
The work will entail numerous contacts with various organisations within the transport field, cooperative partners and other researchers. You must consequently possess both good organisational and cooperative skills, as well as strong skills in written and spoken English. A good knowledge of Swedish is advantageous, but not a requirement.
We will place major emphasis on your personal characteristics, analytical abilities, and ability to take personal initiative and work independently.
Duration of employment
The position is fixed term, with increments of a maximum of one year at a time and will be reassessed on an ongoing basis each year. The position is predicated upon your acceptance into the postgraduate programme at KTH.
As a PhD student, you will be employed by VTI while simultaneously being enrolled in the doctoral programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering at the Division of Highway and Railway Engineering, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden.
About VTI
The Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute (VTI) is an independent and internationally prominent research institute in the transport sector with some 250 employees and an annual turnover of roughly MSEK 300. Our principal task is to conduct commissioned research and development related to infrastructure, traffic and transport. We are dedicated to the continuous development of knowledge pertaining to the transport sector, and in this way contribute actively to the attainment of the goals of Swedish transport policy.
More information
Additional information about the position is available from Research Director Björn Kalman or Professor Sigurdur Erlingsson, +46 (0)13 204123 as well docent Denis Jelagin, +46 (0)8 790 8698.
Information about how we process your personal data when you apply for a job at VTI can be found here: https://www.vti.se/en/about-vti/personal-data
We decline all offerings of advertising or recruiting assistance in connection with this recruitment.
Ref. nr: 2026/0485-3.1
The application
We welcome your application, which must include a personal letter, CV, transcripts, and any other documents you wish to cite.
The deadline for applications is 10 december

Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Welcome to Mycronic!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering group comprising mechanical, electronics, and mechatronics engineers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across different functions, including architects, service, project management, product management, production, and management. With the majority of Mycronic’s R&D operations and production facilities located on-site in Kista, you will have the opportunity to work in close proximity to both the products you develop and the people involved in bringing them to life.
Work tasks
You will take part in the entire development chain, from requirements specification to design and implementation, while working with a diverse range of materials and technologies, including welded and machined steel structures, large and small aluminum and plastic components, high-precision parts, and units for highly accurate motion control. You will work with a range of products within the PA Division, including for example Mycronic Jet Printers, MYTower systems and Pick-and-Place machines.
You will, for example:

Work with the design of mechanical components and functions.

Participate in multiple parallel projects, covering new product development, maintenance, improvements to existing solutions, and product redesign.

Participate in defining requirements and requirements reviews.

Perform verification and documentation to ensure that designs meet specified requirements.

Contribute to the development and improvement of existing ways of working and solutions by identifying opportunities for improvement and suggesting new solutions, features and accessories.

We are looking for
This role is ideal for a curious and collaborative Mechanical Design Engineer with a genuine passion for technology and engineering. You enjoy exploring new ideas, challenging existing solutions and finding better ways of working. You are eager to develop your skills, share your knowledge and learn from the experience and perspectives of others. You enjoy working hands-on with mechanical design, turning ideas into practical solutions and contributing to continuous improvements. You are a team player who values open communication, enjoys collaborating across functions and is motivated by solving technical challenges together.
Furthermore, you have:
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanics, mechatronics, or a related field. 
At least some years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, covering the entire development life cycle. 
Good knowledge in CAD, Mycronic uses SolidWorks. 
Strong proficiency in English and good knowledge of Swedish (or a willingness to learn).

Other information
Start: By agreement. 
Location: Stockholm, Kista. 
Employment: Permanent, Full-time. 
Contact information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se. Recruitment Coordinator Vera Mohlin, vera.mohlin@academicwork.se.
This recruitment process is managed by Academic Work. Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

You will work in a technical team focused on feature development and verification of active safety systems and automated vehicles. The role includes planning and conducting vehicle testing as well as analyzing and documenting test results.
You will work hands-on with both passenger cars and trucks on advanced test tracks and use specialized testing equipment, including driving robot systems and measuring instruments.
The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, functional managers, developers, and customers. You are expected to contribute technical understanding, accuracy, and a professional approach throughout the entire testing process.
Main tasks
Plan, prepare, lead, and carry out various types of testing assignments.
Conduct vehicle testing with passenger cars and trucks on special test tracks.
Work with advanced testing equipment, including installed robotic systems and measurement equipment.
Collect, analyze, and document test results.
Report test results and ensure clear technical documentation.
Support functional managers and development teams in the ongoing work of developing and verifying products.
Contribute to the development and improvement of testing methods, test equipment, and work processes.
Maintain ongoing contact with customers and ensure a professional and service-oriented collaboration.
Represent the organization with high technical expertise and a solution-oriented approach.

Qualifications and mandatory competence
We are looking for someone with relevant technical education and experience in vehicle-related testing.
Education
Bachelor's or master's degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
Alternatively, equivalent relevant post-secondary education.

Technical experience
Experience in vehicle-related testing and verification.
Experience with advanced measuring equipment.
Experience with ABD missile systems.
Ability to conduct technical tests, analyze results, and document conclusions.

Language and driver's license
Excellent knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Swedish category B driving license.
Good driving experience.

Meritorious competence
It is an advantage if you also have:
C, CE, and/or D driving licenses.
Experience in customer-focused technical assignments.
Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB.
Additional experience with advanced test systems, vehicle measurements, and automated test environments.

Personal qualities
We value that you are:
Analytical and meticulous with a structured approach.
Practical and comfortable working outdoors in test environments.
Independent and responsible in planning and conducting tests.
Communicative and service-oriented in contact with customers and colleagues.
Solution-oriented and interested in new technology in vehicles, safety, and automation.
A team player who enjoys collaborating in cross-functional technical teams.

Location and assignment period
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
The role is mainly related to practical work in vehicle and test environments. Presence on test tracks is required to carry out the testing activities.

Attach an updated CV clearly describing your education, experience in vehicle testing, ABD robotic systems, measuring equipment, and relevant programming skills. Also specify your availability and driver's license eligibility.

About Us
At Stellar Capacity, we empower individuals and organizations to thrive amid digital transformation. Through cutting-edge programs in leadership, AI, innovation, and change, we partner with clients globally to accelerate impact.
As we scale, we're seeking a results-driven Strategic Business Developer to fuel growth, deepen client relationships, and help us deliver transformational experiences.
In this role, you will be at the forefront of how organizations across different industries understand, explore, and work with AI. If you're excited by the idea of empowering others through education, we’d love to hear from you.
Your Role
As a Strategic Business Developer you will partner with clients to understand goals, explore options, and co-create clear program proposals. Work alongside our design, marketing, and operations teams to ensure a consistent and seamless experience from first meeting through delivery. You’ll also participate in AI programs to gather insights, strengthen relationships, and identify thoughtful next steps.
Identify new business opportunities by understanding client needs and challenges, and articulating the transformative impact AI can have on their business.
Develop and advance pipeline through targeted outreach and timely follow-up; align with marketing on campaigns and events.
Run discovery and solutioning: diagnose goals, shape recommendations, and translate needs into clear program proposals.
Own core deal stages: qualify, scope, propose, negotiate, and close mid- to large-size engagements.
Lead key relationships: serve as the day-to-day point for strategic accounts; steward executive touchpoints and stakeholder alignment.
Support “all things program + sales”: contribute to decks, one-pagers, agendas, briefs, delivery checklists, follow-ups, and case studies.
Partner cross-functionally: channel client and market insights to refine offerings, messaging, and GTM; ensure strong handoffs to delivery.
Represent the brand at webinars, workshops, and industry events- and convert interest into next steps.

What You Bring
Experienced in sales or business development (edtech, training, consulting, or services a plus) ideally from a fast-moving environment, selling technology, data or digital transformation solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building skills and natural ability to connect with people at every level, turning first conversations to long-term partnerships.
Confident with outbound outreach and meeting activity/pipeline targets.
Creative and solution-oriented mindset; you think beyond templates to design what fits the client best.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills with senior stakeholders; clear, persuasive writing.
Experienced in supporting program delivery (workshops, cohorts, trainings) and collaborating across teams.
Organized, process-driven, and comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, and forecasting.
Genuine curiosity about AI, leadership, and learning; you like turning ideas into action.
Fluent in English and Swedish.

How You Operate
You thrive in high-velocity environments and keep standards high while moving quickly. You’re proactive, resourceful, and hungry to do your best- willing to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to turn opportunities into impact. You stay grounded, put the mission and team ahead of ego, and measure success by shared results.
What we offer: 
Hands-On Impact: A unique opportunity to drive sales for high-impact programs that empower leaders and organizations worldwide.
Dynamic Environment: Be part of a vibrant, innovative team that values creativity, collaboration, and results.
High Candor, Low Ceremony: We give direct, respectful feedback - fast.
Career Advancement: Accelerate your career in a rapidly expanding company with opportunities for leadership and professional growth as a member of our leadership team.
Global Opportunities: Build relationships with top professionals and organizations across the globe.

Ready to make an impact?
If you want to help organizations take their next step with AI, and you thrive where relationships, strategy and results meet, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and few lines about why this role speaks to you. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to apply.

Business unit: Global Workplace Solutions
Role: Facilities Coordinator and Team Lead
Location: Central Stockholm, Sweden
Reporting line: Senior Facilities Manager, Nordics & Lithuania
 
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) produces comprehensive property management services and solutions for its customers. We specialize in managing integrated real estate services, technical maintenance of real estate,project and project management services.
At CBRE Global Workplace Solutions we believe our working spaces should allow everyone to feel comfortable,productive and inspired in their working environment. Because when people feel inspired, great things happen. We are a workplace team providing Facility Services across EMEA for a prestigious global technology client.
 
Are you passionate about delivering world-class workspaces, building high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence? We are looking for an energetic and proactive Facilities Coordinator & Team Lead to champion our safety culture, elevate customer experiences, and lead the team of 3 facilities assistants.
 
In this role, you will be the driving force behind our site's daily success, blending exceptional service delivery, innovative problem-solving, and inspiring people management.
 
Core Responsibilities
Safety and culture champion
Actively foster an environment where safety comes first by logging quality hazards, closing out actions, and embedding compliance and RISE behaviors.
Maintain full adherence to CBRE and client health and safety policies, ensuring a secure environment for staff, contractors, and visitors while assisting with evacuation team training and drills.

 
Operational & Customer Excellence
Deliver the Ultimate Experience: Provide high-class, professional customer service that keeps our spaces running seamlessly.
Own the Environment: Take accountability for all facilities issues, proactively resolving remedial actions and maintaining immaculate space standards.
Comprehensive Support: Lead your team in delivering exceptional soft services
KPI & SLA Driven: Strive for excellence by consistently hitting and exceeding performance targets while building strong, collaborative relationships with client and supply partners.

 
Innovation & Impact
Take ownership of First Day of Business preparations and execution.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Champion fresh ideas, share best practices, and constantly look for smart innovations to improve contract performance.
Increase efficiency with the use of AI.

 
People Leadership & Development
Motivate & Recognize: Build a high-energy, engaged team culture through regular recognition and the performance management cycle.
Grow Talent: Understand team strengths, champion professional growth, and support succession planning with consistent, constructive feedback and one-on-ones.

 
Supplier & Financial Stewardship
Supervise & Support: Coordinate supplier personnel and subcontractors to ensure flawless service delivery and strict adherence to safety protocols (RAMS reviews, permits, and inductions).
Budget Management: Oversee operational budgets, handle invoicing and purchase orders, ensure compliance, and actively identify cost-saving opportunities for our client.

 
Finance
You oversee operational budget and accruals within contract guidelines and financial procedures ensuring spend compliance.
You are responsible for your budget and you manage all costs to ensure it is respected and address any related queries, including invoicing/ PO's that might arise.
You are continually looking for saving opportunities to reduce client costs.

 
Why Join Us?
This is a high-visibility, rewarding opportunity where your leadership will directly shape the daily experience of everyone on site. If you are a collaborative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves bringing out the best in people, we want to hear from you!
 
Succeeding in this role:
Preferred higher educational qualifications (or equivalent)
Fluency in written and spoken English & Swedish languages with strong communication skills
Displays proactive day-to-day problem solving, with ownership and pride
A basic understanding of good health & safety practices, engages in Health & Safety culture
Experience in fostering high-performing teams
Proven financial accuracy and expertise
Ability to prioritize, whilst engaging in self development

 
What do we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits
Possibility to learn from leading global company producing real estate services
Awesome colleagues and exciting working environment
Welcoming you to CBRE's Performance Management cycle
 
Last date of application 20.12.2026
Got questions about the position? Reach out directly to Senior Facilities Manager Tiina Luukkonen,

The opportunity  
Shape the Future of HSE Governance within HVDC 
Are you passionate about management systems, governance, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy creating structures from complexity, bringing people together, and turning requirements into practical solutions? 
As our HVDC HSE Management System Lead, you will play a key role in developing and improving the HVDC HSE Management System. Working across Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental & Energy Management, and Assurance, you will help strengthen the governance framework that supports a safe, sustainable, and high-performing organization. 
You will join a collaborative team that brings together different areas of HSE expertise, with a strong focus on shared ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement. If you have a solid foundation in management systems and enjoy working with people to create meaningful and lasting improvements, we would love to hear from you. 
This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 
How you’ll make an impact  
Shape and continuously improve the HVDC HSE Management System .  
Lead the HSE Governance process and help create clear, effective ways of working across the organization. You will act as Process leader. 
Drive alignment and integration of Environmental, Occupational Health & Safety, and Energy Management requirements. 
Partner closely with the Occupational Health & Safety Lead, Environmental & Energy Lead, and other Governance team members to ensure specialist requirements are effectively incorporated into the management system. 
Coordinate Management Reviews and help translate outcomes into continuous improvement. 
Simplify, harmonize, and improve governance processes, methodologies, tools, and documentation. 
Support the integration of HSE requirements into the wider HVDC Way. 

Your background 
Your experience and expertise are important, and we believe your personal qualities will be equally important to your success. 
You have experience in management systems, governance, process management, or continuous improvement, along with knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. Experience with ISO 50001 is an advantage. 
You may have a degree in Engineering, Environmental Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Sustainability, Business Administration, or a related field, but we equally value relevant practical experience. 
You bring a structured and analytical approach and are comfortable turning complex requirements into practical solutions. 
You communicate clearly, build trust, and enjoy bringing people and different perspectives together. 
You are comfortable facilitating discussions, creating alignment, and driving improvements across organizational boundaries. 
You are curious and open-minded, with a willingness to learn and collaborate with experts across different disciplines. 
Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.  

More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​ 
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

jobs.occupation: Medical Oncologists Wanted for Oncology Departments Across Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in medical oncology looking for a role that combines professional development, multidisciplinary collaboration, and access to modern cancer treatments?
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established oncology department in Sweden that provides comprehensive cancer care across a broad spectrum of diagnoses. You will join an experienced and supportive team where collaboration, clinical excellence and continuous development are highly valued.
This is an opportunity to work in a specialty that is constantly evolving, with access to modern therapies and the possibility to contribute to the ongoing development of cancer care while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
About the role
As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:
Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.
Why this opportunity?

Collaborative and supportive environment: 
Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

Modern oncology practice:
Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

Professional development:
Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

Varied clinical work:
Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

Long-term career opportunities:
Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden
The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.
Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.
Requirements
EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
Strong communication skills in English.
Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

WITRON values employees and strives to create a supportive and rewarding work environment.
Work in a high-tech, future-proof industry

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Radiologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden
Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.
We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals. 
Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.
Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.
Professional Development
The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.
For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.
Relocation and Support
Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.
You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.
Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.
Support for your family
Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.
Language training
To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.
Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.
Living in Sweden
Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.
Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.
Requirements
We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.
Interested?
Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.
Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Nordic Operations Analytics Specialist: join PostNord as an Operations Analyst in Solna and turn data into better decisions.
Help shape the future of Nordic parcel operations. As an Operations Analyst at PostNord, with the role title Nordic Operations Analytics Specialist, you connect operational performance with customer, commercial and financial outcomes. If your background is as a Business Analyst, Logistics Analyst or Supply Chain Analyst, this is an opportunity to build analytical tools, uncover improvement opportunities and turn insights into measurable business impact. Based in Stockholm, Solna or another Nordic head office, you work across markets, influence portfolio decisions and help build analytical capabilities that make a difference.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
Make an impact across the Nordic parcel portfolio, work closely with teams across markets and build analytical capabilities that influence real business decisions. We offer you a flexible hybrid workplace with a prestige-free environment where we as a team help each other to reach our goals. We encourage self-sufficient leadership for development and career opportunities. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
Work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool
Employee benefits through PostNord´s own employee foundation PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement.

Your Responsibilities
You connect operational performance with customer, commercial and financial outcomes to guide portfolio decisions and improvements. Your responsibilities include:
Build dashboards, KPIs and scalable analytical tools with IT, turning business needs into better decision support.
Analyse volumes, flows, lead times, service quality and product usage to uncover root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
Strengthen business cases and portfolio priorities with operational assumptions, impact assessments, sensitivity analysis and quantified improvement potential.
Provide analytical input and follow-up for product changes, launches and migrations across Nordic markets.
Define and govern common product master data structures and drive data quality improvements, while Product Specialists own product-specific data accuracy, maintenance and setup.
Turn findings into actionable recommendations with Product, Operations, Finance, CX, Commercial, Pricing, Digital and country teams to improve efficiency, customer experience and scalability.

The Bigger Picture
Nordic Parcel Product Management develops PostNord’s Nordic parcel portfolio. You report to Manager Solutions Area B2C, with an analytical mandate across all parcel product areas.
The role can be based at PostNord’s offices in Stockholm/Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. The hybrid working model includes three days per week at the office.
Our Expectations
You combine analytical depth with business understanding. You challenge assumptions with facts, make complex findings clear and work across functions to turn insight into action. Taking ownership of analytical quality and building tools and ways of working that make a difference comes naturally to you.
Your background includes experience in analytics, business control, operations development or improvement, product performance or BI/reporting, with strong skills in large-data-set and root-cause analysis.
An understanding of operations, product performance, flows and service quality in logistics or another relevant industry is essential. Connecting these with customer, commercial, digital and financial outcomes is an advantage.
Experience building dashboards, KPIs and analytical models, and developing scalable tools with IT, is also required. You understand master data structures, reporting dimensions and data quality improvement, and bring stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills in a Nordic or matrix environment.
You hold a university degree, college degree or equivalent higher education qualification, and are fluent in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.

jobs.description:
Job description
Business Performance Manager – BA Biomaterials, Stora Enso
Are you ready to bridge the gap between commercial strategy and data-driven analytics in a global company leading the transition to a circular bioeconomy? We are now looking for a Business Performance Manager to join Stora Enso Biomaterials in Stockholm or Helsinki. About the Role As Business Performance Manager within our Sales, Marketing & Supply Chain organization, you will play a pivotal role in driving commercial excellence and profitability. This role blends the hands-on analytical depth of a business controller with the strategic problem-solving and advisory mindset of a management consultant. Acting as a trusted business partner to Sales, you will translate complex commercial and financial data into actionable insights. You will provide critical decision support on pricing, customer and product portfolios, and account planning—helping our commercial teams make sharper, data-backed decisions.  

The position is based in Stockholm or Helsinki, offering a hybrid way of working that combines office collaboration with remote flexibility. You will report to the Head of Marketing & Sales Excellence. Occasional travel may be required. We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded professional who effortlessly navigates complex data while keeping an eye on the bigger strategic picture. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy challenging the status quo, and actively look for ways to elevate commercial processes through data, digitalization, and technology. 

You are structured, take end-to-end ownership from initial analysis to follow-up, and excel at building strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Please submit your application through our recruitment tool as soon as possible, as we review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. 
For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Consultant Jeanette Walters at (jeanette.walters@randstad.se).

Responsibilities
Drive and develop structured commercial performance management, including defining relevant KPIs and conducting regular performance follow-ups. 
Build, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards and analytical models to empower business decision-making. 
Analyze profitability across customers, products, and markets to pinpoint key performance drivers and recommend concrete improvement actions. 
Provide analytical leadership and decision support on pricing, customer and product portfolio optimization, and account planning. 
Own and evolve pricing principles as well as contracting governance. 
Monitor and evaluate Sales Incentive Programs and sales overdue reporting. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Controlling, IT, and Legal to streamline and enhance commercial processes and ways of working.

Qualifications
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 
Several years of experience in commercial performance management, business/sales controlling, management consulting, or a similar analytical role. 
Strong grasp of commercial drivers, pricing strategies, profitability analysis, and performance management. 
Proven track record of developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, as well as leveraging CRM and ERP systems for data-driven decision-making. 
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and tangible business actions. 
Strong communication and presentation skills, paired with experience working across diverse functions and stakeholder groups. 
Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Swedish or Finnish is considered a strong advantage. 

About the company

Stora Enso AB
Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on
packaging. Our purpose is to replace non-renewable materials with renewable
solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high-
quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers,
accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has
approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion.
We believe that diversity strengthens our competitiveness and leads to better
decisionmaking. Diverse teams with different backgrounds help us explore new
perspectives and challenge our ways of thinking. We actively work to increase
diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Stora
Enso is an equal opportunity employer that follows nondiscriminatory practices.

jobs.description:
ERP Programme Planning Specialist – Global ERP Transformation
Are you an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and control to complex international transformation programmes? Do you thrive in an environment where planning, resource management and collaboration are essential to successful delivery?
We are currently looking for an experienced ERP Programme Planning Specialist for an exciting consulting assignment with one of our clients, a leading international company within the industrial sector, based in Lund, Sweden.
This is an opportunity to play an important role in a large-scale global ERP transformation programme, working closely with international teams, project managers and senior stakeholders.
About the role
As an ERP Programme Planning Specialist, you will be part of a Transformation Management Office (TMO), supporting the planning and coordination of multiple ERP rollout projects.
Your main focus will be to create and maintain a clear, integrated overview of programme timelines, milestones, resources and risks, ensuring that programme leadership has the information needed to make informed decisions.
The role combines strategic programme planning with hands-on coordination, analysis and continuous improvement.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and maintain an integrated programme plan across multiple ERP rollout projects.

Coordinate milestones, schedules and dependencies across international teams and workstreams.

Manage resource allocation, capacity planning and forward-looking resource forecasts.

Identify resource bottlenecks, scheduling conflicts and potential delivery risks.

Maintain programme-wide risk registers with clear ownership and escalation procedures.

Monitor programme progress and provide structured reporting to senior stakeholders.

Analyse planning, resource and risk data to support informed decision-making.

Support scenario planning, prioritisation and replanning when programme requirements change.

Collaborate closely with project managers, business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment across the programme.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a structured, analytical and proactive professional with solid experience in large-scale ERP implementations, international system rollouts or complex business transformation programmes.
You understand the challenges of coordinating multiple projects, managing dependencies and ensuring that resources are effectively planned and utilised.
You are comfortable working in international environments, communicating with senior stakeholders and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.
Key skills and experience
Proven experience in programme planning, PMO/TMO or large-scale ERP transformation programmes.

Experience coordinating international ERP implementations or system rollouts.

Strong understanding of integrated programme planning and milestone management.

Practical experience in resource management, capacity planning and forecasting.

Experience identifying and managing risks and dependencies across multiple projects.

Strong analytical skills and experience working with planning and resource data.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work independently while maintaining a programme-wide perspective.

Excellent communication skills in English.

Nice to have
Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP platforms.

Background in global transformation programmes within industrial or manufacturing organisations.

Experience with programme planning, reporting or resource management tools.

Experience supporting senior leadership with scenario analysis and decision-making.

About you
You are a solution-oriented and detail-focused professional who enjoys creating structure in complex environments.
You have a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and the ability to bring people together across different functions and geographical locations.
You understand the importance of balancing long-term programme objectives with day-to-day operational priorities and enjoy contributing to successful transformation initiatives.
Assignment details
Location: Lund, Sweden Work arrangement: Hybrid (on-site presence required) Assignment type: Consulting assignment Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement Duration: Until 22 July 2027 Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week

We would love to hear from you!
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Please submit your application through our application portal, as applications sent directly via email will not be considered.

jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
 Start your career development and become Tetra Pak’s next Future Talent! We are looking for highly motivated newly graduates to join us in 2027! 
 
 
Future Talent Programme is a Trainee Programme within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in September 2027 at our site in Lund. You will onboard an individually designed development programme for 18 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the programme you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person. As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
 
In Materials & Package we are responsible for the industrial lifecycle management and specification management for all packaging materials, packages, openings, closures & paper straws, secondary package and other additional materials for packaging solutions.
 
Visit https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/future-talent and read more about Tetra Pak Future Talent Programme!
 
This position belongs to the Leadership Track.
 
You will be based in Lund, Sweden but you will work in a global arena.
What you will do
As our new Future Talent – Development Engineer Packaging Material you will:
 
Develop new innovative material solutions to meet our customer needs and our sustainability commitments
Work in a cross-functional scrum team where you will turn science into practice and drive the development of material from idea to market release
Design and evaluate the performance and functionality of the material, build knowledge, and participate in problem solving together with specialists and stakeholders
Coordinate test activities and work closely with laboratories, factories and specialists globally. You will work in the test facilities as well as working at your desk analysing data and writing reports and communicating results to stakeholders

We believe you have
You have a Masters Degree in Material Science or equivalent (Graduated 2026-2027)
It is possible that you have experience working with paperboard, polymers, packaging or recycling
You are fluent in English, written and spoken
You have good communications skills, written and spoken
Previous international studies/experience are considered meritorious

We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analysts – Trading Compliance & Analytics
jobs.description:
We are looking for two Senior Business Analysts for a client undertaking a major transformation of its trade surveillance capabilities.
About the role
You will support the development of a next-generation surveillance platform used by international teams. Working at the intersection of business strategy and technology, you will take ownership of functional requirements and help guide their delivery from initial analysis through implementation.
The role involves translating complex business needs into actionable specifications, coordinating delivery activities, and ensuring data integrations meet relevant exchange requirements and technical standards.
Key responsibilities

Develop clear functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation for development, quality assurance, delivery, and surveillance teams.

Identify, document, prioritise, and validate data and functional requirements throughout the product lifecycle, balancing business value, exchange requirements, and technical feasibility.

Collaborate with surveillance teams across Europe and the US, alongside commercial and engineering stakeholders, to plan delivery, track requirements, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment with product design principles.

Work with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to review requirements, clarify expectations, and agree on enhancements and issue resolution.

Maintain the project backlog and establish governance procedures to support effective delivery.

Coordinate the calibration and tuning of surveillance models and detection patterns as they are introduced across asset classes, including equities and fixed income.

Support day-to-day surveillance activities, including reviews of business initiatives, market abuse risk assessments, and responses to user queries.

Required qualifications

A master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

At least five years of experience as a business analyst or product analyst within capital markets, financial technology, or a regulated trading environment.

Strong knowledge of trading data structures, order management and execution workflows, trading protocols, and exchange rules.

An understanding of multiple asset classes and instruments, including equities, fixed income, futures, options, and forwards.

Demonstrated ability to turn complex business and technical requirements into structured documentation, such as functional specifications, user stories, and data flow diagrams.

Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional engineering and product teams, using tools such as Jira.

Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in SQL.

Preferred qualifications

Knowledge of trade surveillance, compliance monitoring, or regulatory frameworks such as MAR, MiFID II, FINRA requirements, and relevant market models or exchange rules.

Experience with large-scale data integration pipelines or market data feeds across multiple asset classes.

Familiarity with instrument reference data and how different traded products affect surveillance requirements.

Experience collaborating with international teams and stakeholders across regions.

Practical experience with trade surveillance platforms, including the calibration and tuning of detection models.

Extensive experience using Jira for backlog management and sprint planning.

Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Personal qualities
You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and communicate clearly with both business and technical stakeholders.
Application & start date
Please submit your CV in English.
Start date: 7 December 2026 / ASAP End date: 31 December 2028 Application deadline: 20 November 2026 Hybrid work: Yes Location: Stockholm

About the role
As a specialist in oncology, you will be involved in:
Outpatient consultations and follow-up of oncology patients.
Systemic cancer treatments and individualized treatment planning.
Participation in multidisciplinary tumour conferences (MDTs).
Inpatient care as part of a rotating ward responsibility.
Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.
Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors.
Contributing to the continued development of clinical pathways and oncology services.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.
Why this opportunity?

Collaborative and supportive environment: 
Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

Modern oncology practice:
Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

Professional development:
Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

Varied clinical work:
Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

Long-term career opportunities:
Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden
The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.
Families appreciate the safe environment, excellent schools and generous work-life balance, while larger cities and international travel connections remain easily accessible.
Requirements
EU-recognised specialist certification in Medical Oncology.
Solid clinical experience as a specialist in oncology.
Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team.
Interest in teaching, supervision and professional development.
Strong communication skills in English.
Motivation to learn Swedish through our language programme.

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Project and Production Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 
Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As a full-time intern in the TEF4 department, you actively contribute to develop and create the conditions for a more efficient production setup to optimize manufacturing.
In this role you will be supporting the local Production Engineering department with daily project management tasks
You will have the opportunity to plan and execute your own production related projects
Evaluating data and creating statistics will allow you to follow up on KPIs of the production
Design parts and create drawings in CAD
Administrative tasks to support the local Production Engineering manager will also be part of your duties
You will be actively participating in the department’s improvement and development, e.g., by moderating workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months preferably starting in February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden
Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Industrial Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Previous production-related experience desirable
Good analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and technical thinking
You thrive in a dynamic work environment – identifying problems, finding solutions and executing them by actively driving your own ideas
Working knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience in other tools (CAD) is a plus
Knowledge in topics like IoT and Industry 4.0 could also be a plus
Open and communicative, ability to approach people easily and to work in a team environment
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English, Swedish is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch
