jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer at Metso in Kil!
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career within automation and robotics? As an automation engineer at Metso, you will have the opportunity to work with international clients in exciting projects, develop innovative solutions, and collaborate with a dedicated team passionate about technology. We look forward to your application!
About the role
As a Senior Automation Engineer at Metso, you will join our EIA team (electrical, instrumentation, and automation) in Kil, which currently consists of about seven specialists. You will become a key player in developing, implementing, and optimizing the control systems and robotics solutions that drive our customers' automated processes worldwide.
The role involves end-to-end responsibility throughout the project lifecycle – from concept and design to machine testing in the workshop and final commissioning at the customer's site. Since we deliver globally, a central part of the position is that you enjoy traveling. Travel is a natural part of the job and can involve stays abroad for up to 8 weeks at a time during major start-ups. In the long term, and as you get settled into the role, we also envision that you can act as a mentor for younger colleagues in the team.
You are offered
Growth & Development: Clear learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and opportunities for global collaboration
Compensation & Benefits: A competitive salary and a generous benefits package
An Inclusive Culture: An open workplace with supportive colleagues committed to helping each other thrive and succeed

Work tasks
Develop and adapt PLC programs, HMI solutions, and instrument configurations based on project-specific requirements and testing  
Perform machine testing in the workshop and handle commissioning at customer sites. Customer visits may range from short service trips lasting a few days to start-ups that can span several weeks over longer periods  
Create instructions, manuals, and training materials, as well as conduct training sessions for the customer’s technicians and operators  
Work with machine simulations and ensure that PLC programs and related systems are kept up to date  
Support other departments with automation-related information and technical assistance

We are looking for you who
Holds a post-secondary degree in automation or possesses equivalent work experience.
Has several years of experience in PLC programming, preferably in Siemens and/or Allen-Bradley environments.
Has excellent knowledge of English, both spoken and written.
Has the ability and willingness to travel internationally.
Holds a valid driver's license

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in robot programming.
Experience with Allen-Bradley Rockwell systems.
Experience with simulation tools such as Enterprise Dynamics, Visual Components, or similar.
Experience in automation R&D projects.

Working hours: 08:00–17:00
To succeed in this role, we believe you are structured, responsible, and detail-oriented. You enjoy leading others and communicate clearly both internally and with customers. You are solution-oriented and take initiative, with analytical skills that help improve processes and documentation. Additionally, you are flexible and confident working both independently and as part of a team.
The work is based in Kil or at Metso’s customer sites. If you are applying from another location, please describe in your application how you plan to commute to the workplace.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Do you want to combine qualified accounting with process development and ERP implementation in a fast-paced industrial environment? Do you thrive in a changing everyday setting where you can combine sharp attention to detail with a broader business perspective? Then this could be your next challenge!
About the position 
Perido is looking for a Senior Accountant on behalf of our client, an industrial enterprise driving large-scale initiatives within green energy and manufacturing. The position is located in Boden, with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.
Your daily tasks
The role is broad and includes both operational accounting and structural development work in close collaboration with various stakeholders across the organization. Your main responsibilities include:
Managing day-to-day accounting and month-end closing
Performing balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations
Handling VAT reporting
Managing CAPEX, fixed assets, and accounting classification
Contributing to the implementation of a new ERP system
Developing and documenting accounting processes and internal controls
Supporting audits and statutory reporting
Collaborating broadly with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization

Your characteristics
To thrive and succeed in this role, we are looking for someone who is structured, proactive, and solution-oriented. Since the assignment takes place in a fast-paced and changing environment, you are comfortable navigating change and can easily switch between seeing the bigger picture from a business perspective and ensuring high accuracy in the details. You are also communicative and find it easy to collaborate with different parts of the business.
Is this a challenge you want to take on? We look forward to reading your application—submit it today!
Qualifications:
At least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial control, or a similar finance role
Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP/K3
Hands-on experience with reconciliations, intercompany transactions, VAT, CAPEX, and fixed assets
Experience from an industrial environment, preferably within production, inventory, or logistics
Excellent spoken and written English

Meritorious:
Experience with ERP implementations, preferably in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud

Contract type and hours
Full-time, consulting assignment until 2028-01-04. Start 2027-01-05.
Application
Please apply through our website at perido.se/lediga-jobb/. Simply click the "Apply" button in the job advertisement, fill in your details, and upload your CV. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible, as the selection process is ongoing. Please note that some details about the assignment and/or client company may have been deliberately disclosed in the advertisement. If your profile matches what the client is looking for and you are contacted by a recruiter, you will receive all the information you need.
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still haven't found the answer you are looking for, you are most welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se and one of our Recruitment Communicators will answer you. Always enter the reference number 36129 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status.                  
About Perido
Why is our company named Perido? The name comes from the Latin word Peridoneus, which means 'well-matched'. Perido is a consulting and recruitment company specializing in the white-collar sector, dedicated to helping you take the next step in your career. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

Process Developer – Finance, AI & Automation
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
Role Summary
Are you passionate about AI, technology and transforming business processes?
We are looking for a proactive and analytical Process Developer to drive the transformation of Scania’s Finance processes, with a focus on Invoice-To-Pay (I2P) and the end-to-end Source-to-Pay (S2P) flow.
Our ambition is to create intelligent, AI-driven and increasingly touchless processes, minimizing manual work while improving efficiency, quality and compliance.
You will identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and drive improvements from idea to implementation. A key part of the role is understanding the entire S2P flow, including upstream activities within Procurement, to address root causes rather than simply automating existing problems.
You will work closely with Procurement, Finance, IT and other stakeholders, influencing decisions and driving change in a complex international environment. You will also contribute to Scania’s SAP S/4HANA transformation.
Job Responsibilities
Drive AI, automation and touchless process opportunities across Finance.
Analyze end-to-end S2P processes and identify upstream improvement opportunities.
Challenge existing processes and drive standardization and simplification.
Translate business needs into requirements and evaluate business value.
Influence stakeholders and drive cross-functional change initiatives.
Lead improvements from analysis to implementation and measurable results.

Who You Are
You are curious, analytical and driven by innovation and continuous improvement. You want to challenging established ways of working and turning ideas into results.
You have:
3–5 years of experience in process development, business transformation, automation, IT or a related field.
A degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, IT, Business or Finance.
Strong analytical skills and an end-to-end process mindset.
A genuine interest in AI, digitalization and intelligent automation.
Strong stakeholder management, communication and change-driving skills.
The ability to work independently and navigate a complex organization.
Fluent in Swedish and English.

Experience with S2P, Procurement, Accounts Payable, SAP S/4HANA, AI or automation technologies is an advantage.
This Is Us
We develop and improve Scania’s financial processes across Europe, China and Scania Latin America.
You will join an international team where process expertise, technology and innovation come together to shape the future of Finance.
 
Scania Offers 
 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-27. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
 
 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
Magda Blosinska, Talent Acquisition Specialist: magda.blosinska@scania.com

Do you enjoy product development and want to be involved in the creation from sketch to finished product? Now you have the chance to become an important part of our mechanics group and help us shape future products. In this role, you have good opportunities to be part of and influence our development journey! We are now looking for a Mechanical Lead Engineer for our Multi Channel Products team at our HQ in Lund, Sweden.
 
Your future team
We're a team of 25 passionate mechanical engineers of all ages and backgrounds who share a love for technology and solving complex challenges. We place a strong emphasis on creativity, collaboration, and openness. You'll find yourself surrounded by supportive colleagues who are always eager to help and contribute to your growth. We have a fantastic collaboration and team spirit. As an employee of the MCP (Multi Channel Products) mechanics group, you will participate actively in projects with different challenges and focuses. We often develop completely new products with innovation possibilities. At MCP, we develop Multidirectional cameras, Panoramic cameras, and Modular cameras.
 
What you'll do here as a Mechanical Lead Engineer
As Lead Engineer for our mechanics team, you will play a key role in structuring and driving the mechanical development process in your product project. Together with the project manager, you will plan and coordinate activities, ensuring that priorities, schedules, and resources are aligned. You will guide the mechanical engineers, build efficient ways of working, and secure smooth collaboration with other disciplines and global suppliers. While much of your focus will be on creating clarity, structure, and teamwork, you will also stay closely involved in the technical development - contributing your expertise and curiosity to shape smart, reliable, and innovative mechanical solutions.
 
As you will have significant responsibility for developing new products, often taking them from the initial concept stage through to the finished product, you will also work closely with the implementation of the product in volume production. In this phase, you will collaborate with quality engineers, production technicians, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
 
Who are you?
We're looking for a passionate and hands-on product development engineer to lead the mechanical development of our next-generation Multi Channel products. You are someone who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges while inspiring others to do their best work.
 
You bring structure, clear communication, and an easygoing, collaborative approach. You lead by example, staying close to the technical details while guiding your team forward.
 
We believe you hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering and have at least 5 years of experience in mechanical design and product development. Experience with die-casting, injection molding, production, mechanical and environmental testing is highly valued. Proficiency in 3D CAD and fluency in English, both written and spoken, are essential.
 
What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. 
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. 
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: 
Axis Career Hub 
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
 
Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!
In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Nils Bjerkås +46 46 272 18 00

Are you a individual who values team spirit over self-interest and also happens to be a Linux expert? Do you want to broaden your technical expertise and make a difference in brand protection? Then the role as Linux System Engineer at Abion could be the perfect fit for you!
About Abion
“Abion is a fast-growing and profitable platform-based IP and domain services provider on a journey on becoming a European IP powerhouse. We have a unique position in the market with nearly 30 years of experience in digitalization as an ICANN-accredited registrar and a comprehensive Brand Protection package and software and services within Domain Management, Trademark Management, and Web Security.
We offer an exciting position in a fast-paced organization that is constantly growing and developing in a highly current industry. At Abion, we believe in giving our employees great freedom with responsibility. We foster a diverse, dynamic, and permissive culture with lots of cross-departmental collaboration and with great opportunities for personal development. We want to be the best and therefore expect the best from ourselves and our colleagues.
Abion is on an exciting path, and we want like-minded people to join us on the next step of our journey to become the best IP company in Europe, an IP powerhouse!”
About the position
As a Linux System Engineer at Abion, you will take on a multifaceted role with a focus on Linux administration in hosting, server management, and web support on Linux platforms. This role heavily involves 3rd-line support, handling escalated cases directed to the Linux team or submitted via email. These cases may include server issues, web platforms, or configuring an email server— essentially, advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving tasks.
Beyond web hosting and Linux administration, you’ll also play a key role in setting up new systems for Abion's clients and contributing to technical discussions during the sales process. Working alongside the sales team, you'll ensure clients choose the right tools for their needs.
You’ll join a collaborative and supportive IT team consisting of both IT Technicians and Linux Technicians. While your primary focus will be Linux, you’ll also be expected to assist with Windows-related issues if needed, reflecting the team-first attitude.
Additionally, Abion operates an on-call IT service, which you may be included in after approximately six months.
Your primary responsibilities:
Linux administration and support for Abion’s clients.
Troubleshooting at the 3rd-line level.
Support the sales team and other departments at Abion with your expertise.

About you
To succeed in the role as Linux System Engineer at Abion, you should have a humble attitude and see yourself as a problem solver. Strong service-mindedness and flexibility are essential, as is comfort working with Linux as an operating system.
You should also have experience handling 3rd-line issues and basic knowledge of Windows servers. Experience with DNS/SSL certificates is a valuable bonus. We are interested in both more junior and senior candidates.
Key requirements for the role:
Professional experience in Linux administration.
Professional experience in web hosting (Apache, PHP, FTP, NodeJS).
Scripting knowledge (BASH, Perl, PHP, or Python).
Basic knowledge of Windows servers.
Fluency in English and preferably also Swedish, both spoken and written.

Desirable skills:
Knowledge and management of DNS/SSL certificates.
Email Security (DKIM, SPF, or DMARC).

What Abion offers
Abion is in a scale up phase, offering you the chance to join them on an international journey. Their strategy includes both organic growth and growth through acquisitions, making for an exciting and dynamic work environment. They also provide excellent benefits, a competitive salary, and opportunities to work abroad at one of their European offices.
Practical details:
Start date: As agreed upon.
Scope: Full-time, 100% + scheduled on-call shifts.
Location: Gothenburg.
Salary: Fixed monthly salary.

Experience selling to universities, hospitals, healthcare institutions or other public-sector organizations.

About Ex Change Parts
Ex-Change Parts AB operates within the global aviation industry and specializes in helicopter support, including the sale, exchange and related services for helicopter parts and components. The company has over 26 years of industry experience and serves more than 2,000 customers worldwide.
Ex-Change Parts has a strong position within the international helicopter aftermarket and works with customers across both commercial and military aviation. The company works with several helicopter models, including the Super Puma family and smaller helicopter models.
 About the Role
As a Sales Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing sales within your assigned markets and building strong, lasting relationships with both existing and prospective customers. You will have an international focus and work closely with customers to understand their needs, identify new business opportunities and provide the right solutions.
The role includes a high volume of quotations, customer follow ups and orders, as well as close collaboration with internal teams. You will also prepare and conduct customer meetings and represent the company at trade shows and other industry events.
Responsibilities and Tasks

Develop and maintain relationships with existing and new customers.

Identify customer needs, new business opportunities and customer needs.

Manage quotations, follow up with customers and handle orders throughout the sales process.

Prepare and present products and solutions to customers.

Analyze customer and market data to support pricing and sales decisions.

Work closely with internal teams to ensure the right products and solutions are offered.

Travel internationally for customer meetings and trade shows.

Your Experience and Skills
We are looking for a driven salesperson with experience in B2B or technical sales. Experience from the aviation industry, preferably within helicopters, is a strong advantage but not a requirement. A strong background in technical sales can also be a great fit for the role.
We see that you have:

Experience in B2B or technical sales.

Fluent Swedish and excellent English, both spoken and written.

Experience working with international customers.

A strong commercial mindset and a drive to achieve results.

The ability to understand and sell technically complex products.

Meritorious:

Experience working with aircraft or helicopter component sales.

Knowledge of the aviation industry.

Understanding of FAA and EASA certification of parts.

As a person, you are driven, positive and comfortable meeting and communicating with different types of people. You enjoy working towards clear goals and are motivated by achieving results together with your team. You are curious, flexible and comfortable taking responsibility for your work.

We Offer
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well established company operating in the international aviation market. You will become part of an international company where you get the opportunity to develop your skills, build a global network and have a direct impact on the business.
You will work in an entrepreneurial environment with short paths to decision making, a high level of responsibility and a team that is driven, customer focused and enjoys working together.

Working together in the Application team, you will specialize in programming and digital image processing, used in our software to automatically detect, and classify cells and other objects in blood and body fluids. Develop and maintain backend services for coordinating access to databases and connecting labs, using C++ and SQL.
Develop algorithms within digital imaging using C++ and Python.
Develop and maintain existing products within Product care.
Perform troubleshooting and testing as part of the quality work.
Conduct investigations and research tasks.
Review designs, reports, and source code contributions from colleagues.
Participate in cross-functional demos and forums as team representative.
Mentor more junior colleagues.

M.Sc. in Engineering within an appropriate field.
Extensive experience in programming skills in C++ or C#.
Experience in machine learning is a bonus.
Very good ability to understand the overall architecture and design of large software systems.
Very good ability to take initiatives and come up with new proposals for working methods as well a strong sense of responsibility.
Very good at evaluating and solving problems.
Very good English communication skills, verbal and written.
Experience in product development involving electronics, mechanics, and software.

As a key member of the team, you will play an integral role in shaping and implementing these initiatives, contributing to the continued development and efficiency of the treasury function.

Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
We are seeking a post doc for a research project focused on understanding biodiversity in managed boreal forests. The project is part of a larger SLU research initiative (the Key Performance Indicator Project) where several researchers, postdocs and PhDs are currently involved, which opens opportunities for collaboration. 
This post doc will focus on issues that concern biodiversity conservation in managed forests by analysing species and structure data from a large-scale field survey conducted in both Sweden and Finland. The research will focus on lichens and polypore fungi, using HMSC modeling to learn how their biodiversity varies based on local forest management and landscape variables. The post doc will work at the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies in Umeå and become a part of a strong research environment focusing on restoration ecology, through empirical studies and large-scale field experiments (see https://www.slu.se/en/departments/wildlife-fish-environmental-studies/research/research-areas/restoration-ecology/). The postdoc will collaborate with the Department of Ecology, the department of Forest Ecology and Management, and the Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) in Finland. 
About the position
The post doc will analyse data from the field survey with the aim of gaining a better understanding of factors controlling species diversity in relation to forest management. They are also expected to write scientific publications together with the research group.
Your profile
The applicant should hold a PhD in ecology (or in a similar relevant subject). As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates obtained a doctoral degree within the last three years. Experience from relevant research questions (Bayesian modeling, Species distribution modeling, terrestrial ecology, nature conservation in forests, landscape ecology, conservation strategies) is a merit. Experience from statistical analyses of large data sets is considered a merit along with a strong publication record (in relation to the time since the doctoral degree). The applicant is expected to be able to take own initiative and work independently and in a group. Excellent skills in written and oral communication in English are required.   
About us
At the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies we offer a creative and stimulating environment and perform internationally recognised basic and applied research, education and environmental monitoring in the areas of biodiversity restoration and conservation, fish biology, wildlife ecology and zoonosis. The department has a large proportion of international employees and well established national and international cooperation which gives opportunities for fruitful exchange. 
For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/department-of-wildlife-fish-and-environmental-studies/
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer – Innovative Wind Propulsion Technology
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Oceanbird

Are you a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning technical designs into practical solutions? Would you like to contribute to innovative technology that is helping transform the global shipping industry?
Briljantin Consulting is currently looking for a Mechanical Engineer for our client Oceanbird.
Oceanbird is developing innovative wind propulsion technology with the ambition to reduce emissions from commercial shipping. The company is a joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, combining extensive industrial experience with pioneering engineering solutions.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Oceanbird's Customer Projects team, where you will play an important role in adapting and delivering mechanical solutions for customer-specific installations.
You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements and mechanical design to manufacturing, installation and commissioning. The role offers a combination of technical engineering, practical problem-solving and collaboration with international customers, suppliers and shipyards.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and adapt mechanical designs for customer-specific projects and installations.

Translate customer and vessel requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Produce and review 3D models, manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, calculations and documentation.

Manage mechanical interfaces between Oceanbird's technology, vessels and shipyard structures.

Participate in design reviews, risk assessments and technical investigations.

Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners regarding quality, cost and delivery.

Provide technical support during installation, commissioning and testing.

Contribute to continuous improvements, standardization and engineering best practices.

Ensure compliance with relevant marine regulations, classification requirements and internal processes.

Key and mandatory skills
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical field.

Experience in mechanical design, product development or project engineering.

Good knowledge of 3D CAD software and experience producing manufacturing drawings.

Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for technical deliverables.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Desired skills
It is considered an advantage if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

Maritime, offshore, heavy machinery or renewable energy industries.

Ship structures, vessel integration or marine installations.

Hydraulic systems, rotating machinery or large mechanical structures.

Marine classification rules and regulatory requirements.

Installation, commissioning and testing of mechanical equipment.

Working with international suppliers, shipyards or customers.

About you
We are looking for a collaborative, structured and solution-oriented engineer with a genuine interest in mechanical engineering and technical development.
You enjoy taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions to complex engineering challenges. You are comfortable working across different technical disciplines and understand the importance of balancing technical performance with quality, project timelines and cost requirements.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with colleagues, customers and external partners.
Above all, you are motivated by seeing your engineering work become part of real-world installations.
Location and travel
The position is based at Oceanbird's office in Flemingsberg, Stockholm.
As the role supports international customer projects, you should be willing and able to travel to shipyards, customer sites and installation locations. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on project requirements.
Why join Oceanbird?
At Oceanbird, you will have the opportunity to work with pioneering wind propulsion technology that contributes to the decarbonization of the shipping industry.
You will become part of a highly competent and dedicated team, working in an innovative and international environment where engineering expertise, collaboration and practical execution are key.
This is an opportunity to follow technical solutions from initial engineering through installation and operation, while contributing to a more sustainable future for global shipping.
Does this sound like you?
Then we look forward to receiving your application!
For more information about the position, please contact Briljantin Consulting.
We review applications continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

jobs.occupation: Research and Development Engineer in Techno-Economic Assessment
jobs.employer_name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Are you driven, analytical and eager to make a change and drive development? Join RISE Processum and work on research projects to develop the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry.
RISE is a gathering of forces for the sustainable transition that business, society, and the world need. We work with the solutions that can make a difference here and now, and with the areas of knowledge and techniques that can be crucial tomorrow.
About us At RISE Processum, we are developing the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry. Through chemistry and biotechnology, we seek to maximize resource efficiency and sustainability in the utilization of society's residual streams for new fossil-free products in food, feed, chemicals, materials and fuel. Within our cluster activities, guidance in techno-economic assessment to both large and small companies in the bioeconomy is a crucial step in the development of new sustainable and competitive concepts.
Our projects range from shorter assignments to larger national and international research projects, often in collaboration with colleagues from RISE's various areas of expertise. You will be part of the Innovationssystem group within Processum, consisting of 10 colleagues.
About the role In collaboration with a team of experts in biotechnology, chemistry, process simulations, business development and technoeconomic assessments, you will develop new research and development projects from idea to finished results. You will conduct contract research to support industry in developing roadmaps for expanding or transitioning existing businesses into competitive and sustainable new market offerings. A substantial part of the role involves developing tools and knowledge through publicly funded collaborative projects, as well as contributing to the development of internal TEA activities at RISE.
You will identify customer needs and build strong customer relationships and develop new business opportunities. This includes securing project funding, preparing funding applications, and contributing to sales and contract-based projects.
The location is Örnsköldsvik. We follow a hybrid work model that allows employees to split their working time between the office and their home workspace. The role includes travel in connection with international projects, such as attending project meetings, events, and conferences.
Who are you? To be successful in the role you are analytical, structured and self-driven. You are motivated by developing projects to create value together with colleagues and partners. You are good at building relationships and with your interest in technology from a societal perspective, you identify needs and turn them into action. You have a strong interest in project management and communication of results.
Requirements for the role
• A Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, preferably in Biotechnology or Chemistry
• Experience from working in or closely linked to bioeconomy related industries
• Experience in performing value chain analyses at different levels and techno-economic assessment, preferably on biobased processes
• Experience with process simulations tools
• Project management experience within research and development
• You speak and write fluently in Swedish or English
Are we a good match? At Processum, you will work close to one of Europe’s leading technology infrastructures for the bioeconomy and contribute to strengthening RISE’s capabilities in scale-up, testing and demonstration. You will work with a wide variety of concepts and value chains in an international and dynamic environment, with colleagues representing many different nationalities. At RISE, we like different things and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge and skills for the future.
Welcome with your application! If this sounds exciting and you want to know more, please contact Johan Börjesson, Director of Innovation Systems, johan.borjesson@ri.se, +46 738 032 315. The application deadline is December 2. Selection and interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Apply with CV and questionnaire (no cover letter needed).
Our union representatives are Frida Sandberg (+46 10 516 67 79) and Veronica Benavente (+46 76 935 86 32) for Unionen and Johanna Källman, +46 10 516 60 10 for Saco.

Swedish language skills

Perido are looking for a Treasury analyst for our client in Stockholm. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring accurate and reliable cash flow forecasts across large-scale projects. As a Treasury Analyst, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing the project cash flow forecasting process from start to finish. You will gather information from multiple project teams and workstreams, analyse payment schedules and contractual terms, and translate these into reliable cash flow forecasts. The role involves maintaining and developing forecasting models, conducting scenario analyses and following up on payment milestones and financial commitments.
You will collaborate with stakeholders across different functions, ensuring that relevant information is collected, validated and documented. This includes understanding project payment cycles, such as payment certifications, invoice processing and advance payments, as well as identifying potential discrepancies or risks that may affect cash flow projections.
Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is structured, analytical and confident in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. You have the ability to build relationships across different functions and obtain the information needed to produce accurate forecasts, even when working with incomplete or unstructured data. You are proactive, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities in a fast-paced and complex environment. Furthermore, you have strong organisational skills and can manage several parallel workstreams and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

At least a B.Sc. in Accounting, Finance or Business

Demonstrated experience in cash forecasting, payment scheduling, or financial planning within a project environment

Ability to interpret contract structures and understand how payment terms translate into cash timing

Embedded C Developer – Transmission 
Mpya Sci & Tech is a company built by engineers – for engineers. We’ve created a workplace where you, as an employee, are always at the center. In everything we do, we strive for a high level of involvement and responsiveness to our employees' thoughts about their future roles and careers. Together, we are building a strong, inclusive, curious, and open-minded culture that offers great opportunities for our team members. We want you to work on assignments that you are passionate about, grow professionally, and maintain a healthy work–life balance.
 About the role
As an Embedded C Developer, you will play a key role in developing the transmission control software for future electric propulsion solutions. You will work on the full software lifecycle of the transmission control unit (TCU), from specifying and designing the architecture to implementation, verification, integration and testing in C. You will also develop test frameworks. We can offer you challenges that are both fun and exciting.
You will work on software that brings the driveline to life. This includes gear shift and clutch control functions, actuator control for solenoids, valves and electric motors, and sensor handling for speed, position, pressure and temperature. The software platform covers MCU low-level drivers, device drivers for all connected peripherals, and CAN and Ethernet communication stacks. It also covers RTOS configuration, the diagnostic event manager and ECU power management. On top of this, you will help improve how we work, our development tools and our continuous integration framework.

…who wants to grow as a professional and brings an open mind and a proactive approach. You have strong drive and creativity, and you come up with ideas and solutions all the way from system design to verification. You understand how software and mechanics work together in a transmission and enjoy solving problems where timing, control and hardware meet. You like working in a team but are just as comfortable working on your own.

B.Sc./M.Sc. in Embedded Software, Electronics, Mechatronics, Physics or equivalent education.
At least five years of experience in embedded software development and real-time systems programming.
Strong skills in embedded C for safety-critical real-time systems.
Experience developing software for transmission, driveline or propulsion systems, for example TCU, gearbox, clutch or e-axle control.
Skills in embedded software architecture, design and verification.
Skilled in Python and Git.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

It is a merit if you have experience with:
Shift strategies, torque control, clutch control or control engineering in general.
ISO 26262 (functional safety) 
AUTOSAR.
Tools such as the Lauterbach TRACE32 debugger, oscilloscopes, CANoe/CANalyzer and Robot Framework.
Electronics and actuator control (PWM, current control, solenoids).
Software development for Volvo Powertrain or another transmission supplier, which will be highly valued.

You are open-minded, proactive and structured, and you have the drive to take the lead.

Be Dedicated
Be Brave and Curious
Be Inclusive and Allowing

You have real influence over your assignments and your career development, with a good balance between work and life.

jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Engineer – Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description:
Do you want to own procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a commercially sharp engineer who wants to master the technology in depth and grow into a skilled procurement professional – in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.
What will you do at NYAB? 
As our Technical Procurement Engineer, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, driving procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. You get real responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side as you grow into the full scope of the role.
Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions.
In this role, you will: 
Own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.

Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.

Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.

Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable-energy projects and make our supply-chain more resilient.

Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver.

You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does – and spotting opportunities for optimization.

About you
You are strongly goal-oriented, a self-starter with plenty of grit and a natural talent for making things happen. You bring commercial instinct, sound judgment and a genuine hunger to learn – both the technology and the art of dealmaking. For you, speed and precision go hand in hand: you take ownership of your commitments and willingly go the extra mile when it matters – while building trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners along the way.
 We believe you have: 
A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems – recently graduated or planned graduation in 2027.

Previous experience from procurement, engineering, project work, construction, energy or another technically oriented environment. 

A strong interest in sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations.

Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad.

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience from sourcing, supplier contacts or commercial work.

Knowledge of solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.

Why work at NYAB? 
NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it.
Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise.
You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow.
We also offer:

Comprehensive health assessments 

Generous wellness allowance  -

Parental pay supplement

Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)

A secure pension plan 

 
Ready to make it happen?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and academic records. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.

Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.

Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong sense of responsibility and confidentiality.
Excellent planning and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Comfortable working in customer-facing environments and taking part in technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

Expert proficiency in C# and .NET Framework/.NET platform development
Experience with C++ development is an added advantage.
Expertise in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript
Strong hands-on experience developing Windows desktop applications using WPF, Experience building rich client applications.
Strong hands-on experience with WCF, REST APIs, Web Services, Inter-Process Communication and Message-based communication framework
Strong knowledge of Multithreading, Asynchronous Programming, Process and Thread Synchronization, Performance Tuning and Optimization
Experience working with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and architecture patterns (Microservices, SOA, Distributed System Architecture)
Experience developing Application Domains (AppDomain), Cross-process communication, Native and managed code interaction, System-level and kernel-level API interaction.
Experience with SQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/Data Modeling/ Query Optimization / Database Performance Tunning
Experience with File Handling, Serialization / Deserialization techniques
Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
Proficiency with GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, AI coding assistants, and intelligent code generation tools.
Hands on with working with static code analysis and security analysis tools, and software maintainability practices.
Effective communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written is needed to effectively collaborate in global environment.

Are you a System Developer who enjoys turning business needs into smart, reliable solutions? At FM Mattsson, you’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to develop and improve business-critical systems, with a particular focus on our ERP platform, Infor M3.
 
The role
 
Digitalisation plays an important role in how FM Mattsson continues to evolve. Our systems and digital solutions are designed to support our operations and help us work more efficiently. As a System Developer, you will join our Digitalisation team and collaborate with teams across the organisation to turn business needs and ideas into effective technical solutions. Your role will span development, integrations and problem-solving, with a particular focus on our ERP system, M3. 
In this role, you will:
Develop, customise and maintain internal applications and solutions within M3 and our wider system landscape.
Develop and maintain integrations between M3 and other systems.
Design technical solutions and help establish shared technical standards and best practices.
Develop, test and quality-assure solutions, as well as troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Contribute to and lead development and digitalisation initiatives.
Collaborate with teams across the organisation, internal specialists and external partners, and coordinate external M3 consultants when needed.
Help improve processes and ways of working across the organisation.

 
What we’re looking for
 
We’re looking for someone who enjoys using technology to solve real business challenges and is eager to understand what users and the organisation actually need. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. As you’ll work with people across different parts of the organisation, strong communication and collaboration skills are important. 
We’re looking for someone with:
A university degree in software development, systems design or a related field.
Experience in software development and programming, preferably with Java, JavaScript and Angular or similar technologies.
Experience working with ERP systems or other business-critical systems.
A good understanding of databases, integrations and system architecture.
The ability to understand business needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

It is an advantage if you also have experience in:
Infor M3.
Integrations and automation.
The manufacturing industry.
AI-assisted software development or the use of AI tools in development.

Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
 
Employment type: Permanent position
 
Location: Mora, Sweden, or Odense, Denmark

About FM Mattsson Group
 
FM Mattsson Group develops, manufactures and sells taps and related products under the well-established brands FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, Aqualla and Bristan. Our vision is to be our customers’ first choice for bathrooms, kitchens and related areas. Our core values guide how we work together and how we engage with the world around us:
The customer comes first
We win together
I step forward

In 2025, FM Mattsson Group generated revenue of approximately SEK 2.0 billion and employed around 560 people across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the Benelux region, the UK, Germany and Italy. jobs.occupation: Product Cost Specialist to Axis Communications
jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist.
About the role
Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.
Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.
This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.
Work tasks
Be responsible for analyzing, negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.

The position will mean some travels abroad.
We are looking for
A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
2-5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience, preferably from international manufacturing companies.
Experience working with RFQs, cost breakdowns, and supplier negotiations.
Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
Advanced Excel skills and good MS Office skills.
Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.
Other information
Start: As soon as possible.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: Lund, and some international travel may be required.
About the assignment: You will be employed by Academic Work on a consulting assignment until the end of September 2027. If both parties are satisfied with the collaboration, there is a  possibility of being hired directly by Axis thereafter.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

jobs.occupation: Global PV Risk Minimization Physician  Injectable Aesthetics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Global PV Risk Minimization Physician to join our Global Pharmacovigilance organisation within Injectable Aesthetics.
This is an influential global role for a physician with deep expertise in medical device vigilance, risk management, and post-marketing safety. You will provide medical and scientific leadership across Galderma's portfolio of injectable aesthetic medical devices, helping ensure that patient safety and benefit-risk considerations remain at the centre of product lifecycle management and strategic decision-making.
Working in a highly collaborative international environment, you will partner with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams. Together, you will shape safety strategies, guide regulatory interactions, and contribute to decisions that impact healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.
This is a unique opportunity to combine scientific expertise, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership in one of the most innovative and rapidly evolving areas of dermatology.
 
Your mission
As Global PV Risk Minimization Physician, you will provide medical leadership for post-marketing safety and risk management activities across Galderma's Injectable Aesthetics medical device portfolio.
You will play a key role in shaping global safety strategies, leading benefit-risk evaluations, and driving initiatives that support the safe use of our products throughout their lifecycle. Working in close partnership with colleagues across Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Commercial teams, you will contribute scientific expertise that informs critical business and regulatory decisions.

In this role, you will:
·      Lead medical assessments of safety data, emerging signals, and benefit-risk profiles.
·      Drive risk minimisation strategies and support their implementation globally.
·      Provide expert input into regulatory submissions, safety reports, and product labelling.
·      Support interactions with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and Notified Bodies.
·      Contribute to safety governance and cross-functional decision-making.
·      Strengthen inspection readiness and support a culture of compliance, patient safety, and continuous improvement.
·      Act as a trusted scientific partner across the organisation and help shape the future of Injectable Aesthetics at Galderma.
 
Your profile 
You are a physician with a passion for patient safety and a strong scientific mindset. Drawing on extensive experience in medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities, you combine deep medical expertise with the ability to navigate complex global environments and build strong partnerships across functions, cultures, and geographies.
You are comfortable translating complex scientific data into clear recommendations and practical actions, influencing stakeholders at different levels, and balancing strategic thinking with operational execution. With strong scientific judgement, a collaborative approach, and high ethical standards, you thrive in a dynamic international environment where patient safety, quality, and compliance are at the centre of decision-making.
 
What you'll bring:
Medical Doctor (MD) qualification.
10-15 years of relevant experience within global medical device safety, vigilance, risk management, or related post-marketing activities.
Strong knowledge of benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, safety surveillance, and risk minimization.
Solid understanding of global medical device regulations and vigilance requirements.
Experience interacting with Health Authorities, Competent Authorities, and/or Notified Bodies.
Knowledge of epidemiology, statistics, and safety data evaluation.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex safety data and translate insights into action.
Proven ability to lead initiatives and influence stakeholders within a global matrix organization.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively across functions and cultures.
A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

 
Additional qualifications in Clinical Pharmacology, Drug Safety, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines are considered an advantage.
 
Location and information 
This position is based on-site in Uppsala, Sweden. 
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Looking for travelling Service Technician - Stockholm Region
jobs.description:
We are currently seeking a traveling Service Technician who would like to become part of our Nordic service team! 
In this role, you will be based from your home and travel daily to customer sites using a company service vehicle. Your assignments will be centrally planned by service coordinators at the headquarters in Stockholm. Your primary work area will be the Stockholm Region, although assignments in other parts of the Nordic region can occur as well. 
You will be part of a team and report to the Team Leader within Mettler Toledo's Product Inspection and Transport & Logistics segments. 
This means that your customers will primarily be found within the food industry, pharma, manufacturing sector, and transportation and logistics industry. The products you will work with are related to inspection, measurement, and weighing processes. The overall purpose of your role is to ensure that our products are installed, calibrated, and maintained correctly. 
Customer communication and documentation of completed work are important parts of the role. Onboarding and continuous training are also included. 
Key Responsibilities:
Installation, troubleshooting, repairs, calibration, and preventive maintenance of Mettler Toledo products and instruments 
Administration within the CRM system 
Ensuring a high level of customer service 
Active collaboration with colleagues such as service technicians, planners, and sales representatives 
Participation in training sessions and meetings organized by Mettler Toledo 
Contributing to and upholding Mettler Toledo's corporate values and code of conduct

What You Need to Succeed
To succeed in this role, you are curious, service-minded, and technically inclined. 
You are solution-oriented, flexible, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and quality, you consistently deliver effective solutions and excellent service. 
Qualifications: 
Technical background in electrical engineering, automation, or mechanics 
Experience troubleshooting technical equipment and strong knowledge of electronics 
General IT proficiency, including experience working with PCs and Microsoft Office 
Well-organized, service-oriented, positive, and flexible regarding working hours and travel 
Valid Category B driver's license and enjoys being on the road

Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Our Offer to You
In addition to great colleagues and a varied, meaningful job, we offer excellent development opportunities and regular training courses. Service training is typically conducted in Switzerland and Germany, and on-the-job training alongside experienced colleagues is also provided regularly.

Company car
