Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Senior Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining automated production systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving PLCs, robots, and other automated equipment, supporting both new production line installations and ongoing process improvements. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with cloud platforms to enable traceability, analysis, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production.  

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead automation system integration during equipment commissioning (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop the automation systems that are to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on process control.  
Code review and test of suppliers work within the projects to validate specified functionality and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor. 
Develop and maintain automation programming standards 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Masters Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with sensors, instrumentation, servo drives and motion technology. 
Experience with PLC, SCADA, vision systems and CCD cameras and software, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens and/or Beckhoff systems. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols and network architecture including design of control systems architecture and PLC code delivering the desired system functionality. 
Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, UML, Test Cases, Test Records). 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.  
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

Turn digital marketing into growth for our clients
Clients come to us with a simple question: how do we grow? In this role, you help them answer it across paid, performance and growth marketing, by leading the work that sets the direction and gets it moving. You also shape what Comprend offers, so our solutions stay relevant as the channels and tools change.
The role
You’ll work with digital marketing at Comprend, alongside colleagues across disciplines. You lead workstreams and projects for clients, and you make sure the quality of what we deliver is high and the numbers are right. Sometimes you lead an assignment from start to finish. Other times you drive one phase and hand over to colleagues. You’re a trusted advisor to clients and colleagues, and your advice rests on deep expertise.
Your impact goes beyond your own assignments. You develop how we talk about and sell our performance and growth marketing offering, and you help others apply the standard you set.
What you’ll do:

Lead and drive paid, performance and growth marketing workstreams and projects for our clients.

Build and grow senior client relationships that create long-term value for clients and for us.

Develop the narrative and go-to-market approach for our performance and growth marketing solutions, and help the offering grow commercially.

Bring AI-supported methods and tools into our digital marketing work to improve efficiency, quality and client value.

Work across disciplines to deliver integrated, insight-driven solutions, and share knowledge across the organisation.

Stay ahead of shifts in the digital landscape and turn them into practical improvements for clients and for us.

What good looks like

Our performance and growth marketing solutions are known, inside and outside Comprend, for quality and results.

Delivery is consistently accurate and of high quality, which leads to satisfied clients and repeat business.

You contribute visibly to knowledge sharing, business development and offering development.

You help strengthen our culture and ways of working through inclusive, value-driven behaviours.

Who you are
You know performance marketing and digital growth strategy in depth, and you turn that into advice that clients and colleagues can act on. You take accountability for outcomes, balance autonomy with alignment to shared goals, and lead complex work without needing formal personnel responsibility.
To succeed in this role, you bring:

Deep expertise in performance marketing and digital growth strategy, across the full range of paid and performance channels.

Experience of developing and commercialising digital marketing offerings or solutions.

The ability to build and maintain senior client relationships that create long-term value.

A strong track record of leading complex workstreams or projects without formal personnel responsibility.

Clear, adaptable communication, with the skill to turn complex insights into client-ready recommendations.

Experience of using AI-supported tools or methods.

Professional Swedish and English.

Working at Comprend
Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge, and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We’d prefer you to be based in our office in Stockholm, but we’re open to discussing a position in Malmö. We offer a competitive employment package.
About Comprend
Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication, driving transformative impact. We’re 250+ specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland, Poland, and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. We’re a proud part of Aura, a consultancy group with seven specialist agencies and 550+ people.

jobs.employer_name: Newsec Property Asset Management Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Newsec – the Full Service Property House in Northern Europe – offers property owners, investors, and tenants a broad range of services in Property Asset Management and Advisory. The company was founded in 1994 and is now partner-owned, with approximately 2,000 employees across all seven Nordic and Baltic countries. Newsec has approximately SEK 600 billion in assets under management, signs leases covering approximately  1,000,000 square metres annually, completes transactions worth approximately SEK 50 billion, and values properties with an underlying value of approximately SEK 1,750 billion. We strive to build a strong sense of team spirit and are proud to have high employee satisfaction and a workforce comprising both experienced experts and young talent. In the annual independent employee survey “Great Place to Work,” Newsec has been ranked as one of Sweden’s best workplaces since 2010. www.newsec.se
About the Role
Would you like to help shape a modern Nordic data platform at a company making a major investment in data and analytics? As a Data Engineer at Newsec, you will play an active role in building and managing our enterprise-wide data platform, powered by Microsoft Fabric and the Azure ecosystem. This role is ideal for a junior to mid-level engineer looking to grow alongside an experienced team while working with cutting-edge Lakehouse technology.
Working closely with Data Architects, BI Developers, and business stakeholders, you will build reliable, scalable data flows supporting analytics, self-service BI, and data-driven services across the Nordics and Baltics.
Your Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and data models in Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse).

Perform SQL-based development, continuous optimization, quality assurance, and monitoring of data pipelines.

Enable self-service BI and analytical workloads through clean, well-structured data foundation layers.

Collaborate on shared engineering practices: documentation, code reviews, version control, and platform security.

Depending on your experience, you will own clearly defined deliverables or larger components of the platform, with structured mentorship from senior colleagues.
Your Skills and Experience
To succeed in this role, you have a relevant academic background (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience. You possess a solid foundation in data engineering concepts and are eager to work with modern SaaS data platforms.
We are looking for:

Core Engineering Foundation: Good proficiency in SQL and a strong understanding of relational database principles, data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling), and data integration (ETL/ELT).

Modern Platform Familiarity: Hands-on experience or genuine project exposure to Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse) or modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Power BI, Databricks).

Development Practices: Understanding version control (Git), automated workflows/CI-CD basics, and core data quality principles.

Programming Exposure: Familiarity with Python or PySpark for data transformation and scripting is a plus.

Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; proficiency in Swedish or another Nordic language is a strong advantage.

The role can be tailored to your level of experience—whether you have gained these skills through university projects, internships, or 1–3 years of hands-on professional experience.
Personal Qualities

Curious & Eager to Learn: You enjoy exploring new technologies (especially inside the rapidly evolving Microsoft Fabric ecosystem) and continuously refining your technical toolkit.

Structured & Quality-Focused: You take pride in writing clean SQL/code, building reliable data flows, and documenting your work for team maintainability.

Collaborative Communicator: You enjoy working in a team environment, actively sharing knowledge, asking for guidance when needed, and communicating technical ideas clearly to both peers and non-technical stakeholders.

Proactive Problem-Solver: You take ownership of your assignments, troubleshoot logically, and look for practical ways to improve platform performance and data quality.

Please feel free to contact Nilesh Agrawal at nilesh.agrawal@newsec.com or +46790621280 if you have any questions about the role.
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible!

Why this role
Want to build and improve an industrial process, hands-on? At Supernormal Greens, we’re building the journey from harvested plants to finished botanical ingredients. Now we’re looking for an engineer who wants to understand that process inside out and make it work better.
Our post-harvest process covers washing, cryogenic freezing, frozen storage, freeze-drying, milling and packing. You’ll join while we’re developing and commissioning it, with plenty to test, understand and improve.
Your job is easy to describe: help the process deliver more, with the right quality and a stable operation. You’ll work closely with production, maintenance, quality and R&D, and have a real say in the equipment and ways of working.

What you will do
Get to know the process. Understand how each step works, where we lose capacity or yield, and what could run better. 

Test your ideas. Plan trials, use the data and check which changes actually improve performance. 

Work close to the equipment. Team up with operators and technicians to solve problems and find their root causes. 

Help bring new equipment into production. Work with suppliers on requirements, factory and site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT), installation and commissioning. 

Make improvements last. Put instructions, documentation and maintenance requirements in place as equipment moves into stable production. 

Share what you learn. Develop standard ways of working, support operator training and work with maintenance on preventive and operator maintenance.

Post-harvest is your main focus. You’ll also work with our Cultivation Technology Specialist and occasionally help with other technical projects.
Priorities are agreed with your manager.

What you will bring (must-haves)
A relevant engineering degree or equivalent competence gained through experience. 

A few years of technical experience close to industrial production, with examples of problems solved or improvements delivered. 

The ability to use data and trials to investigate problems and evaluate results. 

A structured, practical approach and the ability to move work forward together with colleagues. 

Good spoken and written English for supplier and team collaboration and technical documentation. Swedish is an advantage.

Bonus (nice-to-haves)
Experience with freezing, freeze-drying, milling or packing, preferably in food or process manufacturing. 

Involvement in equipment installation, commissioning or production ramp-up. 

Experience working with suppliers, root cause analysis, standard work or maintenance development.

Your growth guide
Meet Gustav Edberg, our Chief Production Officer and your manager. Gustav is down-to-earth, listens carefully and cares about the people he works with. He also expects you to take ownership and follow through. Manufacturing excellence is very much his thing.
He joined us in November 2025, bringing experience in process improvement and factory development from Tetra Pak and across industries by consulting at EFESO Nordics. Together, you’ll agree priorities and follow up on progress.
Some other facts
Full time in Tibro, Sweden, normally 07:00–16:00. Primarily on site, with some remote flexibility when tasks allow. Some supplier travel and busier periods during commissioning may occur.
Permanent employment with an initial probationary period. We have a collective bargaining agreement through Livsmedelsföretagen, including occupational pension and insurance under the applicable terms, plus an annual wellness allowance of SEK 3,000.
We interview as applications come in and aim to fill the role as soon as possible, with a start date agreed together. If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d like to hear from you.
About Supernormal Greens
We are everything but normal. Research and industrial production work side by side in our 7,000 m² vertical farming facility. By controlling the cultivation environment, we develop plants and botanical ingredients for applications including cosmetics and nutraceuticals. You will work with new process technology and follow your solutions from trials into production.

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Role
As a Senior Sysadmin at Univrses, you will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring that our entire engineering organization has the stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure it needs to thrive.
In this role, you will work closely with the CTO to design and maintain a company-wide infrastructure that is both resilient and secure. You will oversee the cross-functional systems that support all our research, development, and production environments. We are looking for a proactive professional to manage our cloud footprint and on-premise resources, ensuring our team of world-class engineers can work without friction.
This is a on-site position since you will be responsible of our on premise infrastructure.
Responsibilities
Strategic Infrastructure Support: implement long-term infrastructure roadmaps that prioritize company-wide stability and data security.

Core Systems Oversight: Design, deploy, and maintain robust server environments (both AWS and on-premise) that support multiple project teams.

System Reliability & Uptime: Proactively monitor system health and performance across the organization to ensure high availability for all internal and external services.

Resource Governance: Manage global resource allocation (databases, storage, compute).

Security & Access Control: Implement and enforce company-wide security.

Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain rigorous backup strategies and recovery procedures to protect company data and intellectual property.

Who you are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.

Maintenance Pro: Proven track record in patch management, software distribution, and maintaining system integrity across a fleet of machines.

Linux Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).

Networking Specialist: Strong understanding of networking architecture.

Cloud & Containers: Proven experience managing AWS environments and containerized applications using Docker.

Reliability Mindset: A "security-first" and "stability-first" approach to managing infrastructure, with the communication skills to report directly to technical leadership.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

Monitoring Stacks: Experience setting up company-wide monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.

Storage Solutions: Experience managing large-scale data storage (S3, NAS, Artifactory).

What’s in it for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Next Steps
If you are a systems-oriented thinker who enjoys building stable environments and working at a strategic level to support a high-performing engineering culture, please submit your resume and a cover letter in English!

The opportunity
Are you passionate about engineering and problem-solving? Do you have as a goal to become a technical expert? This is an opportunity to be an important part of making our technical knowledge accessible for the organization, hence you will have close collaboration with our technology department.
We’re seeking a Breaker Application Specialist to join our Technical Application team. In this role, you’ll provide technical guidance for our sales, projects, and design teams. You will join the design department at HV Breakers who work with products from 52 to 1200 kV.  We currently have 350 employees and are growing to meet market demands. One key area is our eco-friendly product, EconiQ. We are a fast-paced company that encourages you to take the initiative and be innovative.
“At Breakers, our people and the teams are the key to our success! We´re looking for a team player that can contribute with both technical expertise and great collaboration skills. If you’re ready to work together, share ideas, and achieve common goals, we want to hear from you!” – Sara Lingegård, Project Engineering Manager at HV Breakers
How you´ll make an impact
You will collaborate with other departments to find the most suitable product for the application and propose product improvements to make the product even better for the customer.
Writing detailed technical reports for customer orders, reviewing technical data, and analysing reports and drawings.
The technical discussions will take you to customers around the world to find out the best solutions for their applications.
Participation in international technical committees can be a part of the job if you want to share your valuable experiences with customers and competitors for a better world.
You will collaborate with our global technical community to build and increase our technical knowledge and expertise; you do this by leading courses and training externally and internally.

Your background 
You have a degree in Electrical power engineering and/or relevant work experience with High Voltage (52-1200 kV) breakers.
You have a strong technical interest.
You are a team player with good communication skills.
You anticipate needs and take responsibility for problem-solving.
You maintain good structure and can handle prioritization between tasks.
Proficient knowledge in English. Swedish is considered a plus. 

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

About Comsys
Comsys AB is a Swedish cleantech company based in Lund, developing advanced solutions for power quality and energy efficiency. Our products help industries and critical infrastructure use electricity more reliably and efficiently, addressing complex challenges such as harmonics, resonance, flicker and load imbalance.
At the heart of our technology is our patented Active Dynamic Filtering (ADF) technology. With more than 20 years of experience and customers in over 50 countries, Comsys is continuously pushing the boundaries of power electronics and developing high-performance solutions for demanding industrial applications.
At Comsys, engineering is at the core of what we do. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment, collaborating across disciplines such as software, electronics, FPGA and systems engineering to turn complex technology into robust, high-performance products.
https://comsys.se
Do you enjoy writing software that interacts closely with hardware – and seeing your code become part of real, high-performance products?
We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our R&D team in Lund. This is an opportunity to work hands-on with embedded C/C++, Embedded Linux, RTOS, networking and low-level software, in close collaboration with experienced hardware, FPGA and system engineers.
You will be part of the development of advanced industrial products where reliability, performance and robust software matter.
The Role
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle – from software architecture and low-level implementation to integration, verification and release.
You will work close to the hardware and collaborate daily with software, hardware, FPGA and system engineers. The role offers a mix of hands-on development, problem solving, debugging and system-level thinking.

Your responsibilities will include:

Develop low-level software and embedded system components

Work with Embedded Linux and RTOS in resource-constrained and performance-critical systems

Develop and integrate networking functionality in embedded systems

Build, customize and maintain embedded Linux

Collaborate closely with hardware, FPGA and system engineers during development and integration

Debug complex software/hardware issues and troubleshoot at system level

Contribute to automated testing, development tools and continuous improvement of software processes

About You
We are looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding how things work all the way down to the system level. You are comfortable working close to hardware and are motivated by solving complex technical problems. At the same time, you are passionate about agile development and helping the team become better, and enjoy combining technical depth with an interest in Scrum, methodology and team development.
You likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience

Professional experience in embedded software development

Strong programming skills in C and C++

Experience with Embedded Linux and/or RTOS

Experience with low-level programming, embedded networking and debugging

Experience developing secure embedded software and applying cybersecurity requirements in accordance with IEC 62443

A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach to problem solving

Good communication skills in English

It's a Plus If You Have

Experience with Rust in embedded or systems programming

FPGA development experience

Experience developing automated tests or automated test systems

Experience with CI/CD, continuous integration or software quality processes

Experience working with industrial, power electronics, control systems or other hardware-near applications

Why Join Us?
At Comsys, you won't be developing software in isolation. You will work at the intersection of software, electronics, FPGA and system engineering, contributing to products that solve real industrial challenges.
You will have the opportunity to take ownership, work across the technology stack and develop your expertise in embedded systems, Linux, real-time software and hardware integration.
If you are an Embedded Software Engineer who enjoys C/C++, Linux, RTOS, low-level development and working close to hardware, we'd like to hear from you.
In this recruitment process, we are partnering with Radeptus. For any questions regarding the position, please contact Jenny Månsson at +46 703 318 506 or via email at jenny@adeptus.se. Please submit your application here (link).

We are looking for an experienced Site Quality Manager for a construction and installation project.
This is a consulting assignment. The location is Kiruna, Sweden.
The position is full-time.
The assignment involves close collaboration with the client, requiring a high degree of flexibility and strong collaboration skills.
The Assignment
As Site Quality Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and following up quality management activities at site. The role includes ensuring that quality processes, inspections, documentation, and corrective actions are carried out in accordance with the contract and agreed project procedures.
Your responsibilities will include:

Establishing and maintaining project-specific Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for site activities and ensuring compliance with contractual requirements.

Following up the quality inspection process and ensuring that responsible supervisors and installation teams perform their own inspections and basic inspections according to agreed plans and procedures.

Coordinating third-party inspections, including NDT inspections, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken when deviations are identified.

Coordinating and arranging inspections together with the client, including witness points and hold points as specified in the contract.

Participating in weekly and site meetings and reporting on quality management progress across the different site areas.

Using Dalux for documentation management and quality tracking.

Organising and following up activities according to the project's daily management model.

Identifying and managing deviations and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

Performing root cause analysis and implementing actions to minimise the risk of recurring non-conformities.

Preparing and delivering quality documentation and reports to the client as agreed.

Ensuring that subcontractors understand and comply with the project's quality management requirements.

Introducing and reviewing scope-specific ITPs together with responsible supervisors, foremen, and subcontractors.

Managing the handover documentation process and ensuring that required documentation is collected and submitted to the client correctly and on time.

Collaborating with the Project Manager and the wider project team regarding quality and risk management.

Coaching and supporting site management, installation teams, and subcontractors in quality-related matters.

Organising site meetings and reporting on quality activities and progress.

Requirements
We are looking for a candidate with relevant education and professional experience suitable for the role.
You should have relevant experience in areas such as:

Quality management and quality follow-up in construction and/or installation projects.

Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

Quality inspections and inspection processes.

Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and deviation management.

Root cause analysis.

Third-party inspections and NDT inspections.

Witness points and hold points.

Quality management and follow-up of subcontractors.

Handover documentation and document management.

Quality and risk management.

Digital quality and documentation management systems, preferably Dalux.

Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

You are structured, quality-focused, and communicative, with the ability to coordinate quality activities between several stakeholders. You are comfortable working closely with project management, site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and the client.
If this assignment sounds interesting and matches your experience, we look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Centio’s overall goal is to be a consulting company that provides smart and sustainable solutions that contribute positively to the development of society.

Our team consists of dedicated professionals who are passionate about contributing to the development of society. We work in small teams where you have the opportunity to contribute your own experience while also benefiting from the knowledge and expertise of others.

Be part of Clavister's journey to secure the digital world. We are looking for a Product Owner with the leadership, product thinking and technical judgement to lead a cross-functional Java team responsible for authentication, identity management and digital signing products.
Working closely with the Product Manager, you will contribute to the vision and roadmap for our IAM portfolio, own the backlog and guide delivery across Product, Engineering, Architecture and Security.

About Clavister Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.

The role This role combines product ownership, people leadership and engineering delivery. Creating focus, developing people and building an effective team are more important than being an IAM specialist.
You should be comfortable in the IAM domain and able to discuss Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem, architecture, integrations, quality and engineering trade-offs. The portfolio includes established on-premises products with multiple supported versions and SaaS offerings, requiring sound judgement when balancing development and technical debt.

Key responsibilities

Lead and develop a cross-functional Java team, with responsibility for people leadership, competence development, team effectiveness and delivery practices, including feedback and professional development.

Contribute customer, delivery and team perspectives to the Product Manager's vision and roadmap.

Own and prioritise the backlog based on product direction, customer needs, security requirements and capacity.

Translate roadmap objectives into clear outcomes, requirements and acceptance criteria.

Collaborate with engineers, architects and IAM specialists on system design, APIs, integrations and architecture.

Balance new capabilities and technical debt with cybersecurity, privacy, quality, usability, scalability and maintainability.

Drive delivery from refinement and planning through development, automated testing and operational follow-up.

Promote modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, observability, code review and test automation.

Recruit, coach and mentor team members and foster trust, learning and knowledge sharing.

Coordinate dependencies, risks and expectations across Product, Technology, Architecture, Security and other stakeholders.

What success looks like in this role
The team has clear priorities and ownership, delivers secure and maintainable products with predictable quality and flow, and grows through collaborative decision-making and a healthy engineering culture.

To thrive in this role we believe you have

Experience leading and developing commercial software product teams, with focus on people, performance, collaboration and delivery.

Experience with product ownership, backlog management and agile software delivery.

A hands-on background in software engineering or architecture and enough technical understanding to engage confidently with Java developers and architects.

Experience with Java or a comparable enterprise backend ecosystem.

Experience collaborating with Product Managers and stakeholders on product discovery, priorities, vision and roadmap.

Comfort working in IAM and curiosity to learn authentication, identity and signing concepts.

Knowledge of secure software development, privacy and vulnerability management.

Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, problem-solving and change leadership skills.

Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Extra points for

Experience in IAM, authentication, digital identity or electronic signing.

Familiarity with IAM integrations, APIs, federation, identity lifecycle processes or trust services.

Experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar agile facilitation role.

What we offer

Meaningful work in a European cybersecurity company where IAM is a key part of zero-trust security.

The opportunity to lead a skilled Java team delivering authentication, identity and signing products.

A collaborative and inclusive environment across Product, Technology and Security.

Professional development, training and leadership growth opportunities.

Flexible working arrangements, a supportive team culture, competitive salary and benefits.

Join us If you enjoy leading people, creating product clarity and bringing stakeholders together around effective delivery, we would like to hear from you.
We review applications and interview qualified candidates continuously.

Senior Project Engineer – Control & Protection Software, Se-quence & Interlocking HVDC
The opportunity
Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. We develop interlocking principles, automated switching sequences, operating states, and the conditions that determine when a station is ready to perform a specific action. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.
As HVDC technology continues to evolve, so do the challenges. New technologies, new customer requirements, and new ways of operating power systems continuously shape how we work. Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.
This is not a role for someone looking to simply execute predefined tasks. It is a role for you who want to understand how things work, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the future of HVDC technology.
“As managers, our goal is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work while continuing to develop their skills and expertise. We strongly believe in open technical discussions, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and a psychologically safe environment where questions, feedback, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value every person's voice and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.” Andrew Carruthers & Richard Palm, Hiring Managers
How you'll make an impact
Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Transform system and customer requirements into robust operational logic and engineering solutions.
Work closely with system design, control, protection, testing, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Take technical ownership of specific functions, systems, or project areas.
Verify and validate solutions through testing, troubleshooting, and system integration activities.
Support commissioning activities and experience how your engineering decisions perform in the real world.
Drive technical discussions both internally and with customers.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers while contributing to the development of our team's technical capability.
Contribute to future methods, tools, and technical solutions within Sequence & Interlocking.

Your background
We care more about technical capability and your personal skills than matching every item on a checklist. You likely have:
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience working with complex technical systems.
Experience in HVDC, FACTS, substation automation, protection and control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or similar fields.
Experience with commissioning, protection systems, relay applications, operational sequencing, or HVDC projects is highly valued.
Strong analytical skills and an ability to understand interactions across multiple systems and disciplines.
The confidence to challenge assumptions and contribute to technical discussions.
A structured approach and a curios mindset to engineering and problem solving.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
Professional communication skills in English.

Collective agreement

Klarna, briefly
Klarna is a global digital bank and payments network. As of our Q1 2026 results: 119 million active consumers, over a million merchants, 26 markets, 3.4 million transactions a day. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

About the role
Being an engineer at Klarna means building and owning the systems that move money for millions of people — and that responsibility doesn't end when those systems ship. Your team and your focus can also change as the business changes, and the domain you join may look different in a year. Either way, this stays a hands-on role: you're still writing code, still making architecture calls, still in the codebase, and your influence comes from the quality of that work and the engineers you work most closely with. 
We are searching for someone who brings expertise that changes what we are capable of. You've built something we haven't. You've gone deep somewhere we haven't been yet. The engineers here are strong; what they don't have is your specific experience, and that's exactly the gap we're hiring into.

What you'll do
Make sound, defensible technical decisions, and be able to say clearly what you decided against and why.

Think past your own contribution: how it fits the wider architecture, where failures propagate, what breaks first under load, and who feels it downstream.

Tie technical choices to business outcomes and size the solution to the problem's actual value - including when the right answer is something small.

Design for the constraints that come with being a regulated bank - reliability, auditability, controls - and treat them as part of the engineering problem rather than an obstacle to it.

Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across teams. You act as a multiplier and elevate the people and teams around you, not just your own output.

Set the standard for how your domain uses AI in everyday practice - not as a demo, as a working method.

Who you are
You bring a capability Klarna doesn't have today. Your experience doesn't just improve what's already there - it unlocks something new entirely.

You have built and operated systems with real reliability and performance demands at scale, a plus if in Java, JavaScript, or Python environments.

You make trade-offs and can articulate the roads not taken.

You optimize for business outcomes over engineering elegance, and you know the difference between right-sizing and gold-plating.

You explain complex systems clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

You lead through your work, not your title. 

You're comfortable with ambiguity and can move an initiative forward across several teams without formal authority over any of them.

You have scar tissue and you talk about it - the incident, the design that didn't survive contact with production, what you changed afterwards. 

Things you should know before applying
Working together: We value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.

Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.

Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

This is a general Lead Engineer opening, not tied to one fixed team. Depending on need at the time of hiring, you could be placed in one of several domains. A domain is a group of teams working on a related set of problems — for example, everything to do with risk, or everything to do with checkout.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

About the Role
ManoMotion is looking for a highly skilled Computer Vision Engineer to develop robust, high-performance vision solutions for real-world applications.
Our AI Engineers manage the day-to-day work related to neural-network architecture, training, testing, and data management. This role will work closely with them while focusing more deeply on the complete computer-vision system.
You will combine machine learning with advanced image analysis, detection, tracking, geometry, filtering, and algorithmic methods to improve the accuracy, stability, latency, and reliability of our products.
We are looking for someone who understands that a production-ready vision solution often requires more than a neural network. You should be able to identify model limitations and build additional processing, tracking, filtering, calibration, and decision logic around the AI models to achieve a reliable final product.
You will also take technical ownership of customer solutions, from understanding requirements and designing the system to implementation, deployment, and validation.
Responsibilities
Design complete computer-vision solutions combining AI/ML, image processing, tracking, geometry, and rule-based algorithms.

Develop algorithms for image analysis, object detection, segmentation, motion analysis, pose estimation, and tracking.

Build pre-processing and post-processing layers around AI models to improve accuracy, stability, and robustness.

Analyse failure cases and determine whether they should be addressed through model improvements, additional data, tracking, filtering, image processing, or system-level logic.

Work closely with AI Engineers responsible for model architecture, training, testing, and datasets.

Integrate trained models into reliable, real-time computer-vision systems.

Optimize vision pipelines for latency, frame rate, memory usage, and edge hardware.

Take end-to-end technical ownership of customer solutions and integrations.

Participate in customer meetings, technical workshops, demonstrations, and on-site validation.

Build maintainable, testable, and production-quality software.

Use modern AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and other relevant tools to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Stay updated on advances in computer vision, machine learning, and AI-assisted software development.

Key Qualifications
Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.

At least 3 years of professional experience developing computer-vision or AI-based products.

Strong practical knowledge of image processing, object detection, segmentation, tracking, motion analysis, geometry, and camera systems.

Good understanding of deep learning, neural-network training, model evaluation, and data management.

Proven ability to combine machine-learning models with traditional computer-vision algorithms and system-level logic.

Strong programming skills in Python and experience with OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

Good knowledge of C++ and high-performance software development.

Experience deploying and optimizing models using technologies such as ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA, OpenVINO, or similar tools.

Experience developing real-time vision systems for edge devices or computationally constrained hardware.

Strong debugging, problem-solving, and software-engineering skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical solutions.

Excellent English communication skills and confidence interacting directly with customers.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with object tracking, temporal filtering, sensor fusion, or multi-camera systems.

Experience with camera calibration, 3D geometry, depth estimation, or pose estimation.

Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or other embedded GPU platforms.

Experience in industrial, robotics, automotive, safety, or human-machine interaction applications.

Experience working with challenging real-world conditions such as occlusion, poor lighting, motion blur, and changing environments.

Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms, MLOps, or model monitoring.

The Profile We Are Looking For
You are a strong problem-solver who enjoys turning advanced computer-vision technology into dependable products.
You understand AI models and training, but your main strength is designing the complete system around the model. When the neural network alone is not enough, you know how to add tracking, filtering, image processing, geometric reasoning, calibration, and decision logic to make the final product work reliably.
You are comfortable working across algorithms, software, hardware constraints, and customer requirements, and you take ownership of the overall result.

As an Mechanical, Thermal & Propulsion (MTP) Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the next generation of spacecraft propulsion systems at OHB Sweden. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial operators across Europe and worldwide.
OHB Sweden develops propulsion systems for a wide range of scientific, commercial, and Earth-observation missions. Our propulsion solutions enable orbit raising, station keeping, attitude control, collision avoidance, and end-of-life disposal for spacecraft operating in increasingly demanding mission environments.
The Propulsion Department is responsible for the complete lifecycle of OHB Sweden's propulsion products, including system design, analysis, testing, qualification, production support, and future technology development. The department plays a central role in enabling mission success and is a key contributor to OHB Sweden's long-term competitiveness in the rapidly evolving space industry.
As our propulsion business continues to grow, we are strengthening our engineering organization with a new multidisciplinary technical leadership role.
About the Role
As an MTP Systems Engineer, you will be the technical owner of complete propulsion subsystems from concept through qualification and production.
The role combines systems engineering with deep technical understanding of spacecraft propulsion, thermal control, and mechanical engineering. You will coordinate multidisciplinary development activities and ensure that all engineering disciplines work together to deliver an optimized subsystem.
You will lead the technical development of propulsion subsystems while coordinating a team of specialists within propulsion, thermal engineering, mechanical design, and structural analysis. Although these specialists provide the detailed engineering within their respective disciplines, you will be responsible for the overall technical solution and ensuring that all subsystem requirements are met.
You will work closely with customers, suppliers, project managers, and internal engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle.
As an MTP Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Technical ownership of spacecraft propulsion subsystems throughout the full development lifecycle.

Defining technical solutions together with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Coordinating activities across propulsion, mechanical, thermal, and structural engineering disciplines.

Leading technical trade studies and engineering decisions.

Ensuring subsystem performance, interfaces, requirements compliance, and technical consistency.

Driving system budgets including mass, pressure, thermal, structural, and performance.

Coordinating subsystem verification, qualification, and acceptance activities.

Supporting customer meetings, technical reviews, and proposal activities.

Working closely with project managers to balance technical performance, schedule, cost, and risk.

Mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance within the multidisciplinary team.

What We're Looking For
Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related engineering discipline.

At least 7 years of experience developing spacecraft or in-orbit propulsion systems.

Solid understanding of spacecraft mechanical design principles.

Strong understanding of spacecraft thermal control systems and thermal engineering.

Good understanding of spacecraft propulsion systems, including monopropellant hydrazine and bipropellant propulsion.

Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Experience coordinating complex technical developments across several engineering disciplines.

Strong systems thinking and excellent problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Fluency in English.

It is considered an advantage if you also have
Experience with electric propulsion systems.

Experience with propulsion system integration and verification.

Experience working with ESA or other institutional space programs.

Experience with spacecraft system engineering.

Experience supporting customer technical reviews and proposal work.

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to shape the future of OHB Sweden's propulsion systems.

A technically challenging role with significant influence on subsystem architecture and engineering decisions.

Involvement across the complete lifecycle of spacecraft propulsion systems.

Collaboration with highly skilled specialists across multiple engineering disciplines.

A supportive and innovative engineering environment with excellent opportunities for professional development.

The MTP Engineer reports to the Head of Propulsion and will work as the technical lead for multidisciplinary propulsion subsystem development.
Some travel may be required (typically 2–4 trips annually, primarily within Europe).
Join us and help develop the next generation of spacecraft propulsion systems.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Divisional Controller till Atlas Copco
jobs.description:
Do you want to broaden your business perspective, build an international network, and accelerate your development within Atlas Copco?
This is an opportunity to work at the center of the General Industry Division, supporting business performance while gaining valuable insight into how a global division operates. As Assistant Divisional Controller, you will work closely with divisional management and colleagues around the world, contributing to decisions that drive profitable growth and long-term success.
This role offers a unique combination of responsibility, learning, and exposure. Whether you already have experience in business controlling or come from another function with a strong interest in understanding the financial drivers of our business, this position provides an excellent platform for your next career step.
Your mission
As Assistant Divisional Controller, you will have a dual mission: to drive business performance today while building the skills, experience, and network that will prepare you for your next career step within Atlas Copco.
You will:
Support reporting, consolidation, forecasting, and month-end follow-up processes.

Provide financial reporting support to customer centers and product companies worldwide.

Turn financial data into actionable business insights.

Drive best-practice sharing across the division.

Become a key user of GPS and Power BI, supporting digitalization and AI-driven initiatives.

Conduct performance analyses and ad-hoc business studies at divisional level.

The position reports to Fredrik Storm, VP Business Control, General Industry Division.

Why this role?
This is more than a traditional controlling position. It is a unique opportunity to gain a broad understanding of our business and how a global division creates value.
You will collaborate with product companies, customer centers, R&D teams, application centers, and divisional management across the world. Along the way, you will build an extensive international network and gain exposure to a wide range of topics, from business performance and operational excellence to digitalization, strategic initiatives, and future growth opportunities.
The role is designed as a development opportunity and will evolve over time based on your abilities, interests, and ambitions. If you are eager to learn, take initiative, and grow professionally, you will find plenty of opportunities to do so.
Who are you?
You are curious, analytical, and proactive. You enjoy learning, taking ownership, and turning complex information into clear conclusions and recommendations.
You thrive in a collaborative environment, communicate effectively across cultures and functions, and are motivated by making a real impact on business performance. Most importantly, you bring a growth mindset and a willingness to challenge yourself through new experiences.
Requirements

University degree.

A few years of experience working experience, preferably within finance / business control.

Strong English communication skills, written and spoken.

Advanced Excel skills.

Meritorious experience:

ERP systems.

Business intelligence tools, particularly Power BI as well as AI.

An international industrial environment, logistics, operations or process/automation work.

Location
The position is based in Sickla/Nacka, Stockholm, providing access to an international and collaborative working environment.
Application
To apply, click the "Ansök nu" button, upload your CV, and answer a few short questions. Please note that we do not require a cover letter as part of this recruitment process.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to accept applications via email.
If you have any questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact our Recruitment Consultant/Consulting Manager Marie Källström by phone at +46 70 7519343 or via email at marie.kallstrom@jurek.se

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Senior Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, and maintaining automated production systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving PLCs, robots, and other automated equipment, supporting both new production line installations and ongoing process improvements. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with cloud platforms to enable traceability, analysis, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production.  

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead automation system integration during equipment commissioning (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop the automation systems that are to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on process control.  
Code review and test of suppliers work within the projects to validate specified functionality and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor. 
Develop and maintain automation programming standards 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Masters Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with sensors, instrumentation, servo drives and motion technology. 
Experience with PLC, SCADA, vision systems and CCD cameras and software, OPC connectivity and MES interfaces, especially using Siemens and/or Beckhoff systems. 
Experience with industrial communication protocols and network architecture including design of control systems architecture and PLC code delivering the desired system functionality. 
Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 
Experience in writing technical documentation (Requirement specifications, Functional design, UML, Test Cases, Test Records). 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.  
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

Columbus fortsätter att utveckla sin AI & Automation-förmåga och söker nu en Senior Applied AI Solution Architect som vill vara med och designa nästa generations AI-lösningar för enterprise-miljöer.
I den här rollen arbetar du i skärningspunkten mellan affär, arkitektur och realisering. Du är med och omsätter affärsbehov och use cases till robusta, säkra och integrerade AI-lösningar med tydlig koppling till verksamhetsprocesser, affärssystem och kundvärde.
Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera teknisk tyngd med verklig affärsrelevans
Arbetsuppgifter
I rollen som Senior Applied AI Solution Architect designar du hållbara och affärsnära AI‑lösningar baserat på affärsbehov, use cases och kundens miljö. Du är involverad tidigt i initiativ och omsätter idéer till tydlig lösningsarkitektur och realiserbar design.
Du definierar arkitekturmönster för moderna AI‑tillämpningar, såsom LLM‑baserade applikationer, RAG‑lösningar, agentiska upplägg och AI‑stödda arbetsflöden, samt utformar integrationsmönster mot affärssystem, API:er, externa tjänster och verksamhetsdata. I arbetet säkerställer du rätt nivå av säkerhet, identitet, governance och observability.
Rollen innefattar nära samarbete med kollegor inom Data, AI & Automation och ERP. Du bidrar även till utvecklingen av gemensamma arbetssätt, tekniska principer och kvalitetsnivåer inom Columbus AI & Automation‑erbjudande.
Kravprofil
Vi tror att du har

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att designa och realisera LLM‑baserade AI‑lösningar i enterprise‑miljöer, från tidig design till produktion.

Erfarenhet av moderna AI‑arkitekturmönster, såsom RAG‑lösningar och agentiska upplägg, inklusive context engineering, promptdesign, orkestrering och kvalitetssäkring.

God erfarenhet av integration av AI‑lösningar via API:er, connectors, skills, MCP eller motsvarande mönster mot affärssystem och verksamhetsdata.

God förståelse för säkerhet, identitet, access control, governance och ansvarstagande AI, samt hur detta omsätts i praktisk lösningsdesign i molnbaserade miljöer (gärna Microsoft/Azure).
Please Note - This position is located in Sweden and requires a valid working VISA and fluency in Swedish and English.

Ansökan och nästa steg
Hos oss ansöker du enkelt med din LinkedIn-profil eller ditt CV, utan att behöva fylla i långa frågeformulär. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev.
I vår rekryteringsprocess använder vi logik- och personlighetstester. Vi tar alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller erbjudande ges. Intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Daniel Sparrow.
Efter avslutad rekryteringsprocess skickar vi en fråga om din upplevelse som kandidat. Det tar bara någon sekund att besvara frågan och hjälper oss att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess.

Vilka är vi? Vi är ett team med BI-konsulter som levererar data- och AI-projekt inom Business Intelligence, AI och Machine Learning. Vi samarbetar nära med konsulter från andra affärsområden – Dynamics, M3 och Digital Commerce.
Varför? Vi vill hjälpa våra kunder att nå sina affärsmål och göra deras vardag mer effektiv! Målet är att säkerställa deras långsiktiga framgång och guida kunderna genom att vara deras Trusted Advisor. Vi samarbetar med kunderna för att optimera deras lösningar. 💫
Jobba på Columbus
Människorna kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.
Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.
Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.
Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together! ⭐
Vad andra säger om oss
Intresserad av Columbus bakom kulisserna? Varje vecka låter vi en kollega ta över vårt Instagram-konto. 
På Careereye kan nuvarande och tidigare medarbetare dela sina ofiltrerade omdömen om hur det är att arbeta hos oss. Klicka nedan för att läsa deras upplevelser.

We are now looking for a Quality Manager to join DEFA and take a leading role in quality, compliance and continuous improvement across our Norwegian operations. Working from our production facility in Nesbyen, you will be part of an international technology company with its own product development and manufacturing, serving customers within the automotive and energy sectors.

Drive and follow up quality activities within production processes and audits.

Lead and support deviation handling, root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Ensure effective handling of customer complaints and supplier quality issues.

Drive supplier quality activities, including supplier evaluations, audits and continuous improvement initiatives.

Ensure compliance with relevant standards, customer requirements and regulatory expectations.

Higher education in engineering, production/process engineering or a related field.

Relevant experience within quality, management systems or compliance in an industrial environment.

Experience with audits, supplier quality and continuous improvement work.

Experience from manufacturing, electronics, automotive or other quality-driven industrial environments.

Good communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language.

Who you are

A clear communicator who works well across functions and organizational levels.

The opportunity to influence quality performance and continuous improvement across our Norwegian operations.

Company description:
About Group Treasury
Group Treasury is responsible for providing efficient and effective financial infrastructure, capital management, capital structure, funding of Group operations, non-life insurance cover, pension debt related asset management, and external relationships within the financial area for the Volvo Group.
 
 
Job description: 
 
 
 About Market Operations 
 
 Market Operations is a team of nine colleagues within Group Treasury responsible for funding, liquidity management, foreign exchange management, and financial risk management across the Volvo Group.
  
 Our mission is to support the Group's global financing activities while actively managing and optimizing financial risks. We work in close cooperation with Volvo Financial Services, business areas, banks, investors, and internal stakeholders across the Group.
 As part of the team, you will gain exposure to:
  
  Global funding markets, both public and private
 Liquidity management across approximately 20 currencies
 Foreign exchange execution and hedging programs
 Interest rate and funding risk management
 Complex portfolio and risk management activities
 Treasury technology, analytics, and process development
  
 
 While everyone in the team has their own areas of expertise, we work closely together to support strategic decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and continuously strengthen the Treasury function.
 What You Will Do 
 
 As Portfolio Manager, you will play an important role in managing the Group's financial risk exposures and supporting treasury activities from both a strategic and operational perspective.
  
 Your responsibilities will include:
  
  Monitoring financial markets and assessing impacts on the Group's funding, liquidity, interest rate, and foreign exchange exposures
 Managing and analyzing treasury portfolios with a particular focus on risk management and hedging effectiveness
 Evaluating, designing, and executing hedging strategies to support the Group's financial risk management objectives
 Supporting funding, lending, liquidity management, and capital markets activities
 Performing quantitative analysis, scenario modelling, and performance follow-up of treasury portfolios
 Developing and enhancing risk measurement, monitoring, and reporting frameworks
 Identifying opportunities to automate processes and improve decision-making through data analytics
 Driving improvements in treasury systems, data flows, and digital solutions
 Building analytical tools, dashboards, and models to support portfolio management and risk analysis
 Collaborating with banks and other external counterparties in connection with financial transactions
 Participating in cross-functional projects within Treasury, Finance, and Volvo Group
  Who You Are 
 
 You have a strong interest in financial markets and enjoy understanding how financial risks can be measured, managed, and mitigated. 
  
 You are analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex problems. At the same time, you have an interest in technology and enjoy finding smarter ways of working through automation, data analysis, and system improvements.
  
 You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working and taking initiative when you identify opportunities for improvement.
  
 To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:
  
  A university degree or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
 A solid understanding of financial markets and financial risk management principles
 Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities
 Excellent problem-solving skills and a structured way of working
 The ability to communicate complex topics in a clear and practical manner
 Fluency in English, both written and spoken    
  
The following would be considered strong advantages:
  
  Experience with FX, interest rate, funding, or liquidity risk management
 Knowledge of derivatives and hedging strategies
 Programming skills in Python, SQL, VBA, or similar languages
 Experience with Power BI, data visualization, or analytical tools
 Interest in automation, digitalization, and treasury technology
 Experience working with large datasets and quantitative analysis
  What We Offer 
 
 We offer an opportunity to work at the center of the Volvo Group's financial activities in an international environment with significant exposure to global financial markets.
  
 You will join a highly collaborative team where you will have the opportunity to influence both risk management strategies and the continued development of treasury processes, systems, and analytical capabilities.
  
 We are particularly interested in candidates who combine a strong understanding of financial markets and risk management with a passion for technology, data, and continuous improvement.
  
 For more information please contact:
  
 Viktor Nerdal, Head of Market Operations, viktor.nerdal@volvo.com

jobs.occupation: Research assistant in empirical trade economics
jobs.description:
Department of Economics
We are seeking a temporary research assistant to boost our team and to contribute to an ongoing project focused on improving resilience in agricultural and food systems. The core of the project is to apply trade model estimation techniques to analyse the economic impact of disruptions due to adverse shocks. The overall goal of the project is to improve resilience in the food supply chain.
Duties
The https://www.slu.se/en/research/research-catalogue/grupper/m/environmental-economics/ – is seeking a research assistant on a temporary five-month contract to boost the research team. The successful applicant will contribute to the https://www.vr.se/english/swecris.html#/project/2024-01142_Formas, where the task is to estimate a gravity model of trade. The position offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in empirical trade analysis. Note that this is a 100 percent research position.
Qualifications
Successful applicants must hold a Master’s degree or PhD in economics, or expect to complete their PhD by January 2027. Candidates must have strong competence in regression analysis methods. Knowledge and experience in the following three areas are advantageous but not essential: (i) working with trade data or similar; (ii) international economics; (iii) environmental economics. The ability to work constructively in a small group is essential. Successful applicants are also expected to be self-motivated and driven, and able to work independently on (some aspects of) the project.
About us
At the Department of Economics, research and teaching are conducted in the subjects of economics and business studies. The department has master's and bachelor's programmes in economics, and a PhD programme. Priority areas in economics are 1) environment and natural resources and 2) agricultural economics. Read more about working at SLU on the following page: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Place of work
Uppsala
Form of employment
Temporary (“vikariat”), 5 months, with the possibility of extension.
Extent
100%
Starting date
By agreement, but ideally no later than February 2027.
Application
We welcome your application no later than 10 December 2026. Please apply using the button below.
The application must be written in English and contain: a cover letter describing yourself and how you match the project described above; a CV describing your education, publications and relevant work experience; the names and contact details of at least two referees.
