jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: Minimizing Spatial Averaging Uncertainty in Heat Pump Sound
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 

Job Description
Background & Objective
In heat pump sound power declarations under ISO 3741 (direct method) and EN 12102-1, spatial averaging uncertainty of sound pressure is the dominating contributor to overall measurement reproducibility. In Bosch’s reverberation test chamber (chamber volume approximately 250 cubic meters), low modal density below the Schroeder frequency (around 255 Hz) and discrete compressor tones sometimes cause high spatial variance across stationary microphones in low-to-mid frequency region (50 – 1500 Hz).
The primary objective of this Master thesis is to minimize spatial averaging uncertainty (in aforementioned frequency range) in said chamber by investigating and optimizing two complementary physical levers:
Active Diffusion (w. a rotating diffuser): Maximizing dynamic mode-mixing while preventing aerodynamic blade / structural self-noise and cyclic averaging errors.
Low-Frequency Modal Absorption: Increasing modal bandwidth to smooth out spatial variance while respecting ISO 3741 reverberation limits (T60 at least > what-standard-requires seconds)

Scope of Work
Diffuser Self-Noise vs. Speed Envelope: Map chamber background noise versus vane rotational speed (0 to 10 RPM, tip speed up to 2.0 m/s) to determine the safe operational limit where aerodynamic wind noise OR structural noise does not corrupt heat pump measurements.
Active Diffusion & Integration Time: Quantify spatial variance reduction for pure tones and compressor harmonics; validate the rule of averaging time to integer multiples of full vane revolutions.
Microphone Array Optimization: Determine the minimum number of stationary microphones (such as 6, 12, or higher) and required spacing (minimum distance greater than half wavelength) needed to reliably achieve Grade 1 precision accuracy.
Low-Frequency Absorption Assessment: Develop and validate targeted absorption and damping treatments to the chamber to increase the modal overlap at frequencies<315 Hz, while ensuring the chamber absorption satisfies ISO 3741 criteria.

Key Deliverables
Diffuser Operating Envelope & Self-Noise Guideline: Recommendations on vane RPM limits, tip speed thresholds, revolution-locked integration rules and self-noise-reducing measures.
Optimized Microphone Array Setup/Configuration: Quantified trade-off between active diffusion, absorption, and the required microphone count.
Low-Frequency Absorption Evaluation Report: Assessment of modal damping at f<315 Hz, on spatial standard deviation and chamber compliance.
Master’s Thesis Report & Defense Presentation: Academic thesis report and an internal presentation of practical laboratory recommendations.

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Enrolled in an M.Sc. program in Acoustics, Sound & Vibration, Mechanical Engineering, or Applied Physics.
Strong interest in hands-on acoustic laboratory testing, room acoustics, and experimental signal processing.
Basic experience with acoustic acquisition software (such as HEAD acoustics ArtemiS SUITE) and data scripting (MATLAB or Python) is a plus.
Good communication skills in English.

Additional Information
Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

Join us as a Senior Reliability Engineer and play a key role in ensuring the long-term performance and reliability of critical manufacturing assets.
The position is part of the local Maintenance & Reliability organisation in Uppsala and works cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance and other key stakeholders.
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will act as a key technical specialist on both operational and strategic levels, driving the development of a proactive, data-driven reliability and maintenance culture. You will also collaborate closely with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with corporate standards, best practices and long-term strategic objectives.
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and is motivated by turning analysis into action.
Make your mark. Grow with us. 
 
Your mission
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability and long-term performance of manufacturing systems and equipment across our operations.
Using data, engineering expertise and structured problem solving, you will identify improvement opportunities, assess equipment and asset lifecycles, and support decisions on maintenance strategies, upgrades and future investments.
In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise in reliability engineering and asset performance management, supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Through collaboration with local and global stakeholders, you will help shape maintenance practices, improve asset reliability and contribute to sustainable business performance.
This is a senior role that requires a high degree of ownership and initiative. You are comfortable working independently, building strong relationships across functions and driving improvements from idea through to implementation.
You will join a team of experienced engineers who play an important role in supporting operational excellence and the continued development of our Uppsala site.
 
Key Responsibilities
· Drive reliability engineering initiatives across manufacturing operations, systems and equipment.
· Lead and facilitate reliability assessments using methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA and FMECA.
· Analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement measurable reliability improvements.
· Develop and optimise preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset availability and reduce operational risk.
· Support asset lifecycle management and contribute to investment decisions through data-driven recommendations.
· Monitor and improve maintenance performance indicators (KPIs) and reliability metrics.
· Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Production, Automation, QA and Facilities to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
· Collaborate with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with company standards and strategic objectives.
· Promote a proactive, reliability-focused culture through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve operational performance
 
Your profile 
You are an experienced engineer with a background in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management within an industrial environment.
You are comfortable working with complex technical challenges and understand how to translate data into practical actions and long-term improvements. Equally important, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders and thrive in an environment where initiative and collaboration are valued.
 
What you'll bring
· A university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
· Minimum 5 years of experience within reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management in an industrial environment.
· Strong knowledge and practical experience of reliability methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA/FMECA and preventive maintenance optimisation.
· Proven ability to analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement sustainable reliability improvements.
· Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and maintenance performance indicators (KPIs).
· Strong knowledge of asset lifecycle management and maintenance strategies.
· Experience from a regulated manufacturing environment.
· Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
· Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage.
 
Location and other
This position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to submit their application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
 
With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
 
Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
 
We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
 
By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
 
Project Director at atNorth
 
Are you an experienced project leader who thrives on taking ownership of complex, large-scale construction projects?
 
We are looking for a Project Director to lead the delivery of one of our major data center projects in Sweden. In this key role, you will have end-to-end accountability from contract award through construction, commissioning and handover to Operations, ensuring the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the quality expected by atNorth and our customers.
 
You will lead the atNorth project organization and act as our senior delivery representative towards the general contractor, customer and key stakeholders. This is an opportunity to combine leadership, commercial expertise and project delivery while contributing directly to atNorth’s continued growth across the Nordics.
 
Key responsibilities
 
 
Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned project, delivering against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, HSE and Ready for Service (RFS) commitments.

 
Lead the atNorth project organization and build the right team and capabilities for each phase of delivery.

 
Participate in general contractor tendering, evaluation and contract negotiations, and take full accountability from contract award.

 
Manage the GC contract and protect atNorth’s commercial and contractual position, including variations, claims, costs and schedule impacts.

 
Own project cost, schedule and risk forecasting, proactively identifying deviations and escalating risks early.

 
Act as atNorth’s senior delivery interface towards the customer, managing technical requirements, design changes and acceptance.

 
Lead commissioning and integrated systems testing through to successful handover to Operations.

 
Drive a strong health, safety and quality culture, ensuring contracted standards are consistently met.

 
Lead, coach and develop project managers, leads and specialists across the project organization.

 
Ensure strong project governance, reporting, documentation and close-out, while capturing lessons learned to continuously improve future delivery.

 
 
Your profile
 
 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

 
10+ years of experience leading large-scale construction, infrastructure or mission-critical projects.

 
Proven experience of owner-side project delivery, ideally from contract award through construction, commissioning and operational handover.

 
Strong commercial and contractual experience, including contract administration, variations, claims and cost and schedule management.

 
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams, consultants and contractors in complex project environments.

 
Strong stakeholder and customer management skills, with the confidence to make decisions and communicate clearly in challenging situations.

 
Experience from data centers or other mission-critical environments is strongly preferred. Experience from energy, industrial or other complex infrastructure environments is also relevant.

 
Fluency in English is required. Swedish or another relevant local language is preferred.

 
Experience with Nordic construction standards such as ABT 06, or international standards such as FIDIC or NEC, is an advantage. Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is also highly valued.
 
About the atNorth Culture
 
We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.
At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
Welcome to apply!

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join us as a Layout Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in coordinating the overall design of our projects. You will leverage your strong CAD skills, preferably in NX, to create and manage 3D models that accurately reflect the combined input from various engineering disciplines. Your attention to detail and structured approach will ensure that all layout drawings meet project requirements and support customer planning for foundations, buildings, and utilities. Collaborating closely with project teams and customers, you will contribute to successful project execution while continuously learning and developing your knowledge of our products and engineering processes. This role is based in Finspång, and you will need to be present on-site, with some flexibility required for business travel to visit customers as needed.
 
How You’ll Make an Impact
 You will utilize your CAD expertise to create and manage detailed 3D models, ensuring alignment with mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.
 Collaborate effectively with project teams and customers to produce layout drawings that facilitate early-stage planning and site preparation activities.
 Maintain a structured approach to ensure that the layout remains aligned with project requirements throughout the lifecycle, adapting as necessary.
 Foster strong communication and collaboration within an international environment to prevent design clashes and ensure cohesive project execution.
 Contribute to building a long-term engineering support capability that enhances our Layout Engineering team in Finspång.
  
What You Bring
 A University degree in Mechanical Engineering.
 Several years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in gas turbines, power generation, or oil and gas sectors.
 Demonstrated expertise in 3D CAD modeling (Siemens NX preferred) and PLM systems (ideally Teamcenter).
 Strong technical skills in mechanical systems design, steel structure design, and project management.
 Advanced English proficiency for effective intercultural communication and collaboration.
 Attention to detail, structured working style, and excellent communication skills to engage with diverse teams and customers.
 Willingness to learn about our products and engineering processes, with flexibility for business travel as needed.
  
About the Team
The team currently consist of 12 engineers from different parts of the world and with different backgrounds.
 We help each other to build a strong technical knowledge within the team and take joint responsibility to reach our goals.
 Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
 We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Application

jobs.occupation: Husbils och husvagnstekniker till EW Fritid i Uppsala
jobs.description:
Husbils och husvagnstekniker till EW Fritid i Uppsala
En värmepanna som stannar, ett kylskåp som inte kyler eller solceller som ska monteras inför leverans. Som husbils- och husvagnstekniker hos oss arbetar du med systemen och utrustningen i bodelen på både husbilar och husvagnar. Nu söker vi en kollega till vår verkstad i Fyrislund.
EW Fritid säljer och servar husbilar och husvagnar. Vi är auktoriserad återförsäljare och verkstad för Kabe, Adria, Sun Living och Dethleffs. På vår anläggning i Uppsala finns också två försäljningshallar och en KAMA-butik. EW Fritid är en del av BosseBil, som bedriver verksamhet på flera anläggningar.
Ditt jobb i verkstaden
Serva och reparera husbilar och husvagnar, med fokus på bodelen.
Felsöka el-, gasol-, vatten- och värmesystem.
Reparera och byta komponenter och utrustning.
Montera tillbehör som solceller, markiser och antenner.
Gå igenom utfört arbete med kunden vid behov.

Du tar ansvar för dina jobb från felsökning till färdig reparation. När ett fel är svårt att hitta har du erfarna kollegor att bolla med.
Vem vi söker
Du gillar att lösa tekniska problem och arbetar metodiskt, även när det är mycket att göra. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, samarbetar bra med kollegor och kan förklara för kunden vad du har gjort.
Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av fordonsreparationer, el, elektronik, VVS eller annat praktiskt tekniskt arbete. Erfarenhet av husbilar eller husvagnar är meriterande.
B-körkort är ett krav.
Arbetstid och anställningsvillkor
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med arbete på vardagar enligt schema.
Lönen sätts utifrån erfarenhet och kompetens. Vi använder Motorbranschavtalet som riktmärke för lön och övriga anställningsvillkor.
Tjänsten klassificeras enligt SSYK 2012 som 7231 – Motorfordonsmekaniker och fordonsreparatörer.

Genom vårt försäkringsavtal med Fora omfattas anställda arbetare av Avtalspension SAF-LO, avtalsgruppsjukförsäkring (AGS), tjänstegrupplivförsäkring (TGL) och trygghetsförsäkring vid arbetsskada (TFA).
Ansökan

Motorhome and Caravan Technician at EW Fritid in Uppsala, Sweden
We’re looking for a technician to join our workshop in Fyrislund, Uppsala. EW Fritid sells and services motorhomes and caravans and is an authorised dealer and workshop for Kabe, Adria, Sun Living and Dethleffs. Our Uppsala site also includes two vehicle showrooms and a KAMA accessories shop. EW Fritid is part of BosseBil, which operates at several locations.
The role
You’ll service and repair equipment and systems in the living areas of motorhomes and caravans. The work includes troubleshooting electrical, LPG, water and heating systems, replacing components and fitting accessories such as solar panels, awnings and antennas.
You’ll take responsibility for jobs from diagnosis to completion and explain the work to customers when needed. Experienced colleagues are available to help with more complex faults.
Who we’re looking for
You enjoy solving technical problems, work methodically and are comfortable working independently as well as part of a team.
Experience in vehicle repair, electrical or electronic systems, plumbing or another practical technical trade is welcome. Experience with motorhomes or caravans is an advantage.
A valid Category B driving licence is required.
Employment terms
This is a permanent, full-time position with scheduled weekday working hours.
Pay is based on experience and qualifications. We use the Swedish motor industry agreement (Motorbranschavtalet) as a benchmark for pay and other employment terms. 
The position is classified as SSYK 7231 – Motor Vehicle Mechanics and Vehicle Repairers.

Through our insurance agreement with Fora, employees classified as workers are covered by the SAF-LO occupational pension scheme, AGS group sickness insurance, TGL group life insurance and TFA occupational injury insurance.
How to apply
Email your CV and a short cover letter in Swedish or English to jesper.skyten@ewfritid.se by 18 December 2026.
Applications from all countries are welcome. We review applications as they come in and may hold interviews before the deadline.
If you have questions about the role, contact Jesper Skytén, Aftersales Manager, at the same email address.

Nordic Product Manager International & Customs, Nordic Parcel Product Management
Make cross-border journeys work better and turn product ideas into measurable results. As Nordic Product Manager International & Customs, you will manage and develop international services and customs-related services for both import and export. This is a role for a commercially minded product professional who connects customer needs with operational reality, challenges established approaches and brings people together to turn approved priorities into delivery.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
PostNord offers a flexible hybrid workplace in an unpretentious, collaborative environment where colleagues support each other in reaching shared goals. Independent leadership and professional development are encouraged. Benefits include:
A Nordic and flexible working environment, based at PostNord´s offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen.
Great development and career opportunities.
Good insurance and occupational pension terms.
For Stockholm-based employees, a wellness allowance and access to Arken´s gym and indoor swimming pool.
Employee benefits through PostNord Plus, PostNord´s own personnel foundation.
Employment conditions under collective agreements.

Your Responsibilities
Nordic Parcel Product Management develops PostNord’s Nordic parcel portfolio, turning customer and operational needs into product priorities and solutions.
You translate portfolio direction into product proposals, business cases, requirements and actionable plans, driving assigned initiatives across countries and functions to improve customer experience, revenue, cost efficiency and profitable growth.
Reporting to the Manager Solutions Area B2B & International, who owns portfolio strategy, roadmap priorities, resources and lifecycle decisions, you lead product development and implementation within agreed scope and mandate.
Product scope and development: Develop roadmap proposals, improvements, service logic, requirements and acceptance criteria for international and customs-related import and export services, based on customer journeys, market insights, operational needs and country requirements.
Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate Operations, IT, Legal, customs experts, Customer Service, Commercial and country teams to ensure workable import/export flows, data requirements and operational feasibility. Lead through collaboration, including agreed contributions from the Product Specialist Customs/Export, without line-management responsibility. Legal and customs experts retain regulatory interpretation and validation responsibilities.
Business cases and decisions: Work with Finance, Pricing, Analytics, Operations, IT and countries to assess customer value, revenue, costs, feasibility, risks and implementation needs. Present recommendations and secure decisions through your manager and relevant forums.
Implementation and launch: Lead approved development initiatives, launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs, coordinating requirements, milestones, dependencies, operational readiness, rollout and post-launch follow-up. Collaborate with Strategic Pricing on pricing readiness and VP/CX on commercial readiness, customer materials and activation. The Product Specialist Customs/Export maintains detailed specifications, documentation, product master data and setup.
Performance and follow-up: Monitor assumptions and actual outcomes, recommend improvements and communicate progress, risks and readiness. Escalate matters affecting portfolio priorities, budgets, resources or launch decisions, with clear recommendations on unresolved trade-offs.

The Bigger Picture
At PostNord, the role turns international product priorities into practical improvements across import and export journeys. Working across Nordic markets and functions, you combine commercial thinking with hands-on delivery and measurable customer and business impact.
Our Expectations
Relevant experience in product management, cross-border services, business development or complex implementation work in a cross-functional environment.
Understanding of international parcel flows, import and export journeys, customs-related service requirements and how customer experience, operations, systems, revenue and cost connect.
A commercially oriented and analytical product mindset, turning data and insight into product proposals, business cases, requirements and delivery plans.
Strong execution skills to lead initiatives from an approved business case through implementation and follow-up, create structure, address dependencies and keep delivery moving.
Strong stakeholder management skills to align specialists, functions and countries around shared outcomes, take ownership within your mandate and know when to seek a decision.
University degree, college degree or equivalent higher education qualification.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.

The successful candidate works in line with PostNord’s principles: Accountable-owning assigned product deliverables, business cases, execution and follow-up; Brave-challenging assumptions, highlighting risks and trade-offs and presenting clear recommendations; and Committed-aligning stakeholders and following through from customer need to implementation and measurable outcomes.
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. They are recruitment specialists in unbiased and competence based recruitment, which creates diversity and innovation in teams and contribute to a sustainable employment market. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

jobs.occupation: Vi söker Teknikinformatörer för Flight- & underhållsmanualer!
jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.  

Din roll

Som Teknikinformatör fungerar du som länken mellan utvecklare och slutanvändare, där du omsätter komplex teknisk information till tydligt, strukturerat och användaranpassat innehåll.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar att:
Ta fram samt genomföra revisioner på teknisk dokumentation i form av flightmanualer för GlobalEye-systemet.
Samla in, analysera och kvalitetssäkra teknisk information från olika källor och intressenter.
Utforma pedagogiskt innehåll med hjälp av text och bild för att göra komplex teknik lättillgänglig och användarvänlig.

I rollen kommer du arbeta i nära samarbete med både kollegor och externa samarbetspartners. Du kommer bland annat att stötta kollegor inom språk, struktur och pedagogiskt skrivande. Samtidigt kommer du att spela en viktig roll i arbetet med att utveckla och effektivisera arbetssätt, metoder och processer inom teknikinformation.
Du blir en del av organisationen Technical Information inom avdelningen Special Mission & Regional Aircraft (SMRA). SMRA levererar ett brett utbud av tjänster och integrerade supportlösningar till kunder inom försvar och på kommersiell marknad för kostnadseffektiv support av system och plattformar under hela livscykeln
Hos oss får du arbeta i ett kompetent och sammansvetsat team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och arbetsglädje värderas högt. Vi erbjuder en utvecklande miljö med goda möjligheter att växa och ta nästa steg i din karriär. Du har möjlighet att utgå från vårt kontor i Linköping eller Nyköping.
 

Din profil

Som person är du analytisk och har lätt för att se samband, samtidigt som du värdesätter kvalitet och har ett öga för detaljer. Du trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor och samarbetar effektivt med olika parter genom att kommunicera tydligt och sätta dig in i andras perspektiv.

Du tar eget ansvar och driver arbete framåt där du på ett lösningsorienterat sätt hittar vägar framåt, även när förutsättningarna förändras eller inte är helt tydliga. Du söker aktivt den information du behöver och trivs i en dynamisk miljö där du får kombinera struktur, engagemang och flexibilitet.
Vi ser att du har:
Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis flygteknik, kognitionsvetenskap eller ingenjörsområdet - alternativt flera års erfarenhet av arbete med teknisk information
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa produkter eller tekniska tjänster där struktur, noggrannhet och systemförståelse är avgörande
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande:
Erfarenhet av pilotyrket
Erfarenhet av arbete med teknisk dokumentation enligt etablerade standarder, exempelvis S1000D eller iSpec2200
Erfarenhet av arbete med taggning i XML eller SGML.
Erfarenhet av Simplified Technical English (STE)
Tidigare arbete med komplexa system inom försvars- eller flygindustrin

 
Vi söker både seniora och juniora profiler till vårt team. Kanske har du mångårig erfarenhet av teknisk dokumentation eller en bakgrund från operativ verksamhet som pilot. Eller så är du i början av din karriär och vill utvecklas inom ett spännande och tekniskt komplext område!
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

 Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. 
Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. 
Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här. 
Om du är intresserad av vilka förmåner som du kan ta del av som anställd på Saab i Sverige, kan du läsa om dem här
Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

As Project Procurement Manager, you will secure offshore and onshore installation services from the market for complex cable projects. This is an opportunity to work with subcontracting, sourcing and project procurement in an international environment where your work supports the reliable energy transmission.   Coordinate subcontracts for complex cable installation projects As a Project Procurement Manager, you will be responsible for subcontracting activities in projects, with a focus on safe and cost-effective offshore and onshore installation services.  Coordinate procurement activities with projects, stakeholders and legal colleagues 
 Manage commercial and contractual discussions with suppliers 
 Review scope, technical requirements and project time plans 
 Support quality, cost and delivery expectations in project procurement 
  
 This position offers a hybrid set-up, and includes regular domestic and international travel. You will be part of the Procurement team and report to the Director of Project Procurement.

 Experience in project procurement and complex subcontracting

 Skilled in commercial and contractual supplier negotiations

In this role, you will work close to our projects and suppliers to secure installation services that are essential for delivering reliable cable solutions,” says Hiring Manager, Martin Lilja.   Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!   We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 11th of December . Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Director of Data & AI
This role reports to the Chief Product Officer (CPO).

Remote within Sweden

Some travel, under about ten days a quarter 
Every business aviation trip starts with someone needing to be somewhere. Thousands of brokers and operators use Avinode to turn that need into a flight, and every request, quote, and booking they make is a signal nobody else holds. 
Data has been a key product and strategy differentiator in the software industry for years. In the AI era, the importance of clean, timely, and accurate data only accelerates. AI drives efficiency for our customers and our business, but unless it is powered by a solid data foundation, its convincing conclusions risk taking us in the wrong direction, faster. 
Data & AI is a company-wide concern, but to create focus and accountability on the foundations that serve the rest of the company and the product, we are bringing the necessary competencies – starting with data product management, engineering, and analytics – together as one team. This role is about leading that team, and we're looking for real depth in the space, not just general leadership.

What you’ll do

You’ll ensure the delivery of governed data products built around Databricks and its suite of tools.

You’ll make sure entities and metrics have a single agreed-upon human- and agentreadable meaning regardless of their source.

You’ll put models and governed, evaluated agents into production, with accuracy and cost you can prove.

You’ll lead a team consisting of a product manager, analysts, and an engineering team with its own manager.

You’ll grow the team – both in size and capabilities. We’re investing in this fast-evolving space, giving you the opportunity to help shape the team to meet upcoming competence needs.

You’ll have strategic and operational responsibility for the new Data & AI function, where you’ll contribute with a strong voice in shaping the company-level direction.

You’ll make sure your team and the company understand the strategy, priorities, decisions, and expected outcomes.

Who you are

You have 10+ years of experience in data product, engineering, or analytics.

You have a 6+ year track record of building capable, high-performing teams and helping people grow through clear expectations, feedback, and coaching.

You communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences, adapting your message to the audience and context.

You can explain technical priorities, trade-offs, risks, and decisions in terms that support business decisions.

You're still close enough to the work to hold technical direction. This matters more to us than the size of the team you last ran.

You've done at least two of these three properly, and you're literate in the third: - Built a governed semantic or metric layer that people actually trusted, across systems that didn't agree. - Put ML models into production and kept them working. - Shipped LLM or agent systems into production, with evaluation, cost control, and latency as first-class concerns.

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with Databricks in production.

A marketplace, two-sided platform, or another business where the data is the moat.

Experience being an early senior data or AI leader somewhere. 

What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well   as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.    We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.occupation: Document Controller – Data Center Project in Borlänge
jobs.description:
Barona är ett autoriserat rekrytering- och bemanningsföretag som verkar inom flera affärsområden i hela Sverige. Genom bemanning, rekrytering och outsourcing hjälper vi företag att säkra rätt kompetens, samtidigt som vi skapar långsiktiga möjligheter för människor i arbetslivet.
Barona grundades i Helsingfors, Finland 1999.
Location: Borlänge
Employment type: 6-month project-based employment
Start: As soon as possible
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a Document Controller in Borlänge who is interested in developing their skills within document and information management while working on a large-scale technical project.
In this role, you will be an important part of the project team, helping to ensure that drawings, technical documentation and other project information are up to date, correctly structured and available to the right people.
You will work closely with Project Managers, Design Managers, technical specialists, subcontractors and other stakeholders involved in the project.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is structured, detail-oriented and interested in developing their skills while working on a major technical data center project.
About the role
As a Document Controller, you will help create structure and maintain control of the project's documentation and information.
Your responsibilities will include:
Registering, organising and updating project documentation.
Ensuring that documents and drawings are stored correctly and in accordance with project procedures.
Managing document numbers, metadata, versions and revision status.
Updating and maintaining document registers.
Distributing documents and drawings to the relevant stakeholders.
Following up on documents awaiting review or approval.
Managing incoming and outgoing documentation.
Supporting the project team with documentation throughout the different phases of the project.
Assisting with documentation for commissioning and final handover.
Ensuring that documentation is accurate, traceable and up to date.

You will also interact with different parts of the project organisation and help ensure that the right information is available when needed.
Systems and digital document management
An important part of the role is managing documentation in various digital systems and project platforms.
These may include:
Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)
BIM 360
ProjectWise
SharePoint
Aconex
Microsoft Office

You do not need to have experience with all of these systems from the start. What matters most is that you have good computer skills, are comfortable working with digital tools and can quickly learn new systems and ways of working.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with at least three years of relevant experience who is interested in continuing to develop within document and information management.
You may have previous experience in roles such as:
Document Controller
Project Documentation Coordinator
Project Administrator
Technical Administrator
Project Coordinator
Administrator within construction, installation, industrial or technical projects

Previous experience within construction, installation, data centers, infrastructure, industry or energy is an advantage, but not a requirement.
To succeed in this role, we believe that you
Are accurate, organised and structured.
Enjoy creating order and have a strong eye for detail.
Are comfortable handling large volumes of information and documentation.
Have good computer and system skills.
Have good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Are able to quickly learn new digital systems.
Have good communication skills and enjoy working with others.
Can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.
Are solution-oriented and comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.
Can prioritise between different tasks in a fast-paced project environment.

Knowledge of document management, technical drawings, quality management systems or ISO 19650 is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Language skills
As you will be working in an international project environment, you need to be able to communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of Swedish is highly desirable, and additional Nordic languages are considered an advantage.
Take the next step
Above all, we are looking for the right person with the right attitude. You do not need to know everything from day one.
Your attention to detail, organisational skills, curiosity and willingness to learn are just as important as extensive work experience.
If you want to continue developing in an administrative role while gaining experience from a large-scale technical project in Borlänge, we would like to hear from you.
Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be filled before the closing date.
For questions about the position, please contact:
Camilla Arvidsson
0735-40 27 96

Good product data helps good products do their job
Our Product Information Management (PIM) team ensures that customers, partners and colleagues can find accurate, consistent product information wherever they need it. We use Inriver as our PIM platform, closely integrated with our e-Business ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Developer for the PIM platform and its surrounding solutions.
 
About the job
You will be a hands-on member of our PIM team, building and evolving the solutions that keep product data flowing between Inriver and the systems around it. You will work closely with product data managers, architects and business stakeholders, from the first discussion about a need into a solution running in production.
 
Key responsibilities:
Design, build and maintain custom extensions and integrations for Inriver in C# / .NET.
Develop and consume REST APIs and integrate Inriver with surrounding systems, such as ERP, web, digital asset management and channel/syndication solutions.
Model and improve our product data structures together with the business.
Troubleshoot data and integration issues and improve the stability and performance of the platform.
Write testable code, take part in code reviews and contribute to our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Refine requirements together with stakeholders and help shape what we build next.
Share your knowledge, document what you build and help colleagues grow.

 
This role is based in Lund, Sweden, and follows a hybrid working model with a minimum of three days per week in the office.
 
Who are you
A senior developer who enjoys the mix of technology and data. You like to understand the problem before you write the solution, you speak up when something can be done better, and you take ownership from idea to production. You are comfortable working independently and just as comfortable in a team that moves fast and keeps a tight agile rhythm.
 
What you know
Must have
Solid professional experience as a developer with strong skills in C# and .NET
Experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrations between systems
Experience with Git, automated tests and CI/CD
Good understanding of software design principles and clean, maintainable code
Good communication skills in English, written and spoken

Strong advantage
Hands-on experience with Inriver (e.g. extensions, the Remoting/REST APIs, data model, Enrich/Syndicate) or another PIM/MDM platform
Experience with cloud platforms, such as serverless functions, message queues and secrets management
Experience with data integration, ETL or message-based architecture
Experience from product data, e-commerce or manufacturing environments

No Inriver experience? If you are a strong .NET developer with integration experience and curious about product data, we will teach you the platform. Experience from agentic coding is a plus.
 
What we offer
Team. A close-knit, experienced team with a good pace and a pragmatic, agile way of working.
Purpose. Pioneering positive impact is not a slogan on a wall here. Our customers use our solutions to save energy, clean water and make food and medicine available to more people.
Stability. Alfa Laval is a listed company with more than 140 years of history, present in around 100 countries. We think long term, invest steadily in technology and do not chase hype. You can build something here and see it last.
Growth. Real influence over technical choices, and time to learn: onboarding on Inriver and our product data landscape, plus room for your own development.

 
We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.
We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
 
 
At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or have an established presence in the area.
 
Our commitment to integrity
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.
 
As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

Are you passionate about beer, quality, and production processes? Do you want to be a key player in packaging our award-winning beers? Then you might be our next Team Leader!
Omnipollo AB is a Swedish brewery founded in 2010 by brewer Henok Fentie and designer Karl Grandin. Over the years, the brewery has won numerous awards for its beer and has several bestsellers such as Levon, Nebuchadnezzar, and Noa Pecan Mud Cake. Omnipollo AB exports its beer to 45 countries. Omnipollo AB has a number of restaurants and bars including Omnipollos hatt and Omnipollos kyrka in Stockholm as well as Omnipollos Tokyo in Japan.
About the Role
As a Team Leader at our packaging facility in Kungsängen, you will play a central role in leading and distributing the daily work. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the daily operations including tanking, centrifugation, pasteurization, packaging, and ongoing equipment maintenance run efficiently and correctly. You will work closely with the Head of Production, the production team at the brewery, and the Warehouse Manager. You will coach, lead, and coordinate the Packaging Operators to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Together with your colleagues, you will take responsibility for creating a good working environment and developing our operations. The work requires precision to maintain our routines, industry standards, and to produce products of high quality that meet all statutory requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Leading and overseeing the daily operational work at the packaging facility to ensure efficient and smooth processes.
Coaching and leading Packaging Operators, ensuring their work follows company guidelines and industry standards.
Performing ongoing floor maintenance and planning to minimize production downtime, as well as acting as the main contact for technical repairs (welders, plumbers, electricians, etc.).
Assisting in staff schedule planning in collaboration with the Head of Production.
Acting as a supervisor and mentor for new staff and interns.
Ensuring routines and SOPs are followed in daily work and actively contributing to their development.

As well as being a part of the daily operations:
Operating centrifugation and pasteurization.
Packaging our products.
Logging and documenting work.
Transferring beer out of the brewery and into the packaging facility.
Performing cleaning and CIP (Clean in Place).

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone who has a strong interest in production processes and a natural aptitude for leadership. You are a problem solver who can quickly identify and resolve practical or technical issues that may arise during the packaging and brewing process. You have a desire to motivate a team of brewery workers, delegate tasks effectively, and ensure excellent communication within the group. To succeed in this role, you also need to be competent in performing taste and quality tests to ensure our products meet company standards, and be committed to ensuring the team complies with all food, safety and statutory guidelines.
Qualifications:
Brewery technician education or equivalent.
Minimum 4 years of experience working in packaging at a brewery. 
Experience in a leading or coordinating role with an emphasis on technical aspects is highly meriting.

jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
What you’ll do
As the Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead for Green Steel, you’ll bring together project information from Planning, Cost, Contracts, the EPCM contractor and other area teams. You’ll analyse this information to show how the project is performing, highlight trends and deviations, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to support decision-making.
Coordinate the collection, validation and integration of cost, contract, schedule, progress, quantity and resource information.
Analyse performance data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities and issues requiring action.
Prepare consolidated reports, dashboards and management summaries for the area.
Work with project teams and the EPCM contractor to align inputs and resolve gaps or discrepancies in reporting.
Follow up significant differences between reported progress and site execution, escalating issues where needed.
Support consistent project controls processes and reporting standards within the area.
Identify practical improvements to reporting, data quality and analysis, including opportunities to use automation and Power BI.
Provide technical guidance on integrated reporting and performance analysis, and support project reviews and assurance activities.

What you’ll bring
You’re analytical and comfortable working across different project disciplines. You can bring complex project information together, identify what it means for performance, and explain your findings clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant experience in project controls, cost control, contract or commercial controls, or project performance reporting in a complex project environment.
Experience consolidating and analysing information across areas such as cost, schedule, progress, contracts, quantities or resources.
Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.
Strong skills in trend and variance analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and identifying risks and opportunities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and relevant project controls systems.
Knowledge of project controls governance and practices such as AACE or PMI.
Ability to turn complex data into clear reports, insights and recommendations.
Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. A project controls or cost management certification is an advantage.

Benefits at Stegra
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Experience leading enterprise applications, digital products, business capabilities, or technology-enabled transformation within a complex global organization.
Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, business cases, and investment priorities, while managing application portfolios, vendors, budgets, and delivery dependencies.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, engineering, manufacturing, product data, and related business processes; experience with PLM, PDM, ERP, or product information platforms is an advantage.

Join our team as a Docking and Project Superintendent, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth planning and execution of dry-docking operations for Stena Line’s vessels!
 
 
In this role, you will utilize your maritime expertise to provide guidance to our Fleet Groups, ensuring adherence to docking policies and procedures while prioritizing quality, time efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also coordinate fleet and group projects under the direction of Senior Management, while also ensuring vessel accreditation to meet international safety and pollution prevention standards. If you're driven by excellence and adept at optimizing operations, apply now to be part of our team!
 
 
Some of your key responsibilities: 
 
- Manage and coordinate dry-docking processes.
 
- Review and standardize docking and repair specifications.
 
- Coordinate refit budgeting and cost analysis with Fleet Group.
 
- Manage pre-docking planning and reporting.
 
- Act as Project Manager for technical projects.
 
- Monitor project risks and key milestones.
 
- Negotiate terms with ship repair yards.
 
- Ensure efficient vessel management during refits.
 
- Maintain vessel standards and appearance.
 
- Provide expertise to Fleet Group and Company management.
 
- Assist with warranty claims and post-project evaluations. 
 
- Ensure compliance with contractual and commercial agreements.
 
- Liaise with departments supporting vessels.
 
- Travel as required. 
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of colleagues.
 
 
Who are you?
 
At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.
 
 
We believe you are a team-player who thrives in a collaborative environment. You share your knowledge and pay attention to the details in everything you do. We also believe you welcome new challenges with an open, and positive attitude.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
- Unlimited Chief Engineer or Master certification. Alternatively, a degree in nautical science-related fields.
 
- Practical experience either onboard with exposure to onboard management teams or a minimum of 1+ year experience ashore in technical/project roles within a shipping company's operations.
 
- Keen knowledge of vessel operations, and technical and safety requirements for RoPax-type vessels. 
 
- Dry-dock planning and planned maintenance systems. 
 
- Financial knowledge of budgets and cost control to ensure effective project management whilst maintaining company standards of safety and quality.
 
- Strong understanding of the key concepts of Health and Safety  
 
- Knowledge of ISM and ISO standards and codes
 
 
Interested? 
 
This is a full-time, permanent position based in Gothenburg within our Fleet Operations department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than 1 December, 2026. We are having an ongoing selection, so do not wait with your application. To ensure the secure and structured processing of your personal data, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. 
 
 
We have collective bargaining agreements with Unionen, among others, who you can contact for more information. Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment. We may conduct background checks as part of our efforts to ensure the quality of our recruitment process.
 
 
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Hans Corneliusson, Group Head of Fleet Support, hans.corneliusson@stenaline.com or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hedwig.blixt@stenaline.com.
 
 
About Stena Line
 
As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.
 
 
Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Business Manager - E2E.
Your role and responsibilities 
At Metallurgy Products, we develop, manufacture, and deliver electromagnetic stirrers that help customers improve metal quality, process efficiency, and sustainability. Our solutions are used by leading companies in the global steel and aluminum industry. As a global business unit, we combine world-class engineering with our own workshop and production facilities in Västerås, Sweden. This allows us to take full responsibility for the entire value chain, from design and manufacturing to installation and commissioning. Our work extends far beyond the factory floor. Through international projects, site assignments, and customer collaborations across the globe, we help shape the future of the metals industry while delivering innovative solutions to customers worldwide. Joining Metallurgy Products means becoming part of an international team where technology, craftsmanship, and customer focus come together to create tangible value for the world's leading steel and aluminum producers.
Your responsibilities
Drive and continuously improve HSE processes, plans and ways of working.
Support managers, project teams and operational personnel in risk assessments, incident investigations and preventive actions.
Ensure compliance with ABB requirements, legal obligations and internal management standards.
Lead HSE reporting, KPI follow-up and documentation, ensuring activities are completed and properly evidenced.
Promote a proactive culture where hazards, risks and improvement opportunities are identified and addressed.
Support site activities, installation and commissioning phases from an HSE perspective.
Coordinate quality governance activities, including ISO management systems, audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to the development of the function towards a broader HSEQ framework.

Qualifications
Proven experience in HSE within manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering or project environments.
Strong understanding of risk management, compliance, reporting and management systems.
Experience working with audits, ISO standards and quality processes is highly valued.
A hands-on and structured approach, with the ability to work independently and drive activities to completion.
Comfortable working with documentation, KPIs, databases and reporting tools.
Experience from an international and matrix-organized environment is an advantage.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Why ABB Metallurgy?
This role offers a unique opportunity to make a visible impact across manufacturing, operations and global projects. You will join a collaborative team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do, while helping shape the future development of our HSEQ capabilities. 
What’s in it for you?
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. 
More about us

Lead and shape People Operations at our Rosersberg site - driving operational excellence, employee experience, and strong labor relations in a fast-growing circular economy.
Balance leadership, labour law, and staffing while driving efficient HR processes for Sellpy Operations. From coaching to strategic site development, lead our local HR team and build a safe workplace.
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We see a tremendous financial, social and environmental value in making sure unused items are put to use again. We are looking for colleagues who share this vision, and who are ready to see their work contribute to a sustainable future.
HR Manager Interim, at Sellpy
We’re looking for a grounded, operational HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced logistics environment and is passionate about driving a modern, proactive People Operations function. In this interim role, you will take full ownership of leading and developing our local HR function at the site in Rosersberg. You will act as a trusted advisor to our Site Manager and local management, ensuring our site meets staffing targets while fostering a safe, empowered, and sustainable work environment.
You will dive into labor law - specifically Lager- och e-handelsavtalet - manage union relations, and streamline everything from recruitment to on- and offboarding journeys. Together with the site management, you'll balance day-to-day coaching with continuous improvement projects that boost site performance and scalability.
In short, you will
Provide first-line leadership support and coaching to managers across daily employee relations and operational challenges.
Lead, coach, and develop the local HR team at our Rosersberg site. The team consists of one HR Generalist and one Recruiter.
Drive staffing strategies to meet operational targets, balancing direct warehouse recruitment and temporary agency staffing.
Manage labour relations, acting as the primary point of contact for collective bargaining agreements (Lager- och e-handelsavtalet), union collaboration, safety delegates, and occupational health services.
Oversee systematic work environment management (SAM) in close partnership with the Site Manager to ensure a secure and healthy workplace.
Manage authority liaise with relevant agencies and handle work permit applications with Migrationsverket when needed.
Build, optimise, and maintain smooth employee journeys, from onboarding and offboarding to HR system administration and payroll preparations.

We use
Modern HRM and ATS platforms for end-to-end People Operations and recruitment tracking
Google Workspace and collaborative communication tools

Requirements
A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, Behavioral science, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in an HR Manager role (2+ years) or HRBP role (3+ years) within logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, or a fast-paced operational setting.
Solid working knowledge of Swedish labor law (arbetsrätt) and practical experience with Swedish collective agreements, preferably Lager- och e-handelsavtalet.
Experience leading or mentoring HR team members and collaborating constructively with trade unions and safety representatives.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to balance hands-on operational duties and structured process improvements.
Pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with high personal integrity and communication skills.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

We’d be impressed if you have
Experience managing temporary staffing agencies and high-volume blue-collar recruitment.
Worked in a fast-growing, product-focused startup or scale-up environment.
Prior experience handling work permit applications with Migrationsverket.

You get to
Work closely with production and operations, experiencing firsthand the heartbeat of our circular supply chain.
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues.
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform
Make use of prepaid vacation
Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy
Save up with a monthly pension plan
Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities

Location
On-site at our warehouse in Rosersberg.
Due to the operational nature of this role and the need to stay closely connected with the warehouse team and managers, you will spend the majority of your time on-site. You will have regular touchpoints and collaboration with our HQ in Stockholm.
Form of employment: Full-time (Interim)
Start: Mid March 2027 to approximately April 2028

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 
As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. 
 
About the job 
As s Customer Quality Specialist you will own and drive the end-to-end customer claims process across our business unit. This means ensuring timely resolution of customer quality issues, reduction of claim costs, prevention of recurrence, and continuous improvement of customer satisfaction. 
You will lead the end-to-end customer claims process and work cross-functionally to improve customer experience, strengthen quality performance, and drive sustainable business improvements. 
 
The role has cross-functional exposure and you will work closely with Operations, Product & Portfolio Management, R&D / Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Service, and Quality. 
 
Key responsibilities: 
Ownership of the end-to-end customer claims process towards full portfolio. 
Standardize claim management practices across the BU. 
Strengthen cross-functional accountability for corrective actions. 
Increase customer confidence through proactive claim and escalation management 
Follow up on claims and quality situations by making statistics, analysis and creating claims and quality reports. 
Drive and manage quality improvement projects/activities. 

 
Long term goals will be: 
Reduce customer claim costs and quality-related business risks and enable leadership to focus on strategic priorities rather than operational intervention. 
Drive systemic quality improvements through trend analysis and prevention. 
Establish a scalable and sustainable claims management framework. 

 
Networking and stakeholder engagement are important aspects of this role, which includes occasional domestic and international travel. You will be part of a team of three and report to Kubra Kucuk, who leads with trust, welcome creativity and are open to ideas to continuously develop our ways of working. 
 
Who are you 
We are looking for you with a commercial mindset who is proactive, structured and have a curious mind to constantly find ways forward, driving for solutions and gaining results. This is not only an administrative role - but you will also have a big impact on business and customer satisfaction. The scope of this role is broad and diverse, requiring the ability to effectively prioritize competing demands while remaining resilient in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. 
If you enjoy engaging with people, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working in a global environment, you will thrive in this role. 

 
What you know 
This is a role for you with some experience of process ownership in a similar role and who are used to stakeholder management in a larger, preferably international cross-functional environment. 
Requirements: 
Work experience in Quality, Customer Quality, Customer Claims, Manufacturing Quality, or a similar role. 
Root cause analysis and problem solving (8D, 5 Why, CAPA). 
Experience in data analysis and KPI reporting. 
Quality management systems (QMS) understanding. 
Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technical Education - mechanical/chemical/production, or a related field and/or many years of working with customer claims in for the role related field. 
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English 

Merit:
Power BI and digitalization skills 
Experience in engineered products, manufacturing, or industrial equipment. 

 
For more information, please contact 
Kubra Kucuk Aydemir, Head of Governance & QHSE, PPMI  
or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner
