At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what concerns people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we decarbonize and replace cars.
 
 
Welder for collision damage – your next challenge in Västerås!
Are you a welder who thrives on challenges? Alstom is now looking for a new colleague who will work with repairs of damaged and crash-damaged vehicles in a dynamic and exciting environment.
 
Your future role
You will report to the Production Leader and work together with a dedicated and competent team.
The group in the workshop consists of about 12 people and is a mix of both welders/blacksmiths and modification technicians (fitters). You will get good support and support from our colleagues from other functions such as engineering, industrialisation engineering, quality and purchasing.
In this role, you will be an important part of the problem-solving process and we are looking for someone who has a passion for finding effective solutions. Your creativity and initiative are crucial to our daily work.
 
The position includes, among other things:
Replacing and aligning body parts
Welding, gluing and riveting
Disassembling and assembling vehicles

 
You will work with both black and stainless steel as well as aluminum. We would like you to have a few years of experience in welding and be able to read drawings.
 
Who are you?
We value passion and attitude over experience. We don't expect you to have all the skills, but we believe that the following skills will help you succeed and grow in this role:
 
Relevant education or experience in welding
Previous work with welding and repair of vehicles or similar industries
Good knowledge of Black MAG (145 2-12mm) and Stainless Steel MAG (145 2-12mm) to ensure high quality and efficiency in the work
Knowledge of drawing reading and technical specifications related to welding
Worked with welding that has requirements for non-destructive testing, such as Visual Inspection, Penetrant or Magnetic Powder.
Be able to communicate freely in Swedish and good knowledge of English

 
Qualifications:
Welding certificate
Post-Weld Direction
Alu MIG (141 2-12mm), TIG (141) and pin welding (131/111)
Heat direction/cold direction of bumps

 
We value the following personal qualities in you:
Creativity: You have the ability to think outside the box, which helps us find new and innovative solutions to welding-related problems.
Solution-oriented: You quickly identify welding challenges and address them effectively, which is important for keeping our projects on track.
Collaboration-oriented: Your unpretentious approach lifts collaboration in the team and creates a positive work environment where we achieve common goals.

 
The work is carried out during the day, but you should be open to being able to work shifts.
This service requires you to undergo a medical examination, which Alstom will provide.
 
Interviews take place on an ongoing basis, so send in your application today.
 
Things you'll like
Join us on a lifelong transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, allowing you to grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.
 
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career that is free from boring daily routines.
Working with the latest safety standards for the railway industry
Contributing to innovative projects
Steer your career in any direction you want across functions and countries
Leverage our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Samarbeta med tvärpedagogiska team och hjälpsamma kollegor
Stora möjligheter till utveckling

 
 
 
Du behöver inte vara ett tågentusiast för att lyckas med oss. Vi garanterar att när du stiger på ett av våra tåg med dina vänner eller familj, kommer du att vara stolt. Om du är redo för utmaningen, skulle vi gärna vilja höra från dig!
 
Viktigt att notera
Som ett globalt företag är vi en arbetsgivare som främjar mångfald i de 70+ länder där vi verkar. Vi är engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsplats för alla.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner - Surface Fleet and Automation Solutions
jobs.description:
Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:   Do you want to help shape the next generation of automation solutions for the mining industry? As a Product Owner within Surface Automation, you will play a key role in translating product strategy and customer needs into clear priorities and tangible results together with our development teams.  Join Our Team
 You will become part of Surface Software Engineering, where we develop advanced automation solutions for Epiroc’s surface products. Here, we work across teams, functions, and countries, bringing together diverse perspectives to create solutions that deliver real value to our customers.
  
 Your Mission
 As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating the agreed roadmap, Epics, and objectives into clear team goals and a prioritized backlog. You will represent customer and business value throughout the development process and help the team stay focused on what creates the greatest impact. In this role, you will: 
 Own and continuously prioritize the team’s backlog based on customer and business value.
   
Translate roadmaps, Epics, and objectives into clear priorities, scope, and team goals. 
 
    
Balance new functionality with quality, technical debt, maintenance, security, and risk reduction. 
 
    
Follow development progress and deliveries together with the team, ensuring up-to-date forecasts for Epics and features. 
 
    
Validate outcomes, gather feedback early, and use insights to adjust priorities. 
 
    
Coordinate priorities, dependencies, and releases together with other Product Owners and relevant stakeholders.
 
  
Your ProfileWe are looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer, business, and technology. You create structure and clarity even when circumstances change, and you are comfortable making decisions and balancing competing priorities. At the same time, you are a good listener who builds trust through close collaboration with development teams, Product Management, and other stakeholders. To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
   
Experience working as a Product Owner, in agile product development, or in a similar role within software, automation, or complex technical systems. 
 
    
The ability to understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear objectives and priorities for development teams. 
 
    
Strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment, prioritize among competing demands, and drive initiatives to decisions-making.
 
    
Fluency in English is required, both written and verbally 
 
  
 
 You do not need to be the person defining the technical solution yourself. You will work closely with developers, architects, and other technical experts who contribute feasibility assessments, estimates, risk analyses, and solution decisions. Your strength lies in creating clarity around needs, value, and priorities. Experience with industrial automation, autonomous solutions, mining operations, or other safety-critical and complex products is considered an advantage.
 Location and TravelThis position is based in Örebro, Sweden. Travel may be required when needed.
  
 In addition to a culture characterized by growth and development combined with a healthy work-life balance, there are a few things that make us especially proud to work at Epiroc:
  Global career opportunities.
 Epiroc University for your ongoing professional development.
 Community engagement.
 A comprehensive benefits package, including flexible working hours and bonus programs.A Hybrid Workplace Life at Epiroc may include the opportunity for a hybrid workplace. This way of working offers flexibility and inclusion, enabling a better balance between work and personal life while promoting well-being. The hybrid work model is available when the nature of the job allows it, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual circumstances.
  
Application and Contact Information We encourage you to submit your application through our career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 29, 2025.
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process that includes interviews, reference checks, and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity verification as well as drug and alcohol testing. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive, and you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

jobs.occupation: Junior Structural Analysis Engineer – Marine Technology
jobs.description:
Work with large-scale moving structures where structural analysis, advanced mechanics and material engineering come together. Help develop innovative wind-powered technology for more energy-efficient shipping, taking your calculations and design solutions all the way to full-scale applications. As part of a small engineering team, you'll have the freedom to influence the product and take ownership from day one. Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you'll get to tackle complex engineering challenges while developing your technical expertise.
About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Structural Analysis Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Stockholm, developing large-scale mechanical systems for more sustainable shipping. The company combines advanced engineering, mechanical design and material technology to create solutions that harness wind power and reduce fuel consumption in the maritime industry.
In this role, you will focus on developing and improving existing products, making complex mechanical structures lighter, more efficient and easier to manufacture. Your work will range from detailed structural calculations and smaller design improvements to evaluating major design changes and new technical concepts.
You will work closely with mechanical engineers and other specialists in a small, collaborative development team. The products involve large moving structures exposed to demanding environmental conditions, where loads, movement, material properties and mechanical functionality must all be considered.
What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is the ability to influence the actual product. Your calculations and technical assessments will directly contribute to design decisions, and you will have the opportunity to follow your work through development, manufacturing and testing. With a high level of responsibility and freedom, you will play an active role in shaping both the technical solutions and the final product.
Key Responsibilities
Perform structural calculations and analyses of large-scale mechanical structures and components.
Analyze and optimize designs with regard to strength, weight, functionality and manufacturability.
Evaluate how different loads, movements and material properties affect structural performance.
Prepare calculation reports and technical documentation to support engineering decisions.
Work with calculation and simulation tools, including opportunities to develop and improve analysis methods.
Evaluate design alternatives and contribute to technical solutions in close collaboration with mechanical engineers.
Participate in product development, from early concepts and design iterations to final solutions and testing.

About You
A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Engineering Mechanics, Marine Engineering or a related field.
A solid understanding of structural mechanics, strength of materials and mechanical behavior under different loads.
Experience with structural calculations and analysis, gained through academic projects or professional work.
An interest in mechanical design and understanding how individual components contribute to the performance of a complete system.
Good communication skills in English.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with finite element analysis (FEA), ANSYS, Python or similar engineering calculation tools. Experience with large mechanical structures, moving systems, hydraulics, steel or composite materials is also valuable. A background in marine engineering, offshore, heavy industry or working with DNV standards would be particularly relevant.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and comfortable taking responsibility for your own work. You enjoy getting into the technical details of calculations while maintaining an understanding of the bigger picture. You take initiative, explore different solutions and are motivated by seeing your engineering work turn into real, functioning products.
About the employment
This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and our client is for you to transition to direct employment with the client after 12 months.
Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.

Employment: Full-time
Start date: By agreement
Location: Stockholm, Flemmingsberg
Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary
Contact person: Anna Persson

About the company
MAXI-PRESS is a German company that has developed, manufactured and supplied spare parts, wear parts and consumables for industrial laundries since 2006. Its product portfolio supports machinery from a wide range of manufacturers and helps customers maintain reliable and efficient production.
The range includes membranes, ironer padding, conveyor belts and numerous other specialist components, spare parts and consumables for industrial laundry equipment.
MAXI-PRESS became part of the JENSEN-GROUP in 2024 while continuing to operate under its established brand. The business is now entering an exciting phase of growth and is looking to strengthen its presence across Sweden and Scandinavia.

As a Technical Sales and Service Representative, you will become an important customer-facing representative of MAXI-PRESS in Scandinavia. The role combines practical technical work with sales and the development of existing customer relationships.
Initially, the position will have a strong technical focus. You will visit industrial laundries to carry out installations, light maintenance and the replacement of wear and spare parts. This may include installing ironer padding, replacing conveyor belts and identifying requirements for spare parts and consumables.
Working directly at customer sites will give you a natural opportunity to understand each customer’s machinery, operations and future requirements. The commercial side of the role is therefore focused on developing existing relationships and recommending relevant technical solutions rather than traditional cold-call sales.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Carrying out light technical maintenance and installations at customer sites
Installing and replacing ironer padding, conveyor belts and other wear parts
Identifying customer requirements for spare parts and consumables
Developing and maintaining long-term customer relationships
Providing technical advice and recommending suitable products
Preparing quotations and following up on sales opportunities
Planning customer visits and independently organising your working week
Working closely with technical specialists and colleagues within MAXI-PRESS and the JENSEN-GROUP
Supporting the continued growth of MAXI-PRESS across Sweden and Scandinavia

This is a home-based position involving extensive travel, primarily by car. You will mainly support customers in southern Sweden, Denmark and parts of Norway. Approximately 75 per cent of the role may involve travel, including regular overnight stays.
We are therefore primarily looking for someone based in southern Sweden, preferably in Skåne or within the area extending from Gothenburg southwards. Your exact location will affect how frequently customer visits can be completed as day trips.

Has approximately three to five years of experience in an industrial technical, maintenance, service or spare-parts role
Has practical experience with industrial machinery and is comfortable working in production or factory environments
Has a genuine interest in technology and enjoys hands-on technical work
Has customer-facing experience and the ability to build trusted professional relationships
Can independently organise, plan and manage their work
Is comfortable with extensive travel and regular overnight stays
Holds a valid driving licence
Is fluent in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Spare parts, wear parts or technical consumables
Preventive maintenance or technical field service
Food production, process industries, marine engineering or other machinery-intensive environments
Industrial laundries, ironers, conveyor belts or laundry machinery
Technical sales, quotations and consultative customer support
Danish, Norwegian, Finnish or German language skills

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
About the Apps Platform
The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
The Role

Some foundational services we buy from 3p partners, others are not available for purchase and you would be the first in the world to build them at scale. Own the app hosting and deployment pipeline — the runtime that serves user applications in production
Manage and operate composable managed services for storage, logging, workflows etc
Build and maintain custom domains infrastructure, ensuring reliable SSL provisioning and DNS management at scale
Drive vendor evaluation, onboarding, and migration as we continue decomposing our platform from a bundled BaaS to best-of-breed individual services
Establish operational excellence practices: monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and capacity planning across all managed services

What We're Looking For
Experience building and operating distributed systems

The job as Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is exciting and often rewarding, working for the benefit of the Customer Satisfaction, in contact with multiple internal and external stakeholders. We are looking for someone who has experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer who wants to take the next step in their career as a Supplier Quality Engineer.
This position belongs to the Chassis team but is in interaction with the full organisation. You will join a passionate team working in a multicultural, open and dynamic environment, eager to develop and improve with all of our stakeholders, internal and external, in order to ensure the best quality of their products.
The main focus of the team is on performance, both on supplier results and its own efficiency. Opportunities exist for the SQE to attend internal continuous improvement activities aiming for leaner working processes. From the sourcing stage up to the running production, the main tasks assigned to the Surface treatment SQE are:
To evaluate Surface Treatment (coating on Metal / Plastics ) supplier lines and facilities, managing their development plan up to the excellence level required by our customers standards.
To support the new part developments, securing the suppliers ability to coat the parts according to the specification on robust manufacturing processes.
To lead the supplier continuous improvements as well as being entitled to steer strong reaction in case of supplier performance deviation.
To contribute to the Surface Treatment Supplier Quality Global Network, working on new standard inputs, continuously improving the assessment tool and permanently monitoring the next technology and their opportunities.

Preferred Academic Degree about Surface Treatment Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering or Electrochemical Engineering, or Polymer Engineering organic and/or inorganic coating area or:
An extensive experience and strong performance in the Surface Treatment field can substitute for academic degree.
Experience as a Process Engineer and / or Production Engineer.
Has the ability to travel for work.
Are fluent in English and Swedish both spoken and written because the languages is spoken internally/externally.

Experience upon the Surface Treatment (coating) application processes/troubleshooting and its management within automotive business is a plus.

Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden is looking for an experienced Country Quality Manager to lead and further develop our Quality organization and quality performance in Sweden.
This is a senior leadership position with overall responsibility for Quality across our Swedish operations. The role reports directly to the Managing Director Sweden and is a member of the Swedish Management Team.
The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on understanding of manufacturing, customer requirements, process quality and continuous improvement.
The Role
As Country Quality Manager, you will lead the Swedish Quality organization and drive the continued development of quality performance across our operations.
Your responsibility covers Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality, with a strong focus on robust processes, preventive quality and continuous improvement.
You will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, Supply Chain and Production Development, as well as with the Quality Management System organization.
A key part of the role is to strengthen quality ownership throughout the organization and ensure that quality is built into our processes.
You will represent Quality in the Swedish Management Team and act as a senior quality interface with customers, suppliers and the wider Gnutti Carlo Group.
Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Quality organization and quality agenda in Sweden.

Develop the capabilities and ways of working within Customer Quality, Supplier Quality, Quality Assurance and Process Quality.

Drive Customer Quality, including customer relationships, claims, structured problem solving, corrective actions and effectiveness verification.

Strengthen Quality Assurance and Process Quality, including quality gates, control plans, process controls and verification methods.

Drive preventive quality, process capability and manufacturing robustness in close cooperation with Operations and Engineering.

Ensure effective application of automotive quality methods including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strengthen Quality involvement in new products, process changes, industrialization and production launches.

Lead and develop Supplier Quality together with Purchasing and Engineering, focusing on supplier performance and preventive quality development.

Drive reduction of customer claims, internal defects, scrap, rework and Cost of Poor Quality through structured problem solving, lessons learned and sustainable corrective actions.

Establish and follow clear quality KPIs, priorities and management routines, strengthening quality ownership and accountability throughout the organization.

Work closely with the Quality Management System organization to ensure alignment between system requirements and operational execution.

Lead and support the Quality organization, ensuring structured processes, fact-based analysis and effective actions.

Your Profile
We are looking for an experienced quality leader with a strong background in the automotive industry.
You understand quality from both a technical and leadership perspective and are comfortable working close to manufacturing while maintaining the broader perspective required for a country-level management position.
We believe you have:

Several years of leadership experience within Quality in the automotive industry.

Experience as a senior Quality Manager, Plant Quality Manager, Quality Director or equivalent.

Strong knowledge of automotive quality requirements and IATF 16949.

Solid experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA and 8D.

Strong experience in Customer Quality, Supplier Quality and structured problem solving.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, process capability and preventive quality.

Experience in leading and developing teams in an international manufacturing environment.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate quality data into priorities and actions.

Fluent English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Leadership Profile
We are looking for a leader who is visible in the operation, understands manufacturing reality and is comfortable moving between management-level discussions, customer interaction and the factory floor.
You are structured, fact-based and pragmatic. You create clear ownership and expectations, challenge existing ways of working and follow through until actions deliver the intended result.
Most importantly, you understand that sustainable quality performance is built through strong processes, technical understanding, prevention, clear ownership and disciplined execution.
What We Offer
This position offers the opportunity to take a central role in the continued development of Quality within Gnutti Carlo Group Sweden.
As Country Quality Manager, you will have a strong mandate to influence the Quality organization, our ways of working and the long-term development of quality performance across our Swedish operations.

You will help shape a competitive and sustainable supply base that supports our packaging operations, innovation and business growth.

You will shape and deliver procurement strategies for manufacturing, commodities and pallets across North & East EMEA. Reporting to the Sub-Regional Procurement Lead East & North EMEA, you will work with local and global procurement colleagues, Operations and Engineering to lead sourcing, negotiations and supplier partnerships across manufacturing inputs, maintenance services and capital equipment.
Combining international category responsibility with practical impact at site level, you will improve cost, working capital, supplier performance and resilience while supporting innovation and sustainability. This is an opportunity to influence how we source the materials, equipment and services our manufacturing sites rely on.
The role will be based at one of our offices or sites in Sweden or Denmark, with travel of up to 30%. Posible locations: Värnamo, Mariestad or Gothenburg, in Sverige; Grenaa or Taastrup, in Denmark.

But we also consider our colleagues as individuals and would like to make their lives healthier and happier, therefore we offer our colleagues a range of benefits.

We are thriving for being a diverse workplace where everyone can realize their potential. We see equality and diversity as a strength. Thus, we hope that you will apply for the position even if you do not necessarily meet all the requirements.

jobs.occupation: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
jobs.description:
Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.
Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.
We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.
What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.
Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:
Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.
Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.
Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.

Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.
Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.
Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.
Required qualificationsThe position requires:
PhD in Biology or Bioengineering
Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories
At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal 
Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels
Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification
Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D
Experience in microfluidics and microscopy
Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Merits include:
Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation
Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.
Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software
Experience as executive member of scientific societies 

Terms of employment
This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.
The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.
Application instructionsYour application should include:
A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans
A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors
A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)
A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)

We warmly welcome your application!
Mer om Medicinska fakulteten
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.
Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.

What you’ll do
Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.

The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

Backed by the stable Lagercrantz Group, we combine 45+ years of heritage with global industrial manufacturing-and we are gearing up to celebrate our 50th anniversary in 2028. We develop and sell specific steel and aluminum structures used at telecom sites and rooftops worldwide.

We design, develop, and supply optimized steel and aluminum structures, both standard and customized, for telecom sites and rooftop applications worldwide.

 We are looking for our new Head of Product Development. This is a structured succession role: you will start hands-on alongside our current R&D Manager. What will you do?
As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. Your daily work will focus on building high-quality mobile experiences, driving technical excellence, and helping engineers grow in their craft. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
Areas of ownership:

Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.

Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.

Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.

Drive native app excellence. Set high standards for performance, stability, accessibility and user experience across iOS and Android. Guide technical decisions, architecture, testing and release practices.

Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.

Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Hire and develop great engineers, set clear expectations and create an environment where people take initiative, solve problems and take pride in what they deliver.

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.

A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.

Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). You understand native architecture, UI, app lifecycle, concurrency, performance and debugging, and are comfortable contributing production code today. You can guide technical decisions across both platforms, although equal expertise in both is not required. Experience limited to React Native or other cross-platform frameworks does not meet this requirement.

Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.

Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. 🌳 Experienced Climbing Arborist Wanted – Stockholm, Sweden
Svenska Trädmästarna AB is looking for an experienced, skilled and safety-conscious climbing arborist to join our team in Stockholm.
We are looking for someone with at least 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably more, who is highly skilled in climbing, pruning, rigging and sectional dismantling. We place great importance on good climbing skills and the ability to reach far out along branches for pruning.
Trädmästarna is one of Sweden's leading tree care companies, with over 30 years of experience in the industry. We specialize in protected and valuable trees, as well as trees in historically and culturally important environments.

What does it take to keep a growing renewable energy business connected, secure and ready for the future? At OX2, cloud infrastructure supports everything from daily operations and business-critical systems to data platforms and AI. We are now looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Lead to take ownership of our infrastructure landscape, shape its technical direction and ensure that our platforms support the business as it continues to develop.
YOU WILL
OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As OX2 expands its role as an independent power producer, the demand for its digital infrastructure continues to grow. Secure, reliable and well-managed cloud platforms are essential to supporting operations across different markets, as well as the company's ambitions within data and AI.
As Cloud & Infrastructure Lead, you will take overall responsibility for OX2's cloud and infrastructure environment, spanning Azure, AWS and the services connecting them. You will set technical expectations, evaluate proposed solutions and follow up on delivery. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that infrastructure decisions support both operational needs and future digital initiatives.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and develop OX2's cloud infrastructure, including Azure and AWS architecture, landing zones, standards and governance.

Set technical direction across enterprise networking, connectivity and core infrastructure services.

Oversee identity and endpoint management, Windows and Linux environments, backup and recovery.

Strengthen cloud security and operational resilience, including disaster recovery, patching and vulnerability remediation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lithography & Process Development Engineer to Mycronic
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
For over 50 years, our innovative solutions have developed and manufactured machines for electronics and display manufacturing. We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing. 
In this role, you will be part of our R&D team Metrology and Process Control Group (PMCD), which currently consists of 12 team members working within pattern design, metrology, cleanliness, and data analysis.
Work tasks
Technical Project Leadership
Lead technically demanding customer demonstrations and development activities from concept to implementation.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with production, quality, metrology, R&D, suppliers, and customers.
Drive technical decisions, manage priorities and risks, and ensure successful delivery.
Mentor colleagues and contribute to the development of engineering competence within PMCD.

Lithography Process Ownership
Own and continuously improve lithography processes to ensure process capability, stability, yield, and product quality.
Define and maintain process specifications, operating procedures, and engineering standards.
Lead root-cause investigations and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Advanced Process Control (APC)
Develop and implement APC strategies using statistical methods, SPC, DOE, and other data-driven approaches.
Analyze process and metrology data to identify sources of variation and define opportunities for improvement.
Define and monitor relevant process KPIs and drive improvements in process robustness and performance.

Process Development & Technology Innovation
Lead the development and qualification of new lithography processes, materials, and equipment.
Design and execute experiments to optimize processes and support technology development.
Translate research and emerging technologies into robust, scalable manufacturing solutions.

We are looking for
This is a role for you who enjoy combining scientific understanding with practical engineering to develop robust, data-driven solutions that create long-term value. You have a structured and analytical mindset and thrive in multidisciplinary environments. You are curious, proactive, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. As you will collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, customers, and stakeholders across the organization, you are a strong team player who enjoys building relationships, fostering collaboration, and leading technical discussions to achieve common goals.
On top of that, you have:
A Masters Degree or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Electronics, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
At least some years of industrial experience in semiconductor manufacturing, lithography, photomask manufacturing, or another advanced manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of process engineering, process characterization, and statistical data analysis.
Experience with DOE, root-cause analysis, and systematic problem-solving methodologies.
Experience leading technical projects or coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities.
Strong knowledge in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a merit if you have:
Experience with APC, SPC, process monitoring, and metrology systems.
Experience qualifying new processes, materials, or equipment.
Knowledge of semiconductor, photomask, or display manufacturing technologies.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, or other structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience working with international customers and suppliers.

Scope: Full-time 
Location: Täby and possibility of hybrid work (but minimum 3 days per week In office as an average)

How do you design memory technology that delivers high performance while keeping power consumption and silicon area to a minimum? At Xenergic, it starts with a deep understanding of analog circuits, advanced semiconductor technology and the ability to turn complex design challenges into working solutions. We are now looking for an Analog Design Engineer to join our team in Lund and contribute to the development of our next generation of on-chip memory IP.
YOU WILL
 Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, low-power on-chip memory IP for advanced chip technologies. Our engineering teams work with technology that ranges from transistor-level circuit design to physical implementation, verification and integration into customers' products.  As an Analog Design Engineer, you will join a specialised engineering team developing and optimising the analog circuits behind Xenergic's memory technology. You will contribute to new designs and improvements to existing solutions, using your understanding of the broader memory architecture to guide design decisions.  Your main responsibilities will be to:

Design and optimise analog circuits and custom IC blocks for advanced SRAM and memory IP.

Work with transistor-level and schematic design, including circuit simulation and verification across different operating conditions.

Analyse circuit behaviour and optimise designs for power consumption, performance, silicon area and reliability.

Contribute to physical layout, design verification and analysis of layout-related effects, including parasitics and EMIR.

Support the development and adaptation of memory IP across different semiconductor process technologies.

Collaborate with colleagues across analog, digital, layout and verification to solve technical challenges and support integration into customer designs.

You will join an analog team of six engineers with different technical backgrounds and experience. The team holds regular technical discussions to share challenges, design decisions and possible improvements. Much of the work requires independent problem-solving, alongside close collaboration to develop the technology. Depending on the project, you may also participate in technical discussions with customers.
The position is full-time and based on-site at Xenergic's office in Lund.
YOU ARE
You hold an M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Microelectronics or a related field, or have gained equivalent expertise through relevant industry experience. You have at least three years of professional experience in analog IC design, including transistor-level design, schematic development and simulation.
You have a good understanding of CMOS circuit design and are comfortable analyzing simulation results and optimizing circuits for power, performance and area. You have experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre or comparable EDA tools, along with an understanding of how physical layout and parasitic effects influence circuit performance.
Experience in SRAM or memory design is an advantage but not required. Knowledge of advanced technology nodes, FinFET, DRC/LVS, EMIR-aware design, silicon measurements or scripting languages such as Python, shell or SKILL would also be an advantage.
 As a person, you are curious, analytical and enjoy understanding how things work, from individual circuits to broader architecture. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving problems independently and value collaboration with colleagues. You are comfortable working in a smaller organization where learning, flexibility and sharing knowledge are part of everyday work. Fluency in English is required.
At Xenergic, you will work alongside experienced engineers in a highly specialized environment where your ideas and technical contributions can make a real difference. You will have the opportunity to influence the development of advanced memory technology and see your work become part of products used by customers around the world
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. Applications are reviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We look forward to hearing from you.
ABOUT XENERGIC
Xenergic is a Swedish deep-tech semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed and low-power on-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications. Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic's solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.

TL;DR — You'll make sure no one at Lovable spends time on anything AI can do. We're defining how AI-native companies operate internally, across Product, GTM, and G&A. You'll own the systems that let a 300-person team move like a 3,000-person company: workflow automations, internal AI tools, data enrichment pipelines. You'll use Lovable itself to build much of this. This role is part of Project Automate Lovable, working closely with our AI Operations & Automation function and FBOS team.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Shipped production automations at a company: You've built workflow systems at scale that ran without you. Actual business-critical automations used by teams.
Engineering brain, modern toolkit: You understand how systems actually work (APIs, databases, architecture) and can review code confidently. You move fast by choosing the right tool for the job: AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code etc) when they're faster, no-code (Lovable itself, n8n, Clay, etc.) when it fits, raw code when it's needed.
Data is part of your building material: You can turn fragmented data across tools, databases, and external sources into reliable, usable systems. You’re comfortable designing data models, writing complex SQL, building enrichment and transformation pipelines, and creating the feedback loops that keep data trustworthy over time.
AI tool obsessed: You're always testing the latest models, apps, and workflows before anyone else. You've deployed internal AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT with custom contexts, AI agents, MCPs, etc.) at a company and you're constantly experimenting with new ones.
Can't unsee inefficiency: You see the whole company as one machine. Once you spot a broken process, you can't leave it alone.
High agency: You don't wait for permission. You find the bottleneck, build the fix, and ship it.

What you’ll do
Own internal AI systems that make Lovable run faster than it should.
Define how AI-native companies operate: Help build the playbook. What we learn here scales to every company using Lovable.
Build internal tools and workflows: Using Lovable, AI agents, no-code, raw code—whatever gets the job done fastest. Lovable on Lovable first, always.
Turn company data into operational leverage: Connect and enrich data across our stack, then put it directly to work, powering automations, internal tools, AI agents, decision-making, and proactive workflows across Finance, Business Operations, Legal, etc.
Deploy AI agent armies: Claude/ChatGPT with MCPs configured so every teammate has AI working for them, not the other way around.
Squeeze value from our stack: Make the AI features in Slack, Linear, Notion, Ashby, etc. actually deliver.
Level up the team: Turn everyone at Lovable into AI power users. Document what works. Scale it.
Own it end-to-end: You build it, you maintain it, you improve it.

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: Finance Business Partner - Northern Europe to KUKA Nordic
jobs.description:
KUKA Nordic is looking for an experienced Finance Business Partner to support the Northern Europe organisation across the Nordics, Baltics, the UK and Ireland. This is a broad regional role where you will combine financial expertise with business partnering, working closely with senior stakeholders to strengthen financial performance, governance and business decision-making.  If you are motivated by combining financial expertise with commercial impact, KUKA Nordic offers the opportunity to make a real difference across Northern Europe.

As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting KUKA's Northern Europe organisation across the Nordics, Baltics, the UK and Ireland. As a member of the Northern Europe leadership team, you will combine financial expertise with commercial insight to support business decisions, strengthen financial governance and drive business performance across the region.
While transactional accounting and statutory reporting are managed by KUKA's Shared Service Center in Hungary, you will have the regional financial responsibility and act as the key link between the business, the SSC and Group Finance. Acting as a trusted Finance Business Partner to the Northern Europe leadership team and Country Managers.

Supporting strategic and commercial decision-making through financial analysis, business cases and performance insights.

Leading budgeting, forecasting, performance management, and KPI follow-up across the region.

Driving financial governance and ensuring high-quality financial reporting in collaboration with the Shared Service Center.

Coordinating audits, statutory compliance, tax matters and external stakeholders across multiple countries.

Monitoring working capital, cash flow and overall financial performance while identifying opportunities to improve business results.

Driving continuous improvements to finance processes and strengthening collaboration across the regional finance organisation.

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a passion for supply chain excellence, product introductions and supplier collaboration? Join Ascom in Gothenburg and play an important role in ensuring that our products are introduced and manufactured with the right quality, capacity and efficiency.
The role
As our Project Manager within Supply Chain, you will manage global supply chain projects from initial scope and planning through execution, follow-up and handover to the maintenance phase.
You will coordinate activities between main project and across Supply Chain, Quality, Purchasing, Logistics, R&D and other relevant functions, while working closely with our EMS and ODM suppliers. A key part of the role is ensuring that new products and manufacturing processes meet Ascom’s requirements regarding quality, capacity, cost, flexibility and lead time. The position is based at our office in Gothenburg and includes international collaboration and frequent travel to supplier sites.

Your responsibilities

Plan, lead and follow up supply chain projects, including scope, timelines, deliverables, risks and reporting.

Ensure quality assurance and on-time delivery throughout the project lifecycle.

Coordinate product introductions and secure a smooth transition into ramp-up, mass production and the maintenance phase.

Ensure that products are manufactured and repaired according to Ascom’s requirements for quality, capacity and lead time.

Manage project progress with EMS and ODM suppliers, including cost, quality management plans, yield, capacity, efficiency and pre-series activities.

Confirm that manufacturing processes and deliveries are developed, validated and ready for implementation.

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate activities across Supply Chain, Quality, Purchasing, Logistics, R&D, Marketing and other relevant functions.

Support the continuous improvement and standardization of supply chain project methods, processes and ways of working.

Contribute to a stable, secure and continuously improving global supply chain. 

What you bring

A master’s degree in mechanical engineering, electronic engineering or a related technical field.

Several years of experience within Supply Chain, Manufacturing and/or Quality Assurance.

Proven experience leading projects and cross-functional project teams.

Strong knowledge of project management methods, planning, risk management and stakeholder coordination.

Strong understanding of electronic manufacturing processes, production flow, test methods and industrialization.

Experience working with external manufacturing partners, preferably EMS or ODM suppliers.

Experience and strong knowledge in translating technical requirements into clear manufacturing, supplier and quality deliverables.

A good understanding of electronic manufacturing processes, including production, testing, logistics, purchasing and quality assurance.

Experience building and developing strong, long-term supplier relationships.

Knowledge of ERP systems and good proficiency in Microsoft 365.

An understanding of Lean Production principles and continuous improvement.

Excellent communication skills and professional fluency in English. 

Who you are
You are a structured, proactive and technically skilled Project Manager with a strong understanding of production processes, engineering drawings and technical specifications. You can quickly identify gaps, clarify requirements and drive practical solutions together with suppliers and internal teams. You communicate clearly, follow up systematically and balance technical detail with project progress.
You are comfortable in bringing people, processes and priorities together while navigating complex projects where requirements may evolve and where successful outcomes depend on collaboration across organisational and geographical boundaries.

You have strong technical skills, communicate clearly, build trust with suppliers and colleagues, and know how to influence decisions without relying on formal authority. You combine attention to detail with a strong understanding of the bigger picture and are motivated by improving quality, efficiency and ways of working.

Why join Ascom?
At Ascom, your work supports technology and communication solutions that help improve efficiency and decision-making in healthcare and other mission-critical environments. You will join an international organization where high quality, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Work in a global and cross-functional environment.

Collaborate with experienced colleagues and international suppliers.

Influence how new products are introduced and manufactured.

Contribute directly to supply chain quality, stability and performance.

Develop your expertise through challenging projects and continuous learning. 

Ready to join us?
If you are ready to take ownership of complex supply chain projects and contribute to the successful introduction of Ascom’s products, we would be happy to hear from you. Apply today and help us shape a reliable, efficient and future-ready supply chain.

Ascom is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated fairly and has the opportunity to succeed.

Volumental is a FitTech™ company used by footwear brands and retailers, matching people with shoes that truly fit through 3D scanning and machine learning.

 Where you fit in

We’re now looking for a Senior People Partner to shape what comes next.  What you’ll do

Partner with managers, using data, business understanding, and trusted relationships, to help them build engaged, high-performing teams.

Rethink recurring people work such as onboarding, probation, and development talks. Spot automation opportunities, and prototype solutions quickly.

Own and improve our people tooling (HiBob, Teamtailor, and our agents). Extract insights across People processes and use them to improve outcomes.

Run our company-wide cycles, such as salary reviews and engagement surveys, using our Manager Academy forum to prepare managers so each cycle runs smoothly.

Contribute team-level insights to workforce planning, organization decisions, engagement priorities and compensation decisions.

Balance employee experience, operational efficiency, and compliance in the everyday work that keeps everything running. 

What you'll need

6+ years of hands-on HR experience across the employee lifecycle, or deep expertise in at least three core areas of it (e.g., performance, compensation, onboarding, employee relations).

Experience implementing or redesigning company-wide performance, compensation, distributed workforce, or manager-enablement processes.

Experience adding features to or integrating an HRIS (HiBob or comparable).

Working fluency with AI tools and agents - you leverage AI tools in your day-to-day work (e.g., drafting, analysis, research) and know when to trust the output and when to check it.

A broad understanding of employment law.

Fluent English. 

How you work

You are pragmatic, structured, and enjoy building and iterating systems-level solutions for continuous improvement.

You get to the root of complex situations and make difficult people moments feel clear instead of chaotic.

You turn recurring questions and team-level signals into useful insights for managers.

You work well on your own and with others, and you can influence at every level.

You solve problems in the open, asking good questions, sharing your knowledge, and shipping first iterations sooner rather than presenting polished answers later.

You see things through, spotting what needs doing without being asked, and making it happen all the way to done.

Bonus - Not required, but nice to have

Experience at a tech scaleup, especially an engineering-heavy one.

Experience building automations or AI agents, using n8n, Zapier, Apps Script, MCP servers, or similar.

Familiarity with Swedish labor legislation.

Familiarity with remote work setups.

What we offer

Flexible work policy (at least 3 days from the office)

An AI-forward team that gives you the tools to work smarter

Personal learning budget and access to coaching

Occupational pension at ITP1 level

Flexible Public Holidays Policy

Options Program

Parental pay top-up

Wellness allowance

This is a full-time position based at our Stockholm headquarters, reporting to our Head of People & Culture. We welcome applicants from all background! If this role excites you but you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity
What if your next role puts you at the center of multi-million-dollar projects transforming the energy system? As a Senior Tender Manager, you will shape and execute bid strategies for large, complex HVDC pursuits, coordinating multidisciplinary teams and shaping solutions that bring together capabilities from across the Hitachi Energy portfolio. From defining the bid strategy to presenting a compelling technical and commercial offering to the customer, you will play a central role in winning the projects that will shape the future power grid.
“At Bid & Proposals, we lead the tendering of large-scale HVDC greenfield projects worldwide. My team focuses on the Northern European (NEU) market and is based in Sweden and the UK. Last year alone, our department secured 5 HVDC projects across the NEU region, giving our team a direct role in shaping Hitachi Energy’s business pipeline. We play a key role in driving business growth, supporting net-zero targets, and helping secure Europe’s energy supply..” – Louise Hellman, Hiring Manager.
Your base will be in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden, and you will be part of the HVDC product group within Hitachi Energy. HVDC technology has been on the market for the past 60 years and is used to transmit power over long distances with minimal losses, using overhead lines, underground and submarine cable systems.
Come as you are and be ready to learn. Bring your passion, your energy, and join a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Innovation.
How you´ll make an impact
You will be leading a Bid & Proposal team of technical, commercial, legal, tax and insurance experts from early pursuit stage to contract signing and execution handover.
