Would you like to take ownership of global trade compliance in an international, technology-driven environment? As Global Trade Compliance (GTC) Manager at Silex, you will develop our export control processes and help colleagues navigate trade compliance requirements in their daily work. With our headquarters and manufacturing operations in Sweden and ambitious expansion plans in the United States, you will play a key role in supporting our continued international growth.
Would you like to know more about Silex and what we do? Read more here.
In this role, you will:

Lead and develop global trade compliance, with a focus on export controls, sanctions, and international trade regulations, including US requirements.

Work with export controls under the Wassenaar Arrangement as a central part of the role, translating requirements into practical processes and guidance.

Coordinate export license applications and regulatory matters with authorities, including the Swedish Inspectorate of Strategic Products (ISP).

Oversee customer and end-use screening, export classifications, and compliance records in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.

Read and assess trade compliance requirements in customer and supplier agreements, identifying export control implications and supporting internal decision-making.

Develop and maintain trade compliance processes, guidelines, and documentation, and update procedures as requirements evolve.

Train and guide colleagues on export control and trade compliance, making complex requirements clear and actionable.

Your role in the organization
As our in-house specialist in global trade compliance, you will take ownership and establish clear processes, priorities, and ways of working. You will work closely with executive management and our Sales & Business Development, Operations, Finance, and Quality teams. The role combines hands-on export control work with the development of a structured GTC framework, helping the business make informed decisions as Silex grows internationally.
We are looking for someone who has:

Extensive experience working with global trade compliance in a technology-driven industrial company.

The ability to read and understand agreements and identify requirements relevant to export control and trade compliance.

A structured approach and the ability to translate complex trade compliance requirements into clear, practical business guidance.

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you also have:

Experience working with export controls under the Wassenaar Arrangement. This is highly valued, but not a strict requirement; it will be a central part of your work in this role.

Technical understanding that helps you assess products, processes, and related export control requirements.

Experience from an international company and with export controls related to the United States.

You are pragmatic, curious, and self-driven, with a hands-on mindset and the ability to see the bigger picture. You take initiative, bring structure, and are as comfortable getting things done yourself as you are developing better ways of working. You enjoy collaborating and make complex matters easy to understand.
What we offer you:

Close collaboration with management and specialist colleagues.

The opportunity to take ownership of and shape our global trade compliance processes and ways of working.

A key role supporting a leading technology company’s international growth.

Knowledge exchange with technical experts, connecting advanced MEMS technology with export control and trade compliance.

About Silex Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
The Silex team brings together talented, curious, visionary, and determined individuals to break new ground in the industry alongside customers, developing the latest process technology within MEMS for global applications. As part of this team, you will work with some of the world’s largest technology giants and innovation leaders in industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.
Additional Information We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.
We look forward to your application and to welcoming you on this exciting journey!

jobs.occupation: Information Security Compliance Manager Assa Abloy
jobs.description:
Shape the future of information security at ASSA ABLOY! Strengthen security and compliance across the Nordic region.
Are you ready to make a real impact on information security in a global organization?At ASSA ABLOY, you will strengthen security governance, risk management and compliance across the Nordic Business Area. Working with security specialists and business stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical improvements.Combining strategic influence with hands-on responsibility, you will work across complex IT and OT environments, supported by an international team and strong management commitment.
The Opportunity
Information security is business critical at ASSA ABLOY. As Nordic operations move towards more unified security practices, you will help align requirements, strengthen collaboration and improve security maturity across countries.
You will join a collaborative Security team and influence how security is implemented across the business. ASSA ABLOY is the global leader in access solutions, with nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 countries.
Your Challenge
As Information Security Compliance Manager, you will develop and implement a unified approach to security governance and compliance across the Nordic Business Area. You will work hands-on with audits, risk assessments and controls, translating standards and regulations into practical solutions.
Your key responsibilities include:
Strengthen security governance, processes and controls across Nordic operations.
Implement and maintain security practices aligned with ISO 27001, IEC 62443, NIS2, CRA and relevant protective security requirements.
Plan, conduct and follow up on internal, external and third-party security audits, driving remediation with technical teams.
Develop supplier security risk management, assessing new suppliers and prioritizing existing suppliers based on risk.
Conduct hands-on security assessments across IT and OT environments, production sites and critical suppliers.
Develop security policies, guidelines and awareness initiatives to strengthen security culture.
Participate in security incident response, preparedness, recovery and lessons learned.
Monitor security KPIs and KRIs, report to management and advise stakeholders across IT, procurement, legal and business.

You will have the opportunity to challenge existing approaches, take ownership and make a tangible difference to security across the Nordic organization.
The Team and Workplace
You will join an international Security team with colleagues across the Nordic region, including Sweden, Denmark and Finland. Collaboration is mainly digital, with the team aiming to meet in person approximately once a month.
The position can be based in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark or Estonia. The general guideline is three office days per week, with individual flexibility.
You will report to the Head of Risk Management and Security for the Nordic Business Area.
About You
We are looking for an information security professional combining governance, risk and compliance expertise with a practical, business-oriented approach. Your background may be in information security, cybersecurity, GRC or a related field. Hands-on experience and the ability to deliver improvements matter more than a specific number of years in the profession.
We believe you bring:
Practical experience in information security, risk management and compliance.
Applied knowledge of ISO 27001 and relevant standards and regulations, including IEC 62443, NIS2 and CRA.
Experience implementing controls, conducting audits and following up on security risks.
Understanding of IT and OT environments and industrial security challenges.
Ability to translate security requirements into workable business solutions.
Strong collaboration, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently across teams and countries, with strong written and spoken English.

Experience implementing ISO 27001 in a larger organization is particularly valuable. ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification, protective security knowledge and experience from manufacturing, technology or critical infrastructure are advantages.
Relevant education, certifications or equivalent practical experience are welcome.
You are curious, pragmatic and proactive. You build trust, take initiative and find solutions when answers are not obvious. You enjoy combining structure with hands-on work and collaborating across different functions and backgrounds.
Security requirements: The position requires a personal security pre-employment check, security interview and evaluation in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act (Säkerhetsskyddslagen 2018:585). The assessment takes place after the recruitment selection process and before an employment offer.
Let´s Connect!
We have chosen to work with Ada Digital in this hiring process. Their recruitment process focuses on transparency, inclusion and a fast moving candidate experience. And now we want to know more about you – on your own terms! To apply, please fill out the short form, briefly motivate why you are interested in the position, and attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile. No additional documentation is needed. You can then, in real-time, follow your application online as our recruiters are working with it. We work with a continues selection process which means we might hire a candidate before the final apply date, so apply already today! Interested and want to know more? Please contact our recruiter today.  We are looking forward to connecting soon!

jobs.occupation: Operations Manager Gävleborg, Dalarna, Uppland och Västmanland (vikariat)
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren ledare och som vill ta nästa steg i karriären på Espresso House?  
Rollen som Operations Manager (OM) erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera ett starkt affärsdriv med ett genuint engagemang för människor. I denna roll får du leda flera coffee shops inom ett distrikt, bygga starka team, skapa resultat och vara en nyckelperson i vår dagliga verksamhet. Vill du anta en ny utmaning, har flerårig erfarenhet av ledarskap och vill arbeta nära verksamheten och teamet? Då är det dig vi söker! 
Arbetsuppgifter 
Som Operations Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett distrikt bestående av flera coffee shops från marknaden Sweden North. Du arbetar nära dina Coffee Shop Managers (CSM) och leder, coachar och utvecklar dem för att säkerställa att våra gäster får en service i världsklass varje dag. Du driver både operativa och strategiska frågor och analyserar KPIer för att omsätta dem till konkreta åtgärder som utvecklar både människor och affär. 
Vi söker dig som: 

Har minst 5 års erfarenhet av att leda andra, gärna inom service eller retail 

Är en trygg och inspirerande ledare med starka kommunikativa färdigheter 

Har förmågan att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt 

Har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och ett lösningsorienterat mindset 

Vill jobba mot uppsatta mål och följa upp resultat, erfarenhet av att nå resultat genom andra är meriterande 

Har erfarenhet av rekrytering, utveckling och coachning av personal 

Har B-körkort, resa ingår i tjänsten.  

Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo och har ett stort engagemang för service, kvalitet och människor

Vad erbjuder vi dig? 
Vi erbjuder en vardag där engagemang, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Som Operations Manager har du en central roll med stort ansvar och utrymme att påverka. Hos oss får du arbeta nära verksamheten, driva förbättringar och utveckla både team och affär. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare och erbjuder goda möjligheter till både personlig och professionell utveckling. Du kan läsa mer om våra olika karriärmöjligheter på vår hemsida. 
Tjänsten är ett vikariat med start 1:a januari som sträcker sig till december 2027.  
Rekrytering sker löpande – skicka in din ansökan redan idag! 
 
 
English version
Are you an experienced leader ready to take the next step in your career at Espresso House? 
 
The role of Operations Manager (OM) offers an exciting and rewarding opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong business acumen with a genuine passion for people. In this role, you will oversee several coffee shops within a district, build strong teams, drive results, and play a key part in our daily operations. Are you ready for a new challenge, have several years of leadership experience, and want to work closely with the business and your teams? Then we’re looking for you! 
 
 
Responsibilities 
As an Operations Manager, you will have overall responsibility for a district consisting of several coffee shops, in Gävleborg, Uppland, Dalarna and Västmanland. You will work closely with your Coffee Shop Managers (CSMs), leading, coaching, and developing them to ensure our guests receive world-class service every day. You’ll be responsible for both operational and strategic initiatives and will analyze KPIs to translate them into concrete actions that drive both people development and business growth. 
 
 
We’re looking for someone who: 

Has at least 5 years of leadership experience, preferably in service or retail 

Is a confident and inspiring leader with strong communication skills 

Can work both hands-on and strategically 

Has a structured approach and a solution-oriented mindset 

Is goal-driven and results-oriented, with a proven track record of achieving results through others 

Has experience in recruitment, staff development, and coaching 

Holds a Category B driving license (travel is part of the role) 

Thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a strong commitment to service, quality, and people 

Have experience with working by concept standards in a consistent and passionate way. 

What do we offer you? 
We offer a dynamic work environment where engagement, collaboration, and growth are key. As an Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role with significant responsibility and the ability to make a real impact. You’ll work closely with the business, drive improvements, and develop both teams and operations. We invest in our people and offer great opportunities for both personal and professional development. You can read more about our career paths on our website. 
 
 
This is a temporary position with start 1st of January - December 2027.  
Recruitment is ongoing – submit your application today!

Lecturer in nursing with a specialisation in Healthcare for Children and Adolescents

The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
The Department of Health and Care Sciences conducts education and research focusing on healthcare, health and people's living conditions. We educate nurses, radiographers, specialist nurses and midwives, with the aim of meeting society's need for skilled and committed healthcare professionals.
Research at the Department covers a wide range of areas, with a shared foundation in person-centred and evidence-based care. We are nationally and internationally recognised as a leader in person-centred care, an approach that underpins our education, research and collaboration with healthcare providers.
The Department is part of Sahlgrenska Academy at the University of Gothenburg and is located at Campus Medicinareberget, close to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. This provides an environment characterised by interprofessional collaboration, strong links to clinical practice and high academic standards. The Department has approximately 1,200 students enrolled in first- and second-cycle programmes leading to professional qualifications in healthcare.
We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and with different experiences and perspectives. We value diversity and actively promote an inclusive and equal working environment where all employees have opportunities to thrive and develop. To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer flexible working arrangements.
The University of Gothenburg is a Swedish government agency, which means that employees benefit from favourable employment conditions, generous annual leave and an occupational pension scheme.
Read more about working at the University of Gothenburg on our website: Work at the University of Gothenburg

We are looking for a colleague with a strong interest in teaching and a commitment to course development and the advancement of teaching and learning. The successful applicant should be highly motivated to share knowledge with students and demonstrate a strong commitment to educational development.
The position will primarily be based in the Section for Care in Long-term Conditions. Teaching will take place at both first- and second-cycle levels. Depending on operational needs, duties may also involve collaboration with other sections within the Department.
Subject area 
Nursing with a specialisation in Healthcare for Children and Adolescents 
Subject area description 
Nursing is grounded in a humanistic view of the person and encompasses knowledge of human development, health and well-being in relation to birth, ill health, suffering and death. It aims to promote a meaningful life despite illness or disability and to enable a dignified death.
The focus of nursing is to alleviate suffering, promote health and prevent disease and ill health at individual, group and societal levels, where the applicant's clinical work experience should be applied in relevant teaching situations. Nursing addresses needs and challenges related to health, ill health and everyday life, while also recognising individuals’ resources and their ability to manage their life circumstances.
Duties 
The duties include teaching and assessment, course coordination, supervision of degree projects and supervision of students during clinical placements. The duties will primarily be carried out within the subject area of healthcare for children and adolescents at both first- and second-cycle levels. Teaching and other duties within the Department’s other courses and programmes are also included, particularly at first-cycle level in the Nursing Programme.
As course coordinator, responsibilities include planning courses, developing and coordinating learning outcomes, learning activities, assessment methods and assessment criteria in relation to course content, objectives and current research in higher education pedagogy. The role also involves ensuring the quality of education through validated evaluation methods.
Administrative duties related to educational activities constitute a significant part of the role.
The duties also include actively contributing to the development of the main field of study and collaborating with healthcare providers on clinical placements. Other duties may also be assigned, and the responsibilities associated with the position may change over time.
The position also involves actively contributing to the achievement of the Department’s objectives and operational plan. This includes supporting the development of the academic environment within the section’s Complete Academic Environment (KAM). In addition, all staff members are expected to participate in scheduled departmental meetings and joint activities.
The successful candidate will teach in both Swedish and English.
See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.

Fluent in English, and at least moderate in Swedish

Experience using AI-assisted tools in software development

Experience developing automated tests in Python

Experience working with Git

About WAHEGURU AB
WAHEGURU AB is an established Swedish restaurant company specialising in restaurant and food service operations.
As part of our plans to develop and expand our restaurant operations, we are seeking an experienced and professionally skilled Indian Cuisine Chef who can contribute specialist culinary knowledge, maintain high food quality standards, and support the continued development of our kitchen.
We are particularly interested in candidates with extensive practical experience in authentic North Indian and Punjabi cuisine, traditional tandoor cooking, Indian curry preparation, and professional restaurant kitchen operations.
Main Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
Independently preparing and cooking authentic Indian dishes according to traditional recipes and restaurant quality standards.

Managing daily kitchen preparation, including curry bases, marinades, sauces, spice blends, and food preparation.

Preparing traditional North Indian and Punjabi dishes, including Butter Chicken, Chicken Tikka Masala, Lamb Karahi, Rogan Josh, Korma, Jalfrezi, and other regional specialities.

Operating and managing traditional tandoor ovens for preparing Tandoori Chicken, Chicken Tikka, Seekh Kebab, Lamb Tikka, and freshly baked Indian breads.

Preparing different varieties of naan, roti, paratha, and other traditional Indian breads.

Preparing authentic biryani, rice dishes, lentil preparations, vegetarian curries, and Indian side dishes.

Ensuring consistency in flavour, texture, presentation, cooking methods, and portion sizes.

Developing and improving menu items while maintaining authentic Indian culinary traditions.

Managing ingredient preparation, stock rotation, food storage, and minimising kitchen waste.

Maintaining kitchen hygiene, food safety, temperature controls, and allergen procedures in accordance with Swedish food safety regulations.

Coordinating kitchen operations during busy lunch and dinner services.

Supporting and training other kitchen employees in Indian cooking techniques when required.

Assisting restaurant management with menu planning, food costing, and kitchen efficiency.

1. Indian Curry and Gravy Preparation
Candidates must have advanced practical knowledge of traditional Indian curry preparation, including the preparation of onion-tomato gravy bases, makhani sauces, cream-based curries, slow-cooked meat dishes, and vegetarian specialities.
2. Traditional Tandoor Cooking
Professional experience operating a traditional clay tandoor oven is required, including meat marination, temperature control, tandoori grilling, kebab preparation, and baking Indian breads.
3. Indian Spices and Traditional Cooking Techniques
Candidates must demonstrate strong knowledge of Indian spices, including cumin, coriander, turmeric, cardamom, cloves, fenugreek, garam masala, and traditional spice-roasting and tempering techniques.

Practical experience preparing Punjabi and North Indian restaurant dishes is particularly important. Candidates should understand traditional preparation methods and be able to maintain authentic flavours across different menu items.

Candidates must be able to organise kitchen preparation independently, maintain food quality during high-volume service, manage ingredients efficiently, and follow professional food hygiene procedures.

Minimum five years of documented professional experience working as an Indian cuisine chef or specialist cook in a commercial restaurant kitchen.

Demonstrated experience in North Indian and Punjabi cuisine.

Strong practical knowledge of tandoor cooking, curry preparation, Indian breads, and biryani.

Ability to independently prepare authentic Indian dishes from raw ingredients.

Experience working in a professional restaurant environment with established food safety and quality procedures.

Ability to manage multiple food orders efficiently during busy service periods.

Good understanding of kitchen hygiene, food handling, and allergen management.

Relevant culinary education, vocational training, or equivalent professional experience.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Basic English communication skills are desirable; Swedish language skills are advantageous.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for a responsible, organised, reliable, and quality-focused chef who takes pride in traditional Indian cooking.
The ideal candidate should be adaptable, capable of working under pressure, and motivated to contribute to the restaurant's long-term development.
What We Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish requirements and relevant industry standards.

A professional and supportive working environment.

Opportunity to contribute to menu development and restaurant growth.

Long-term professional development within an established Swedish restaurant business.

Application Procedure
Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV detailing their professional culinary experience, relevant qualifications, and previous employment references.
Applicants should clearly describe their practical experience in Indian curry preparation, tandoor cooking, Punjabi cuisine, and professional kitchen operations.

Manage user accounts, groups and permissions in Google Workspace, Slack and other central systems

Write and maintain documentation and support guides so colleagues can solve common problems themselves

Help improve our support process

Professional proficiency in English and Swedish

A chance to be part of a growth journey and help keep the leading Nordic marketplaces running

A collaborative work environment with colleagues who believe in CDON Group’s mission

A role where you learn from and work closely with the Head of IT, with room to grow your responsibilities

A competitive compensation package, including pension and insurance through Max Matthiessen and the MyBenefit portal

Monitor European capital-market developments, investment trends and financing opportunities.
Represent the company in discussions and negotiations with European investors, financial institutions and strategic partners.

Investment & Financing Management
Establish and continuously improve the company's local investment and financing processes in Europe.
Support the development and implementation of European investment and financing strategies.
Build and coordinate local investment and financing resources, including internal teams and external professional advisers.
Ensure investment and financing activities comply with applicable EU and Swedish regulations and internal governance requirements.
Identify, monitor and escalate material investment, financing and compliance risks to senior management.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:
A bachelor's degree or higher in finance, economics, business administration or a related field.
At least 4 years of experience in primary-market investment and financing, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience in European or Nordic markets.
Proven experience in cross-border equity fundraising, investment transactions and European local investment execution.
A strong understanding of European capital markets, investment practices and financing regulations, including relevant EU and Swedish requirements.
An established professional network among European private equity funds, venture capital firms, industrial investors or other relevant capital providers.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage investment and financing projects, including investor negotiations and transaction execution.
Strong commercial judgement, financial analysis, negotiation and project management skills.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to work effectively in an international business environment.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience in industrial investments, advanced manufacturing, new energy, lithium-ion batteries or related sectors.
Experience leading equity fundraising or strategic investment transactions involving European or Nordic investors.
Experience establishing local investment and financing functions or coordinating cross-border teams.
Familiarity with European industrial investment projects and international corporate structures.
Experience working with international headquarters, senior executives and multidisciplinary advisory teams.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where investment and financing activities are directly connected to manufacturing development, strategic expansion and long-term business growth in Europe.
The role offers significant responsibility and direct exposure to senior management, European capital markets and cross-border investment projects. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of key financing initiatives, develop investor relationships and contribute directly to the company's European development strategy.
We value professionalism, ownership, collaboration and straightforward communication. We believe good decisions come from different perspectives and encourage an open, respectful and inclusive working environment.

We have calendars that people count down to, toiletry bags made for the wishlist and tools that make everyday routines a little bit better. Here, you’re the one who makes them happen. 💭

Ever heard of Make up Store, Rebecca Stella, Waterclouds or Estelle & Thild? They’re part of our ever-growing family of own brands. Now we’re looking for a Product Manager with experience in both product development and purchasing to own one of our most trend-driven categories: tools and accessories. From spotting the next big thing to holding the finished product in your hand, it’s all yours.

What you’ll do

Fast trends, lots of launches and never a dull week. Over the year you’ll juggle lots of projects, big and small, often at the same time. You plan the assortment, negotiate with our suppliers in Asia and around the world and make sure every product lands with the right quality, cost and margin, right on time. Together with our design resources, you turn trends into products that feel spot on.

→ Take products all the way from brief to shelf: calendars, toiletry bags, tools, lovables and more→ Build the assortment and the strategy behind it, with trends as your compass→ Negotiate price and terms with our suppliers in Asia and other international markets, and push back when it matters→ Keep lots of projects moving at once, without losing track of a single detail→ Brief and steer design and packaging with our design resources, so every product shines in store and online→ Team up with product managers across every category, Brand Managers, Stores and Supply

Your category touches every other category in the team, so you’ll never be short of people to work with.

Who are you?

You spot a trend before it hits the feed. You love the pace, you love the details, and you’re not shy at the negotiating table. A beauty background? Not needed. Fashion, accessories or gifts work just as well, as long as trends have been calling the shots.

What you bring:

3+ years in both product development and purchasing of trend-driven consumer products, in fashion, accessories, beauty or similar
Strong product knowledge and a gut feeling for what’s next
Experience planning an assortment and thinking strategically about it
The confidence to negotiate and challenge suppliers on price and terms
The ability to project manage yourself and keep every detail in check, even when the to-do list is long
Great communication skills and energy from working with lots of people
Fluent English, written and spoken. Swedish is a plus, not a must

Bonus points if you’ve worked directly with suppliers in Asia. Everything Lyko-specific, we’ll teach you on the job.

At Lyko Own Brands we have a lot of fun and get to be creative, but it takes focus and a high pace to keep it all on track. So we’re looking for someone who loves owning both the big picture and the small stuff.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway! Who you are and what you can do matters more to us than your CV.

The practical stuff

This is a permanent position with a six-month probationary period, starting as soon as possible or by agreement. You’ll be based at our office on Sveavägen in Stockholm and report to Elisabet Kernell, Head of Product & Sourcing Own Brands.

We believe great, inclusive cultures are built by people actually meeting and working together, so we’ve landed on what we call “Business First”: at least three days a week at the office, the other two up to you, as long as it works with the needs of the business. A pretty good balance, if you ask us.

Using AI? Totally fine!

Feel free to use AI to polish your wording, we do it too sometimes! But it’s you we want to get to know, not your chatbot. So keep the content your own, with your experiences and thoughts. If you move forward, we’ll dive deeper into your answers later in the process. And just to be clear: a person always makes the call on who moves forward 😊

Apply without CV or cover letter

If this sounds exciting and you’re eager to apply, go ahead and do it ASAP! It’s quick and easy. No CV or cover letter needed. Instead, we ask you to answer a few questions that are valuable for us in our selection process. Please apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Questions about the role? Contact Elisabet Kernell, Head of Product & Sourcing Own Brands, at elisabet.kernell@lyko.com. We look forward to receiving your application! 🌟

Lyko is a haircare and beauty specialist with the ambition to transform the industry.

Who We Are
Allgon is a leading manufacturer of wireless machinery control systems, delivering customized solutions to companies across the industrial sector. Our customers engage with us through our subsidiaries Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica. We are passionate about developing industrial remote control solutions that enhance safety and efficiency worldwide.
You will join our Product Compliance & QESG team, which works with product compliance, quality, environment, sustainability and management systems. We are a small, close-knit team spread across Gothenburg, Björbo and Málaga. You report to the department manager at the head office in Gothenburg.
The role can be based in Gothenburg, Björbo/Borlänge or Málaga, Spain. You will work closely with colleagues across Allgon’s global organization.

About the Role
As a Certification Engineer at Allgon, you make sure our products obtain and keep all required approvals before and after market release. This covers radio, RF exposure, EMC, electrical safety and functional safety. You will also support the work to meet new requirements under the EU Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity legislation.
You will independently manage certification projects, from updates to existing approvals to new approvals in development projects. You will work closely with R&D, product management, quality, manufacturing, external test laboratories, certification bodies and our subsidiaries.
Key Responsibilities:
Interpret and apply EU and international regulations and standards (RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, FCC, ISED and others)
Support R&D with functional safety: safety requirements, risk assessment, PL/SIL verification and safety documentation (ISO 13849, IEC 62061, IEC 61508)
Drive product cybersecurity compliance (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, the Cyber Resilience Act and the Machinery Regulation)
Plan and run certification projects
Coordinate testing with external laboratories, and work with TCB/FCB, Notified Bodies and authorities
Review test reports, technical files, declarations of conformity and product labeling
Manage updates, renewals and maintenance of existing approvals
Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on our products
Provide certification input during new product development and market expansion
Support customer service and subsidiaries with certification expertise

What We’re Looking For
You are a detail-oriented and analytical engineer with a strong interest in product certification and regulatory requirements. You enjoy working independently, take ownership of your tasks and are comfortable coordinating many stakeholders. With a structured approach and clear communication, you turn complex requirements into practical actions that support product development and market access.
Key qualifications include:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
Experience in product certification, regulatory affairs or a similar role
Strong knowledge of RF and EMC standards and global wireless certification requirements
Knowledge of and practical experience with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 62061/IEC 61508), e.g. risk assessment and PL/SIL determination and verification
Experience working with EU and international regulations (e.g. RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation, FCC, ISED, MIC)
Ability to review and interpret test reports and certification documentation
Understanding of PLM systems and certification documentation processes
Fluent English, spoken and written. Swedish, Spanish or other languages are also a plus.

It is a plus if you have:
A functional safety certification
Experience with product cybersecurity (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, CRA)
Experience with RF exposure assessment and TCB/FCB processes
Experience with marine/offshore type approvals from classification societies (e.g. DNV, Lloyd’s Register)
Project management experience

What We Offer
Work with cutting-edge, high-quality products in a dynamic environment
A key role at a time when functional safety, the Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity are reshaping our industry
Opportunities for continuous professional growth and career development.
A challenging and rewarding role within a growing organization
Collective agreement (working in Sweden), including 9 extra days off per calendar year through reduced working hours
3,000 SEK annually for wellness benefits (working in Sweden)

About Allgon
Allgon is a Swedish company specializing in industrial radio control, with a strong track record in wireless technology innovation. Through our brands Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica, we have built a global presence, employing over 470 professionals and presence in 26 countries.
We offer an exciting work environment in a profitable and growing organization with a strong technical focus. Despite our global reach, we maintain the close-knit atmosphere of a smaller company, where every employee has a voice and can influence the projects they work on.
At Allgon, sustainability is a key priority—ecologically, socially, and financially. We are committed to attracting passionate individuals who share our vision of a safer, more efficient world through advanced wireless technology.
Last application date is 5 January 2027. Selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before last application date. Welcome with your application already today!

 Designing assurance methodologies for evaluating control effectiveness, including testing approaches, effectiveness ratings and evidence models.
 Creating a reporting structure that enables visibility into compliance status, control effectiveness, gaps and exposure across the organization.

 Supporting audits, assessments and regulatory reviews by providing a consistent and reliable control framework.

 Strong experience working with cybersecurity regulations and frameworks such as NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, NIST CSF or similar.
 Experience harmonizing requirements from multiple sources into a single control framework or baseline.
 Experience defining, maintaining or assessing cybersecurity controls.

 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Fluent English, spoken and written.
 A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician for an International MedTech Company!
jobs.description:
Are you a service-oriented problem solver? On behalf of our client, we are currently looking for an IT Support Technician in Stockholm for a 1-year temporary position. Become a key player at a global MedTech company whose tools make a difference in healthcare. Apply today!
About the role
Our client is an established and innovative Swedish medical technology company that develops digital decision-support tools to facilitate and ensure quality in assessments and treatment follow-ups within neuropsychiatry. With headquarters in Stockholm and operations in the UK and the USA, among other countries, the company is characterized by an open, multicultural, and family-like atmosphere where technology and societal benefit go hand in hand.
As one of the colleagues on the team is going on study leave, we are now looking for a replacement for a one-year temporary position to secure daily IT delivery, starting with a thorough handover in December.
In the role of IT Support Technician, you will serve as the hub for daily technical support at the Stockholm office, while also supporting colleagues at the London office remotely. You will work broadly with 1st line support (with the opportunity to take on 2nd line tickets as you grow into the role) in a mixed Windows and macOS environment. At the Stockholm office, there is an open "digital workplace" area where employees can drop by for quick assistance, making you a visible and appreciated point of contact for the entire organization. In addition to your colleagues at the office, you will collaborate closely with your own international IT team—consisting of colleagues in Stockholm, the UK, and the USA—holding weekly check-ins to distribute workload and drive tickets forward.
You are offered:
An international and welcoming workplace where you contribute to products that make a real difference for both healthcare providers and patients.
The opportunity to work broadly in a modern Microsoft environment with great prospects for technical development toward 2nd line support and automation.
A solid introduction at our client's company with a structured and thorough handover from your current colleague.

Work tasks
Daily Support & Ticket Management: Provide 1st line IT support (and 2nd line, depending on experience) on-site in Stockholm and remotely for the UK, as well as manage incoming tickets in Jira Service Management.  
User & Device Management: Take responsibility for onboarding and offboarding, hardware and license management (asset management), and administration in Microsoft 365, Entra ID (SSO), and Intune.  
Troubleshooting & IT Security: Troubleshoot in Windows and macOS, trace phishing emails in Microsoft Defender, escalate incidents, and work with existing scripts in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.

We are looking for
Has 3–5 years of experience working in IT support or a similar IT service role.
Has a strong technical understanding and practical experience working in a Microsoft environment, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Defender.
Has strong troubleshooting skills in both Windows and macOS.
Has a strong security mindset and understands the importance of regulatory compliance and data security.
Has very good proficiency in English, both spoken and written, as it is the corporate language and you will communicate daily with colleagues in the UK and the USA. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus.

It is considered meritorious if you have:
Experience with ticket management in Jira Service Management.
Basic knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or AI tools to streamline workflows.
Previous experience from a regulated industry, such as MedTech or Life Science.

To succeed in this role, you have the following personal qualities:
We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and are looking for someone who is distinctly service-oriented, helpful, and unpretentious. Since you will meet colleagues both via the ticketing system and face-to-face at the office, you are communicative, patient, and able to explain technical solutions in a pedagogical way to people without a technical background. Furthermore, you are structured, thorough, and enjoy collaborating in an international team where everyone pitches in to solve tasks.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the future of physical retail and turning strategy into tangible customer experiences? Do you understand what makes a store format commercially relevant, operationally strong and scalable across markets? 
We are looking for a Format Developer to join our Retail Strategy team within Commercial at H&M. In this role, you will work at the intersection of strategy and execution, helping shape how our stores evolve and ensuring that strategic direction translates into relevant, concrete and commercially viable store formats. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As a Format Developer, you will: 
Translate overarching retail strategies into tangible store formats and concrete format developments. 
Lead and coordinate the creation of new store formats and specific developments to increase relevance and performance in our store portfolio. 
Partner with teams within and beyond retail to ensure cohesive end-to-end execution and define the project pipeline across initiatives together with relevant stakeholders. 
Develop clear briefs and guiding principles that enable different functions and markets to move from direction to execution. 
Monitor store and format performance, identify opportunities and capture learnings from implementation. 
Support global rollouts through clear documentation, playbooks, guidelines and rollout principles. 
Contribute hands-on throughout projects, ensuring that strategic intent is translated into solutions that work in the reality of our stores. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
This is a broad and highly collaborative role. You will work across Commercial, global functions and Sales Markets, connecting perspectives across areas such as customer experience, assortment, store operations, interior and technology. You will act as a bridge between strategic development and operational execution, bringing different stakeholders together around a clear direction for our physical retail experience. 
The role reports to the Head of Retail Strategy.
WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
A background as a senior retail professional, with a strong understanding of how physical stores operate and how to generate commercial impact and create great customer experiences. 
Experience driving complex, cross-functional projects or initiatives from direction through implementation. 
A strong understanding of store concepts, formats and the different components that shape the physical retail experience. 
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to align multiple functions and perspectives. 
The ability to translate broad strategic direction into concrete briefs, principles and actions. 
A commercial and customer-oriented mindset, combined with an understanding of operational realities. 
The ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity and create structure in complex topics. 
Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
Experience from fashion retail or another large, complex retail organization is highly relevant. Experience from H&M or a similar global retail environment is an advantage given the cross-functional nature and complexity of the role. 

And people who are… 
Curious, pragmatic and outcome-oriented. 
Comfortable working across organizational boundaries and challenging, influencing and bringing people with you. 
Able to connect the right perspectives, challenge assumptions and move initiatives forward, without needing to own every area yourself. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. An example of our benefits: 
25% staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET). 
H&M Incentive Program – HIP. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm. Please send your CV in English as soon as possible. (For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with your manager before applying.) 
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Would you like to work for a growing company devoted to making a real difference in drug development through groundbreaking imaging? A place that is constantly moving forward, with great science, great people, and an informal atmosphere? Then keep reading.
At Antaros Medical, we use advanced imaging methods such as MRI and PET to design and deliver clinical trials for decision-making and differentiation in drug development. We value competence and development as much as ideas and solutions. Relationships and trust are key to success, and we currently have around 160 employees across Sweden and the US.
As part of our continued growth, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to join our commercial team in Sweden.
Role overview
As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting our commercial operations and ensuring a seamless customer journey. Working closely with Business Development, Project Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, you will coordinate proposals, contracts, budgets, and commercial documentation while helping maintain efficient and scalable ways of working.  
The position combines proposal development, pricing and budget preparation, contract administration, commercial operations support, and process improvement activities.
You will be reporting to our Director Sales Operations, based in Uppsala. 
This role offers an opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of an international life science company while supporting partnerships with global pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
Key responsibilities
Commercial & Proposal Coordination

Prepare and coordinate proposals, budgets, and commercial documentation.

Support Business Development throughout the customer lifecycle.

Maintain and improve proposal templates, pricing tools, and supporting materials.

 Contract & Documentation Management

Support administration of contracts, change orders, and related commercial documentation.

Maintain document control, tracking, and compliance with internal processes.

 Sales Operations & Process Excellence

Support CRM administration, reporting, and commercial data management.

Help improve processes, increase efficiency, and drive operational excellence across functions.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders. 
You are organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with strong communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with numbers, budgets, and complex Excel-based calculations, and you are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a growing organization where your contribution can make a real difference.
 Requirements

2-4 years of experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Proposal Management or similar

Experience from a clinical research organization (CRO), imaging services provider or another project-based service organization.

Experience with pricing, budgeting, and proposal development.

Experience managing and coordinating proposals, budgets, contracts, or other commercial documentation involving multiple stakeholders.

Experience working with commercial agreements such as MSAs, SOWs, Change Orders, or similar contracts.

Bachelor's degree in business administration, Life Sciences, Project Management, or related field.

Strong Excel skills, including working with complex calculations and data, as well as proficiency in Microsoft 365.

Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

 Advantageous

Experience within Life Science, biotech, pharmaceutical, or healthcare environments.

Experience with medical imaging or imaging-based clinical research.

Experience supporting global customers and international commercial teams.

Experience driving process improvements and implementing new ways of working.

Experience working with CPQ (configure/price/quote) and Sales CRM systems

 Are you interested?
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! 
Please submit your application, including your CV, via the link below. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For questions about the role, please contact Malin Hagström, HR Business Partner, at malin.hagstrom@antarosmedical.com.
This is a permanent full-time position with a six-month probationary period. Applications are handled exclusively through Teamtailor. The recruitment process is managed directly by Antaros Medical, and we kindly ask recruitment and staffing agencies not to contact us regarding this position. 
About Antaros Medical
At Antaros Medical, we combine ground-breaking imaging with profound experience in drug development and deep knowledge of disease mechanisms. We are specialized in cardiorenal & metabolic diseases and oncology. We have a global network of collaboration partners and customers, including both Big Pharma and Biotechs, and several European collaboration initiatives such as Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI) and COST.
Antaros Medical has delivered small complex, mechanistic studies as well as multi-center clinical trials worldwide utilizing our innovative imaging methods. Our global headquarter and imaging Corelab are based in Sweden, and we have recently opened a subsidiary in the US. If you want to find out more about our company, go to our website: www.antarosmedical.com
Our culture is our people, and our values makes us everything that we are. Please feel free to have a look upon our Culture Handbook to get to know us even more: Our culture - Antaros Medical.

jobs.occupation: Safety Engineer for the Engine Management System
jobs.description:
Role Summary
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden 
Would you like to combine hands-on safety engineering with complex technical challenges—and see your work contribute to vehicles across the TRATON Group? 
As a Safety Engineer for our Engine Management System, you will conduct safety analyses and define safety measures to address risks arising from malfunctions in electrical/electronic systems and mechanical powertrain components. You will work with engine and aftertreatment control systems in a domain where safety, vehicle performance and environmental impact are closely connected. You will be close to product decisions through participation in approval forums and system-level decision meetings.
Job Responsibilities 
Your tasks will include:
Creation of structured, systematic techniques such as Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
Development of technical safety concepts for the engine and after treatment systems.
Contribute to the further development of safety processes and culture at the Powertrain Controls department.

 
Perform safety analysis like FTA (Fault Tree Analysis) and DFA (Dependent Failure Analysis)
Who You Are 
We are looking for a curious and analytical professional with a strong passion for functional safety and a collaborative mindset. You thrive in cross-functional environments, take ownership of your work, and enjoy solving complex problems in a structured and methodical manner. You can drive topics independently and confidently navigate technical discussions with a variety of stakeholders. 
Experience working with functional safety and leading technical development activities is highly valued. Familiarity with industry standards, particularly ISO 26262 (with emphasis on Parts 4, 5, and 6), as well as experience developing products in regulated environments, would be a strong advantage. Knowledge of software and hardware safety monitoring concepts is also desirable. 
Additional qualifications include an interest in programming, experience with Python, and an understanding of engines and vehicle systems. You hold a degree in engineering or equivalent and possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Swedish, or a willingness to learn the language, is considered an advantage. A Category C/D driving license is also beneficial. 
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
This Is Us 
You will join a team of 14 engineers working across System Ownership, Functional Safety, Safety Engineering, Requirements Engineering and Cybersecurity. Together, we support the Engine and Aftertreatment Control Systems—among Scania's most advanced real-time control systems—and help ensure compliance with functional safety standards and cybersecurity regulations in markets including the EU, China, and the United States. 
Our responsibilities span several disciplines, but we work towards a shared goal. We take ownership of our respective areas while helping each other solve problems and succeed with our deliveries. There is always someone to discuss a challenging technical question with, explore a different perspective or ask for support. 
We value an open environment where you can ask questions, share ideas and learn from others. Our different cultural and educational backgrounds bring a range of perspectives, and knowledge sharing and personal development are important parts of how we work. Here, you will have room to deepen your expertise while contributing to the team's collective knowledge and results. 
Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.
TRATON Offers 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
Application 
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-03. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Elisabet Larsson Landström, Unit Head, elisabet.larsson.landstrom@scania.com 
We look forward to your application!

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story through science, innovation, and strong partnerships. We are now looking for a QA Supplier Quality Specialist to join our Supplier Control team in Uppsala. This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal stakeholders across the organization to ensure compliance, quality, and continuous improvement throughout our supply chain.
You will represent Galderma in supplier audits and quality discussions, acting as a trusted quality partner while contributing to the development of our supplier quality processes.
If you enjoy building relationships, driving quality excellence, and taking ownership of complex supplier-related quality activities in a global and regulated environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.
 
Your team
You will join Galderma's Supplier Quality team, a collaborative and highly engaged group within Quality Assurance. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers consistently meet Galderma's quality and compliance expectations.
Working closely with colleagues across QA, Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs, you will contribute to building a robust supplier network that supports both operational excellence and patient safety.
 
Your mission
As QA Supplier Quality Specialist, your mission is to ensure that Galderma's suppliers and external partners operate in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements. Through proactive supplier oversight, audits, quality agreements, and continuous improvement initiatives, you will help safeguard product quality throughout the supply chain.
You will act as a trusted quality partner, representing Galderma in supplier interactions and helping to strengthen the quality culture both internally and externally.
 
Key Responsibilities
Manage supplier qualification, supplier control, and supplier lifecycle activities.
Plan, conduct, and follow up quality audits of suppliers, service providers, and contract manufacturers.
Represent Galderma during supplier audits and quality reviews.
Act as a key point of contact for supplier quality-related questions and support suppliers in meeting Galderma's quality expectations.
Analyze audit outcomes, identify compliance gaps related to GMP and GDP requirements, and ensure timely follow-up of observations and corrective actions.
Review and manage supplier change notifications and assess potential quality impacts.
Investigate and manage deviations related to materials and external services.
Establish, maintain, and update quality agreements with suppliers and business partners.
Drive continuous improvements within supplier quality processes and programs.
Collaborate closely with Procurement, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MS&T), Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other Quality functions to ensure robust supplier oversight.
Build strong and sustainable relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

 
Your profile
We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance professional who enjoys working in a role with a high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and external exposure. As a trusted representative of Galderma, you will interact closely with suppliers and partners, lead quality discussions, and contribute to building strong and sustainable supplier relationships.
You are comfortable taking ownership of complex quality matters, investigating issues, and driving activities through to completion. At the same time, you understand the importance of collaboration and are able to build strong relationships across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.
To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and self-driven professional who combines a structured and analytical approach with sound judgement and a continuous improvement mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by delivering high-quality results.
 
Required Qualifications

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our open-minded team where collaboration and support are at the heart of what we do! In this dynamic role, you will engage in designing structural and layout solutions for our gas turbine packages, producing manufacturing data in Siemens NX along with essential technical documentation. You will play a crucial role in strengthening our capability within electrical integration by working closely with the Electrical Engineering department. Your efforts will support the placement and routing of electrical installations, such as junction boxes, cable trays, conduits, and cable routing within our NX environment. This position offers a unique opportunity to blend traditional Structure & Layout work with a growing specialization in electrical integration, helping to shape future methodologies alongside our electrical experts.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Design structural and layout solutions for gas turbine packages while producing manufacturing data and technical documentation in Siemens NX.
Develop and maintain 3D layouts, installation concepts, and design documentation for package structures and equipment arrangements.
Drive the integration of electrical installations within the package layout, including junction boxes, cable routing, cable trays, conduits, and installation supports.
Collaborate closely with Electrical Engineering to ensure electrical solutions are efficiently incorporated into the overall product design.
Participate in the development and maintenance of product standards, design guidelines, and best practices within Structure & Layout and electrical integration.
Work with procurement, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams to develop robust, cost-effective, and manufacturable technical solutions.
Support development projects and customer orders by delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements, schedules, and quality expectations.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on electrical routing methodologies, NX design processes, and installation concepts.

What You Bring
A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Proficiency in Siemens NX for design and documentation.
Experience in structural design and layout, particularly in the context of gas turbine packages.
Relevant knowledge of electrical systems, including familiarity with electrical integration concepts and installation practices.
Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
A commitment to delivering high-quality designs that meet project requirements.
Advanced English proficiency is required.

About the Team
The Structure & Layout team consists of 19 skilled engineers specializing in structural engineering and layout design for complex energy projects. Organized into two collaborative teams, we foster a close-knit and supportive work environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual support are key to our success. We place a strong emphasis on personal and professional development, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to grow. This commitment to quality and continuous improvement creates a culture where individuals thrive while delivering high-quality solutions.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Scientist (temp cover)
Analytical Chemistry and HPLC
Nordic BioAnalysis AB | Södertälje, Sweden
Are you an experienced analytical scientist with strong hands-on HPLC expertise? Join NBAB and take a key role in developing robust analytical methods and delivering reliable results for pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device clients.
About NBAB
Nordic BioAnalysis AB (NBAB) is a GMP-certified analytical laboratory with ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation for a defined scope of methods. Established in 2010 and based in Södertälje, we provide chemical, biochemical, microbiological and molecular biological analysis of materials and products, from development through to commercialisation.
Our international team brings together experienced scientists, technicians and project managers committed to quality, scientific integrity and responsive customer service.
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Scientist with at least five years of hands-on analytical laboratory experience in a GMP and/or ISO-regulated environment, with a strong focus on HPLC.
This is a practical laboratory role with substantial responsibility for HPLC method development, transfer, validation, troubleshooting and routine analysis. You will work independently, contribute scientific expertise to customer projects and help colleagues resolve analytical challenges.
You will join a small, collaborative company where your expertise and ideas can influence laboratory practices and the company’s development.
Your responsibilities
·      Develop and optimise HPLC methods, including sample preparation, separation conditions, detection and system suitability.
·      Plan, execute and document analytical method transfers, validation and verification studies.
·      Perform routine HPLC analysis of raw materials, active substances and finished products to support quality control, release testing and stability studies.
·      Investigate chromatographic issues, including poor separation, retention-time shifts, peak shape, carryover and inconsistent results.
·      Perform routine analysis such as TOC, Water content with KF and other wet chemistry analysis.
·      Evaluate analytical data, interpret results and prepare clear protocols, reports and laboratory records with full traceability.
·      Contribute to laboratory investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective actions in collaboration with quality colleagues.
·      Take responsibility for assigned instruments, including maintenance, calibration and qualification activities.
·      Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with colleagues.
·      Collaborate with project and quality teams to deliver accurate results within agreed timelines.
Your experience and qualifications
Essential
·      At least five years of hands-on experience in an analytical laboratory operating under GMP and/or an ISO laboratory quality system, particularly ISO/IEC 17025.
·      Extensive practical HPLC and GC experience, with demonstrated ability to develop, transfer, validate and troubleshoot methods, as well as perform routine analysis.
·      A university degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences or a closely related discipline.
·      Strong understanding of laboratory documentation, data integrity, traceability and working to approved procedures.
·      The ability to plan and perform laboratory work independently, assess results critically and solve analytical problems.
·      Full professional proficiency in English.
An advantage
·      Experience with HPLC-UV and HPLC-RI.
·      Experience with reversed-phase, size-exclusion or ion-exchange chromatography.
·      Experience with pharmacopoeial methods and pharmaceutical or medical device testing.
·      Additional skills in Karl Fischer titration, TOC, IR, UV/Vis or wet chemistry.
·      Experience mentoring colleagues or coordinating analytical projects.
·      Knowledge of Swedish.
Who you are
You are structured, curious and thorough, with a practical approach to problem-solving. You take ownership of your work and communicate clearly with colleagues and customers. You enjoy combining independent laboratory work with close teamwork. You are comfortable handling varied assignments and changing priorities while maintaining high standards of quality and documentation.
What we offer
·      An ambitious international team with close collaboration across scientific disciplines.
·      Opportunities to deepen your expertise and broaden your analytical skills.
·      Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how we work.
·      A laboratory environment with equipment maintained and qualified to GMP requirements.
·      Clear company and individual goals supporting quality, business performance and professional development.
Location and employment
The position is based at Biovation Park, Södertälje. Initially this will be a temporary position for a six-month period. However, there might be opportunities to extend if business operations allow so.  Applicants must have the right to work in Sweden.
Apply
Send your CV and a brief introduction to info@norbab.com, using the subject line “Scientist – Temp Cover”. Please describe your experience in GMP and/or ISO-regulated laboratories and give examples of your hands-on work with HPLC method development, transfer, validation and troubleshooting.
