About the job
Alfa Laval is investing in digital planning capabilities to create a more connected and consistent supply chain. Today, planning is supported by a mix of solutions, including Blue Yonder, SO99+, Inact Now and Excel. As Product Manager, Supply Chain Planning, you will shape the product vision and roadmap that help bring these capabilities together, align them with business processes and deliver greater value across the organization. 
 
Working at the intersection of supply chain, business and technology, you will connect digital opportunities with real planning needs. You'll partner with business leaders, planners, architects, analysts and delivery teams to define priorities, guide implementation and improve how Alfa Laval plans demand, supply, production, inventory and service parts. A key challenge will be determining what belongs in the ERP solutions and what is best supported by planning platforms outside the ERP. 
 
Key responsibilities 
Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and roadmap for supply chain planning, aligned with business priorities and long-term objectives. 
Prioritize the product backlog, build business cases and track whether expected benefits are realized. 
Lead the planning product area across demand planning, S&OP/IBP, master planning, supply and production planning, inventory and replenishment, and service parts planning. 
Connect digital capabilities with business processes, including assessing what should be delivered in the ERP and what should be built cross ERPs. 
Translate business needs into clear digital requirements, features and epics. 
Align stakeholders across Business Units, Operations, Service, IT and senior management. 
Guide delivery in Agile and waterfall environments, working closely with the Product Owner and delivery teams. 
Promote standardization and evaluate new approaches, including AI/ML-based and autonomous planning. 
Support governance, training, adoption and continuous improvement so users can realize the value of new solutions and ways of working. 

 
Who are you
You are an analytical, business-minded partner who can understand how planning works in practice, identify where improvements will matter and turn complex needs into clear priorities. You build trust across functions and cultures through strong communication, facilitation and collaboration. Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving digital products, you take initiative, challenge conventional thinking constructively and bring stakeholders together to make sound decisions and achieve shared goals.
 
What you know
To succeed in this role, you bring broad supply chain experience and the ability to lead transformation across business processes, people and technology. We believe our ideal candidate has:
Several years of experience in supply chain planning on the business side, for example as a planner, planning manager or in a comparable role.
A broad understanding of end-to-end supply chain planning, including demand, supply, inventory, production and capacity planning.
Proven experience leading or contributing to a supply chain planning implementation or transformation, with strong project management skills and experience working in both Agile and waterfall environments.
The ability to translate business problems and requirements into clear product needs and technology-enabled solutions.
Experience with planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, SO99+, Microsoft D365 Supply Chain Planning or similar, and an understanding of ERP landscapes such as D365, Jeeves or Movex.
Experience with planning across manufacturing or OEM sites and distribution centers, including spare parts and service planning.
A bachelor's or master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
Professional fluency in English.

It is considered an advantage if you have:
Experience with S&OP/IBP, demand sensing, inventory optimization or advanced planning and scheduling.
Knowledge of supply chain process frameworks such as APQC, SCOR or similar.
A relevant certification such as CSCP or CPIM; PMP, PSPO or SAFe certification is also an advantage.

 
What's in It for You?
You'll have the opportunity to shape an evolving digital product area and influence how planning capabilities support Alfa Laval's business, not just how systems are implemented.
Help connect planning processes with current and future digital capabilities.
Influence the balance between ERP and specialized planning solutions.
Explore how emerging technologies could improve planning and decision-making.

About the role
As Senior Fraud Specialist, you will play a central role in our efforts to prevent, detect and investigate fraudulent activity across our Swedish and Finnish markets.
You will take ownership of complex and high-exposure fraud investigations, make independent decisions within your mandate and act as a senior point of expertise for the team. In addition to your operational responsibilities, you will provide quality assurance through four-eyes reviews, support and coach colleagues, and contribute to improving our fraud detection rules and processes.
Working closely with the Head of AFC, Fraud Specialists, Operations, Customer Care and AML, you will help ensure that we maintain strong controls while continuously adapting to new and evolving fraud patterns.
This is a senior specialist position with professional leadership responsibilities, but no formal line-management responsibility.
Key responsibilities

Lead complex fraud investigations, including account takeovers, APP scams, mule networks, organized fraud and cross-border transactions.

Make independent decisions on fraud cases, including account blocks, contract terminations and police reports within your mandate.

Perform four-eyes reviews and quality assurance of investigations and decisions made by other Fraud Specialists.

Identify emerging fraud trends and typologies, translating insights into improvements in our fraud prevention capabilities.

Lead the preparation, testing and documentation of changes to our Hawk AI detection rules and monitoring models.

Analyze transaction data and detection performance to identify opportunities to improve our controls.

Act as a subject matter expert, supporting and coaching colleagues in investigative methods, fraud typologies and documentation.

Prepare fraud reporting and support regulatory reporting requirements.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders, other financial institutions and law enforcement when needed.

Who you are
We believe you are an experienced fraud professional who combines strong investigative capabilities with sound judgement and a structured approach to decision-making. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex situations, making independent assessments and guiding others through challenging cases.
You are analytical, detail-oriented and curious about how fraud patterns evolve. At the same time, you understand the importance of balancing risk management, customer experience and commercial considerations.
You also enjoy sharing your knowledge, challenging existing ways of working and helping a team continuously improve.
What we are looking for

At least four years of experience in fraud prevention, fraud detection or financial crime, with substantial hands-on experience in operational fraud investigations.

Strong knowledge of fraud typologies such as account takeover, APP scams, SIM swapping, bust-out fraud, mule networks and business email compromise.

Experience working with automated fraud monitoring systems, ideally Hawk AI, including detection rules, testing and calibration.

Understanding of transaction monitoring, device intelligence and session intelligence.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently investigate and assess transaction data.

Experience reviewing colleagues' work, providing guidance or training others is highly valued.

Good understanding of relevant financial regulations, payment services legislation, AML requirements and data protection.

Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

A university degree in Law, Economics, Finance, Business Administration, Data Analysis or a related field is preferred, but equivalent professional experience is equally relevant.
What we offer
At Northmill, you'll be part of a fast-moving and entrepreneurial environment where technology, innovation and people come together. We believe in taking ownership, challenging conventions and making a real impact.
You'll join a collaborative team where your expertise matters, your ideas are encouraged and you have the opportunity to influence how we protect our customers and develop our business.

An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact

Great opportunities for professional development

Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance

Conference abroad every other year

Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday

Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office

Apply today and be a part of Northmill!
Background Checks
As a bank, we place great importance on trust, security and integrity. As part of our recruitment process, we therefore conduct background checks on candidates in the final stages of the recruitment process. These checks form part of our commitment to maintaining a safe, secure and compliant business.

The opportunity 
Are you an experienced program leader with a passion for governance, strategic execution, and software-driven innovation? At Hitachi Energy, we are developing advanced solutions that support the modernization and digitalization of the global energy system. We are now looking for a senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex technical programs, govern product and release deliveries, and ensure successful execution across multiple stakeholders and disciplines.
In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing strategic programs and release initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, technical requirements, governance frameworks, and financial targets. A key part of the position is to drive program governance through established gate models, monitor risks and dependencies, and enable informed decision-making throughout the program lifecycle. You will work closely with software development teams, engineering, product management, finance, and senior leadership to ensure successful program execution
This role is ideal for a senior project or program management professional who combines attention to detail with the ability to see the bigger picture, navigate complexity, and drive strategic outcomes in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead large-scale technical programs and release initiatives from planning through execution and successful delivery.
Own program governance and ensure compliance with established stage-gate and release management processes.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across software development, engineering, operations, product management, and business functions.
Facilitate program roadmaps, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and governance structures.
Drive effective risk management by proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating program risks and dependencies.
Monitor program performance through key milestones, deliverables, financial forecasts, and quality objectives.
Support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
Communicate program status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including adoption of digital tools, AI-driven capabilities, and best practices in program management.

Your background
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
PMP certification is a requirement.
Minimum 10 years of experience leading complex technical projects and programs, with a proven track record of delivering results in large and cross-functional organizations.
Strong experience from software development environments and a solid understanding of software development lifecycles, release management, and software engineering concepts.
Experience working with structured governance models, stage-gate processes, and program steering frameworks, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and risk management with attention to detail.
Strong financial acumen, including experience with forecasting, budget management, Estimates at Completion (EACs), and financial analysis.
Hands-on experience with project and program management tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira. Experience with Monday.com is considered an advantage, as are advanced Excel skills.
Experience from the energy sector is highly valued. Knowledge of network control systems, grid automation solutions, or related technologies is considered a strong advantage.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across teams. Experience applying AI-enabled solutions is considered a plus, and fluency in English is required.

Company description:
"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."
Job description:Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
 Your future team
 Would you like to develop advanced driver assistance functions that make commercial vehicles safer, smarter and easier to operate? At Volvo Group, you will have the opportunity to turn complex engineering challenges into technology that makes a real difference on the road.
 You will join the Driver Support Functions team within Volvo Trucks Technology & Industrial Division in Gothenburg. We develop Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) throughout the entire product life cycle, from early concepts and requirements to software development, verification, vehicle integration and product maintenance.
 Our work includes functions such as Intelligent Speed Assist, glare-free lighting, driver distraction, drowsiness warnings, and pilot assistance. We collaborate closely across software, systems and verification, combining technical expertise with an agile and supportive team environment.
 We are now looking for a Senior ADAS Function Developer who brings deep software expertise, strong technical judgement and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges. This is an opportunity to take technical ownership, influence software solutions and contribute to the next generation of driver support functions across Volvo Group's global truck portfolio.
  
 What you will do
 In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end ADAS function deliveries, working across system development, software implementation, integration and verification. With a strong focus on embedded software development, you will play an important role in turning functional requirements into reliable, high-quality solutions.
 Your responsibilities will include:
  Develop ADAS functions and algorithms for advanced driver support applications.
 Translate customer, regulatory and system requirements into use cases, software designs and testable solutions.
 Design, implement and integrate embedded software using C++ in an Adaptive AUTOSAR environment.
 Contribute to software architecture, interfaces and integration on vehicle compute platforms.
 Define signals, interfaces, KPIs and evaluation methods to assess and improve function performance.
 Plan and support verification through simulation, SIL, HIL, test rigs and vehicle testing, analyzing results and resolving issues.
 Investigate complex technical challenges across software and system boundaries, contributing to robust integration and product maintenance.
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and contribute to continuous improvement, technical discussions and knowledge sharing.
  
 
 Who are you?
 You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and understanding how individual components contribute to a complete vehicle function. You combine hands-on technical expertise with a structured, analytical approach and are comfortable taking ownership of challenging engineering tasks.
 You thrive when tackling technically demanding software challenges, whether that means investigating complex system behavior, identifying root causes or developing robust solutions at code level. You bring the technical depth to challenge existing approaches and contribute to sound engineering decisions.
 You value collaboration, communicate technical concepts clearly and are motivated by developing reliable solutions that make a tangible difference.
 We believe that you have:
  A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field.
 Several years of experience in automotive embedded systems, function development or another safety-critical software domain.
 Strong hands-on experience in C++ software development and Adaptive AUTOSAR.
 Experience working across the development life cycle, from requirements and software design to implementation, integration and verification.
 A solid understanding of software architecture, interfaces and system behavior.
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Additional experience that is valuable:
  Embedded Linux, service-oriented communication, debugging, performance optimization or integration on vehicle compute platforms.
 Model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink.
 Software quality practices such as clean code, code reviews, static analysis, CI/CD, test automation, ASPICE or MISRA C++.
 Functional safety and safety of the intended functionality, including ISO 26262 and SOTIF.
 AI-assisted engineering, machine learning or data-driven methods for function development, analysis, testing or evaluation.
 Verification using SIL, HIL, test rigs, measurement and calibration tools, vehicle networks or in-vehicle testing.
 Signal processing.
  
 
 Ready for the next move?
 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
 Last application date: December 1st, 2026.
  
 As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
  
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
 
 
 
 
Job description: Are you ready to take your next step within the Volvo Group? Financial Control & Accounting TTI (Trucks Technology & Industrial Division) is looking for a Chief Accountant to strengthen our team.
  
 Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a global finance organization in Group Finance responsible for securing finance and tax compliance, accounting and financial reporting for most Divisions, Business Areas and Group Functions in Volvo Group. FCA also hosts our Finance Global Delivery Center providing qualitative, process efficient, automated finance deliveries. We are a truly global organization with around 1400 highly professional colleagues in more than 50 countries, closely integrated with local business operations.
  
 Our mission is to secure accurate and timely financial reporting and compliance with the Volvo Group. We aspire to lead finance and compliance through excellence and innovation.
 What you will do 
 
 As Chief Accountant, you will lead and coordinate the end-to-end monthly closing and accounting process for Volvo Parts, handling the accounting of the TTI value chain Service Operation and Technology (SOT). This is done in close collaboration with Global Competence Centre (GCC) Finance, TTI SOT Business Control, Tax, Payroll & Pensions and Group Accounting. You will be accountable for accurate, efficient and compliant financial reporting for TTI SOT legal accounting, contribute to driving improvements and you will also represent Accounting in relevant projects and initiatives.
  
 As a business partner and trusted advisor, the Chief Accountant provides expert advice on accounting treatment, financial risks, regulatory developments, and legal entity considerations. The role proactively identifies accounting risks, drives compliance, and supports informed decision-making across the organization.
  
 Key Responsibilities
  
  Lead TTI SOT accounting processes and ensure alignment with local and Group accounting principles
 Own and drive the closing process, ensuring timely, high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual financial closes
 Lead financial analysis, balance sheet reviews, and reconciliations to ensure financial integrity, accuracy and compliance.

Company Description

Bosch Home Comfort in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources: rock, water and air. Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.
We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life.
 

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?
As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.
Your key responsibilities
Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.
Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.
Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.
Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.
Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.
Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.
Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.
We are looking for someone with:
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage
Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement

Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box. We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.
Who you are
You are curious about the business behind the numbers. When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.
You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

Additional Information

Why join us in Tranås?
In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.
For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory.
The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.
At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

Competitive compensation
Pension, insurance and other benefits in accordance with our collective agreement
Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role
Employee discounts on Bosch products
Development opportunities within an international Bosch organization

Regular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.
If you enjoy combining finance, manufacturing and problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.
Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.
The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.

Research project and duties
The overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.
The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.
Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.
Your work will include:
Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.
Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.
Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.
Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.
Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.

The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.

Trees For Me – Phase II
Trees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.
Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.

Research environment
The project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.
You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.

Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.
You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.
The following qualifications are considered merits:
Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.
Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.
Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.
Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.

You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.
Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.

Employment and application
Employment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.
Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.
Starting date: By agreement.
Application deadline: 6 December.
Your application should include:
A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.
A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.
Contact details for two referees.

Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.
For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.

About Skogforsk
Skogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.
We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.
At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

Strong knowledge of financial systems and reporting tools, including advanced Excel skills; experience with SAP, BPC and BI tools is highly desirable.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to manage large volumes of information, prioritise effectively and deliver accurate results under tight deadlines.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence business partners, present financial insights clearly and communicate fluently in English.

 
What we offer you?
We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

 
 
WHY JOIN BAT?
In BAT Sweden we strive to create a smokeless reality on a day-to-day basis. If you wonder how we are getting there, please take a look at the OMNI report – a comprehensive study done to analyse the current market trends in tobacco harm reduction.
 
We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.

We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.

Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.
If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

Unit for Field-based Forest Research
Would you like to take on a key leadership role, guiding a dedicated team and contributing to the future of field-based forest research? With us, you will have the opportunity to work outdoors in spectacular natural surroundings and help develop groundbreaking projects addressing forest ecosystem and climate-related issues.
We are looking for a hands-on professional with research experience and leadership skills to lead operations at the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, as well as serve as a member of the management team for the entire Unit for Field-Based Forest Research. This position offers excellent opportunities for someone who enjoys a varied range of responsibilities, thrives on challenges, and wants to contribute to research on boreal forest production and forest ecosystems.
In 2024, the Unit revised its strategic operational plan through to 2030, resulting in a partially new organisation structure that has recently been implemented. In line with the Faculty’s ambition to broaden its activities, the Unit’s remit is also being gradually expanded. This calls for a cohesive and functional organisation across the Unit, structured around its four main areas of activity: long-term experiments, major research infrastructure, commissioned projects, and environmental monitoring and analysis.
About the position
You will be a member of the Unit’s management team. As manager of the Siljansfors and Jädraås Experimental Forests, you will have overall responsibility for operations within your area of responsibility (Svealand and southern Norrland), including financial and personnel management, as well as occupational health and safety matters. Your role is to ensure that activities at the experimental forests develop in a way that best supports field research, environmental monitoring, and education, while remaining within the allocated budget. Cooperation within SLU and engagement with the surrounding community are also ongoing aspects of the station managers responsibilities.
As the station manager, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure that ongoing forest field experiments are maintained and revised according to plan, using modern technology, and that new experiments are established today to address future research questions. You will be responsible for the content of metadata databases and the databases associated with them. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the Siljansfors team actively participates in the steering groups for the Unit’s various main areas of activity, and that the tasks agreed upon by these groups are implemented within your area of responsibility. An important part of the role involves receiving requests and, whenever possible, carrying them out. These may concern the establishment or revision of forest field experiments, environmental monitoring assignments, as well as teaching or outreach activities.
During the snow-free season, you will also participate in practical fieldwork, which involves spending considerable time outdoors and undertaking shorter periods of work-related travel. 
Your profile
Requirements:
Higher education in forestry, preferably supplemented by doctoral studies or other relevant experience in academic work, and a good understanding of the conditions and requirements of research
Extensive experience with practical fieldwork in forest environments
The ability to organise and structure work, and to act in an educational and diplomatic manner
A valid category B driver’s license
Good command of both Swedish and English

Desirable Qualifications:
Management experience, including personnel responsibility
Practical experience in forestry operations and forest inventory
Experience working with databases, GIS data, and related software
Familiar with methods and techniques for tree measurement and field data collection
Experience with meteorological instruments and data loggers

We place great importance on your personal qualities. Of particular importance is your ability to handle unexpected situations, for example when new tasks need to be undertaken at short notice. The position is based at the Siljansfors experimental forest office in central Mora, and at the field station in Siljansfors, 18 km southwest of Mora. SLU’s Faculty of Forest Sciences is located in Umeå.
Employment: Permanent, full-time position. SLU applies a probationary employment period.
About the employment: Your title will be Experiment Group Leader, with the additional responsibility of station manager. This responsibility will be transferred to you at a time agreed upon by you, the current station manager and the Unit Director.

jobs.occupation: Design Engineer  Power Supply Units & Electrical Components
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups - and we’re just getting started. 
At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future -  and we want you to be part of it. 

About the Team
The Electromechanics Design Department within Global Robotics R&D Technology consists of 16 engineers specializing in verification, mechanics, mechatronics, and electronics. We are responsible for the electromechanical systems used in our robotic mower platforms and work across the complete product lifecycle, from technology investigations and feasibility studies to product development projects and maintenance activities.
Our team defines system requirements, drives technical coordination across disciplines, and leads verification and validation activities in close collaboration with software, electronics, sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams.
We offer an international and collaborative working environment characterized by openness, professionalism, and a strong passion for technology and innovation.

About the role
We are looking for a Design Engineer with experience in electrical and/or electromechanical component development to strengthen our electromechanics team.
In this role, you will play a key part in the development of future robotic platforms and act as a technical contributor and coordinator in cross-functional projects. Depending on experience, the role may also include technical leadership responsibilities.
The primary focus of the role is the development and management of Power Supply Units (PSUs), including PSUs both with and without communication interfaces. Responsibility also includes other electrical components such as wiring harnesses, user interface hardware, connectors, and related electromechanical subsystems.
Development activities are carried out in close collaboration with both internal stakeholders and external development partners and suppliers.

Your responsibilities will include:
Development, specification, and integration of power supply units and other electrical components
Defining component requirements and securing technical compliance throughout the product lifecycle
Coordinating development activities in tight cooperation with suppliers and external engineering partners
Leading technical investigations, concept evaluations, and feasibility studies
Cross-functional coordination in tight cooperation with mechanics, electronics, sourcing, quality, manufacturing, and others
Planning and execution of verification and validation activities
Driving continuous improvements in development methodologies, processes, and engineering tools
Supporting technology roadmaps and future platform strategies within electrical systems and components

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
About 3 years of relevant industrial experience
Experience in product development involving electrical or electromechanical systems
Experience working with suppliers and external development partners
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Meritorious Experience
The following experience is considered highly valuable:
Development and specification of Power Supply Units (PSUs)
Electrical distribution systems, wiring harnesses, connectors, and related components
Low-voltage electrical systems and electronics integration
Product development within consumer products, robotics, automotive, or related industries
Verification and validation of electrical and electromechanical products, especially round component certification
Technical leadership or project coordination
Experience working with global suppliers and development partners
Experience with CATIA Electrical or other similar 3D tools
Experience with Teamcenter and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems

Personal Profile
We are looking for a curious and driven engineer with a genuine interest in technology and product development. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, and contributing to the development of both products and working methods.
You have a pragmatic mindset, can balance technical details with a system perspective, and are motivated by turning concepts into robust production-ready solutions.

Location
The assignment is based at Husqvarna Group's Robotics R&D center in Huskvarna, Sweden. A significant on-site presence is expected, as close collaboration with development teams, suppliers, prototypes, products, and test equipment is an essential part of the role.

Your application: 
Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person. For more information about the position, contact hiring manager Staffan Palm on staffan.palm@husqvarnagroup.com For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo on Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data 
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. 
For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you passionate about the evolving creator economy and how creators can drive both brand relevance and commercial impact? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce to shape and build how we work with creator-led commerce at scale. 
In this role, you’ll lead the strategic direction of our creator affiliate offering and turn that strategy into scalable capabilities, ways of working and measurable business results. You’ll connect creator marketing, affiliate and commercial opportunities, ensuring our approach supports both short-term performance and long-term creator relationships. 
You’ll work closely with Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams to build a connected creator ecosystem and unlock the full potential of our creator partnerships across the business. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce, you’ll shape the strategy and build the capabilities required to grow creator commerce across markets. You’ll translate strategic priorities into clear plans, processes, tools and technology, while driving collaboration across teams and markets. 
You will: 
Define and drive the creator affiliate and commerce strategy, ensuring it complements the broader affiliate strategy and overall creator marketing direction. 
Build scalable operating models, processes, tools and technology that enable creator commerce across markets. 
Shape quarterly strategies, priorities and budget allocation within your area. 
Work closely with markets to identify commercial opportunities and define activation plans. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment. 
Identify opportunities to maximise creator value across awareness, engagement and conversion. 
Build strong collaboration across Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams, ensuring partnerships and creator relationships are leveraged strategically across initiatives. 
Balance performance and commercial objectives with long-term creator relationships and strong brand alignment. 
Use performance insights and learnings to continuously evolve the creator commerce offering and identify new opportunities for growth. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for a strategic and commercially minded creator marketing professional who combines deep expertise with a builder mentality. You’re comfortable setting direction, but equally motivated by turning strategy into something tangible, scalable and actionable. 
You understand both the relationship-driven side of creator marketing and the performance-driven nature of affiliate and creator commerce. You can navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, influence across teams and markets and turn business needs into clear operational and technical requirements. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator, influencer or affiliate marketing, with strong expertise in creator commerce and performance-driven partnerships. 
Proven experience building or scaling creator-led commercial or affiliate programmes. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution. 
A solid understanding of affiliate platforms, tracking, attribution, tools and technology supporting creator commerce. 
A commercial mindset with a strong focus on measurable results, business impact and optimisation. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance short-term commercial opportunities with long-term creator relationships and brand priorities. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the drive to build new capabilities and ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter. 
 
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

 Elevate people and performance on NKT’s growth journey NKT is dedicated to building a diverse organization and a culture in which people from all backgrounds can succeed and do their best work. Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Health and Safety Manager. As the Health and Safety Manager you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. 
You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear. You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.
This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers. You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives. You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites. You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required. 
Key job responsibilities
Implement safety standards, policies and best practices.
Provision and Management of Training: Induction, Refresher Training as required, develop and deliver training/presentations to support achievement of H&S objectives. Ensure all H&S training requirements are fulfilled.
Collaborate with vendors (General Contractors, sub-contractors, Emergency Services) as they relate to operations and construction.
Ensure compliance and implementation of global safety programs and local regulatory legislation. 
Develop and review safety plans for on-site emergencies, special events and other unique safety situations.
Perform safety data analysis and create bench marking.
Ensure safety record keeping and provide accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
Consult and work with compliance teams on safety regulations interpretations and investigations. 
Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to risks and prevent injury.
Adapt to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, strategy and deadlines. 
Able to work as part of a team and provide safety support to regions outside of local cluster when required.
Other duties as assigned.

About the team
We’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
Basic qualifications
Minimum 5+ years of field experience in in a Health & Safety role within operational environments. 
Fluent English language skill required (written and verbal communication). 
Valid driver's license.
Ability to work on-site at office and Data Center locations.

Preferred qualifications
Considerable knowledge of local safety and health regulatory laws and practices and workplace safety. 
Experience / knowledge of implementing safety programs, processes, and procedural documentation. 
Data center, manufacturing, construction, or similar industry safety experience with mix of full-time employees and third-party contractors.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.

jobs.occupation: Radiographer – Daytime position in coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Utne, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Utne, Western Norway.
As a nurse in Utne, you will work across both nursing home and home care services. You will meet patients with different healthcare needs, take independent professional responsibility and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Utne is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 2.5 hours from Bergen and Bergen International Airport. Located by the Sørfjord, a branch of the famous Hardangerfjord, Utne is surrounded by mountains, fruit orchards and some of Western Norway’s most characteristic scenery.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Utne, you will have a varied working day and the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. Some patients will be cared for in a nursing home, while others receive care in their own homes.
You will work independently and make professional assessments, while also being part of a team and working closely with other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Utne
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life in the heart of Hardanger
Utne is located by the Sørfjord in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, surrounded by mountains and fruit orchards. Fruit growing has been part of life here for generations, and the landscape changes with the seasons, from orchards in full bloom in spring to apples, plums, pears and cherries later in the year.
Life here is quieter than in a large city, with the fjord and mountains right outside your door. You can spend your free time hiking, exploring the fjord or discovering local farms and producers. Utne also has a strong cultural heritage, including the Hardanger Folk Museum and the historic Utne Hotel.
If you are moving with your family, there is a kindergarten in Utne and a primary school with after-school care nearby. Odda, the main town and administrative centre of Ullensvang Municipality, is around 45 minutes away by car and offers a wider range of shops and services. Ferry connections link Utne to both sides of the fjord, making it easy to explore Hardanger and travel onwards towards Voss and Bergen. Bergen, the largest city in Western Norway, is around 2.5 hours away and has an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

Volvo CE in Braås, near Växjö, developes articulated haulers and wheel loaders and manufactures articulated haulers. Experience with Creo or another 3D modelling tool

Lean and Agile ways of working

Are you passionate about test automation, cutting-edge technology, and building reliable solutions? Take on a key role in developing and improving quality assurance for advanced financial crime prevention platforms at one of the Nordic region’s largest banks. Join a collaborative team where your expertise in automation, data testing, and AI-driven testing approaches will make a real impact!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance
Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP
Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention
Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible
Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them
Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineering

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.

8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge
Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer
Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing
Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic
Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls
A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team
Strong communication and documentation skills
A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience
