jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

jobs.occupation: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
jobs.description:
We are looking for a licensed veterinarian with a few years of professional experience who wants to become part of our team and work broadly within small animal practice. With us, you will have the opportunity to use and further develop your expertise across several areas, from outpatient care and inpatient wards to emergency medicine, surgery, and on-call work.
About AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.
My name is Jens Berisson, and I work as the Hospital Director here at AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital. We are now looking to strengthen our fantastic team and are seeking a licensed veterinarian who is passionate about animal healthcare and wants to continue developing the hospital together with us.
About the Role
This role is ideal for someone who appreciates that no two days are the same. Your primary focus will be tailored to your experience and interests, but we would like you to be comfortable working across different areas of the hospital.
Examples of responsibilities include:

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.

Emergency patients and emergency medicine.

Surgery and perioperative care.

On-call and evening shifts.

More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.

Who Are You?
We believe you are a veterinarian who:

Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.

Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.

Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.

Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.

Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.

Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.

Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.

Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.
Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?
At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.
We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.
What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.
About AniCura Sweden
Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.
With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.
Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.
We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension schemes, insurance coverage, and wellness benefits, as well as excellent opportunities for continued professional development throughout your career.
Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.
Would You Like to Join Our Team?
If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!
If you have questions about the position or your development opportunities with us, please contact:
Jens Berisson, Hospital Director jens.berisson@anicura.se
Emma Idman, Talent Acquisition Partner emma.idman@anicura.se
Welcome to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital – where you can make full use of your veterinary expertise.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Location:
Uppsala, Sweden
Form of employment:
Indefinite-term employment. We use 6 months probationary employment.
Scope:
100%
Start date:
As agreed.
Application:
Please submit your application before deadline 7 December 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
 
Please include in your application: 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Letter of intent
Copies of appropriate degree certificates

Union representatives:
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/

RaySearch, a world leader in the field of software for advanced radiation therapy, is now looking for a Sales Operations Administrator to strengthen our international Sales team.

As one of our CRM experts, you will be responsible for data integrity within our CRM system and guaranteeing that all licensing documentation remains accurate, complete, and fully compliant. By ensuring accurate insights and reliable system structures, you will support business decisions and contribute to the continued growth of RaySearch.

Process customers’ license applications, renewals, upgrades, transfers, etc., in a timely and accurate manner
Be an expert of the licensing structure and provisioning at RaySearch
Work with data quality, structure and management of data in Salesforce
Follow up and monitor documentation about our customers
Submit information to RaySearch’s global sales network (direct sales and distribution network)

Your profile
To succeed in this role, you have strong communication and administrative skills combined with an analytical and structured mindset. You are a fast learner that understands complex concepts and ideas. You are detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to maintaining high-quality data and documentation.
You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, can manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines. An adaptable team member who readily supports the group through peak periods.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong customer-service orientation.
We would like to see that you have:
Relevant university degree or equivalent education
1-3 years experience in sales support, business operations, or CRM administration
Hands-on proficiency with CRM software platforms, specifically Salesforce
Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Office Suite
Very strong organizational and administrative skills
Excellent written and spoken skills in English and Swedish

Good knowledge in other languages are considered a merit. It is also an advantage (but not required) if you have experience from a software company, medical devices or healthcare industries.
Our Culture 
Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. 
Our Offer 
At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 
Application 
Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

Nederman - The Clean Air Company  Founded by Philip Nederman in 1944, Nederman is now one of the world's leading companies supplying products and services in the environmental technology sector focusing on industrial air filtration. Our products and solutions are contributing to reducing the environmental effects of industrial processes, creating safe and clean working environments and boosting production efficiency, mainly within industries such as woodworking, metalworking, composite machining, food processing, vehicle service and emergency stations, laboratories and dentists. Nederman's offering encompasses everything from the design stage to installation, commissioning and service. Sales are carried out via sales offices and distributors in over 50 countries and development and production in own manufacturing and assembly units in 12 countries on five continents. Nederman Group, with headquarters in Helsingborg, Sweden is listed on Nasdaq OMX, Stockholm and has about 2500 employees.
Do you want to be the one who sets the direction for automation across an entire product portfolio? At Nederman, you get to work with technical innovation at a high level, in a dynamic team of skilled colleagues, all sharing the same goal - shaping the future of clean air. We do more than product development. We create solutions that truly make an impact, driven by knowledge and passion. 
The global Operational Technology Center (OTC) at Nederman is dedicated to advancing cross-product platform solutions that bridge the gap between traditional industrial equipment and modern digital technologies. Our focus lies in developing new ways of controlling our equipment to improve performance, reduce costs, and reduce their environmental footprint. Data is systematically collected through our fleet of connected devices, aiding our ongoing development initiatives, and delivering valuable insights. Empowered by cutting-edge AI technologies, we seamlessly provide these insights to our customers through user-friendly web and mobile applications. Robust, well-designed automation is the foundation all of this is built on. With a substantial and growing client base, we are committed to a rapid digital expansion.
The objective is to build highly integrated digital platforms to create products and solutions that only Nederman – The Clean Air Company can offer. We are now looking for a Senior Automation Lead to be the organization's primary automation expert and help shape what comes next.
About the roleAs Senior Automation Lead, you will be the technical leader and strategic driver for automation at Nederman's Operational Technology Center (OTC). You will shape the future of our control systems and automation platforms, ensuring robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions across our product portfolio. As the organization's foremost automation expert, you will provide technical direction, establish engineering standards, and guide key architectural decisions. A significant part of your role will be fostering technical excellence within the automation team through mentoring, coaching, and knowledge sharing. You will help build a strong automation capability that supports current product development and future innovation. While your primary focus will be automation and control systems, you will work closely with colleagues in software development, electronics, product management, and other engineering teams to ensure successful integration and alignment across solutions. This is a technical leadership role without formal personnel responsibility based on-site in Helsingborg.
Profile and experience
To be successful in this role you need
At least 8 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, or Operational Technology, with several years in a senior technical role.
Deep expertise in industrial automation and control systems, including automation architecture, PLC-based control systems, industrial communication, HMI solutions, functional safety, and the development of robust, scalable automation platforms.
Being comfortable making architectural decisions and balancing immediate product needs with long-term technical strategy.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
Swedish citizenship. The position is security-classified and requires security vetting, including a background check.

Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing engineering direction and working with stakeholders and requirements is highly valued. Experience with Schneider EAE or IEC 61499 is an advantage but not required.
We are looking for someone passionate about automation and engineering excellence. You are curious, pragmatic, and energized by solving challenging technical problems while continuously improving products and ways of working. With a deep technical knowledge and strong collaboration skills, you bring structure, credibility, and a long-term perspective while remaining hands-on when needed. With a natural ability to lead through expertise and influence you truly enjoy developing people, sharing knowledge, and creating an environment where engineers can grow and perform at their best.
Apply today In this recruitment process Nederman collaborates with Mpya Sci & Tech. For questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Recruitment Consultant Christian Billberg on 0731-489 875. We review applications on a rolling basis so do not hesitate to apply via www.mpyascitech.com as soon as possible, as the position may be filled before the final application date.

jobs.occupation: 5G RAN System Engineer / Baseband System Developer
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
TECHLA is now looking for an experienced system profile within 5G RAN/Baseband for an exciting consulting assignment in Gothenburg. This role is a great fit for someone with a strong technical interest in radio systems, communication theory, signal processing and the development of functionality in modern mobile networks.
About the role
In this role, you will work with system development within 5G RAN, focusing on developing, analyzing and improving the performance of baseband-related functionality. The work may include areas such as radio resource management, scheduling, link adaptation, time-critical communication, antenna control and optimization of 5G network performance.
You will work closely with development, design and test teams and be involved throughout the development chain, from early ideas, analysis and specification to implementation, verification and deployment of new features.
Examples of responsibilities:
Design and specification of algorithms within RAN/Baseband
 Systemization and requirements breakdown for new base station features
 Analysis and optimization of 5G network performance
 Work related to radio resources, scheduling, link adaptation and antenna control
 Support to design and test teams throughout the development process
 Analysis of fault reports and technical issues on system level
 Contribute to the development of new features from early concept to customer-facing product environments

We believe you have
Experience from 5G RAN, Baseband or similar telecom systems
 Good understanding of 3GPP-based communication systems, such as 3G, 4G/LTE and 5G NR
 Experience from the lower layers of the protocol stack, such as L1/L2, PHY or MAC
 Knowledge within communication theory, signal processing or radio algorithms
 Experience from system work, algorithm design, technical analysis or performance optimization
 The ability to understand complex technical problems and drive them forward
 Good English skills, both spoken and written

It is meritorious if you have
Previous experience from Ericsson, Combitech or another RAN/Baseband-related environment
 Experience with scheduling, link adaptation, RRM, MIMO, beamforming or antenna control
 Experience with Python, C, MATLAB or similar tools for analysis, simulation or performance evaluation
 A Master of Science or Ph.D. within Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Telecom, Communication Technology or a similar field
 Experience using AI tools in technical development work
 Swedish language skills

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.description:
Company Description
At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “9 to 5” you, because life is all about balance.
At Bosch, we celebrate you. Our people are what make us remarkable. Therefore we recognize your contribution with
competitive salary packages, collective agreements with unions, occupational pension, and other attractive benefits, such as wellness contribution, smart work, flexible working hours, Gym & Yoga classes at site.
Let’s not forget the sincere “thank you” for our employees’ contribution. Our success is your success. Let’s celebrate together.
At Bosch we understand that everyone has their own focus in life, whether it is about new professional challenges, training, and development, or more time for family, friends, and hobbies, whatever your goals are we are flexible. Let ‘s strike a balance.
At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.       
Job Description
About the Role
Are you passionate about sustainable technology and modern software engineering? Join our cross-functional team in developing the next generation of energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions. In this role, you will help design, implement, and optimize intelligent control and regulation algorithms for state-of-the-art heat pumps, directly contributing to the global energy transition.

Your contribution
Shape the future: Develop control and regulation functions for our latest heat pumps, actively driving forward innovative algorithms for energy-efficient, resource-saving heating and cooling systems.
Take a holistic approach: Guide software functions throughout their full lifecycle—from requirements gathering and concept simulation through to implementation and verification across multiple testing levels (MIL, SIL, HIL).
Realize model-based software: Design and optimize model-based software functions in Matlab/Simulink for the closed-loop control of thermodynamic and hydraulic systems.
Implement software: Apply modern software development practices and text-based languages (e.g., C/C++), utilizing modern engineering and AI-assisted tools to advance embedded software modules.
Validate & test: Commission and test application software on cutting-edge heat pump test benches, supporting rapid prototyping and real-world system validation.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work in an international, agile environment, collaborating closely with experts across software, electronics, HMI, hydraulics, and thermodynamics.

Qualifications
What You Bring
Education: Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Mechatronics, Control Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical engineering background).
Core Competencies:
Solid foundational understanding of control engineering, mechatronic systems, or thermodynamic processes.
Practical experience in software development—either through model-based development (Matlab/Simulink) or text-based embedded programming (C/C++).
Working familiarity with software testing or simulation concepts (e.g., MIL, SIL, or HIL).
Languages: Working proficiency / business fluency in English (written and spoken).
Mindset: Solution-oriented mindset, strong curiosity for clean energy technologies, and an eagerness to learn and grow within an international team.

Nice to Have
Several years of dedicated industry experience in embedded software or controls engineering.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, or hydraulic systems.
Experience with bus protocols and communication interfaces (e.g., CAN, LIN, Modbus, MQTT).
Familiarity with agile development practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., Git, Jira, Jenkins).

Additional Information
What We Offer
Impactful Mission: Play an active role in decarbonization and sustainable climate technologies.
Flexible Working: Flexible working hours and hybrid work options for an optimal work-life balance.
Continuous Growth: Access to cutting-edge development tools, AI tooling, and tailored technical/language training opportunities.
Collaborative Culture: An open, appreciative, and international team environment with state-of-the-art laboratory and test bench facilities.

Quintus Technologies is looking for a Forwarder to join our logistics team in Västerås.
Here, you will work with international project logistics, coordinating shipments of advanced high-pressure systems to customers around the world. Our equipment often requires carefully planned transport solutions, detailed documentation and close collaboration between several parties.
You will become part of a collaborative logistics team where you have the opportunity to take responsibility, develop your expertise and contribute to successful deliveries worldwide.
About the role
As a Forwarder at Quintus Technologies, you will be responsible for planning and coordinating international shipments, with a particular focus on project logistics and customs-related matters.
You will work closely with project managers, production, purchasing, external freight partners and customs authorities to find suitable transport solutions, ensure compliance with customs regulations and secure efficient, accurate and timely deliveries.
Customs management will be a key focus area of the role, where you will take an active part in developing customs procedures, handling customs-related documentation and staying up to date with international trade regulations.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Requesting, evaluating and comparing transport quotations and selecting suitable freight forwarders.
Preparing and managing shipping documentation, packing lists and product labels.
Handling Letters of Credit (L/C) and ensuring that the required shipping documentation is accurate and complete.
Managing customs documentation, import shipments and relevant import/export requirements.
Maintaining accurate shipping records and updating information in relevant systems.
Coordinating external warehousing and storage solutions when needed.
Taking greater ownership of customs-related matters, proactively developing customs procedures and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

Who are you?
We believe you are someone who enjoys working with logistics and takes pride in making sure that everything is handled correctly.
You are structured, thorough and service-minded, with a natural ability to keep track of details and deadlines. You enjoy coordinating different activities, communicating with people and finding solutions when unexpected challenges arise.
You are comfortable taking responsibility for your work and understand the importance of accuracy, particularly when dealing with international shipping documentation and customs requirements.
As a colleague, you are approachable, collaborative and proactive. You enjoy being part of a team while also having the confidence to work independently.
We believe you have:
Education in logistics, freight forwarding or international trade, preferably from a vocational college, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of international transportation, shipping documentation and logistics processes.
Good understanding of customs procedures and import/export requirements.
An interest in international trade, transportation and logistics.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

Experience in freight forwarding, project logistics, Letters of Credit (L/C) or ERP systems is highly valuable.
Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the right mindset, a willingness to learn and the ability to take responsibility for complex logistics activities.
Why join Quintus Technologies?
At Quintus, you will work with logistics that go beyond everyday transportation.
Our advanced high-pressure systems are delivered to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical technology. Each project brings its own requirements, challenges and opportunities to find smart solutions.
You will join a forwarding team of four people and work closely with colleagues across the organization. Here, collaboration and knowledge-sharing are important, and you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in an international environment.
Quintus combines advanced technology and a global customer base with a welcoming, down-to-earth and family-oriented culture.
If you enjoy variety, responsibility and international collaboration, this could be a great next step in your career.
Location
The position is based in Västerås, Sweden.
About Quintus Technologies
Quintus Technologies specializes in the design, manufacturing, installation and support of high-pressure systems for sheet metal forming, advanced materials densification for high-quality industrial components as well as high pressure processing for food and beverage to deactivate the bacteria.
Headquartered in Västerås, Sweden, and represented in 45 countries worldwide. Quintus is the world leader in high-pressure technology, having delivered more than 1,900 systems globally to customers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy and medical implants.
Learn more about us at: www.quintustechnologies.com (http://www.quintustechnologies.com)
Are you Interested in this opportunity?
We are collaborating with Norén & Lindholm for this recruitment process. Should you require more information, feel free to contact Simon Johansson at +46 (0)70 778 94 61 or via email at simon@norenlindholm.se.
Applications are accepted until November 15 and can be submitted at www.norenlindholm.se (http://www.norenlindholm.se) or by clicking the button below. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to send in your application.
We look forward to receiving your application!
All applications will be treated confidentially.

Rozen Clean – En av de mest rekommenderade städfirmorna Både kunder och personal väljer oss för vår pålitlighet och höga kvalitet. We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Finance Lead to join a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS, and to grow with it.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP). Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
This is not a traditional accounting position. Half the job is making the financial foundation work exceptionally well: payroll, bookkeeping, tax, payments, reporting, and administration, together with our founders and external advisers. The other half is commercial: working with the founders on pricing, business models, cost structures, and where the company puts its money.
One day you might be running payroll and closing the month. The next, you could be modeling the economics of deploying our platform across hundreds of customer sites, finding a European innovation grant, or helping the CEO evaluate a new commercial opportunity.
What you will work on
• Bookkeeping, reconciliations, and monthly and annual closing in Fortnox.
• Payroll, benefits, reimbursements, VAT, and tax, together with our auditors and banks.
• Invoicing, supplier payments, accounts payable and receivable, and corporate cards (Mynt).
• Filings with Bolagsverket and Skatteverket, board materials, minutes, and shareholder documentation.
• Budgets, forecasts, cash flow and runway models, and reporting for leadership, the board, and investors.
• Unit economics across cloud, AI inference, hardware, and deployment, and the margins they produce.
• Grants and non-dilutive funding from Swedish and European programmes.
• Replacing repetitive finance work with AI and modern software, so the function scales without its overhead growing at the same rate.
Who we are looking for
You are early in your career, with a strong financial foundation and an appetite for far more responsibility than you have today. You might be at a Big Four or mid-sized audit firm, an accounting agency, or in finance operations at a growing company.
• Around 2–4 years in accounting, auditing, or financial operations.
• Solid command of Swedish bookkeeping, payroll, and compliance, and hands-on experience with Fortnox or similar.
• Strong analytical skills and a real interest in modeling and commercial analysis.
• Excellent Swedish and English, written and spoken.
You take responsibility for the outcome, not just the task. You know payroll and tax have to be right every time while almost everything else moves fast, and you can hold both. You do not wait to be asked before fixing a process or chasing an opportunity.
It is a plus if you have worked with startups or venture-backed companies, understand SaaS metrics and unit economics, or have applied for funding through Vinnova, Almi, or EU programmes. You do not need all of this. We care more about judgment and how fast you learn than about years on your CV.
Life at Antrino
You will join a team of driven, ambitious people who thrive at a fast pace and enjoy working together. We go to AI events, host our own, and end plenty of weeks with an afterwork. Things change quickly here, and everyone's work is visible in what the company becomes.
What we offer
• Direct work with the CEO and board members on financial and commercial decisions.
• Exposure to fundraising, investor relations, and international expansion.
• Potential participation in our stock option programme after the probationary period.
• Freedom to improve systems, challenge processes, and bring AI into finance work.
• AI events, afterworks, team activities, and travel when the business requires it.
• Occupational pension, insurance, and friskvårdsbidrag.
Process
1. Introductory conversation about your background and ambitions.
2. Finance and accounting conversation about your hands-on experience.
3. Practical working session on a realistic scenario in operations, forecasting, or a commercial decision. We care how you think.
4. Conversation with the founders about options and terms.
We review applications continuously. References may be requested at the final stage.
Apply with your CV and a short note on why you want to move beyond traditional accounting into helping build a technology company.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Senior Vision Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, reverse-engineering, and maintaining machine vision and optical inspection systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving cameras, lighting configurations, and image processing algorithms, supporting both legacy production line re-commissioning and new vision system installations. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with PLCs, SCADA, and upper-level MES platforms to enable inline defect traceability, dimensional inspection, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 

Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  

Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  

Lead vision system integration and optical calibration during equipment commissioning and line re-starts (Project timeline dependent). 

Develop and reverse-engineer the vision inspection systems to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory, as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 

Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  

Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on machine vision, optics, and quality inspection gates. 

Code review and test of suppliers' vision software and algorithmic work within the projects to validate specified defect detection thresholds (Gauge R&R) and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper-level systems. 

Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 

Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 

Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 

The role requires regular presence on the production floor, with a minimum of approximately 25% of working hours spent on-site. Depending on project needs (such as line re-commissioning), there may be periods where up to 100% of working hours are required on the shop floor. 
Develop and maintain machine vision and image processing programming standards. 

Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 

Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 

Masters Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 

Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 

Experience of working with industrial camera systems, optical components, and lighting techniques, including the selection, configuration, and calibration of camera hardware for manufacturing inspection and process control applications 

Experience in the design, configuration, and deployment of machine vision systems including cameras, lighting, and vision software platforms such as Cognex, Halcon, or equivalent, with experience integrating vision outputs into PLC, SCADA, and MES environments via OPC connectivity. 

Experience developing and optimising image processing pipelines and vision algorithms for applications such as defect detection, pattern recognition, and dimensional verification, with familiarity with industrial communication protocols for vision system integration. 

Experience in writing technical documentation including inspection requirement specifications, algorithm validation reports, vision system configuration records, functional design, UML, test cases, and test records. 

Experience with image processing software and programming tools relevant to industrial vision applications, such as Python, C++, OpenCV, or equivalent vision libraries, with the ability to develop, test, and optimise vision algorithms for real-time manufacturing environments 

Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 

Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 

Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.  

Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 

Ability to document technical problems concisely. 

Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 

Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 

Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 

Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 

A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

As part of building our Maintenance Engineering organization, we are expanding our team with a Process Equipment Engineer focused on our Furnace Area. This is an opportunity to contribute to a technically advanced manufacturing environment and play an important part in strengthening our capabilities within the Furnace Area.
Read more about Silex here.
The team and the area
You will be part of the Maintenance Engineering organization and report to the Maintenance Manager. The Teams purpose is to provide technical leadership for assigned equipment and work closely with Team Managers, Service Technicians, Maintenance Engineers, Process Engineers, Area Managers, and external suppliers.
The Furnace Area is an important part of our production and includes advanced high-temperature processes such as epitaxy, Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD), and thermal oxidation. These processes are used to grow and deposit controlled material layers and to form high-quality oxide films, making stable temperature profiles, gas flows, pressure, and equipment conditions essential to product quality and process repeatability. You will bridge equipment maintenance and process engineering, using equipment data, process results, and production feedback to identify causes of instability, improve uptime and utilization, and ensure that technical actions are coordinated across teams.
About the role
As a Process Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical health, reliability, and continuous improvement of equipment within the Furnace Area. Equipment is your primary discipline, supported by process knowledge that enables effective fault analysis, improvement work, and close collaboration with Process Engineers.
You will act as the technical lead for the assigned equipment, guide service technicians, coordinate technical escalations, and lead root cause analyses of downtime events and recurring failures. You will also develop equipment monitoring and preventive maintenance, define relevant KPIs, contribute to equipment purchases and upgrades, and serve as a technical contact for suppliers.
In this role, you will:

Act as the technical lead for assigned furnace equipment, guiding service technicians and leading complex troubleshooting, root cause analyses, and follow-up of corrective actions.

Manage technical escalation plans and coordinate equipment status, priorities, and actions with Team Managers, Process Engineers, and suppliers.

Use equipment and process data to identify causes of instability, define and follow up KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, and MTTR, and improve equipment monitoring through equipment dashboard and SPC.

Develop preventive maintenance routines, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to equipment purchases, installations, upgrades, and spare-part planning.

Lead equipment-related risk analyses and ensure LOTO and other safety requirements are reflected in maintenance routines, documentation, and training.

We are looking for someone who has:

A Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

At least five years of relevant experience in manufacturing with strong equipment-related knowledge and an understanding of production processes. Experience in semiconductor or MEMS process development or manufacturing is an advantage.

Experience with root cause analysis, data analysis, SPC, quality-control methods, equipment monitoring, and preventive maintenance systems.

Proficiency in English, particularly in technical terminology and documentation. Swedish is considered as highly meritorious.

To thrive in this role, you enjoy working analytically and finding practical solutions to complex technical challenges. You take a structured and proactive approach to your work, communicate clearly with different stakeholders, and are comfortable guiding others. With several activities often running in parallel, you are also able to prioritize effectively and ensure that actions are documented and followed through.
What we offer you

The opportunity to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology and some of the most advanced equipment in the industry.

A technically challenging environment where you solve complex problems and continuously develop your expertise.

A varied role in which new challenges, technologies, and improvement opportunities make every day different.

About Silex
Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
The recruitment process
We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.
YOU WILL
OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.  As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.
You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.

Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.

Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.

Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.

Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.

Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.

Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business

The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.

YOU ARE 
You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.
Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.
You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.
At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We are looking forward hearing from you!
ABOUT OX2
OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.  With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.  OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

About Taigatech
We solve some of the most important problems in industry with AI and computer vision. With our connection to the latest research and academia, we take world-leading research in AI and computer vision and turn it into impactful solutions that help the wood industry increase yield, availability, and productivity.
Technology is reshaping our world. We believe the forest and wood products have an important role to play in a sustainable future, and AI is how the industry gets there.
We are a growing team in a comfortable office in central Gothenburg, working closely with many of the leading names in wood processing. Our systems run in production at sawmills and pulp mills in Sweden and abroad. There's no better time to join our journey than now.
Why this role exists
Our systems create value the moment their output reaches the customer's control system — a correction, a signal, something the line can act on.
What determines the results are a handful of decisions made early and made well: which signal, where it lands, what the line does with it, and how it behaves when something unexpected happens. Get those right and the implementation is small and quick.
Today that judgement is distributed between our own team and the automation partners we work with on each installation. We want someone to decide what the interface should look like, judge whether it came out right, decide when a sensor or other component needs replacing, and if the signal belongs on a different fieldbus.
That's the person we're hiring. You don't replace our automation partners. You become the one who leads them.
What you'll do
The role is both technical and leadership, and the balance shifts from project to project.
Own the machine-side interface. You decide how our system talks to the customer's PLC. Signals, timing, handshakes, watchdog, fail-safe behaviour. You write the functional description the work is built from.
Lead our automation partners. Sometimes that means writing the code snippet yourself. Sometimes it means explaining what needs doing and reviewing that it came out right. You decide which.
Make the technical decisions on the customer's plant. Upgrading a component for better results, or moving to a different fieldbus, is yours to propose and drive. The implementation itself normally goes to a partner.
Be the customer's main contact through the project — scope, timeline, status, time and cost reporting. You take over from sales and carry the delivery home.
Clear the path. OT network access, change control, and the dialogue with the site's automation and IT departments, so the installation can be done quickly and safely.
Work closely with our ML and vision engineers. Translate what the process needs into what the model has to output, and the model's limits back into what we can promise.
Make it repeatable. A reusable interface specification, a commissioning checklist, and a growing network of automation partners to deliver alongside.
Who you are
You need experience, but we don't care how many years you have behind you. We care about what you've done.
You have programmed PLCs in live production, on at least one major platform — Siemens TIA/S7, Beckhoff, ABB, Mitsubishi, Codesys or equivalent
You have hands-on experience of industrial networks: Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, OPC UA or equivalent.
You have extended control systems you did not write with retrofits onto existing, running equipment
You have written functional descriptions that someone else built from
You have stood on site during commissioning, with production running and someone waiting
Drives the project forward by keeping people accountable, asking the right questions, and pushing decisions when it matters — even when that means a difficult conversation.
Swedish and English, and you sometimes travel to sites
Bonus
Sawmill, pulp and paper, or other heavy process industry
Vision systems, sensors or measurement equipment
Experience on the supplier side, responsible for subcontractors
Machinery directive and risk assessment on modified lines
Python and basic data analysis
What we offer
You'll be our first dedicated automation hire. You set the delivery process, and it becomes the standard we scale on. As delivery volume grows, the function gets built around you.
You'll work directly with the founders, with our ML engineers and with the mills themselves. Office in Gothenburg.
We review applications on a rolling basis.

We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
We Offer
A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product. 
The opportunity to work with new technology and contribute to innovation together with our Jet Printing core development team of 15 specialists across software, mechanics, electronics, configuration management, testing, product management, as well as collaborate with a wide range of functions across the company. 
A culture of innovation and collaboration, working together at our Kista office.

 
Work tasks
As a Systems Architect, you will lead the definition, development, and evolution of robust, scalable, and sustainable system architectures. You will provide the architectural perspective that connects our engineering disciplines and helps translate business and customer needs into technical direction. To do this effectively, you will invest the necessary time to truly understand our products and customers. This includes gaining firsthand experience of their perspective by using our systems during experiments, exploring new opportunities, and developing a deep understanding of how our solutions are used in practice.

They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving cameras, lighting configurations, and image processing algorithms, supporting both legacy production line re-commissioning and new vision system installations. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with PLCs, SCADA, and upper-level MES platforms to enable inline defect traceability, dimensional inspection, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead vision system integration and optical calibration during equipment commissioning and line re-starts (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop and reverse-engineer the vision inspection systems to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory, as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on machine vision, optics, and quality inspection gates. 
Code review and test of suppliers' vision software and algorithmic work within the projects to validate specified defect detection thresholds (Gauge R&R) and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper-level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor, with a minimum of approximately 25% of working hours spent on-site. Depending on project needs (such as line re-commissioning), there may be periods where up to 100% of working hours are required on the shop floor. 
Develop and maintain machine vision and image processing programming standards. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Bachelors Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with industrial camera systems, optical components, and lighting techniques, including the selection, configuration, and calibration of camera hardware for manufacturing inspection and process control applications

Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely.

Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.
