You will contribute to a project investigating materials, surfaces and corrosion-related challenges in components such as pipes and heat exchangers. The objective is to evaluate alternative materials and technical solutions that can meet future regulatory requirements while supporting increased sustainability and cost efficiency.
Approximately 70% of your time will be spent carrying out practical work in laboratory and testing environments. You will conduct tests and experiments, follow up on the results and ensure that the work is performed in a structured and reliable manner. The remaining time will be dedicated to analysis, documentation and reporting.
You will work closely with the technical lead for the materials and surfaces area and receive guidance from experienced specialists with strong connections to research and academia. The role also involves collaboration with experts and stakeholders across the organisation, to whom you will present results and provide input for continued development.
Your responsibilities will include:
Planning and conducting practical tests and experiments in a laboratory environment.
Investigating materials, surfaces and corrosion-related properties.
Evaluating alternative material solutions for pipes, heat exchangers and other processing equipment.
Following test plans and contributing to the development of relevant experimental setups.
Analysing and compiling test results.
Documenting methods, observations and conclusions in a structured manner.
Presenting results and technical conclusions to specialists and relevant stakeholders.
Ensuring that tests are reliable, traceable and repeatable.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:
Holds a BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.
Has practical experience in laboratory work, materials testing or experimental work.
Has knowledge of material properties and how materials are affected by factors such as mechanical loads, surface conditions and corrosion.
Is comfortable documenting, analysing and reporting technical results.
Can work independently in a laboratory environment and take responsibility for conducting accurate and reliable tests.
Communicates fluently in English, both spoken and written, as you will be working in an international organisation.

Corrosion testing, materials characterisation or surface technology.
Developing or improving test methods through practical experimental work.
Designing and building new test setups, procedures or experimental configurations.
Statistical analysis and evaluation of experimental results.

We put great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities, and believe that you are practical, curious and detail-oriented. You enjoy hands-on work and are motivated by understanding why a material or technical solution behaves in a particular way.

jobs.description:
Senior Lecturer in Biomedicial Laboratory Science
Reference number PAR 2026/891
The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
At the Institute of Biomedicine, the scientific focus is on gaining a fundamental understanding of the living cell, its composition, how it functions, how its function is regulated by the genome, and how it interacts with its surroundings. This knowledge is used to investigate the causes of various disease conditions, with the aim of developing new opportunities for diagnosis and treatment. The Institute is responsible for the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme, which includes teaching in areas such as molecular cell biology, clinical chemistry, and pathology. Further information about the Institute’s activities is available on its website:https://www.gu.se/en/biomedicine
Subject area 
Biomedical Laboratory Science.
 
Subject area description 
Biomedical Laboratory Science is an interdisciplinary field of science grounded in medicine, natural sciences, statistics, and technology. The discipline encompasses theoretical and methodological knowledge of laboratory medical and physiological analytical and examination methods used to analyse biological samples, study physiological processes, and assess body function in health and disease.
Central to the discipline are pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical processes, including sample collection, method selection, analysis, interpretation, and quality assurance of results. The discipline also encompasses the development, validation, and quality assurance of analytical and examination processes, with relevance to diagnostics, monitoring, prevention, patient safety, and research.
 
Duties 
The position involves extensive teaching responsibilities, including course coordination and serving as an examiner within the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme, the supplementary education programme for biomedical laboratory scientists with foreign qualifications, and courses at the second-cycle level.
Teaching encompasses both basic laboratory methodology and theoretical and practical teaching in courses focusing on clinical chemistry, haematology and/or clinical pathology. Teaching also includes profession-specific components related to the professional practice, responsibilities, and scope of competence of biomedical laboratory scientists. The successful candidate will also collaborate with clinical laboratory services within the healthcare sector to ensure the professional relevance of the education and that students’ knowledge and skills are assessed in relation to the requirements established by the national qualitative targets for the biomedical laboratory science profession. 
As a course coordinator, the successful candidate shall, in collaboration with other teaching staff, lead, plan, and develop courses within the programme, with the patient in focus. The duties may also include supervising biomedical laboratory science students during their degree projects. The successful candidate shall also participate in the development and revision of the programme syllabus for the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme. The position may also include responsibility for the entire programme.
The successful candidate shall also conduct independent, nationally competitive research within the field of biomedical laboratory science, apply for research funding, and establish scientific collaborations with other research groups at the University of Gothenburg and other higher education institutions.
 
Eligibility 
Eligibility requirements for appointment to a teaching position are specified in the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg’s Appointment Regulations.
A doctoral degree in Biomedical Laboratory Science or another discipline deemed equivalent by the employer, demonstrated teaching proficiency, Swedish professional status qualification as a biomedical laboratory scientist, and the ability to teach in both Swedish and English.
 
Assessment criteria 
The assessment criteria for appointment to a teaching position are specified in the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg’s Rules of Procedure.
Greatest weight will be given to teaching proficiency. In assessing teaching proficiency, particular consideration will be given to experience in education and teaching within biomedical laboratory science, particularly haematology, clinical chemistry, clinical pathology, advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs) and/or precision diagnostics, responsibility for teaching administration, and pedagogical development work. Teaching proficiency must be demonstrated through documentation of completed courses in higher education pedagogy, teaching experience, experience in pedagogical development work, and responsibility for teaching administration. Proficiency must be well documented in a manner that enables an assessment of the quality of the teaching activities.
Secondly, scientific proficiency will be considered. Scientific proficiency must be demonstrated through scientific publications, assessed in terms of both quantity and quality, contributions to scientific conferences, the ability to secure research funding in national and international competition, and supervision of doctoral students. Proficiency must be well documented in a manner that enables an assessment of the quality of scientific activities.
Thirdly, documented experience of clinical laboratory work within clinical chemistry, haematology, clinical pathology, molecular diagnostics and/or methodologies relevant to future laboratory practice, such as ATMPs and precision diagnostics, will be considered.
Fourthly, administrative proficiency and experience will be considered, demonstrated through documented experience of leadership responsibilities and/or collaboration within various organisations, both within and outside academia.
 See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.

One of the most exciting aspects of our job is the ability to follow a product from the initial customer request all the way to when the truck leaves the production line!
Who You Are
 
To excel in this role, we believe you should be a driven, proactive, and curious individual who isn't afraid to ask questions. You thrive on handling a variety of tasks that may change quickly and enjoy getting hands-on with technical issues when needed. Your positive and enthusiastic attitude makes you a great team player who fosters knowledge sharing and propels the team forward.

Experience with Scania products, our modular system, and Catia V5 is advantageous. It is also meritorious if you have worked with gas and hydrogen solutions before.
This Is Us
 
Our group within the Customized Trucks department specializes in designing gas trucks, including CNG and LNG, at a complete truck level. Recently, we were also involved in the exciting task of developing customized hydrogen solutions.
We are a team of nine development engineers and one group manager, and we take great pride in our diversity. We operate within a value flow, maintaining close contact with other cross-functional teams such as Sales and Marketing, Project Management, Aftermarket, Production, Purchasing, and Certification. This means you will build a broad Scania network from day one!
 
Scania Offers
 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally through a structured development plan and various courses.

events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents can enjoy direct access to Södertälje via the Scania Job express buses.
 
Application

Are you ready to take on a strategic role where HR, Compensation & Benefits and international collaboration meet? Join our client’s Group R&D team and play a key role in shaping future compensation structures and strategic HR initiatives!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Compensation Benefits Specialist for our client, a world-leading supplier of transport solutions and together with partners and customers, they are driving the transition to a sustainable transport system. Your daily tasks

Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. jobs.occupation: Chief Engineer - Tissue Machine Controls & Automation
jobs.description:

We are looking for a Chief Engineer to join Valmet's Tissue Machine Controls & Automation department. We design, develop, and commission automation solutions for project deliveries in Sweden and internationally, ranging from new tissue mills to large machine rebuilds and service projects. As customers increasingly look for integrated solutions and value throughout the entire machine lifecycle, automation is becoming an ever more important part of our offering.
Within the department, we work closely across disciplines including electrical engineering, software programming, hydraulics, pneumatics, lubrication systems, and piping design. We also collaborate closely with project management, other departments, and our customers. The field is developing rapidly, particularly within digitalization, which means there are always new challenges and opportunities to learn. Acting as the link between the project team and the main project manager regarding status, risks, technical decisions, and design reviews.
Contributing technical expertise in electrical engineering and machinery safety, including risk assessments, safety functions, and verification of our deliveries, together with relevant specialists.
Sharing experience and lessons learned across projects and taking an active role in developing common, globally scalable ways of working.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in machine learning for materials design
jobs.description:
Work assignments 
The primary focus of the position is on developing and applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methods for large-scale computational materials discovery. The research aims to advance data-driven materials science through the development of methods for exploring vast spaces of possible materials, identifying promising candidates, and guiding the discovery and design of new materials with desired properties.
 
The work includes the development and application of physics-informed machine learning models, generative AI methods, machine learning interatomic potentials, and high-throughput computational workflows. The research may also involve computational physics methods, studies of materials stability and properties, and data-driven approaches to understanding and predicting materials synthesizability.
 
Particular emphasis will be placed on efficient methods and software for massively parallel GPU-accelerated computations on high-performance computing (HPC) systems. The aim is to contribute to our AI-driven materials design platform to enable large-scale screening and inverse design of materials, with potential applications in, e.g., quantum information processing, energy storage, and electronic and optoelectronic devices.
As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.
Qualifications
To be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree.  This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.
It is considered advantageous if your doctoral degree is no older than three years at application deadline for this job. If there are special reasons for having an older doctoral degree – such as taking statutory leave – then these may be taken into consideration.
Your application must include documents that clearly show that you fulfill the following requirements for the position:
A doctoral degree in physics, materials science, computational science, or equivalent. A course transcript with grades must be included in the application. 
A publication list that includes multiple co-authored research publications in computational materials science, materials informatics, machine learning, and/or related areas of computational science.
Co-authored publications demonstrating experience with the development or application of AI/machine learning methods for prediction of materials properties or other applications in materials discovery.
Experience with high-throughput computational materials science, automated computational workflows, or large-scale materials datasets.
Extensive documented programming experience, particularly in Python, demonstrated, for example, through co-authored publications describing the use of Python and links to open-source software to which the applicant has contributed.

It is considered a strong merit for the position if your application shows documented experience, in particular in relation to materials science, of (i) developing new AI/machine learning methods (beyond applying existing ones); (ii) experience with generative AI methods, such as flow matching and diffusion models; (iii) development or fine-tuning of machine learning interatomic potentials; (iv) GPU-accelerated computing and high-performance computing (HPC), particularly using Python-based frameworks such as JAX.
It is considered a merit for the position if your application shows other documented experience demonstrating a high level of understanding and skill in the fields of solid-state physics, thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, crystallography, and crystal symmetries.
You are expected to be creative, independent, and intellectually curious, and to have a high level of engagement and motivation to contribute to materials science and the development of AI-driven methods for materials discovery.
The workplace
More information at: https://liu.se/en/research/materials-design-and-informatics
The employment
This employment is a temporary contract of two years with the possibility of extension up to a total maximum of three years.
 
The employment is full-time.
Starting date by agreement.
Salary and employment benefits
At Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.
More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.
Union representatives
Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.
Application procedure
Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 17 December, 2026. 
 
 
 
Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. 
 
 
 
Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. 
Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University. 
 
 
 
In the event of a discrepancy between the English translation of the job announcement and the Swedish original, the Swedish version shall take precedent. 
 
We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.
 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
 
 
Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

Would you like to work with modern cloud technology and build secure digital solutions used in critical business processes?
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our CLM & eSign team in Solna. You’ll work with modern cloud-based technology, take ownership of technical decisions and help us build scalable, secure solutions for digital signing and contract lifecycle management.
About us
At Verified, we build cloud-based solutions for identity verification, electronic signing and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). Our platform supports AML/KYC, supplier due diligence and secure digital workflows.
We’re around 100 people, mainly serving the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. Our API-first platform lets businesses integrate secure, scalable services into their existing systems and workflows.
Technology is at the heart of what we do, and we keep investing in cloud infrastructure, scalable architecture and AI-driven solutions. Our engineers work in autonomous, cross-functional teams with shared ownership, a strong engineering culture and a real say in how our products and technology evolve.
The role and the team
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you’ll help develop and scale our cloud-based CLM and eSign platform. You’ll work across frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure, with significant influence over architecture and technical decisions.
You’ll join a collaborative, cross-functional engineering team where developers own the full development lifecycle, from system design and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. We work closely across different parts of the platform, with a strong focus on technical quality, knowledge sharing and building reliable solutions.
You’ll be working with a modern, scalable stack built on microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture. Our backend runs primarily on C# (ASP.NET Core and .NET Framework) alongside Node.js, while the frontend combines React with ASP.NET MVC (Razor). Everything is hosted on AWS - leveraging ECS, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and Elasticsearch to power different parts of the platform.
In the role, you will:

Design and develop scalable cloud-based systems, REST APIs and modern web applications.

Contribute to architecture and technical decisions, building resilient microservices with AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and event-driven systems.

Develop integrations, manage complex workflows, asynchronous processes and help evolve the shared infrastructure for our CLM and eSign services.

Drive engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD and production monitoring.

Use AI agents, RAG and automated workflows to improve our products and development processes.

AI is an important investment area for us. Our engineering organisation is exploring a more agentic approach to software development, so you’ll have the chance to shape how AI is used across the development lifecycle and built into our products.
We see software engineering as a craft, where technical quality, thoughtful decisions and pragmatic solutions go hand in hand.
What will you bring to the team?
At least five years of experience in software development, preferably in cloud-based SaaS environments.

Strong experience with ASP.NET Core, C# .NET and Node.js, alongside React.

Experience building REST APIs, microservices and distributed systems.

A good understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous communication.

Hands-on experience with AWS and databases such as SQL Server and DynamoDB.

A strong understanding of system design, security, scalability and modern application architecture.

Experience with, or an interest in, AI tools and modern development workflows.

Professional proficiency in English and the right to work in Sweden.

It’s good to have experience working with real-time communication using SignalR, command-query separation (CQS) patterns and Event Sourcing. It’s also a plus if you’ve worked with third-party integrations or in regulated industries such as FinTech and RegTech.
As a person, you’re curious, analytical and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy technical discussions, sharing knowledge and finding practical solutions that balance quality, performance and business needs.
What we offer
With us, you’ll work on technology that helps businesses manage critical digital processes securely and efficiently. You’ll join an experienced engineering environment with significant influence over architecture, technical decisions and development practices, and you’ll help shape how we use AI and modern technologies across Verified.

Significant influence over technical decisions and product development.

An experienced team with a high degree of autonomy and shared ownership.

Modern cloud technology, distributed systems and AI-driven development.

30 days of vacation, plus five “Verified days” for bridge days and holiday flexibility.

Wellness allowance and occupational pension.

A hybrid model and prefer working together from our Solna office 2-3 days per week.

Office breakfasts and snacks, social activities and one moving day per year.

Other information
Start: According to agreement 

Extent: Full time

Location: Our Stockholm office in Solna

The recruitment process
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply!
We’re running this recruitment together with our partner Detechtiv. If you have any questions about the role or the process, contact Oliver at Oliver@detechtiv.se
Our selection process is continuous, and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the screening or interview phase.

Job Title: PSIRT Operational Specialist
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let's make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
Role Summary

Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the future of secure and sustainable transportation. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems.
This role combines both operational and tactical responsibilities. You will collaborate with experts across Vehicle Security Operations, Cybersecurity Testing, Product Development, Safety, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure the highest level of cybersecurity resilience throughout the product lifecycle.
If you are passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to contribute to products that impact millions of people worldwide, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
 
Job Responsibilities

As a PSIRT Operational Specialist, you will:
· Analyze cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks, including assessment of CVEs, CPEs, and CVSS scores, as well as disclosure management.
· Contribute to, and when ready coordinate or lead, cross-functional incident triage, forensic investigations, and response activities.
· Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PSIRT playbooks, security procedures, and incident readiness plans.
· Configure, validate, and support our security tools and technologies.
· Support in compliance activities related to cybersecurity regulations and standards such as ISO 21434 and UNECE R155.
· Stay informed about emerging cyber threats, technology trends, and industry developments to proactively develop our security capabilities.
 
Who You Are

You are a driven and proactive cybersecurity professional who thrives in a technical environment and enjoys collaborating across teams, functions, and cultures. You can balance tactical thinking with hands-on execution and remain calm in critical situations.
We believe you have:
· Experience from cybersecurity operations, incident response, vulnerability analysis, PSIRT, SOC, or automotive cybersecurity environments.
· A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
· Experience from evaluating security risks, threats, or vulnerabilities.
· A structured and detail-oriented approach combined with strong integrity and professionalism.
· Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
· And, a strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats
 
It is a plus if you have:
· Experience from working with automotive EE systems, connected vehicles, or embedded systems software.
· Knowledge of ISO 21434, UNECE R155, CRA, digital forensics, or threat intelligence.
· Security certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, or CompTIA Security+.
· Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar.
 
This Is Us

We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork.
Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company's cybersecurity status.
 
Who Is Your Manager
I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. I believe in creating a safe, transparent, and collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better solutions.
Our work is challenging yet meaningful, which is why I prioritize trust, teamwork, and personal development and growth. Just as important, I value work-life balance and the well-being of every individual in the team.
 
Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Jenny Holmqvist, Manager in CS Monitoring & Incident Response jenny.holmqvist@scania.com.

We look forward to your application!

 Join our teamYou will join a small, dynamic and closely collaborating Investor Relations and Media team consisting of Karin Larsson, Head of Investor Relations, Ola Kinnander, Media Relations Manager, Gustaf Bratt, Investor Relations Project Manager, and yourself.
  
 You will report to Karin Larsson, and the team is part of the CFO organization headed by Håkan Folin.
  
 Your missionYou will play an important role in Epiroc's dialogue with the financial markets and gradually take on increasing responsibility. A large part of your role will involve coordinating investor activities, including preparing and participating in investor meetings, roadshows, conferences, the Capital Markets Day and Annual General Meeting. You will also:
  
  Create and continuously improve financial and investor presentations.
 Maintain and develop the Investor Relations section of Epiroc's website.
 Coordinate investor roadshows and other capital markets activities.
 Proofread and quality-assure financial and external communication.
 Support Media Relations, including the preparation of press releases.
 Participate in meetings with investors and analysts.
  
 
 As you grow into the role, you will take on increasing responsibility, including conducting investor meetings independently and managing investor roadshows.For the right person, this is an opportunity to build a strong foundation in Investor Relations, financial communication and capital markets in a global listed company.
  
 Your profileWe are looking for someone who is curious, driven and eager to learn. You have a strong understanding of financial statements, including income statements, cash flow and balance sheets, as well as an interest in company valuation, financial markets and the industry. You enjoy combining financial analysis with understanding the drivers of the business and communication and have the confidence to interact with many different stakeholders, both internal and external.
  
 Just as importantly, you are a team player. You are practical, solution-oriented and service-minded, with high integrity and strong attention to detail. You take ownership, meet deadlines and are comfortable working in an environment where priorities can sometimes change quickly.
  
 Your qualifications:
  University degree in finance, business administration, economics or similar.
 A good understanding of financial statements and the ability to understand the logic and relationships behind financial performance.
 Interest in AI and hands-on experience with AI tools, agents or automation.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish and English.
 Strong sense of responsibility and ownership.
  
 
 Location and travelThe position is based in Sickla, Stockholm. We are a closely collaborating team and therefore spend most of our working time together in the office. We offer flexibility when needed, but this is primarily an office-based role. Occasional travel is part of the position, for example in connection with investor roadshows, conferences and other capital markets activities.
  
 Why Epiroc?Most importantly, we want you to enjoy coming to work. We are a close-knit team that likes working together, helping each other and delivering at a high level. Our work brings us into contact with colleagues, investors, analysts and other stakeholders around the world.
  
 At Epiroc, you will be part of a global company serving customers in more than 150 countries, with many opportunities to develop and grow over time. We hope you will enjoy the role so much that you will want to stay for a long time. But when you are ready for your next challenge, we Epiroc offer plenty of opportunities to continue your career within the Group.
  
 Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 14, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
  
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.
  
 For questions about the position, please contact:Karin Larsson, VP/Head of Investor Relations, at karin.larsson@epiroc.comOtto Wetterström, Recruitment Specialist, at otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com 
  
 Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email. We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries.

Job Description
The Senior Cyber Security Architect will shape the future direction of security architecture across the organization. You will turn business priorities, cyber risks and technology needs into clear architecture roadmaps, standards and guidance.
Working across Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering and the wider business, you will influence key technology decisions and help build a secure, resilient and future-ready technology landscape.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Define and evolve H&M’s Security Architecture, target state and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities, technology strategy and cyber risk appetite.
Establish reusable security principles, standards and reference architectures 
Drive secure-by-design and secure-by-default practices by translating security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical guardrails, patterns and automated controls for product, platform and engineering teams.
Guide the development of H&M’s modern Cyber Defense Architecture, strengthening capabilities for prevention, detection, response, recovery, security observability and automation.
Shape and evolve the AI Security Architecture together with Security, Enterprise Architecture, AI and Data, Privacy and Risk teams, enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across H&M.
Act as a subject matter expert on AI security, advising stakeholders on AI-related risks, governance, controls, data protection, secure architecture patterns and emerging threats.
Identify and drive the security capabilities, products and services needed to enable secure AI adoption, modern engineering practices and scalable digital innovation.
Lead resolution of complex cross-domain security architecture challenges, including identity boundaries, privileged access, cloud and workload protection, network segmentation and shared security services.
Partner with technology leaders to ensure security architecture enables resilient, compliant and trusted digital products and services.

WHO YOU ARE
You are an experienced Senior Cyber Security Architect who can operate at both strategic and technical levels. You can see the bigger picture across a complex technology landscape, define where security needs to go and influence others on how to get there.
We are looking for people with:
10+ years of experience across information security, architecture, engineering or related technology roles.
5+ years of experience in enterprise or security architecture.
Ability to align senior stakeholders, including executive around a common security vision, architecture direction and prioritized outcomes.
Ability to define and evolve strategic security architecture direction, manage complex trade-offs, and balance cyber risk reduction with business value, speed, usability, resilience and cost.
Strong knowledge of modern security architecture across cloud, hybrid and SaaS environments, including identity and access management, data security, application security, platform & Infra security.
Experience designing and evolving security capabilities for cloud-native, API-led, distributed and event-driven technology landscapes.
Deep understanding of Zero Trust principles and the ability to translate these into scalable architecture patterns, guardrails and engineering practices.
Experience with security observability, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, security automation and continuous control monitoring.
Strong understanding of DevSecOps, software delivery, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated security testing, policy-as-code and platform engineering.
Experience developing enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, reference architectures, standards and roadmaps that can be adopted across multiple domains and product teams.
Knowledge of data and AI security, including the secure adoption of AI services, model and data protection, access controls, third-party AI risk, AI governance and emerging AI-related threats.
Ability to solve complex, cross-domain architecture challenges and guide technology transformation that enables new digital opportunities and business models.
A strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the ability to connect security architecture decisions with business strategy, digital products, platforms and the wider technology landscape.
Experience leading, coaching and developing architecture or engineering teams, while influencing stakeholders beyond direct reporting lines.

Additional Information
This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.
Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation 
At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age. 
Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. 
Our Offer 
At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

Job Title: Process Manager - Data Management & People Analytics
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. 
 
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future. 

 Role Summary
 
We are looking for a Process Manager Data Management & People Analytics to strengthen how People data and analytics support business decisions within our assigned Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities.  
In this business-oriented role, you will connect business needs with global P&C processes, data governance and analytics capabilities. Working from a dual perspective, you will support the adoption of global standards within our Business Areas while contributing to the priorities of the Finance and P&C Communities. As part of the Cross Area Team, you will also contribute to broader initiatives where your expertise adds value, adapting to changing business needs and priorities. 
 
Job Responsibilities
Your main responsibilities will include:
 
Connect business needs with data and People analytics: Identify opportunities where People Analytics can improve decision-making and translate business needs into data, reporting and analytics requirements. 
Strengthen data quality and governance: Support the adoption of global P&C processes, data standards and definitions. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, clarify ownership and resolve issues through established governance channels. 
Enable self-service and data-driven ways of working: Guide and train stakeholders in using trusted People data, analytics tools and insights in everyday decisions. 
Drive collaboration, change and adoption: Work across business functions, P&C and specialist teams to facilitate discussions, build alignment and support sustainable behavioural change. 
Support AI-related transformation: Help turn AI capabilities into practical business value, supporting adoption and contributing to the team's AI upskilling journey. 

Enable actionable insights: Support the development and use of People Analytics, reports and dashboards to help stakeholders understand trends and make informed decisions.
 
Who You Are
We believe you are an experienced P&C professional with a background in similar business-facing roles or P&C Business Partnering, combining broad P&C understanding with Data Management & People Analytics capabilities. 
You enjoy working close to the business, navigating organisational complexity and turning People data into meaningful insights and business value. You build strong stakeholder relationships and thrive in a changing environment where priorities evolve. 
We believe you also bring: 
Proven experience with HR data, People Analytics, data governance, reporting, business intelligence or HR process management. 
Good understanding of data management principles, including governance, stewardship, data quality, ownership and accessibility. 
Ability to identify analytics opportunities, translate business needs into actionable insights, and perform basic analysis, reporting and visualisation. 
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with experience supporting change and adoption. 
Fluency in written and spoken English. 
A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Management, Analytics, Information Systems or a related field. 

Experience with self-service analytics, digital transformation or AI-related change would be an advantage.
 
This Is Us
 You will join a collaborative team within P&C Enabling Functions, working across organisational boundaries and close to the business. 
Our team works close to the business, connecting business needs with P&C expertise and turning strategic priorities into practical results. We value collaboration, flexibility and the ability to navigate organisational complexity and changing priorities. 
The role offers an opportunity to combine your P&C experience with Data Management & People Analytics, contribute to better business decisions and help develop more effective, data-driven ways of working within our Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities. 
We encourage curiosity, continuous learning and the willingness to explore how AI and new technologies can create business value.
 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-04. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
Åsa Kylestorp, Head of Cross Area Team, P&C Enabling Functions, asa.kylestorp@scania.com   
 
We look forward to your application!

Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
The role
You will lead the Decisioning squad as its most senior data scientist: data scientists, ML engineers, and backend engineers across Stockholm and India, reporting to the Associate Director, Revenue Intelligence, in Stockholm.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will still write models, run the offline evaluations, and read the experiment results yourself. You will also set the modelling direction for the squad, decide which problems are worth solving next, and hold the bar on how a model earns its way into production.
The work has a direct commercial edge. The squad's models decide which ads run and at what price on Truecaller's largest ad surfaces, so a better model shows up in revenue within weeks. The next step is to move from choosing the campaign to setting the bid: one decision that combines a calibrated conversion probability with price, pacing and frequency.
What you'll do
Own the modelling roadmap for decisioning - conversion prediction, ranking, campaign selection and bidding - and agree it with product and engineering.
Design, build and run production models end to end, from problem framing and features through offline evaluation, A/B tests and monitoring.
Evolve the contextual bandit from choosing which campaign to show to setting a per-request bid, with exploration, off-policy evaluation and safe rollout built in.
Keep model scores honest: calibration per campaign and placement, and a clear link between offline metrics and the revenue and conversions advertisers actually see.
Set the bar for experimentation in the squad: every model change ships with a holdout, an agreed success metric, and a clear ship or kill rule.
Lead the squad: set the technical direction, review designs and code, run the prioritisation, and grow the data scientists, engineers and interns around you. You are accountable for what the squad ships, not only for your own work.
Write the RFCs and decision records the group works from, and present results and trade-offs to product, commercial and executive leadership.
Work with backend and data engineering on serving latency, feature pipelines and data quality, so models run reliably at very high throughput.
Raise the data science practice across Revenue Intelligence and the wider discipline through reviews, shared methods and mentoring.

What you bring in
7+ years in data science or applied machine learning, including several years owning models in production that real revenue depends on.
Depth in ranking, recommendation, or conversion prediction at scale - multi-task learning, deep learning, gradient-boosted models, and calibration.
Hands-on experience with online learning or decision systems, such as contextual bandits, exploration strategies, and off-policy evaluation.
Strong experimentation skills: A/B test design, power, causal reasoning, and telling a real lift from noise.
Expert Python and SQL, with a modern deep learning framework (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch) and a cloud warehouse at real scale. We run on GCP and BigQuery; equivalent depth on another stack transfers.
Technical leadership of a team: setting direction, reviewing other people's work, and raising the quality of the people around you.
Strong written English. You will write the RFCs, evaluation reports, and design docs, and they will be read by people who were not in the room.
Comfort operating across Stockholm and India time zones.

It would be great if you also have
Ad tech experience - real-time bidding, auctions, pacing, attribution or campaign delivery.
Experience with the India digital advertising market and performance advertisers.
An MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.
Experience taking models to low-latency serving, and the MLOps around it: model registries, monitoring and automated retraining.
Exposure to privacy-constrained modelling, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.
Experience applying LLMs to modelling or analysis work.

Life at Truecaller
Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/
Sounds like your dream job? We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

The research group focuses on improving diagnostics and advancing our understanding of central nervous system (CNS) tumours through epigenetic and molecular approaches. Our research particularly focuses on DNA methylation profiling, nanopore sequencing, and the analysis of patient-derived samples, including liquid biopsies. We combine advanced sequencing technologies with bioinformatic method development and multiomics analyses to develop new diagnostic and prognostic tools and gain deeper insights into tumour biology. Close collaborations with pathologists, neurosurgeons, and oncologists at Sahlgrenska University Hospital support the group's strong translational research focus. 
Duties 
We are seeking an experienced and independent researcher with strong expertise in bioinformatics and a particular interest in computational method development within cancer research. The position focuses on developing and applying advanced bioinformatic methods for sequencing data analysis, with particular emphasis on nanopore sequencing, epigenetic modifications, liquid biopsy, and integrated multiomics analyses.
The successful candidate is expected to independently develop novel computational methods and bioinformatic pipelines and contribute to the design and execution of research projects within the group.
Responsibilities include:
Independent development, implementation, and optimisation of bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines for large-scale sequencing data.
Development of analytical methods for DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing data, including the identification and quantification of DNA methylation and other nucleic acid modifications.
Development and application of bioinformatic methods for liquid biopsy analysis, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), using nanopore sequencing and enzymatic methyl-seq (EM-seq).
Development of computational approaches for the analysis of RNA modifications from sequencing data.
Integration of genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data through advanced multiomics analyses.
Development of robust and reproducible computational pipelines, including evaluation and validation of novel analytical methods.
Independent statistical analysis, visualisation, and biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Scientific responsibility for the bioinformatic aspects of research projects, including study design, methodological decisions, data interpretation, and scientific publication.
Collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers, as well as supervision of junior researchers and students in bioinformatics.

 
Qualifications 
Required qualifications
PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or another relevant discipline with a strong computational focus.
Several years of documented experience in independent bioinformatic research and computational method development.
Extensive expertise in the analysis of large-scale sequencing data, particularly DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing.
Documented experience in developing and implementing bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines.
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of DNA methylation and other epigenetic modifications.
Experience in the analysis of liquid biopsy data, RNA modifications, and/or integrated multiomics datasets.
Excellent programming skills, for example in Python and R, and experience working in Linux-based computational environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, conduct, and lead bioinformatic research projects.
A strong scientific publication record in relevant research areas.
Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

Meriting qualifications
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of liquid biopsy data using nanopore sequencing and EM-seq.
Experience in developing methods for identifying RNA modifications from nanopore-based direct RNA sequencing.
In-depth knowledge of epigenetics, DNA methylation, and epigenetic tumour classification.
Research experience in CNS tumours or other areas of cancer research.
Experience in integrating genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic datasets.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC), version control, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience in translational research and the development of bioinformatic methods for diagnostic applications.

Employment 
The position is temporary, 11 months, full time and is placed at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.
Selection process 
https://www.gu.se/en/work-at-the-university-of-gothenburg/how-to-apply-for-a-position
Contact information for the post 
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Helena Carén, Professor,
Tfn: +46 31 7863838, E-mail: helena.caren@gu.se
Unions 
Union representatives at the University of Gothenburg can be found here: https://www.gu.se/en/work-at-the-university-of-gothenburg/how-to-apply-for-a-position#collective-agreement-and-union-representatives
Application 
To apply for a position at the University of Gothenburg, you have to create an account in our recruitment system. Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline. 
The application should contain:
A cover letter giving a brief description of previous research experience, and a motivation to why you are applying
A CV including a list of publications
Proof of completed PhD
Contact details of two references

Applications must be received by: 2026-12-14
 
The University works actively to achieve a working environment with equal conditions, and values the qualities that diversity brings to its operations. Salaries are set individually at the University. In accordance with the National Archives of Sweden’s regulations, the University must archive application documents for two years after the appointment is filled. If you request that your documents are returned, they will be returned to you once the two years have passed. Otherwise, they will be destroyed. In connection to this recruitment, we have already decided which recruitment channels we should use. We therefore decline further contact with vendors, recruitment and staffing companies.

Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!
At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.
We are now looking for a MES Solution Architect to play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that support our production and logistics operations.
This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.
Where we are right now
Nobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are continuously developing the digital capabilities that support our highly automated production environment at Nobia Park in Jönköping.
As production volumes continue to increase and new capabilities are introduced, the need for scalable, integrated and business-driven MES solutions becomes even more important. We are therefore strengthening our MES organization and expanding our internal capability to design, develop, and support solutions that create value across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and supply chain operations.
About the role
As a MES Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical MES solutions that enable efficient and reliable operations across the factory.
Acting as the bridge between business processes and technical execution, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards.
The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, process development, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.
Your responsibilities

Translate business requirements into scalable and effective MES solutions, ensuring alignment with both operational needs and architectural standards.

Design and support integrations between MES, SAP S/4HANA, production equipment, and other business-critical systems.

Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, MES Solution Engineers, and external partners throughout the design, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.

Contribute to the evolution of MES architecture, development standards, governance, and future ways of working.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support incident management, and contribute to increased operational efficiency, system stability, and production performance.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. This is an on-site position.
Who you are
To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys working where manufacturing processes and technology meet.
You have the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into sustainable system solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, engaging with stakeholders across different functions, and driving improvements that create measurable business value.
You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and thrive in an environment where technology plays a critical role in operational success.
Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where your expertise will help shape the digital manufacturing landscape of one of Europe's most advanced production facilities.
We believe you bring

5+ years of experience working with MES solutions in manufacturing environments, preferably within highly automated production facilities.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES architecture, and system integrations across MES, ERP (preferably SAP S/4HANA), machines and shop floor technologies.

Experience with C#, T-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and industrial communication standards such as OPC UA.

Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

It is highly desirable if you have

Experience with Insight2020.

Experience working in Agile development environments.

About Nobia
Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form.
At Nobia, you will have the opportunity to be part of a modern manufacturing environment where you can make a real impact. We offer a dynamic workplace with excellent opportunities for both personal and professional growth, giving you the chance to influence the way we work and the results we achieve. Our culture is built on safety, collaboration, and a continuous drive for improvement.
Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.
Want to be a part of our journey?
Then we would like to receive your application later than December 13.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match.
As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening may be conducted as part of the recruitment process. A six-month probationary period can be applied.
For questions regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com
We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit

jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit
