Job description: Are you an experienced finance professional who wants to work close to senior management, gain broad exposure across a global organization and take the next step in your development?
 It all starts with people. People like you.
 Join our team
 We are now looking for a Divisional Controller to join the Drilling tools division (RGD) Finance team. This is a key role supporting the VP Controlling & Finance and the divisional finance organization, combining financial control, consolidation, performance management and business analysis.
 The role provides broad exposure across RGD’s global operations, with the opportunity to work with Customer Centers, Product Companies, Distribution Centers and other parts of Epiroc. You will join an experienced finance team and collaborate closely with Business Lines, controllers and finance colleagues across regions.
 Your mission
 As Divisional Controller, you will have a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and supporting divisional performance. The role combines financial controlling with business controlling, from closing and reporting to performance analysis and forecasting.
 The role requires you to move between financial details and the bigger picture, and to help management understand what is behind the numbers.
 Your main responsibilities will include:
  Coordinate and participate in divisional monthly, quarterly and annual closing and review processes, including adjustments and eliminations, and ensure consistency across P&L, balance sheet and KPIs.
 Analyze reporting from operational units and ensure high-quality, timely financial information.
 Analyze divisional performance and identify key drivers behind deviations from plan, forecast and prior years.
 Coordinate forecasting and planning across the division, collaborating with controllers across regions and operational units to improve forecast quality.
 Partner closely with the VP Controlling & Finance and support management with analysis and financial insights.
 Support strategic initiatives, business cases, investments and profitability improvement programs, and participate in cross-functional projects.
 Contribute to developing reporting, dashboards and analytical tools and identify opportunities to simplify and automate ways of working.
  
 
  
Profile description:Your profile
 You are curious and analytical, with an eye for detail and the ability to step back and see the bigger picture. You enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures, are comfortable sharing your perspective and listening to others, and take responsibility for following up on what has been agreed. We believe that you have a genuine interest in how automation and AI can help us work smarter in finance.
 You have a relevant university degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, and you will likely bring around 5–10 years of experience from financial controlling, business controlling, FP&A, business finance or a similar area.
 We believe that you bring:
  Experience working in a global or matrix organization.
   Strong Excel skills and experience with ERP and reporting systems.
   Experience using Power BI or similar data visualization and reporting tools, with the ability to interpret and analyze the information they provide.
 Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  
Experience from controlling within production, supply chain or distribution and from consolidation systems such as Tagetik or similar is an advantage.
  
  
We offer: 
 Location and other
 The position is preferably based in Sweden, at one of our Epiroc offices in Sickla (Stockholm), Örebro or Fagersta. Occasional travel might be required.
 We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.
 Why Epiroc?
 By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.
 To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:
  Global career opportunities
 Learning & Development programs
 Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
 Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
 Global Parental Leave Policy
 Community involvement
  
Application and contact information
 We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than 4/12 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

The Opportunity
As Category Manager, you will lead the development and execution of category strategies for High Voltage Breakers supporting HVDC projects worldwide.
The role offers a unique combination of strategic sourcing, market engagement, supplier relationship management, tender support, technology understanding, and business development. Working at the interface between Supply Chain, Sales, Engineering, Project Execution, and Technology Development, you will help ensure that category strategies support both immediate project needs and long-term business objectives.
You will be the key driver of the category roadmap, translating market intelligence, supplier capabilities, and business requirements into actionable strategies that strengthen competitiveness, ensure supply security, and support business growth.
The role requires strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills to align diverse stakeholders, manage complex business situations, and drive decisions that create measurable business value and outcomes.
How You'll Make an Impact
Develop and implement category strategies aligned with business growth, technology, roadmaps, and market developments.
Develop and maintain a long-term category roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and future market needs.
Build and manage supplier relationships to secure capacity, innovation, quality, and competitiveness.
Support commercial and tendering activities through market intelligence, cost analysis, supplier insights, and sourcing strategies.
Drive market intelligence activities, including supplier analysis, technology trends, capacity outlook, competitive dynamics, and cost drivers to support strategic decision making.
Drive early supplier involvement and leverage supplier expertise to support technology and business objectives.
Lead supplier negotiations, contract management activities, and business reviews to maximize value creation.
Identify and execute cost optimization, localization, and supply chain improvement initiatives.
Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, competitive developments, and supply chain risks to support informed business decisions.
Translate market trends, supplier capabilities, and business needs into actionable category plans.
Influence and align stakeholders across Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, and SCM to support business objectives and successful project execution.
Lead and navigate complex business challenges while driving accountability, progress, and measurable business outcomes.
Drive supplier performance improvement initiatives related to quality, delivery reliability, sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence.
Contribute to successful HVDC project execution through effective supply chain planning and supplier engagement.
Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Your Background
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (preferable), Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related technical field.
Several years of experience in one or more of the following areas are required:
Supply chain management (Strategic sourcing, Category management)
High-voltage products and systems (key differentiator)
Technical sales
Product management
Bid and proposal management
Understanding project environments, industrial markets, customer requirements, technology trends, and commercial drivers.
Ability to influence stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.
Experience managing supplier relationships, commercial negotiations, contracts, and business performance.
Proven experience developing category strategies, roadmaps, and long-term supplier strategies.
Strong market intelligence and analytical capabilities with the ability to convert insights into business actions and sourcing strategies.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive decisions in a complex global environment.
Ability to translate technical and business requirements into practical strategies and decisions.
Analytical mindset combined with effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.
SAP knowledge and proficiency in digital tools and data-driven decision making are advantages.
Strong result-oriented with a demonstrated ability to create value, drive execution, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
A collaborative, curious, and proactive attitude with a passion for continuous improvement and business growth.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing wellbeing, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grows together. ​

Do you want to work with advanced ASIC development at the forefront of technology? Join the team responsible for the ARTPEC SoC - at the heart of Axis products - and help coordinate a complex development project with people across many disciplines.
This is an opportunity to contribute to a high-impact technology project while developing your project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues. We are looking for an Early-Career ASIC Project Manager to strengthen Axis ASIC development in Lund.

What is Axis?
Axis is a fast-growing and highly innovative company offering intelligent security solutions. Our network video and surveillance solutions help create a safer and smarter world.
Our success comes from our skilled people and our culture of openness, collaboration, and innovation. At Axis, we do more than create products - we shape solutions that deliver value to our customers.

Who is your future team?
The Axis ASIC Department develops custom ASICs that accelerate essential functions in our surveillance cameras. We design, develop, implement, integrate, and verify hardware modules that help strengthen Axis' technology leadership.
Our hardware blocks support functions such as image processing, video compression, radar, audio, and computer vision. We also work closely with external vendors who provide third-party IP cores.
The ASIC development team brings together colleagues with a range of experience and expertise. We value an open working environment and collaborative, low-ego teamwork.
Learn more about ARTPEC: https://newsroom.axis.com/article/artpec-foundation-quality

What you do
You will join the ASIC project leadership team, which coordinates the internal development of an ASIC at Axis. Working with colleagues across the organization and with external partners, you will help keep the project organized and moving forward.
Your tasks will include:
Coordinating work across internal and external interfaces, including software, algorithms, electronics, product teams, and partners
Tracking project progress, coordinating priorities, and communicating plans and status.
Planning and following up on deliveries to and from other projects and external partners, such as third-party IP core providers
Helping track and visualize the project budget
Supporting technology intake activities within the ASIC Department

You will build your project leadership skills while developing your understanding of the technical and commercial aspects of ASIC development. An interest in technology and working with external partners is important. Experience in technical or commercial negotiations is a plus.

Who are we looking for?
You have a technical background and are curious about ASIC development and the technology behind complex products. You enjoy creating structures, connecting people, and helping a team make progress towards a shared goal.
You don't need to have held a formal leadership role. You may have developed relevant skills through your studies, a thesis project, an internship, or your first professional role. What matters is your interest in taking responsibility, supporting collaboration, and growing into project leadership.
We believe you have:
A master's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related field. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field may also be suitable, depending on your experience and overall profile.
Some knowledge of ASIC development, or a strong interest in learning about technology.
An interest in project planning, coordination, and follow-up.
Clear communication skills and the ability to create shared understanding.
Familiarity with agile ways of working, or an interest in learning them.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish.

You bring your own perspective, ask questions, and enjoy working with people across different disciplines. You value collaboration and are motivated to help a team succeed. At Axis, you'll have the opportunity to develop your technical understanding and project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ Lund

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Life at Axis blog
Engineering at Axis blog
Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

Do you want to join us? Apply today! For more information, contact our recruiting ASIC Systems Manager, Tomas Larsson, on +46 46 272 1500.

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
Do you want to start your engineering career close to real equipment, practical testing and experienced colleagues?
 
We are looking for a Test Engineer to join our development organization in Lund. This is an opportunity for a recent graduate or someone at the beginning of their engineering career who wants to learn through practical participation in real test activities. You will be part of and execute testing across equipment, functions, materials and new concepts. Working alongside experienced Test Engineers and specialists, you will learn how tests are prepared, performed, documented and followed up. You are not expected to work independently or know our technology from day one. Your main focus will be to participate, learn and gradually build the practical and technical skills needed for the role.
 
This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden. Limited travel to suppliers or customer sites may be required depending on project needs.
What you will do
•  Participate in the planning, preparation and execution of tests together with colleagues.
•  Help prepare test equipment, instrumentation and test conditions, and learn how a safe and reliable setup is created.
•  Learn and follow established safety procedures, test methods and documentation practices.
•  Learn to use measurement equipment and data logging tools under guidance.
•  Record observations, summarize results and learn how clear test specifications and reports are prepared.
•  Participate in troubleshooting with designers, automation engineers and other specialists.
•  Help maintain a safe, tidy and effective working environment in our test facilities.
•  Ask questions, share observations and contribute ideas as your experience grows.
We believe you have
•  A relevant technical education in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, automation, electrical engineering or a comparable area. A higher vocational education or bachelor’s degree is suitable.
•  Interest in hands-on engineering and willingness to work practically with machines, components and test equipment.
•  A basic understanding of technical systems and measurements, together with an interest in learning more.
•  The ability to work carefully, safely and methodically.
•  Curiosity, willingness to learn and confidence to ask for guidance.
•  Good collaboration and communication skills.
•  Good written and spoken English.
 
It would be beneficial if you have experience in one or more of the following areas, but we do not expect you to have everything:
•  Tetra Pak equipment or similar equipment used in food or packaging production.
•  Industrial automation or PLC-based systems.
•  Measurement technology, test instrumentation and data logging.
•  Electrical drawings, cabling or practical electrical troubleshooting.
•  Structured test methods such as Design of Experiments, FMEA or similar engineering methods.
•  Data analysis and statistical methods.
•  Automating parts of test execution, data collection or result handling.
As a person you enjoy participating in practical work, observing experienced colleagues and learning by doing. You like working as part of a team, are comfortable asking questions and are open to feedback. You take safety and quality seriously and understand that development comes through practice, guidance and continuous learning. You are curious, dependable and motivated to gradually build confidence and take on more responsibility
We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

At SSC Space, you are part of something bigger. 
Every day, our people contribute to missions that expand knowledge, support critical services, and help society benefit from space. We believe the best results come from passionate experts who collaborate, take ownership, and turn ambitious ideas into reality.  
As Mission Manager, you will oversee customer payload missions from initial planning through launch and post-mission review. Working in an international environment, you will bring together customers, brokers, satellite manufacturers, launch vehicle providers and operators, and internal teams to define mission requirements and coordinate delivery against agreed objectives. 
You will serve as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the mission lifecycle, combining technical coordination, project management, and customer relationship management. The role is part of Sales & Customer Operations within Orbital Launch & Rocket Test and reports to the Head of Sales & Customer Operations. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS
To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
A master's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 
A proactive, solution-focused mindset and strong analytical skills. 
The ability to read, understand, and interpret complex technical documentation. 
Effective communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with customers, partners, and colleagues. 
A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational boundaries. 
A high level of spoken and written English. 

Experience with satellite systems, launch vehicle operations, mission planning, satellite qualification and integration, CAD and space industry practices, as well as familiarity with launch regulations is considered an advantage. A high level of spoken and written Swedish is also desirable. 
 
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
In this role, you will: 
Lead mission planning with customers and partners, defining objectives, requirements, interface control documentation, constraints, launch timelines, orbital parameters, payload integration plans, and mission success criteria. 
Act as the primary customer contact throughout the mission lifecycle, providing progress updates, responding to inquiries, and managing expectations to support customer satisfaction. 
Coordinate payload integration, testing, and verification with satellite engineers, launch engineers, payload specialists, and launch vehicle providers and operators. 
Conduct launch readiness reviews covering technical readiness, safety compliance, regulatory requirements, and risk management, and ensure necessary approvals and certifications are obtained. 
Oversee and coordinate launch campaign activities, including launch vehicle transportation, pre-launch preparations, and final readiness activities, together with launch site personnel, ground support teams, and external stakeholders. 
Manage mission projects, identify and assess risks, develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans, and address issues throughout the mission lifecycle. 
Conduct post-mission reviews, capture lessons learned, and implement improvements to processes and working practices for future missions. 

WE OFFER YOU
Meaningful work connected to science, society and the future of space. 
The opportunity to collaborate with talented and passionate colleagues across disciplines, countries, and missions. 
Real responsibility, trust, and the freedom to influence both your work and your development. 
A unique chance to contribute directly to projects where you can see the impact of your ideas and efforts. 

Additional Benefits 
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year and Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar. 
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year. 
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees. 
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. 
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. 
Collective Agreement, including competitive pension plans, parental pay, and insurance. 

LOCATION
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in Solna or Kiruna. 

FURTHER INFORMATION
For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact: 
Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com 
Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com 

NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and conduct interviews throughout the process. 
When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process. 
This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply. 

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE
SSC Space is a trusted end-to-end mission partner and employer of choice, recognized for reliability, expertise and enabling mission success. From satellite communications and spacecraft operations to launch services, engineering, and consultancy, we help customers around the world achieve their space ambitions.  
Our unique capabilities include Esrange Space Center in northern Sweden and one of the world's most dependable ground station networks. Together with around 800 colleagues worldwide, we are creating new opportunities in space while helping Earth benefit from Space.  
Limitless Together.  
Learn more at sscspace.com

Denna position rapporterar till:
Chapter Lead
__
Our R&D engineers and scientists develop breakthrough technologies and products that change the way the world works and industries do business. We constantly expand beyond convention, while retaining our focus on delivering solid returns for our customers and shareholders
We are now looking for several R&D Engineers with a mechanical focus to join one of our agile development teams
Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s advancement with technology, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your abilities by providing ideas and by being able to work both while managing your own tasks and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.
You will be reporting to the R&D Electromechanical Chapter Leader and joining the Load Control Agile Unit based in Västerås, Sweden. This unit operates within ABB Electrification/Smart Power division, dedicated to developing and taking care of our portfolio within low voltage products such as contactors and soft starters.
The work model for the role is: Onsite
You will be mainly accountable for:
Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects
Performing various tasks in the assigned area related to electromechanical design, from building concepts, gathering requirements to designing, implementing, integrating, testing, technology transfer or maintenance, and operations.
Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.
Managing the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.

Our team dynamics
You will be part of an agile development team, working closely with a Product Owner. The Product Owner sets the direction and goals – the team decides how to accomplish them.
This role is not task‑driven in the traditional sense. Instead, you will work in a problem‑solving engineering environment.
Qualifications for the role
Relevant experience in product development or maintenance is an advantage. We are recruiting across experience levels, from recent graduates to engineers with 5+ years of experience.
A Masters degree in mechanics, mechatronics, engineering physics or equivalent.
Basic knowledge in CAD software and PLM tools is meritorious.
Fluency in English is a requirement, Swedish is a plus.

You thrive in situations where you can work freely and do not rely on having every task spelled out ahead of time. You are structured, communicative, and able to define both what needs to be done and what you need from others in order to achieve results. You enjoy working in a collaborative environment while maintaining a high level of initiative.
More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Sales Lead Wanted for an Exciting Growth Journey!
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE // MAKE IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS
Start: January 12th Scope: 50–100%, based on mutual agreement and the candidate’s availability Assignment length: 3 months, with potential for extension
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Sales Lead to join a growing tech company within the supply chain and coffee industry. You will play a key role in a new business initiative, bringing an established digital solution to a new customer segment and helping validate its potential in the European market.
This is a role for someone who knows how to open doors, build trust with senior decision-makers and take a sales dialogue from first contact all the way to closing. You will work with an identified target market while also taking ownership of prospecting and building a structured sales pipeline.
Your responsibilities will include:

Drive sales and new business development within a new business initiative

Prospect and identify relevant potential customers

Initiate contact through cold calls, emails and other relevant channels

Book and lead meetings with senior decision-makers within procurement and category management in HORECA and Foodservice

Present and demonstrate the solution based on the customer's needs and business challenges

Handle objections and move opportunities forward through the sales process

Work towards proposals, agreements and closed business

Build and maintain your own structured sales pipeline

Work closely with senior management throughout the sales process

YOUR PROFILE // YOU BRING THE EDGE
We are looking for someone with:

Several years of experience in a similar senior B2B sales role, with a strong track record of new business development and complex customer dialogues.

Proven experience of new business development and outbound sales, managing the full sales cycle from prospecting and first contact to meetings, proposals and closing

Experience owning and developing relationships with larger or strategically important customers

The ability to build credibility and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, particularly within procurement or category management

Strong presentation and communication skills

Fluency in English

Comfortable working with digital tools and systems

It is an advantage if you have:

Experience in FMCG, HORECA, foodservice, convenience, food & beverage or the coffee industry

Experience selling standardised IT or digital solutions to larger organisations

Experience working with CRM systems, procurement systems or supplier management systems

Swedish or additional European language skills

As a person, you are driven, commercially minded and entrepreneurial, with a strong ability to build trust and long-term relationships. You listen to the customer, understand their needs and translate them into clear business value. You are results-oriented and comfortable driving a dialogue towards a decision, while maintaining a consultative and long-term approach. You thrive in a small, fast-moving organisation where you are expected to take initiative and contribute hands-on, regardless of seniority.

ABOUT THE ORGANISATION // CULTURE WITH REAL CHARACTER
You will join a small and entrepreneurial tech company developing digital solutions for more efficient and transparent supply chains, with deep roots in the coffee industry. The company combines industry expertise with technology, data and traceability and is now taking the next step by exploring a new customer segment. You will join a fast-moving and purpose-driven environment where you have the opportunity to make a real impact and contribute to shaping a new business area.

ABOUT WISE SALES
Wise Sales specialises in recruitment, consulting services and advisory within sales. We know which sales professionals truly deliver and which ones simply sound like they do. That is how we find the people who build strong relationships, drive business and help teams perform. We bridge the gap between potential and results, helping our clients grow with focus, momentum and precision.

WHEN YOU BECOME ONE OF US
As a consultant at Wise, you become part of an environment where both your security and development matter. We offer a competitive salary, wellness allowance, pension contributions and a collective bargaining agreement, because nothing is more important to us than making sure you feel secure in your employment.
From day one of your consulting assignment, you will have the opportunity to develop, take on new challenges and help shape the workplaces of the future, together with committed colleagues and with us as a continuous sounding board. Wherever you are in your career, working as a consultant should give you valuable experience, new knowledge and inspiration for your next step.
Welcome to Wise, a world full of opportunities!

YOUR APPLICATION // TALENT SPEAKS LOUDER
To apply for the role, click “Apply now” and attach your CV. Please note that we are unable to accept applications via email.
Things often move quickly in the consulting world, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
If you have any questions about the role, please contact the responsible Consultant Manager Felicia på felicia.andersson@wise.se.

jobs.occupation: Lead Project Leader - Google Cloud AI Transformation

jobs.description:
Job ID: 6347
Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive strategic AI and cloud transformation initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will lead the delivery and governance of Google Cloud AI platform capabilities, establish scalable and reusable AI services, and coordinate complex dependencies across cloud foundations, security, data, architecture and engineering domains. 
You will help shape the AI platform roadmap, drive adoption of cloud-native AI capabilities and ensure that strategic AI ambitions are translated into executable delivery plans and measurable business outcomes. The role combines strategic leadership, programme governance, stakeholder management and hands-on delivery leadership across multiple technology domains. 
What you'll be doing
Main responsibilities in this role:
Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic GCP AI and cloud transformation programmes, from ideation and planning through implementation and value realisation. 
Drive execution of Google Cloud and AI platform roadmaps, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, architecture direction and delivery plans.
Coordinate dependencies across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform and business teams.
Drive delivery of shared, reusable AI platform capabilities that support scalable onboarding of use cases and teams.
Shape and maintain programme plans, milestones, budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues and dependencies.
Establish effective programme governance, decision forums and reporting for senior stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory, resilience and operational requirements.
Support the development of a sustainable cloud operating model, including platform ownership, service management, cost transparency and operational readiness.
Proactively identify delivery obstacles, resolve escalations and drive decisions across organisational boundaries.
Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement. 

 
Who you are
This role is a strong match if you are a strategic and delivery-oriented leader who can create clarity and momentum in a complex environment. You combine strong programme leadership with a solid understanding of cloud and AI technologies, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, and are comfortable challenging assumptions, influencing decisions and driving organisational alignment. 
Your background and skills include:
Proven track record of leading large-scale technology programmes and strategic transformation initiatives in cloud, data or AI environments. 
Strong experience driving delivery and governance of Google Cloud Platform initiatives across multiple technology domains. 
Deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform services, cloud foundations, platform engineering and cloud operating model principles. 
Experience establishing and evolving cloud and AI platform capabilities that enable scalable adoption of AI solutions across an enterprise. 
Strong understanding of AI technologies, including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, AI orchestration frameworks and emerging cloud-based capabilities. 
Ability to define and drive strategic roadmaps, translate them into executable delivery plans and ensure alignment with organisational priorities. 
Experience coordinating complex dependency landscapes across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and business teams. 
Strong governance and leadership skills, including establishing decision forums, steering committees and executive reporting structures. 
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across multiple organisational units and technology domains. 
Understanding of platform-oriented delivery models, including shared services, reusable capabilities, automated onboarding and self-service enablement. 
Strong understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational readiness and cloud financial management principles. 
Proven ability to proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments and drive successful outcomes in complex environments. 
Very good financial and resource management skills. 
Very good analytical skills and attention to detail. 
Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written. 
Can-do attitude.

What we offer
Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
Our way of working - We believe in bringing people together and want our offices to remain a cornerstone of the company. Our offices are where we connect, collaborate, learn from one another and build our culture. Therefore, as a principle, we work mostly from the office.
Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
Next steps
The recruitment process consists of the following steps:
Preliminary CV selection
Online interview with the hiring leader
Background check

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

jobs.employer_name: Moses Bil o Lack Tollarp AB
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsbeskrivning
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB är inte bara en arbetsplats, det är ett center för innovation och hantverksskicklighet inom bilindustrin. Beläget strax söder om Kristianstad, arbetar vi med en varierad kundbas som inkluderar försäkringsbolag, företag och privatpersoner. Vårt team på cirka 65 engagerade medarbetare arbetar i toppmoderna faciliteter, utrustade för att hantera allt från småreparationer till avancerade lackeringsuppdrag.
Som auktoriserad servicepartner till Volkswagen, Skoda, Seat, Volkswagen Transportbilar och Tesla, och med erfarenhet av att arbeta med de exklusiva bilarna från Koenigsegg, har vi etablerat oss som ett ledande fullservicecenter inom bilreparation och lackering. Att vi får förtroendet att lackera karossdelar från Koenigsegg är ett kvitto på vår strävan efter perfektion och vår förmåga att leverera resultat i världsklass.
Arbetsuppgifter
Vi söker nu passionerade och skickliga yrkespersoner som vill bli en del av vårt växande team. Vi har lediga tjänster för både förberedelsearbetare så som spacklare och maskerare samt polerare som brinner för detaljer och perfektion. I din roll kommer du att arbeta med en varierad flotta av bilar – allt från vardagsbilar till exklusiva modeller värda miljoner. Varje uppdrag kräver noggrannhet och ett öga för detaljer, och du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att säkerställa att varje bil lämnar vårt center i perfekt skick.
Vad vi erbjuder
Arbete med prestigeprojekt: Du får möjlighet att arbeta med bilar från några av världens mest exklusiva märken, inklusive Koenigsegg.
Moderna arbetsmiljöer: Våra faciliteter är toppmoderna och utrustade med den senaste teknologin inom bilreparation och lackering.
Ett sammansvetsat team: Hos oss är du inte bara en anställd, utan en del av en familj som stöttar varandra och strävar efter gemensamma mål.
Personlig utveckling: Vi värderar kompetens och erfarenhet, och ger dig möjligheten att utvecklas och växa inom företaget.
Kollektivt boende: Vi erbjuder kollektivboende som är på gång avstånd från arbetsplatsen .

Vem är du?
Vi söker dig som har omfattande erfarenhet inom bilförberedelse. Formell utbildning är meriterande, men inte ett krav – vi lägger större vikt vid din erfarenhet och de resultat du kan uppvisa. Du är en flexibel, pålitlig och dedikerad person som sätter kvalitet i första rummet. Ditt öga för detaljer och din förmåga att arbeta med precision, även under tidspress, är avgörande för att lyckas i denna roll.
Ansök nu
Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och bli en del av ett företag där perfektion är normen? Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB.
VACANCY NOTICE IN ENGLISH
About the Job
Company Description
Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB is not just a workplace; it's a hub of innovation and craftsmanship in the automotive industry. Located just south of Kristianstad, we serve a diverse clientele including insurance companies, businesses, and private individuals. Our team of around 60 dedicated employees works in state-of-the-art facilities, equipped to handle everything from minor repairs to advanced painting projects.
As an authorized service partner for Volkswagen, Skoda, Seat, Volkswagen Transport bilar and Tesla, and with experience working on the exclusive Koenigsegg cars, we have established ourselves as a leading full-service center in car repair and painting. Being entrusted with painting body parts for Koenigsegg is a testament to our pursuit of perfection and our ability to deliver world-class results.
Job Responsibilities
We are now seeking passionate and skilled professionals to join our growing team. We have openings for both preparation specialists and experienced painters who are dedicated to detail and perfection. In your role, you will work with a diverse range of vehicles—from everyday cars to exclusive models worth millions. Each task requires meticulousness and an eye for detail, and you will play a crucial role in ensuring every car leaves our center in perfect condition.
What We Offer
Prestigious Projects: You will have the opportunity to work on vehicles from some of the world’s most exclusive brands, including Koenigsegg.
Modern Work Environment: Our facilities are state-of-the-art and equipped with the latest technology in car repair and painting.
A Close-Knit Team: Here, you are not just an employee; you are part of a family that supports each other and strives towards common goals.
Personal Development: We value skills and experience and provide opportunities for you to grow and develop within the company.
Relocation package/Accomodation: We are offering accomodation. The accomodation is very close (walking distance) and is owned by the employer.
Help with administrative issues: The employer will also help you with administrative issues about living and working in Sweden

﻿Who You Are
We are looking for individuals with extensive experience in car preparation or painting. Formal education is advantageous but not required; we place more importance on your experience and the results you can demonstrate. You are a flexible, reliable, and dedicated person who prioritizes quality. Your attention to detail and ability to work with precision, even under pressure, are essential to succeed in this role.
Apply Now
Ready to take the next step in your career and be part of a company where perfection is the standard? Submit your application today and join Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB.

Make Nordic parcel logistics work better for customers and operations. Turn complex product needs into practical improvements.
PostNord is developing its Nordic parcel portfolio to create customer value, support profitable growth and harmonise services across markets. As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will play an important role in making these improvements work in practice within your assigned product area. You will combine your understanding of logistics and operational parcel flows with product expertise to improve processes, systems and services across the Nordics.The position offers the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across functions and Nordic markets, turning complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable data and practical improvements.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
The position offers a flexible hybrid workplace in a collaborative environment where colleagues support each other in reaching shared goals. Independent working methods are encouraged, alongside opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Benefits include:
The opportunity to work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance and access to office gym and swimming pool, depending on office location
Employee benefits through PostNord´s employee foundation, PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement
 

Your Responsibilities
As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will turn complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable product data and practical implementation support. Using your product expertise and understanding of logistics operations, you will help improve products, streamline launches and simplify everyday work.
The role will focus on either C2C/Recommerce or International & Customs, including international parcel flows, import and export. Responsibilities will be adapted to the assigned product area, customer journeys and operational needs.
Your main responsibilities include:
Build expertise in product logic, services, terms, customer needs and logistics processes.
Support Product Managers with insights for roadmaps, lifecycle decisions, portfolio optimisation and product improvements. 
Maintain clear product specifications, rules, terms input, operational requirements and documentation.
Translate operational needs into system requirements in close collaboration with IT and Operations.
Ensure accurate, consistent product data across systems and channels, and make product knowledge accessible to stakeholders.
Support launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs through readiness checks, implementation follow-up, issue resolution and hypercare.
Coordinate implementation across Operations, IT, Customer Service, Commercial, Legal, CX, Pricing and Nordic markets.
Share product knowledge through guidance, internal communication and change support.
Capture and escalate local needs, implementation issues and post-launch feedback to support Nordic product development and prioritisation.

The Bigger Picture
The position is part of PostNord´s Nordic product organisation, where operational understanding and collaboration across different functions are essential to improving parcel services.

The Nordic Product Specialist reports to the relevant Manager Solutions Area and works closely with Product Managers and colleagues across functions and Nordic markets. The role provides insight into how logistics processes, systems and customer needs connect across the Nordic network.

The position can be based at one of PostNord´s main offices in Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. A hybrid working model applies, with three days per week at the office. Some travel within the Nordics is expected, particularly when building relationships and gaining a deeper understanding of operations.
 
Our Expectations
The role is suited to someone who is curious, business minded and practical in their approach, combining product expertise with analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to challenge unclear logic, simplify complexity and connect people across Nordic markets is important. Taking ownership and following through until changes work in practice will be key to succeeding in the position.

Relevant experience from logistics, preferably parcel logistics, or from a role involving operational logistics flows and process improvements is important. Suitable backgrounds may include product management, operations, customer service, sales support, process development or a comparable area.

Relevant skills and experience include:
Understanding of logistics operations, operational processes and how parcel flows connect with systems and services.
Ability to structure complex product information, documentation, requirements and master data.
Understanding of how products, operations, systems, channels and market implementation connect.
Analytical, solution oriented thinking that turns product knowledge into practical improvements.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills to move work forward across functions.
Good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to analyse information and present findings clearly.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish.
 

Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, product launches, migrations or change initiatives involving different functions is an advantage. Relevant experience within international logistics and customs, or C2C/Recommerce, is also valuable depending on the assigned product area. A university or college degree is an advantage but not a requirement.
 
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

As Nordic Product Commercial Lead/T&C at PostNord, you turn product changes into commercial reality across the Nordics.
Turn Nordic product transformation into commercial reality. As Nordic Product Commercial Lead/T&C at PostNord, you create commercial product clarity and coordinate market readiness and implementation across markets. You connect product decisions and legal requirements with clear customer terms, commercial offers and practical go-to-market material. You will influence how product changes reach customers, strengthen Nordic collaboration and develop agents and digital tools that make product knowledge easier to access and apply. Based in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen, you join Nordic Parcel Product Management, where customer value, profitable growth and Nordic harmonisation are central.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
See your contribution take shape in launches, migrations and everyday commercial execution. You will join a Nordic team, combining clear ownership with broad cross-functional collaboration and great development opportunities. In addition to fair employment conditions according to collective agreements, we offer:
We offer you a flexible hybrid workplace with a prestige-free environment where we as a team help each other to reach our goals. We encourage self-sufficient leadership for development and career opportunities. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
Work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool
Employee benefits through PostNord´s own employee foundation PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement.

Your Responsibilities
You will ensure that parcel product changes are translated into clear, accurate and aligned terms, customer-facing material and commercial implementation plans.
Nordic terms and conditions: Develop, maintain and coordinate Nordic terms and conditions and the process for parcel-product-related changes. Ensure structured planning, stakeholder input, documentation and implementation follow-up, in close collaboration with each country’s price and terms process.
Harmonised product content and communication: Ensure clear, consistent product rules, service descriptions, limitations and commercial conditions across Nordic markets, aligned with legal, product and value proposition decisions. Translate these into customer-facing descriptions, FAQs, sales support and launch material. Develop internal communication plans and content across agreed channels.
Governance and continuous improvement: Maintain governance and documentation for commercial product content and terms. Identify and resolve inconsistencies, unclear product logic, customer friction and documentation gaps. Use feedback from customers, markets, Sales and Customer Service to improve clarity and commercial product material.
Commercial planning and market readiness: Coordinate commercial planning and activation for selected projects, product adjustments, launches and migrations, covering stakeholder alignment, market implementation and follow-up.
Agents and digital support tools: Develop agents and digital tools that improve efficiency, quality and consistency in product, T&C and customer-facing work, helping commercial teams understand and apply product information and customer value.
You work closely with Product Managers, Pricing Leads, Value Proposition Leads, Legal, Sales, Customer Service, Digital and country organisations.

The Bigger Picture
Nordic Parcel Product Management owns and develops the Nordic parcel portfolio across markets. Here, transformation means turning complex customer and operational needs into clear portfolio choices and effective delivery. The role reports to the Manager Value Proposition & CX.
You can be based at our offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. The hybrid arrangement means three days a week at the office and the option to work from home two days a week.
Selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. Certain positions may require a background check. If this becomes relevant, you will be informed in advance.
Our Expectations
Collaborative, structured and commercially minded, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to support PostNord’s Nordic transformation.
Experience from product management, commercial documentation, terms and conditions, sales  enablement, customer communication, go-to-market work or a comparable field.
Excellent writing and communication skills, experience from translating complex product information into consistent terms and customer-facing and operational material. 
An analytical, detail-oriented approach to identifying unclear logic and finding practical solutions.
Proven ability to plan and deliver cross-functional initiatives, align senior stakeholders across countries and commercial teams, and manage governance, timelines, dependencies and follow-up to ensure timely, high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.
Ability to create agents and tools that simplify work and help sales and commercial teams understand, explain and apply product, service and customer value information.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.
University degree, college degree, or equivalent higher education qualification.
Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, logistics, e-commerce, parcel products or regulated commercial environments is an advantage

You lead in line with PostNord’s leadership principles: Accountable, taking ownership of commercial clarity and execution plans; Brave, addressing uncertainty and misalignment early with facts and practical solutions; and Committed, staying focused on detail and delivery until full completion.
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

Shape how we grow, compete, and protect the value we create. As General Counsel for Business Area Machining, you are a trusted leader and strategic partner to the Business Area President and Management Team. Bringing together legal, intellectual property, compliance and governance expertise, you help turn complex matters into confident decisions, secure growth and a strong culture of integrity. 
About the job 
You act as senior legal adviser to the Business Area President and Management Team and take an active part in the management and governance of Sandvik Machining. With overall functional responsibility for Legal Support, Compliance, Legal M&A, Patents and Intellectual Property, you lead an international function supporting the business area and its divisions across multiple jurisdictions. Through proactive risk management and clear, simple governance, you balance risk to enable a decentralized, global business where accountability sits close to the customer. You also hold responsibility for our policy portfolio, Machining Way, and the continued development of the Machining management system.  
Working closely with Sandvik Group Legal and the Legal Management Team, you contribute to Group-wide priorities, governance and functional development. You report to the President of Business Area Machining and are a key member of the Management Team. 
Your impact 
Your work makes a tangible difference to our performance. You help the business win and grow by securing strong commercial agreements and protecting our intellectual property and innovation. You enable acquisitions, divestments and partnerships to be executed with speed and confidence. You protect our license to operate in a changing regulatory landscape and build trust among customers, authorities and colleagues through a credible compliance and Speak Up culture. 
Job responsibilities
Provide commercially oriented legal counsel to senior management and integrate legal, compliance and intellectual property perspectives into strategic decision-making. 
Lead the Legal, Compliance and IP function, setting priorities and developing its structure, capabilities, senior professionals and ways of working. 
Lead and inspire the global Legal function: set direction and priorities, build capabilities and succession, develop senior professionals and foster a high-performing, collaborative team culture. 
Oversee material legal and compliance risks, including commercial agreements, disputes, regulatory developments and the implementation of relevant Sandvik policies and procedures. 
Lead the business area's compliance framework and oversee Speak Up and Code of Conduct investigations, including escalation, remediation and follow-up. 
Provide strategic leadership of Legal M&A activities across acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, investments and partnerships. 
Hold responsibility for patents and intellectual property, ensuring that IP considerations are integrated into strategy, innovation and commercial decision-making.  

Location 
This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm, Sweden and requires global travel.  
Your profile 
To succeed in this executive position, you bring the legal and leadership capability to operate confidently at senior management level. You provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially grounded legal guidance under time pressure, enabling rapid decisions while protecting the company’s interests, reputation, and compliance obligations. You demonstrate sound judgment, calm leadership, and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives. The position calls for someone who can lead across legal disciplines while building strong collaboration across a complex international organization. 
Your background includes: 
Broad expertise in commercial legal matters, risk management and complex transactions. 
Strong understanding of compliance, integrity matters, investigations, patents and intellectual property. 
Ability to lead and develop senior professionals and multidisciplinary global legal functions. 
Experience working closely with executive management and a broad range of business and functional stakeholders. 

You build trust, encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and maintain an independent perspective when addressing significant legal, compliance and integrity matters. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Nuclear Competence Cluster Lead.
Lead with Vision. Inspire with Purpose. Build a Sustainable Future. 
Are you ready to make your mark and drive meaningful changes on a national, regional and global scale? 
We’re looking for a passionate Global Nuclear Standards Manager - someone who thrives on challenge, innovation, and cross-country collaboration. 
Who We Are 
At ABB, we are committed to meeting the world’s toughest challenges head-on. Our core values - care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - guide us every day as we work to empower our people and deliver sustainable solutions. Our culture of diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities ensure everyone has a chance to contribute and succeed. 
Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide*
While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience match this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.
This position does not require relocation. The selected candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office
About the Role 
As Global Nuclear Standards Manager, you will be a part of ABB’s Nuclear Competence Cluster, and play a key role in building the quality, standards and assurance framework required for ABB to scale as a global nuclear supplier. The role will act as a global point of expertise for nuclear quality and standards, helping ABB establish a consistent approach across businesses and markets while ensuring that local requirements are appropriately addressed. 
Own and continuously develop ABB’s global nuclear quality management system, standards framework and assurance model. 
Lead ABB’s roadmap toward ISO 19443 readiness and ensure alignment with applicable nuclear quality and regulatory requirements. 
Translate nuclear standards, regulations, industry and customer requirements into practical processes for engineering, procurement, manufacturing and project execution. 
Establish and maintain governance for nuclear audits, corrective actions, supplier qualification, management review and continuous improvement. 
Monitor evolving international and market-specific nuclear requirements and assess their impact on ABB’s operations and offering. 
Provide expert guidance to ABB businesses and local Quality teams on nuclear standards, compliance and quality requirements. 
Support customer audits, assessments and qualification activities including direct engagement with customers, representing ABB on nuclear quality and standards topics. 
Drive nuclear safety culture and best-practice sharing across ABB’s nuclear organization. 
Collaborate across Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and business teams to ensure consistent implementation of nuclear requirements globally. 
You will be mainly accountable for:
Influencing and consulting with senior management across ABB global organizational units/functions to innovatively shape the design and development of your functional area, to improve the organization’s overall performance.

jobs.occupation: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.
We call this role a Frontier Fellow: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.
About the role
You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.
Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.
The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.
What you will do
Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Shape HiveAI. Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.

What you might build
An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.

Who are you?
You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.
You bring:
Coding agents such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests
Experience taking software into production, where security, reliability and performance matter.
Practical knowledge of AI models and agents: how they behave, what they cost, how to measure them with evals.
Working knowledge of Azure, Entra ID, On-Behalf-Of and least privilege.
Direct customer-facing experience, from technical discovery and workshops to architecture discussions and communication with senior stakeholders.
A good understanding of modern product development, including when customer-specific functionality should become a reusable product capability.

Nobody ticks every box. If you're strong in several of these and know where to find help for the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
What is HiveAI?
At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.
At its core is the HiveAI Agent Platform, built on Microsoft Azure, which runs AI agents securely and at scale. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, which helps organisations develop, manage and continuously improve their agents over time.
Why Fellowmind?
Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.
Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.
The practicalities
Start: As soon as possible, and of course we'll take your notice period into account.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
Travel: You will work with regional teams and customers across Fellowmind, so travel is a natural part of the role.
Language: Professional proficiency in English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.
Process: We start with a screening interview, followed by in-depth interviews, assessments or case work, and reference checks.

Do you enjoy precise, well-organized work, and are you curious about how innovations are protected?
Are you curious about technology, innovation, and how groundbreaking ideas are protected? Join our global IPR team as an IPR Coordinator and become a key part of the journey from invention disclosure to granted patents around the world. In this role, you will work at the intersection of technology, intellectual property, and international collaboration, connecting inventors, patent engineers, R&D, Legal teams, and external patent agents. You will help ensure that valuable innovations are captured, protected, and managed efficiently while contributing to process development and data quality within a global organization. 
This role offers flexibility in location and can be based at one of our main offices in Sweden or Finland, with a preference for Karlstad in Sweden. 
Your responsibilities 
You will coordinate invention disclosures, register new matters in our IP management system, and work closely with inventors, patent engineers, and R&D teams throughout the innovation process. 
You will manage patent, trademark, utility model, and design filings by collaborating with inventors, external patent agents, and international stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met. 
You will maintain and develop our patent portfolio, monitor deadlines, coordinate office actions, and help secure high-quality intellectual property protection worldwide. 
You will support competitor monitoring activities and perform searches in international patent databases to help provide valuable patent information. 
You will manage IPR-related documentation, agreements, invoices, reporting, and data quality while supporting continuous improvements within the IPR function. 

Expectations for you 
You have a relevant post-secondary education and/or experience in administration, coordination, or a similar role. 
You have experience from IPR, legal services, or technology-intensive environments, or a strong motivation to develop expertise within intellectual property. 
You are comfortable working with digital systems, data management, reporting, and process improvement activities. 
You have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. 
You have advanced written and spoken Swedish and English proficiency. 

To succeed in this role 
Success in this position requires organizational skills, a structured way of working, and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines. You are comfortable coordinating stakeholders simultaneously and enjoy working in an international environment where accuracy and collaboration are essential. Your curiosity about technology and intellectual property, combined with a service-minded approach and strong digital skills, will help you create value across the organization. 
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer 
You will join a global IPR function that works closely with R&D, Legal, and business teams across multiple countries. You will gain hands-on insight into the world of patents, trademarks, and innovation protection while working alongside experienced colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge. The role provides opportunities to develop your IPR expertise, improve processes and systems, and contribute to how intellectual property is managed globally. 
At Valmet, you will find an inspiring and collaborative work environment where innovation and sustainability go hand in hand. We support your professional development through learning opportunities, flexible working arrangements, and competitive employee benefits. You will work with modern tools, international colleagues, and meaningful technologies that help industries move toward a more sustainable future. 
Want to know more? 
If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 6, by filling in our online application form. For further information about the position, please contact Ari Malkasaari, Director, IPR at ari.malkasaari@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 
When everything works together  
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.   
At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.  
Join the team – and lead the way with us!

 Our work includes functions such as Intelligent Speed Assist, glare-free lighting, driver distraction, drowsiness warnings and pilot assistance.  What you will do

 Who are you?

 You are someone who naturally connects the dots, sees dependencies before they become obstacles and takes initiative to bring clarity and alignment when development challenges arise.
 You bring structure to complex situations, communicate clearly across technical disciplines and enjoy facilitating discussions, building alignment and supporting a collaborative team environment.
 We believe that you have:

 Hands-on experience in software development using C++
 Experience working across the development life cycle, from requirements and design to implementation, integration and verification.
 A solid understanding of software architecture, interfaces and system behavior.
 Experience working in agile development teams and an interest in taking on Scrum Master responsibilities.
 Strong communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Additional experience that is valuable:

 Experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR or model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink.
 Software quality practices such as clean code, code reviews, static analysis, CI/CD, test automation, ASPICE or MISRA C++.
 Functional safety and safety of the intended functionality, including ISO 26262 and SOTIF.
 AI-assisted engineering, machine learning or data-driven methods for function development, analysis, testing or evaluation.

 Signal processing.
  
 
  
 Ready for the next move?
