jobs.description:
Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Software Engineer with expertise in React, Typescript, and Next.JS to join our dynamic development team. As an experienced Frontend Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the user interface of our web applications using React and related technologies. You will work in an agile team and collaborate with our product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.

Some of your responsibilities will include: 
Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications for COS application in Portfolio Brands
Strong working experience in Next.js, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Github actions
Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
Based in Stockholm and come to H&M Office in Stockholm atleast 4 days in a week
Collaborate with product owners, UX/UI designers, architects, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and implementation of engineering standards.
 AI First development mindset
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Strong understanding of frontend architecture patterns and state management solutions.
Strong integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL working with backend services.
Proficiency with version control systems such as Git.
Experience with testing frameworks and automated testing strategies.
Experience with cloud platforms Azure, or Aws or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
The Portfolio Brands domain enables brand-unique customer experiences and partnership solutions for our four Portfolio Brands. The domain has three areas, PB Digital Experience delivering the e-commerce platform and associated customer facing experience, PB Store Experience enabling our brands to create lasting store experiences for each brand and PB Partnership Solutions supporting PBs growth agenda through external sales.

Digital Experience delivers the e-commerce platform and the ecosystem of composable solutions for our Portfolio Brands, ensuring unique brand experiences can be implemented. The area leads business development and expertise across the e-commerce platform, digital marketing and omni-channel experience, ensuring stable operations as well as strategic vendor management.

COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear, and accessories rooted in exceptional quality and lasting design. The creative soul of the brand is fuelled by a deep connection to modern culture, dynamic global cities and compelling fashion movements. With an emphasis on expert craftsmanship, innovation and materiality, collections are created with a mindful approach, seamlessly blending contemporary and timeless.

Qualifications
WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with…
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
Proven work experience as a Frontend Engineer, preferably with a focus on Next.JS 
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
Experience with React.js and its core principles. 
Experience with Node.js is preferable.
Strong communication skills to collaborate with our clients and gather requirements. 
Familiarity with popular React libraries and frameworks such as Redux, React Router, or Next.js. 
Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development. 
Knowledge of frontend build tools and module bundlers such as Webpack or Babel. 
Experience with version control systems, preferably Git. 
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts. 
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks. 
Experience with backend technologies and RESTful APIs. 
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library. 
Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers. 
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

Additional Information
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 
Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market. 
30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance. 
Additional perks and discounts from Benify. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. 
Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

Shaping tomorrow's technology
At Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable,innovative, and data‑driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle lifecycle. We support the Volvo Group engineering community with advanced tools, methods, and architectures that enable continuous customer value even after start of production.
Our strategy is to accelerate the Software Defined Vehicles journey by using a layered software and electronic architecture with industry‑standard interfaces, enabling faster development and regional adaptation.By decoupling hardware from software, we ensure that software can evolve independently, unlocking flexibility, scalability, and long‑term performance improvements. We align our electrical and software architecture with business and operational models to fully leverage the potential of Software Defined Vehicles.
Are you passionate about shaping the future of automotive technology? We are looking for a highly skilled Specialist Electronics Development Engineer to play a key role in the development of advanced automotive electronic systems, including Electronic Control Units (ECUs) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.
In this position, you will combine your deep technical expertise with strong leadership and project coordination skills, working closely with Tier 1 suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams. You will be instrumental in driving technical excellence, ensuring robust validation, and delivering high-quality solutions for next-generation vehicle systems.
What You Will Do
As a Specialist Electronics Development Engineer, you will:
Lead and support the development of advanced automotive electronic systems, with a focus on ECUs and HPC platforms.
Coordinate development activities across hardware, software, and verification teams to ensure seamless execution.
Collaborate closely with Tier 1 suppliers to align technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
Drive validation activities to ensure product quality, robustness, and compliance with automotive standards.
Manage and resolve technical issues using structured methodologies, including root cause analysis, failure investigation, and 8D reporting.
Define, maintain, and follow up on action plans, project risks, and issue resolution activities.
Monitor project progress and provide regular updates on milestones, technical status, and key risks.
Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and ensure clear communication among all stakeholders.
Contribute to continuous improvements in engineering processes, validation methods, and project execution practices.

Who You Are
You are a technically strong and structured engineering professional with a passion for automotive electronics and a proven ability to lead complex development activities. You thrive in collaborative environments, confidently manage multiple stakeholders, and enjoy solving challenging technical problems.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
Extensive experience in automotive electronics development.
Proven experience developing ECUs and exposure to High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.
Demonstrated technical leadership experience, including leading engineering teams and technical activities.
Strong understanding of collaboration models with Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs.
Experience in automotive validation and verification activities.
Experience in project management or technical coordination within automotive development programs.
Hands-on experience with:
Action plan management
Failure analysis and root cause investigations
8D problem-solving methodology
Progress tracking and project follow-up
Experience working in cross-functional environments involving hardware, software, and verification teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing complex automotive programs involving multiple stakeholders and supplier networks.
Knowledge of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.
Experience with system integration and issue resolution in multidisciplinary environments.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international engineering organization.

 
Key Competencies
Automotive electronics expertise
Technical leadership
Structured and analytical problem-solving
Cross-functional collaboration
Project planning and execution
Effective communication and stakeholder management
Supplier and customer interface management
Results-driven mindset

 
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on cutting-edge automotive technologies and contribute to innovative products that shape the future of mobility. You will work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative, international environment where your expertise, leadership, and ideas will help drive technical excellence and meaningful results.
In this role, you will report to the Head of ECU and HW
Ready to take the next step in your career? We look forward to hearing from you.
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. 
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

At Voyado we’re growing internationally, and with growth comes new opportunities, challenges, and decisions to make. That’s where you come in!
We’re looking for an FP&A Lead who combines a sharp analytical mind with a strong commercial mindset. Someone who’s curious about the business behind the numbers, enjoys working with people, and isn’t afraid to challenge assumptions or bring new ideas to the table.
This is a role where you’ll get the best of both worlds: taking the lead in a small team while staying close to the business and getting hands-on with the numbers yourself.
Sound like your kind of challenge? Keep reading!
About the role
As our FP&A Lead, you’ll connect financial performance with what’s happening across the business.
You’ll provide day-to-day leadership for a team of business controllers, setting priorities and supporting their success without formal people-management responsibilities. Working closely with stakeholders across Voyado, you’ll turn financial insights into meaningful conversations that help drive smarter business decisions.
You’ll also help develop our FP&A processes and ways of working as we continue to scale. You’ll report directly to our CFO, Björn Källén.
Some things you'll be up to:
Partner with the business. Work closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, challenge assumptions, and bring financial and commercial perspectives to the table.
Stay hands-on. Own financial planning, forecasting, performance follow-ups, and analysis for your business areas.
Connect the dots. Analyze SaaS metrics and business performance to identify opportunities, understand what’s driving growth, and support better decisions.
Lead by example. Guide the team’s day-to-day work, support your colleagues, and foster collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Challenge and improve. Help develop our FP&A processes, reporting, and tools, including exploring how automation and AI can help us work smarter.

Who you are
First things first: we’re not looking for someone who simply loves spreadsheets and financial reporting. We’re looking for someone who loves understanding a business and using numbers to make a difference.
We believe you bring:
Solid experience in FP&A, business controlling, commercial finance, or a similar business-oriented finance role.
Hands-on experience in tech/B2B SaaS, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue models and key metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, and customer economics.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial data into actionable business insights.
A commercial mindset and experience working closely with stakeholders to influence business decisions.
Experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.
The ability to guide and support others, bring people together, and create structure and momentum in a team.
Professional fluency in English.

Experience leading or coordinating others is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take initiative, bring people together, and lead by example.
Your background doesn’t have to follow the traditional finance path. What matters is that you understand the commercial side, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn insights into action.
High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.
You’ll join a growing international SaaS company where finance plays an important role in shaping the business.
You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. With plenty of room to challenge existing ways of working, bring new ideas, and influence how we grow, this is a role where your contribution will truly matter.
And of course, we want you to enjoy the journey along the way!
Some of our benefits:
30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

About Voyado
Voyado is the agentic OS for retail. AI is only as good as what it knows about the business, so Voyado brings customer, product, order, and behavioral data together in one connected system, creating the context retail runs on. With retail intelligence and agentic reasoning on top, AI agents use that single source of truth to make informed decisions and act across the full customer journey.
By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
Ready to make an impact?
Fantastic! 🎉
Applying is easy — just upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
Additional information
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
Making it personal with AI
We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

Are you looking for your next challenge in Firmware Development?
We are looking for a curious, driven, and engaged Firmware Developer to help shape the future of our connected smart lock solutions. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of innovative products that deliver secure and seamless access experiences to customers around the world.
Join ASSA ABLOY Opening Solutions in Malmö, Sweden, and become part of a talented team where knowledge transfer, innovation, and engagement are at the heart of everything we do. We offer an environment that empowers you to grow professionally, take ownership of your work, and build a career you can be proud of.
At ASSA ABLOY, our success is built on the values of Empowerment, Innovation, and Integrity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking culture where new ideas are encouraged, people are inspired to make an impact, and collectively develop market-leading solutions that help our customers live, work, and move through the world more safely and conveniently.
What you would do as our Firmware Developer
You will join a small team of experts and play a key role in developing innovative connected products from concept to market. Working in a team-oriented, cross-functional environment, you will help create secure, dependable, and high-performing embedded solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.
You would also:
Analyse product and system requirements and translate them into effective firmware architectures and technical solutions.
Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for both new product development and existing product enhancements.
Collaborate closely with hardware, cloud, mobile, and product teams to ensure seamless integration and successful product delivery.
Contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and scalable technologies for the next generation of connected access solutions.
Participate in technical reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen product quality, performance, and engineering practices.

The skills and experience you need 
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, combined with 3-7 years of professional experience in embedded real-time software development.
Demonstrates strong programming skills in C and a solid comprehension of RTOS concepts, including threading, synchronization, memory management, and interrupt handling, along with hands-on experience in embedded software development, debugging, and modern development practices using tools such as J-Link, GDB, Git, or similar.
Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to the successful delivery of complex embedded software solutions.
Is fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantage.
Is passionate about developing high-quality embedded systems and has a proactive mindset toward learning new technologies, improving software quality, driving innovation, and taking ownership of their work.

Ideally, you would also have experience with Zephyr RTOS; microcontroller platforms from vendors such as Nordic, STMicroelectronics, or NXP; secure firmware development including secure boot, cryptography, key management, and certificate handling; IoT protocols and connectivity technologies such as MQTT, Matter, Bluetooth® Low Energy (BLE), Wi-Fi, and Thread; low-power battery-operated IoT devices; peripheral driver development for interfaces such as SPI, I2C, and UART; as well as Python programming and test automation.
What we offer
We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:
Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills. 
A competitive salary and benefits package.
A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
The chance to make a meaningful impact in attracting and retaining top talent.

We review applications regularly, so don’t wait
We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.
To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post.
If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Alexandra Kymäläinen, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at alexandra.kymalainen@assaabloy.com
Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be a subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.
Let’s create a safer and more open world - together! 
To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com
We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. 
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

At TRATON Group, we believe that the whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Together with our brands we can make the future of transportation more sustainable - Let's make a difference together.
 
The TRATON AB office, located in Södertälje, consists of experienced colleagues with various backgrounds and nationalities from all TRATON Group brands. We enjoy solving strategic problems cross functional and cross brand in the TRATON Group. We strive for a climate where opinions and knowledge are openly shared within and between teams and we welcome new ideas in order to create dynamic synergies. 
 
With its brands Scania, MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus and International, TRATON Group is one of the world's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. Its offering comprises light-duty commercial vehicles, trucks, and buses. At TRATON, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation. Find out more: www.traton.com
Role Summary
As a Product Cost Controller, you will drive product cost planning, analysis, and optimization to support the profitability of TRATON's products. Working closely with R&D, Controlling, and brand teams across the Group, you will set cost targets, evaluate cost performance, and identify improvement opportunities. The role combines financial analysis, technical understanding, and cross-functional collaboration in an international environment.
Job Responsibilities
 
As part of the Group Product Cost Controlling team, you will work cross-functionally with TRATON AB, local R&D entities, and brand Controlling teams. Together, you are responsible for calculating, challenging, and tracking product costs for current and future products.
 
Your responsibilities include:
 
Deriving top-down product cost targets from a market perspective in early product development phases
Setting clear cost ambitions to secure long-term profitability
Driving and facilitating cross-functional discussions, workshops, and benchmark activities to identify and implement cost-optimizing measures
Performing product cost calculations throughout the entire product lifecycle
Consolidating cost data into comprehensive product cost views across all brands
Presenting analyses and results in cross-functional committees and to senior stakeholders
Tracking and monitoring product cost development over time
Conducting deviation analysis and supporting change management activities

 
As this is a Group function, you will maintain a holistic TRATON perspective and collaborate frequently with all brands within the Group.
Who You Are
You combine analytical strength with technical curiosity and a strong business mindset. You are comfortable working close to product development and thrive in environments where finance meets engineering.
 
We believe you bring:
 
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong interest in technical matters
5-10 years of experience within product cost controlling of hardware products, or related areas such as Purchasing, R&D, Project Management, or Strategy
Strong analytical capability and a high level of quality awareness and accountability
A structured, communicative, and collaborative working style
The ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling way
A genuine interest in working in a diverse, international environment with stakeholders across the globe
Fluency in English (written and verbal). Swedish or German is considered a strong advantage

 
You are a team player who challenges constructively, drives progress, and contributes to securing long-term profitability through structured cost governance.
This Is Us
TRATON Group Product Cost Controlling is part of Project and Product Cost Controlling and plays a key role in ensuring the profitability of TRATON's product portfolio.
 
We operate in a dynamic and complex environment, working closely with cross-functional management teams and product development organizations across the Group. Our team culture is characterized by collaboration, high ambition, and continuous learning.
 
We believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and better decision-making. We value different perspectives and backgrounds and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
 
At TRATON, we also recognize the importance of work-life balance and strive to provide the flexibility and support our employees need to succeed both professionally and personally.
TRATON AB Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON supports your professional growth both locally and internationally. 
Benefits include access to our health center & wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. The group also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm. 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-04. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 
 
If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
Emma Karlsson, Head of Product Cost Cab & EE/SW/AU, emma.x.karlsson@scania.com 
We look forward to your application! 
This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON AB

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   
With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  
SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   
Want to help create a safer workplace where people can do their best work? 
As Health & Safety Coordinator at Esrange Space Center, you will help managers turn work environment requirements into clear routines and practical improvements. You will work closely with teams across the site to identify risks, strengthen safe working practices and support compliance with Swedish work environment regulations. 
This is a hands-on role combining coordination, analysis and training in a technical environment, where your focus will be occupational health and safety. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS
A relevant university degree in engineering, risk management, occupational health and safety, or equivalent knowledge gained through work experience. 
At least five years of relevant health and safety experience. 
In-depth knowledge of Swedish work environment regulations and experience applying them in practice. 
Experience working at industrial or technical sites in Sweden where operations involve significant health and safety risks. 
Fluency in Swedish and English. 
A category B driving license valid within the European Economic Area. 

You communicate clearly and can explain requirements in a way that helps people understand what they need to do and why. You are comfortable addressing risks, challenging unsafe practices and following up on agreed actions. You bring sound judgement, integrity and an analytical approach, together with the ability to build effective working relationships across different teams. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 
Support managers in systematic work environment management, including risk assessments, safety rounds, allocation of work environment tasks and an annual work environment plan. 
Develop and improve health and safety processes in line with SSC Space’s global management system. 
Provide guidance on Swedish work environment regulations and coordinate health and safety inspections and audits with relevant authorities. 
Support incident investigations and root cause analysis, and follow up on actions to prevent recurrence. 
Establish routines for tracking required training and certificates for high-risk work, such as working at height.  
Coordinate chemical inventories, safety data sheets and chemical risk assessments together with the organization. 
Develop and deliver health and safety training and communication for managers and employees. 
Monitor health and safety indicators, support the Site Manager with performance reporting and contribute to improvements and certification preparations. 

You will collaborate with site management, line managers, safety representatives, HR, the Range Safety Office, the Environmental Manager, the Group HSE Officer and specialists responsible for flammable goods and explosives. 

 JOB BENEFITS 
We offer you   
A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.  
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.  
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   

Additional benefits  
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.   
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.  
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.   
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.  
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.  
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  

LOCATION  
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our space base Esrange outside of Kiruna. 

FURTHER INFORMATION
For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:  
Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com  
Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com  
    
NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  
As the application period runs close to the Christmas holidays, please be aware that feedback and next steps may take a little longer than usual. We appreciate your patience during this period. 
When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.   
As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.  

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE  
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  
With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.   
 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Mips gives you the confidence to follow your passion. Whether you are training for fitness, riding to work, heading out on the mountain or playing team sports, our mission is leading the world to safer helmets. Mips specializes in helmet-based safety and is a world-leader in this area. Based on an ingredient brand business-model, Mips’ safety system is sold to the global helmet industry. The technology is based on over 25 years of research and development together with the Royal Institute of Technology and the Karolinska Institute, both located in Stockholm, Sweden. Mips’ headquarter with 84 employees engaged in research and development, sales, marketing and administration is in Stockholm, where its product and technology test facility also is located. The Mips share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap. For more information: www.mipscorp.com2025, Mips announced its acquisition of KOROYD, strengthening the company’s world-leading helmet safety technology portfolio with complementary technology. Recognizing the potential synergies between the two brands and their respective technologies, Mips and KOROYD will continue to operate separately under their respective leadership teams. www.koroyd.com
As Mips grows across markets, channels and audiences, the brand is becoming a central driver of commercial value. We are now looking for a Global Brand Lead to take ownership of the brand on a global level and turn it into one clear strategy, one strong brand team and one consistent expression in every market and every channel.
The role
 
You set the strategic direction for the Mips brand, you lead the global brand team that delivers it, and you drive brand awareness across both B2B and B2C audiences. You are part of the marketing leadership team and the connecting point between brand strategy and commercial execution. This is a highly cross-functional role: you work with the rest of Marketing, Product and Sales so the brand is expressed consistently and effectively. Your mission is to build a brand that is trusted by the manufacturers who put Mips in their helmets and preferred by the people who wear them. 
 
What you will do
Own the global brand strategy. Develop and own positioning, brand platform, narrative and visual identity, and translate them into clear priorities and targets for the brand team.
Lead and develop the global brand team. Lead, coach and develop a team of an Art director, a graphic designer, a content creator and a product marketer, and set clear priorities.
Lead the creative and content function. Own the brand and creative platform, brief and empower the Art director to drive the creative expression, and make sure design, content and campaign production deliver against the brand strategy. Own the global content strategy and plan across channels, and prioritize production capacity against business needs.
Build awareness and preference. Grow brand awareness and preference among B2B customers and B2C end consumers, adapting the message to each audience without diluting the brand, and turn strategy into campaigns, activations and go-to-market plans together with the team.
Connect brand and product marketing. Make sure product positioning, messaging and launch narratives are aligned with the brand across B2B and B2C, and partner with Trade marketing, PR and Digital to deliver a consistent brand experience across all touchpoints.
Measure and sharpen. Define and follow up on brand KPIs: awareness, consideration, preference and brand equity. Use the insights to sharpen the strategy and present results to senior leadership.
Be the guardian of the brand. Govern the brand guidelines, approve key assets and support partners and customers in using the brand correctly.
Manage budget and partners. Own the global brand budget and the relationships with external agency partners.

 
 
Who you are
You have at least 7+ years of experience in international brand management, head of brand or head of marketing with brand lead, ideally from a similar type of passion driven context.
You have experience of leading a brand team of specialists, including creative and content roles such as designers, content creators and product marketers, with strong people leadership and coaching skills.
You write sharp briefs and know how to work with senior creatives.
You have worked in both B2B and B2C environments and understand how brand building differs between them.
You are strategic: you move from insight and analysis to a clear brand strategy, and then make it actionable.
You have documented experience of building brand awareness and measuring its effect.
You are a strong collaborator who thrives in a cross-functional, matrixed and international organization, with excellent stakeholder management skills and comfort presenting to senior leadership.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is a strong advantage.

 
Why Mips? 
 
Mips has built a strong position in safety, with a technology trusted by leading brands around the world. Cycling represents around 70% of our sales, while sport, motorcycle and new categories offer exciting opportunities for growth. Europe is a key focus, with Germany as a priority market. Now is the time to build the next chapter of MIPS. If you want a role where you can shape a global brand, build a team and see your ideas come to life across markets, this could be your next challenge.
 
Location: Stockholm/Solna
 
Reporting to: Head of Marketing
 
Scope: Global

Job Description

Are you passionate about creator culture, social-first content and the role creators play in shaping how brands connect with audiences? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead, focusing on social and creative Strategy to help shape and elevate how we approach creator marketing across markets. 
In this role, you’ll combine the full scope of a Creator Marketing Lead with particular depth in social culture, creator-led marketing and creative strategy. You’ll bring a strong point of view on what makes creator content relevant, distinctive and effective, translating audience insights, cultural shifts and social behaviors into creator strategies and campaigns. 
You’ll work in Creator Marketing, under Creative Studios, work with local market teams and strategic functions to strengthen our creator marketing approach, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, creatively strong and connected to broader brand and business priorities. 
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead, you’ll lead creator marketing across assigned markets while championing social-first and creative strategic thinking within the wider Creator Marketing team. 
You’ll translate strategic priorities and audience insights into clear creator recommendations, campaign approaches and activation plans, while supporting teams in delivering high-quality creator work at scale. 
You will: 
Shape quarterly creator marketing strategies, priorities and budget allocation across assigned markets or areas. 
Work closely with markets to identify opportunities and translate them into relevant creator activation plans. 
Shape creator recommendations, briefs, campaign approaches and creative direction through a social-first lens. 
Bring audience insights, creator culture, platform behaviours and emerging content trends into strategic and creative decision-making. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment across assigned initiatives. 
Partner closely with the Creative Strategist and other strategic functions across Creative Studios to ensure creator initiatives are rooted in audience insight, cultural relevance and strong creative direction. 
Ensure creator marketing initiatives connect with broader brand, creative and business objectives while remaining authentic to creators and their audiences. 
Identify emerging creator, platform and cultural opportunities and translate them into actionable recommendations for the team. 
Develop and evolve creator marketing best practices, frameworks and ways of working that strengthen quality and consistency across markets. 
Act as a subject matter expert for social-first creator marketing, continuously helping evolve and future-proof our approach. 
 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for an experienced creator marketing professional who combines strategic thinking with a strong creative instinct and a deep understanding of social culture. 
You understand the creator landscape beyond individual campaigns. You’re curious about how audiences behave, how creator and platform cultures evolve and why certain ideas resonate. You can turn those insights into clear strategies, creative recommendations and relevant creator activations. 
At the same time, you have the operational and leadership capabilities required of a Creator Marketing Lead. You’re comfortable setting direction, managing priorities and budgets, guiding teams and influencing stakeholders across functions and markets. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator or influencer marketing, with a strong track record of developing and leading creator marketing initiatives at scale. 
Deep understanding of social platforms, creator culture, audience behaviours and evolving content trends. 
Proven experience shaping creator strategies, campaign approaches, creative recommendations and briefs. 
A strong social-first mindset and the ability to assess what makes creator content culturally relevant, authentic and effective. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate insights and strategy into clear activation plans. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance creative ambition, audience relevance and brand objectives with strong operational delivery. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with a clear point of view and the confidence to challenge, influence and continuously raise the quality of creator marketing work. 

WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.  
 

JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency.

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
WELCOME TO THE TEAM!
Join us in leading the verification of Volvo CE software and HMI platforms, helping ensure that our machines and digital solutions deliver robust, safe, and high-quality customer experience. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you want to make a difference on a global scale while working with next-generation technologies and highly collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
The Volvo Group culture is defined by a set of five carefully chosen values- Customer success, Trust, Passion, Change, and Performance. These values guide our day-to-day behavior and drive our decision-making at all levels of the organization. They express our shared beliefs across countries and entities to form the basis for a high-performing culture that can help maximize the full potential of the organization. Our company values help guide us on that journey.
About the Role
As a System Software Verification Leader, you will be part of a collaborative team working cross-functionally across Software platform, HMI platform, and other system-level projects. You will lead verification from requirements and architecture through system integration, test environments, and final product validation, creating clarity and enabling people with different perspectives and experiences to contribute.
Who are you?
You enjoy bringing people together to solve complex, real-world engineering problems and are curious about how software, electronics, interfaces, and complete machine systems work together. You combine a broad system-level perspective with hands-on technical capability and can guide teams through verification challenges across software platforms, HMI, and embedded-system projects.
You value collaboration, listen actively, and create space for different perspectives. You take ownership of outcomes while enabling others to contribute and grow. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, adapting as priorities and information evolve, and creating direction when the path is not fully defined. You communicate effectively in English and are confident making pragmatic decisions, constructively challenging solutions and exploring novel approaches together with cross-functional and international teams.
What will make you successful in this role:
Demonstrated experience in system verification for automotive, construction equipment or other complex embedded-systems domain, with the ability to define and drive verification strategies, test plans, and quality.
Broad understanding of software platforms, HMI systems, ECUs, vehicle networks, and system integration, including how user interaction, embedded software and machine functions come together at system level. Familiarity with CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, or SOME/IP is valuable.
Hands-on experience with verification tools and test environments. Experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, CAPL or VT System is an advantage.
Experience in test automation and software-driven verification. Knowledge of Python, object-oriented programming, Git or CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins and GitLab CI is beneficial.
Experience with HIL or simulation-based verification environments, such as dSPACE, and an interest in building efficient, repeatable, and scalable testing.
Ability to lead complex technical investigations, log analysis, and root-cause analysis, translating findings into clear and actionable feedback for development teams.
Proven ability to set technical direction, establish verification priorities and drive commitments to completion, while improving automation, coverage, traceability, and efficiency across the verification lifecycle.
An inclusive leadership approach, with the ability to mentor engineers, encourages different perspectives and facilitates sound, data-informed decisions.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, explain complex technical topics and establish clear verification priorities.
Comfort with ambiguity and change: You thrive in evolving environments where requirements, technologies and priorities may not always be fully defined. You balance structure with experimentation, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and help the team turn uncertainty into clear next steps without losing momentum.

What’s in it for you?
The role is based at our Technology Center in Eskilstuna, where you will have direct access to our machines, test rigs, and modern verification facilities. This gives you the opportunity to lead verification in representative environments and collaborate closely with development teams and other stakeholders. You will have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, shape verification capabilities, explore modern technologies and grow your career within a large international organization.
We recognize that strong candidates bring different experiences and may not meet every qualification listed. If this role interests you and you believe your skills can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.
Ready for the next move?
If you are curious to explore how we put our words into actions, follow us on LinkedIn and volvogroup.com.
Last day to apply: 10 December 2026.
Location: Eskilstuna Technology Center. The role requires regular on-site presence to work with machines and test environments, with flexibility based on business and project needs.
For questions about the position, please contact: Kumar Mrinal, Head of System Verification (Mrinal.kumar@volvo.com) or Talent Acquisition Partner Olof Person, (olof.person@volvo.com)
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. We look forward to receiving your application!
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.occupation: Customer & Market Insights Analyst at PostNord.
jobs.description:
Turn customer and market insights into business opportunities as Nordic Value Proposition Analyst at PostNord.
Do you enjoy turning customer, market and commercial data into clear insights and business opportunities? Perhaps you are currently working as a Commercial Analyst, Customer Insights Analyst, Customer & Market Insights Analyst or in a similar analytical role. Join PostNord in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen as Nordic Value Proposition Analyst and help build the fact base behind stronger Nordic value propositions, sharper sales activation and measurable commercial impact. You will collaborate across markets and functions, help shape how customer and market insights are gathered and used, and build insight capabilities that directly influence commercial decisions.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
Join a Nordic team where your insights help shape stronger customer value propositions and commercial decisions. You will work closely with colleagues across markets and functions, with broad exposure to sales activation, customer experience and product development. You will also have the opportunity to build insight capabilities, develop ways of working and challenge established assumptions with data.
We offer you a flexible hybrid workplace with a prestige-free environment where we as a team help each other to reach our goals. We encourage self-sufficient leadership for development and career opportunities. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
Work in a Nordic and flexible environment
Good insurance and occupational pension conditions
Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool
Employee benefits through PostNord´s own employee foundation PostNord Plus
Employment according to a collective agreement.

Your Responsibilities
You will help ensure that value proposition development and commercial activation are grounded in evidence. By combining data and insight from multiple sources, you will identify customer pains, needs, buying triggers, value gaps and segment opportunities.
Turn data into actionable insight: Identify and structure relevant data, tools and sources across customers, markets, products, CX, sales, brand and countries to build a strong fact base for commercial decisions.
Deepen customer and market understanding: Identify customer pains, needs, buying triggers, value gaps and segment opportunities across markets and customer groups.
Drive commercial priorities: Translate insights into clear recommendations for value propositions, Sales Plays and commercial activation, providing fact-based input to roadmaps, business cases and continuous improvement.
Measure performance and impact: Define relevant KPIs and measurement frameworks, and follow up the performance and commercial impact of value propositions, sales materials and activation initiatives.
Build effective feedback loops: Consolidate input from countries, sales teams, customers, CX and product teams, identifying recurring gaps and unmet needs and translating them into actionable feedback for Product Managers.
Enable data-driven decision-making: Develop dashboards, analytical materials and decision support, collaborating with IT and other stakeholders to continuously improve the tools, data structures and reporting capabilities needed for high-quality analysis.

The Bigger Picture
PostNord is on a transformation journey where customer value, profitable growth and Nordic harmonisation are central. Nordic Parcel Product Management owns and develops the Nordic parcel portfolio across markets.
As Nordic Value Proposition Analyst, you provide the fact base for Nordic value proposition development. You support and collaborate with Value Proposition Leads, CX Leads, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders by translating customer, market, product, sales, CX and country insights into clear analyses, opportunity areas, prioritisation input and actionable recommendations. The role reports to the Manager Value Proposition & CX.
You will be based at one of PostNord’s main offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. The hybrid working policy includes three days per week in the office.
Our Expectations
We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical professional who turns customer and market insights into clear priorities and business impact. You are curious, structured and connect the dots across customers, markets, products, sales and CX.
Customer & market insight: You identify customer pains, needs, buying triggers, value gaps and segment opportunities across markets and customer groups, combining data sources and analytical tools to understand what drives customer value.
From insight to commercial action: You translate complex insights into actionable recommendations that strengthen Nordic value propositions, Sales Plays and commercial activation, supporting strategic priorities and day-to-day decisions.
Performance & impact: You define relevant KPIs, measure customer response, sales usage and commercial impact, and turn findings into decision support for roadmap priorities, business cases and continuous improvement.
Collaboration & feedback loops: You work across countries and functions, bringing together sales, customer, CX and product perspectives. You identify recurring gaps and unmet needs, communicating insights through dashboards, summaries and recommendations that support commercial and product development.
Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one Nordic language.
University degree, college degree or equivalent higher education qualification.
Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, logistics, e-commerce, product management, sales enablement or customer insight is an advantage.

You work in line with PostNord’s leadership ABC principles: Accountable, owning the insight fact base, analysis quality, dashboards and commercial recommendations; Brave, challenging assumptions with data and turning gaps, risks and insights into clear recommendations; Committed, building insight capability, improving data quality and turning analysis into practical impact.
Interested?
We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in materials informatics and materials digital infrastructure
jobs.description:
Work assignments 
The primary focus of the position is on developing methods and software for making materials data accessible, interoperable, and reusable, as well as for managing, processing, and analyzing large-scale materials datasets. The research aims to advance data-driven materials science by improving the standardization, exchange, and utilization of research data and computational tools.
 
The work may include the development of methods for data management and interoperability, standardized data representations, integration of databases and computational workflows, and the application of AI/machine learning methods to materials data. The research may also involve the development and application of computational physics methods, high-throughput simulations, and data-driven approaches to understanding and predicting materials properties.
 
The position is connected to the EU project MaterialsCommons, which aims to establish a federated European digital infrastructure and a common digital market for materials data and services, connecting databases, computational tools, and other digital resources across institutions and national boundaries.
As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.
Qualifications
To be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree.  This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.
It is considered advantageous if your doctoral degree is no older than three years at application deadline for this job. If there are special reasons for having an older doctoral degree – such as taking statutory leave – then these may be taken into consideration.
Your application must include documents that clearly show that you fulfill the following requirements for the position:
A doctoral degree in physics, materials science, or equivalent. A course transcript with grades must be included in the application.
A record of multiple research publications in theoretical and computational materials science, materials design, and/or materials informatics.
Co-authored publications demonstrating experience with data-driven materials research.
Extensive, documented programming experience, particularly in Python, demonstrated, for example, through co-authored publications describing the use of Python and links to open-source software to which the applicant has contributed.

It is considered a strong merit for the position if your application shows (i) co-authored publications that involve work with materials databases and datasets; (ii) direct technical experience with maintaining materials databases and making research data accessible through them.
It is considered a merit for the position if your application shows: (i) course transcripts demonstrating high grades in completed courses of high relevance to the work assignments; (ii) other documented experience demonstrating a high level of understanding and skill in the fields of thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, group theory, crystallography, and crystal symmetry; (iii) experience with AI/ML for materials science.
You are expected to be creative, independent, and intellectually curious, and to have a high level of engagement and motivation to contribute to materials science and materials data infrastructure.
The workplace
The position is at the Materials Design and Informatics Unit within the Division of Theoretical Physics, Department of Physics, Chemistry and Biology (IFM), Linköping University.
The unit conducts research in theoretical and computational physics, with a particular emphasis on computational materials science and materials informatics. Our research includes large-scale computational studies of materials, development of software and automated workflows for scientific computations, management and analysis of data in large-scale materials databases, and development and application of informatics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) methods in materials science.
More information at: https://liu.se/en/research/materials-design-and-informatics
The employment
This employment is a temporary contract of two years with the possibility of extension up to a total maximum of three years.
 
The employment is full-time.
Starting date by agreement.
Salary and employment benefits
At Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.
More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.
Union representatives
Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.
Application procedure
Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 8 December, 2026. 
 
 
 
Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. 
 
 
 
Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. 
Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University. 
 
 
 
In the event of a discrepancy between the English translation of the job announcement and the Swedish original, the Swedish version shall take precedent. 
 
We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

jobs.occupation: Development Engineer - Visibility Components and Mechatronics
jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let's make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.

Role Summary
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden
Help shape the future of vehicle visibility and mechatronics at TRATON 
Growing demands for safety, comfort and functionality are driving the development of tomorrow's commercial vehicles. As new technologies enable more advanced functions, vehicle systems become increasingly complex, placing higher demands on the capabilities, performance and integration of our lighting and mechatronic components. 
 TGREEVV Visibility Components and Mechatronics develops components for TRATON's heavy commercial vehicles. Our scope includes exterior lighting such as headlamps, fog lamps and roof lamps. Interior lighting such as reading lights and ambient lighting. And mechatronic components such as sensors, washer systems, actuators and sound systems. 
We are looking for a Development Engineer who is curious about technology and wants to help develop reliable, high-quality products for future TRATON vehicles. 
 
Job Responsibilities
You will take technical responsibility for components throughout their development and product lifecycle. Working with colleagues across TRATON and with external suppliers, you will help turn requirements into robust solutions, from early development through testing, industrialisation and production follow-up. 
Your work will combine technical problem solving, collaboration and practical evaluation. This may include reviewing designs and requirements, building or assessing prototypes, and planning or carrying out tests in laboratories, vehicles or at test facilities. 
 In this role, you will:
Define, review and follow up technical requirements for your components. 
Coordinate development activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders. 
Plan and follow up verification and validation, including laboratory, vehicle and field testing. 
Analyse test results, resolve technical issues and drive corrective actions. 
Work cross-functionally with areas such as project management, system engineering, styling, purchasing, production and aftermarket. 
Follow up component quality and support the product after launch. 
Identify opportunities to improve products, processes and ways of working. 

 
Who You Are
You enjoy taking ownership and driving development forward. As a component owner, you are the central point of contact for your components bringing together colleagues across different functions and external suppliers. You enjoy being at the centre of communication, initiating discussions, aligning expectations and following up agreed actions.  
You are curious about technology and structured in your work. You build strong working relationships, actively seek the information you need and involve the right people to solve problems and move development forward. 
We also believe you have:
A university degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, mechatronics or mechanical engineering. 
Experience in product development; experience from the automotive industry is an advantage. 
An interest in vehicle technology and the development of components and systems. 
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and organisations. 
Strong written and spoken English. Swedish is an advantage. 

 Competence in automotive lighting is a merit. Relevant experience from practical projects or technical hobbies is also valued.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
 
This Is Us
We are a diverse and collaborative team of engineers passionate about developing the next generation of visibility and mechatronic systems for TRATON vehicles. We value teamwork, open communication and continuous learning, and we actively support each other in solving technical challenges.
Here, you will have the opportunity to contribute your ideas, grow your expertise and work with colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together.
 
Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.
 
TRATON Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Mattias Dalqvist, Unit Head, mattias.dahlqvist@scania.com
 
We look forward to your application!

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
An important and growing part of the role is to lead the development and coordination of Tetra Pak's contribution to food resilience and civil preparedness in Sweden, translating strategic priorities into an actionable roadmap together with relevant business owners.

Risk & Compliance Officer – Resilience & Security

AB Tetra Pak Site Management safeguards the licence to operate and creates the conditions for Tetra Pak’s businesses in Sweden at all sites to operate safely, sustainably, efficiently and resiliently by providing local governance, compliance, infrastructure and cross-company coordination, as well as managing and coordinating relationships with relevant external authorities within these areas.

This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden.
What you will do
You will work across regulatory compliance, preparedness and security, driving assignments from assessment to implementation and follow-up. Depending on business priorities and developments in the external environment, you will:

Independently monitor and assess regulatory developments, determine implications for Swedish operations together with legal and subject-matter experts, and recommend prioritised actions to management
Lead implementation of relevant security and preparedness requirements, translating them into clear responsibilities, plans and controls, and following up on progress and gaps

This work connects business perspectives with government, industry, academia and wider society, and helps shape Tetra Pak’s role, priorities and milestones within food resilience initiatives.

A relevant university degree at master's level, or equivalent, in law, engineering, risk management, security, crisis management, civil preparedness or a related field

Strong experience leading complex cross-functional assignments from assessment to implementation
The ability to interpret complex requirements, develop governance and controls, advise senior management and influence across functions without formal line authority
Experience in areas such as Protective Security, NIS2, CER, crisis management, civil defence, business continuity or critical infrastructure is highly valuable

Fluent Swedish and English, written and spoken

Who you are
The scope is deliberately broad. You do not need to be an expert in every regulation, but you must bring solid specialist expertise in relevant areas and the ability to independently assess unfamiliar issues, recognise the limits of your expertise and engage the right specialists. We expect you to combine analytical depth with the judgement and drive to deliver results in a complex stakeholder environment. 

You bring specialist depth in relevant areas, combined with the judgement to assess unfamiliar issues, involve the right experts and drive work forward in a complex stakeholder environment. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to connect people across organisational boundaries, and skilled at turning complex requirements into clear action.

You also communicate with credibility and clarity, whether engaging with specialists, senior management, authorities or external partners.
We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements
